local p = {} --p stands for package

function p.TableauCapacites( frame )
	local infos = frame.args
	local donnees = mw.loadData("Module:Test172/Data")
	--local homonymies = mw.loadData('Module:Data/Homonymies Capacités')
	if infos["type"] ~= nil then 
		local entete = "{| class=\"tableaustandard centre " .. string.lower(infos["type"]) .." sortable\"\n! width=\"40%\" | Nom\n! width=\"15%\" | Type\n! width=\"10%\" | Catégorie\n! width=\"10%\" | Puissance\n! width=\"10%\" | Précision\n! width=\"5%\" | PP\n|-\n"
		else local entete = "{| class=\"tableaustandard centre sortable\"\n! width=\"40%\" | Nom\n! width=\"15%\" | Type\n! width=\"10%\" | Catégorie\n! width=\"10%\" | Puissance\n! width=\"10%\" | Précision\n! width=\"5%\" | PP\n|-\n"
	end
	local contenu = {}
	local contenu_ligne = {"| [[" , "", "]] \n| {{type|", "", "}} \n| {{type|", "", "}} \n| ", "", "\n| ", "", "\n| ", "", "\n|-\n"}
	ligne = 1
    while infos[ligne] ~= nil 
    do
    	capacite = infos[ligne]
    	if capacite ~= nil then
    		if donnees[capacite] ~= nil then 
    			--if ressources.indexTableau(homonymies, capacite) then 
    				contenu_ligne[2] = capacite -- Nom
    				--else contenu_ligne[2] = capacite .. " (capacité)|" .. capacite
    			--end
    			contenu_ligne[4] = donnees[capacite][1] -- Type
    			contenu_ligne[6] = donnees[capacite][2] -- Catégorie
    			if donnees[capacite][3] == 0 then contenu_ligne[8] = "—"  -- Puissance
    				else contenu_ligne[8] = donnees[capacite][3]
    			end
    			if donnees[capacite][4] == 0 then contenu_ligne[10] = "—"  -- Précision
    				else contenu_ligne[10] = donnees[capacite][4]
    			end
    			contenu_ligne[12] = donnees[capacite][5] -- PP
    			table.insert(contenu,table.concat(contenu_ligne))
    		else error("Capacité " .. capacite .. " non reconnue")
    		end
		end
    	ligne = ligne+1
    end
    return entete .. table.concat(contenu) .. "|}"
end

return p

function covert_into_en_capslock_layout(layout) {
	var c,i;
	var capslock_layout=[];
	for(i=0; i<layout.length; ++i) {
		c=layout[i];
		if(c>64 && c<91) c+=32;

		capslock_layout.push(c);
	}
	return capslock_layout;
}

body:
{{TNT|Policy}} {{NoteTA|G1=IT|G2=MediaWiki}} 虽然在TestWiki上封禁很常见，但在执行或解除封禁时，仍有一些细节需要留意。 == 测试封禁 == 通常用于测试的封禁时间应较短。在您自己的账号上进行测试时，封禁时长没有任何限制。您只能对您直接控制的账号进行测试，或对[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Testing policy#Users you can test on|此处列出的测试账号]]
进行测试 '‘'禁止在其他用户的账号上测试封禁功能，此举可能导致用户权限被撤销。’'' == 特殊封禁 == 特殊情况下的封禁只能由Consul、行政员、CVT或监管员执行。若您认为某用户因特殊原因应被封禁，可以在[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Community portal|社区门户]]提出请求，或直接联系执政官。申请封禁时，必须提供符合其他TestWiki政策或Miraheze全球政策中所述的有效且严重的理由，否则可能会被视为骚扰。管理员或行政员若进行非测试性质的封禁，最高可能会被处以包括无限期TestWiki封禁在内的处罚。 == 申诉 == 因特殊原因实施的封禁可通过以下方式提出申诉： *被封禁用户可在其讨论页直接提出申诉， *被封禁用户可直接向实施封禁的执政官发送电子邮件。若封禁由行政员（Bureaucrat）执行，您可联系任何一位行政员进行首次申诉，后续申诉将由Consul审核。若封禁由CVT和/或监管员（Steward）执行，被封禁用户应按照封禁通知中提供的申诉指引进行申诉。 今后第三方的申诉将不予受理，并会立刻驳回。 在对封禁提出申诉时，请务必针对封禁的原因进行说明。但您应该避免攻击他人（例如负责封禁的管理员），或将您的封禁情况与其他被封禁用户的封禁情况进行比较。此类申诉无效，审查管理员将不予考虑。若反复滥用讨论页访问权限，可能会导致该权限在封禁期间被撤销。 == 解封 == 除非满足以下条件，否则请勿移除或修改特殊封禁： *您是consul或行政员。 *您是以官方身份行事的CVT/监管员。 *Miraheze信任与安全团队根据全球政策和/或《使用条款》以官方身份行事。 若您在未满足上述条件的情况下解除封禁或更改特殊封禁，您可能会受到处罚，最高可被无限期封禁TestWiki账号。 == 封禁通知 == 在实施封禁时，建议（但并非强制要求）封禁执行者在用户的讨论页上发布封禁通知，说明封禁原因、申诉步骤及/或其他限制措施。 == 酌情处理 == 若出现本政策未明确规定的情况，Consuls保留根据需要对上述政策进行善意解释的权利。 [[Category:Non-test pages]] [[Category:Policies{{#translation:}}]]

name: TestWiki:Testing policy/zh
body:
{{TNT|Policy}} 用户可以在此维基上做任何事，只要他们的行为不违反此方针。此测试政策是为了帮助指导社区明确禁止哪些行为而制定的。此政策是测试维基最少数的政策之一，因此请确保你没有违反此政策。 == 请求权限 == 用户可以以[[TestWiki:Request permissions]]自由请求任何可用于测试的权限，并将其用于测试目的。权限请求页面本身提供了可用权限列表。请求权限时，您可能需要提供您在其他项目中持有的其他帐户的信息，但这并不总是必需的。根据经验，我们的目标是授予每个用户他们请求的任何权限。 如果网络中的其他项目存在任何未解决的问题，您可能会在在获得测试权限之前被要求解决这些问题。 如果您已经拥有能够授予其他用户权限的测试权限，请随意授予自己额外的测试权限。请注意，您也可以自由授予其他用户测试权限，但前提是他们在wiki上提出了请求。但是，如果请求有争议，我们要求您将该请求留给项目经理。 == 封禁用户 ==
管理员经常在实时项目中进行阻止，因此我们自然可以在这里进行测试！然而，由于TestWiki本身是一个项目，这里也将有实际的块。这里的所有“真正的”管理区块将在区块摘要和用户对话页面中明确标注，以最大限度地减少混淆。我们要求测试阻止和解除阻止功能的用户忽略这些真正的阻止并避免解除阻止被阻止的用户。
== 用户可以测试的条件 == 我们已经创建了几个用户帐户供您测试。这些用户是： * [[User:Example]] * [[User:Example2]] * [[User:Example3]] * [[User:TestUser (BZPN)|TestUser]] 您可以随意阻止和解除阻止这些帐户，以及测试添加和删除权限。然而，在发生了一些涉及Example的事件后，这些帐户被锁定以防止恶意破坏。因此建议您[[Special:CreateAccount|创建其他账号]]，如果您需要一个单独的账号进行测试。 == 编辑与删除页面 ==
Edit and delete away! Just please don't delete important pages like this one or the user and user talk pages of other users. Also, please do not delete your own user talk page in an attempt to clear messages. It's best to simply blank the content. Pages that should not be deleted as a test are marked with the category [[:Category:Non-test pages|Non-test pages]].
== Non-test pages ==
Pages that should not be tested on are placed in the ''non-test'' category. As the name suggests, please don't test on these pages.
== Behavioral guidelines ==
As always, please treat other users with respect. Harassment and other forms of intimidation are not allowed and should be reported to a project manager.
== After testing ==
Please always '''[[TestWiki:Revert|revert]]''' your edits after testing and say ''test done''.
== Use common sense ==
Using common sense is important on any project, but even more so here. Due to the nature of this project, it's very important that you use common sense when carrying out your tests. If you have any questions regarding this policy or the project in general, feel free to post in the community portal or join us on IRC at #miraheze-testwiki on freenode.

== 用户可以测试的条件 == 我们已经创建了几个用户账户供您测试。这些用户是： * [[User:Example]] * [[User:Example2]] * [[User:Example3]] * [[User:TestUser (BZPN)|TestUser]] 您可以随意封禁和解封这些账户，以及测试添加和删除权限。然而，在发生了一些涉及Example的事件后，这些账户被锁定以防止恶意破坏。因此建议您[[Special:CreateAccount|创建其他账号]]，如果您需要一个单独的账号进行测试。 == 编辑与删除页面 == 请随意编辑和删除内容吧！ 但请不要删除本页这类重要页面，也不可删除其他用户的用户页及用户讨论页。 同时，切勿为清空留言而删除自身的用户讨论页，直接清空页面内容即可。 标注分类为[[:Category:Non-test pages|非测试页面]]的页面，禁止用作测试删除对象。 == 非测试页面 ==
Pages that should not be tested on are placed in the ''non-test'' category. As the name suggests, please don't test on these pages.
== Behavioral guidelines ==
As always, please treat other users with respect. Harassment and other forms of intimidation are not allowed and should be reported to a project manager.
== After testing ==
Please always '''[[TestWiki:Revert|revert]]''' your edits after testing and say ''test done''.
== Use common sense ==
Using common sense is important on any project, but even more so here. Due to the nature of this project, it's very important that you use common sense when carrying out your tests. If you have any questions regarding this policy or the project in general, feel free to post in the community portal or join us on IRC at #miraheze-testwiki on freenode.

group_order end local function applyAggregation(group_rows, agg_specs, new_row) local format_specs = {} for _, spec in ipairs(agg_specs) do if spec.func == 'FORMAT' then table.insert(format_specs, spec) elseif spec.func == 'COUNT' then new_row[spec.output_col] = aggCount(group_rows, spec.args[1]) elseif spec.func == 'TABLE' then new_row[spec.output_col] = aggTable(group_rows, spec.args[1]) elseif spec.func == 'MIN' then new_row[spec.output_col] = aggMin(group_rows, spec.args[1]) elseif spec.func == 'MAX' then new_row[spec.output_col] = aggMax(group_rows, spec.args[1]) elseif spec.func == 'ANY' then new_row[spec.output_col] = aggAny(group_rows, spec.args[1]) end end return format_specs end local function applyFormatSpec(new_row, spec, fmt_template) local array_len = nil for _, arg_col in ipairs(spec.args) do if type(new_row[arg_col]) == 'table' then array_len = #new_row[arg_col] break end end if array_len then local results = {} for i = 1, array_len do local result_str = fmt_template for _, arg_col in ipairs(spec.args) do local val = new_row[arg_col] local sv if type(val) == 'table' then sv = tostring(val[i] ~= nil and val[i] or '') elseif val == nil then sv = '' else sv = tostring(val) end result_str = result_str:gsub('%%' .. arg_col .. '%%', function() return sv end) end table.insert(results, result_str) end new_row[spec.output_col] = results else local result_str = fmt_template for _, arg_col in ipairs(spec.args) do local val = new_row[arg_col] result_str = result_str:gsub('%%' .. arg_col .. '%%', function() return val == nil and '' or tostring(val) end) end new_row[spec.output_col] = result_str end end local function groupResults(results, group_by_cols, agg_specs, columns, group_sort, args) if #group_by_cols == 0 then return results end local group_by_set = {} for _, col in ipairs(group_by_cols) do group_by_set[col] = true end local covered = {} for _, spec in ipairs(agg_specs) do covered[spec.output_col] = true end local groups, group_order = buildGroups(results, group_by_cols) local grouped_results = {} for _, key in ipairs(group_order) do local group_rows = groups[key] if group_sort then sortResults(group_rows, group_sort) end local new_row = {} for _, col in ipairs(group_by_cols) do new_row[col] = group_rows[1][col] end local format_specs = applyAggregation(group_rows, agg_specs, new_row) for _, col_info in ipairs(columns) do local col_name = col_info.alias if not group_by_set[col_name] and not covered[col_name] then new_row[col_name] = aggAny(group_rows, col_name) end end for _, spec in ipairs(format_specs) do local fmt_template = args[spec.output_col .. '-agg'] if fmt_template then applyFormatSpec(new_row, spec, unescape(fmt_template)) end end table.insert(grouped_results, new_row) end return grouped_results end local T = { PARENTHESIS_L = 1, PARENTHESIS_R = 2, AND = 3, OR = 4, NOT = 5, COMP = 7, STR = 8, NUM = 9, BOOL = 10, ID = 11, EOF = 12 } local KW = { ['AND'] = T.AND, ['OR'] = T.OR, ['NOT'] = T.NOT, ['true'] = T.BOOL, ['false'] = T.BOOL } local FILTER_OPS = { CONTAINS = true, ICONTAINS = true, MATCH = true } local function parseJoins(join_str) local joins = {} for join_part in join_str:gmatch("[^,]+") do local join = {} local parts = {} for part in join_part:gmatch("[^=]+") do table.insert(parts, mw.text.trim(part)) end if #parts == 2 then join.left = parts[1] join.right = parts[2] table.insert(joins, join) end end return joins end local function tokenize(s) local t, i = {}, 1 while i <= #s do local c = s:sub(i, i) if c:match('%s') then i = i + 1 elseif c == '(' then table.insert(t, { type = T.PARENTHESIS_L }); i = i + 1 elseif c == ')' then table.insert(t, { type = T.PARENTHESIS_R }); i = i + 1 elseif c:match('%d') or c == '.' then local n = s:match('^%-?%d*%.?%d+', i) table.insert(t, { type = T.NUM, val = tonumber(n) }) i = i + #n elseif c:match("[%w_]") then local w = s:match('^[%w_.]+', i) table.insert(t, { type = KW[w:upper()] or KW[w] or T.ID, val = w }) i = i + #w elseif c:match('["\']') then local q, str = c, '' for j = i + 1, #s do local ch = s:sub(j, j) if ch == q then table.insert(t, { type = T.STR, val = str }); i = j + 1; break end str = str .. ch end elseif c:match('%d') or c == '.' then local n = s:match('^%-?%d*%.?%d+', i) table.insert(t, { type = T.NUM, val = tonumber(n) }) i = i + #n elseif c:match('[=<>!]') then local op = s:match('[=<>!]+', i) if not op then error("Invalid operator at position " .. i) end table.insert(t, { type = T.COMP, val = op }) i = i + #op else error("Unexpected character '" .. c .. "' at position " .. i) end end return t end -- Break out of the dependency loop local parsePrimary local function parseNotExpr(toks, pos) if toks[pos] and toks[pos].type == T.NOT then local node, new_pos = parseNotExpr(toks, pos + 1) return { type = 'not', operand = node }, new_pos else return parsePrimary(toks, pos) end end local function parseAndExpr(toks, pos) local left, new_pos = parseNotExpr(toks, pos) while new_pos <= #toks and toks[new_pos].type == T.AND do local right, next_pos = parseNotExpr(toks, new_pos + 1) left = { type = 'and', left = left, right = right } new_pos = next_pos end return left, new_pos end local function parseExpression(toks, pos) local left, new_pos = parseAndExpr(toks, pos) while new_pos <= #toks and toks[new_pos].type == T.OR do local right, next_pos = parseAndExpr(toks, new_pos + 1) left = { type = 'or', left = left, right = right } new_pos = next_pos end return left, new_pos end parsePrimary = function(toks, pos) if toks[pos].type == T.PARENTHESIS_L then local node, new_pos = parseExpression(toks, pos + 1) if toks[new_pos].type ~= T.PARENTHESIS_R then error("Expected ')' at position " .. new_pos) end return node, new_pos + 1 elseif toks[pos].type == T.ID then local op_tok = toks[pos + 1] if op_tok and op_tok.type == T.ID and FILTER_OPS[op_tok.val:upper()] then local v = toks[pos + 2] if not v or (v.type ~= T.STR and v.type ~= T.NUM and v.type ~= T.BOOL and v.type ~= T.ID) then error("Expected value after filter operator at position " .. (pos + 2)) end local value = (v.type == T.NUM) and v.val or tostring(v.val) return { type = 'filter_op', field = toks[pos].val, op = op_tok.val:upper(), value = value }, pos + 3 elseif op_tok and op_tok.type == T.COMP then local v = toks[pos + 2] if v.type ~= T.STR and v.type ~= T.NUM and v.type ~= T.BOOL then error("Expected value after comparison operator at position " .. (pos + 2)) end return { type = 'comparison', field = toks[pos].val, op = op_tok.val, value = v.val }, pos + 3 else error("Expected comparison or filter operator after identifier at position " .. (pos + 1)) end else error("Unexpected token at position " .. pos .. ", expected identifier or '('") end end local function parseCond(toks, pos) local node, new_pos = parseExpression(toks, pos) return node, new_pos end local function toBucket(n) if n.type == 'and' then return Bucket.And(toBucket(n.left), toBucket(n.right)) elseif n.type == 'or' then return Bucket.Or(toBucket(n.left), toBucket(n.right)) elseif n.type == 'not' then return Bucket.Not(toBucket(n.operand)) elseif n.type == 'comparison' then return { n.field, n.op, n.value } end end local FILTER_FUNCS = { CONTAINS = function(v, s) return type(v) == 'string' and mw.ustring.find(v, s, 1, true) ~= nil end, ICONTAINS = function(v, s) return type(v) == 'string' and mw.ustring.find(mw.ustring.lower(v), mw.ustring.lower(s), 1, true) ~= nil end, MATCH = function(v, s) return type(v) == 'string' and mw.ustring.match(v, s) ~= nil end, } local COMP_FUNCS = { ['='] = function(a, b) return a == b end, ['!='] = function(a, b) return a ~= b end, ['<'] = function(a, b) return compareValues(a, b) == -1 end, ['>'] = function(a, b) return compareValues(a, b) == 1 end, ['<='] = function(a, b) return compareValues(a, b) <= 0 end, ['>='] = function(a, b) return compareValues(a, b) >= 0 end, } local function evalFilter(node, row) if node.type == 'and' then return evalFilter(node.left, row) and evalFilter(node.right, row) elseif node.type == 'or' then return evalFilter(node.left, row) or evalFilter(node.right, row) elseif node.type == 'not' then return not evalFilter(node.operand, row) elseif node.type == 'filter_op' then local fn = FILTER_FUNCS[node.op] if not fn then error('Unknown filter op: ' .. node.op) end return fn(row[node.field], node.value) elseif node.type == 'comparison' then local fn = COMP_FUNCS[node.op] if not fn then error('Unknown comparison op: ' .. node.op) end return fn(row[node.field], node.value) end end local function applyFilter(results, ast) local filtered = {} for _, row in ipairs(results) do if evalFilter(ast, row) then table.insert(filtered, row) end end return filtered end local function runQuery(columns, args) local bucket_name = mw.text.trim(args[1] or args['bucket'] or '') if bucket_name == '' then error('Must specify the name of the bucket') end for _, col in ipairs(columns) do col.label = args[col.alias .. '-label'] or col.alias end local all_originals = {} for _, col in ipairs(columns) do all_originals[col.column] = true end local alias_to_column = {} for _, col in ipairs(columns) do if col.alias ~= col.column and not all_originals[col.alias] then alias_to_column[col.alias] = col.column end end local column_names = {} for _, col in ipairs(columns) do table.insert(column_names, col.column) end local query = mw.bucket(bucket_name).select(unpack(column_names)) local join_str = args['join on'] or args['join'] if join_str then local joins = parseJoins(join_str) for _, join in ipairs(joins) do join.left = alias_to_column[join.left] or join.left join.right = alias_to_column[join.right] or join.right local right_table = join.right:match("^[^.]+") or join.right query = query.join(right_table, join.left, join.right) end end local where_str = args['where'] if where_str then local toks = tokenize(where_str) local ast = parseCond(toks, 1) translateAliases(ast, alias_to_column) query = query.where(toBucket(ast)) end local limit = tonumber(args['limit']) if limit ~= nil then query = query.limit(limit) end local offset = tonumber(args['offset']) if offset ~= nil then query = query.offset(offset) end return query:run() end function p.get(frame) local args = getArgs(frame) local columns_str = args['select'] or args['fields'] if not columns_str then error("Must specify which columns to select.") end local columns = parseColumns(columns_str) local results = runQuery(columns, args) -- mw.logObject(results) renameColumns(results, columns) local filter_str = args['filter'] if filter_str then local toks = tokenize(filter_str) local ast = parseCond(toks, 1) results = applyFilter(results, ast) end if #results == 0 then return args['default'] or "No result" end local group_by_str = args['group by'] if group_by_str then local group_by_cols = parseGroupBy(group_by_str) local agg_specs = parseAggregateArg(args['aggregate'] or '', columns) for _, spec in ipairs(agg_specs) do if spec.is_new_col then table.insert( columns, { column = spec.output_col, alias = spec.output_col, label = args[spec.output_col .. '-label'] or spec.output_col } ) end end local group_sort = parseOrderBy(args['group-sort'] or '') results = groupResults(results, group_by_cols, agg_specs, columns, group_sort, args) end applySplitColumns(results, columns, args) local order_by_str = args['order by'] if order_by_str then local order_by_rules = parseOrderBy(order_by_str) sortResults(results, order_by_rules) end -- FIXME: this inserts markup that may need to be preprocessed, but for performance reasons -- we don't want to preprocess them row-by-row. applyValueFormats(results, columns, args, frame) local format = args['format'] or "table" local intro = args['intro'] or "" local outro = args['outro'] or "" local text = "" if format == "table" then text = formatTable(frame, results, columns, args) elseif format == "template" then text = formatTemplate(frame, results, columns, args) elseif format == "userformat" then text = formatUserformat(frame, results, columns, args) else error(string.format("Invalid format %s specified.", format)) end return intro .. text .. outro end -- Exports for testing p.sortResults = sortResults p.aggCount = aggCount p.aggTable = aggTable p.groupResults = groupResults p.parseAggregateArg = parseAggregateArg p.T = T p.tokenize = tokenize p.parseCond = parseCond p.applyFilter = applyFilter p.renameColumns = renameColumns p.applySplitColumns = applySplitColumns p.translateAliases = translateAliases return p

local p = {} local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs local yesno = require('Module:Yesno') local lang = mw.language.getContentLanguage() local O_TYPE = "type" local O_DELIM = "delimiter" local O_REQUIRED = "required" local OPTIONS = { O_TYPE, O_DELIM, O_REQUIRED } local O_ALIASES = { delim = 'delimiter', notnull = 'required', } local C_TARGS = "templateargs" local C_SUB = "sub" local C_NOSAVE = "nosave" local C_LOG = "log" local CONF_VALS = { C_TARGS, C_SUB, C_NOSAVE, C_LOG } ---Is `value` one of the `targets`? ---@param value string Type you want to check is in list. ---@param targets string[] List of targets that `value` could be. ---@return boolean local function oneof(value, targets) for _, target in ipairs(targets) do if value == target then return true end end return false end ---Parse a single value based on type name ---@param t string Type name ---@param v string Value to parse ---@return boolean success Did parsing succeed? ---@return any value Parsed value if success, string if fail. function p.parse_typed_value(t, v) -- probably should return an object instead if oneof(t, { "text" }) then -- possible TODO with page return true, v end if oneof(t, { "int", "integer" }) then local val = tonumber(v) if val ~= nil and val % 1 == 0 then return true, val else return false, "integer" end end if oneof(t, { "float", "double", "num", "number" }) then local val = tonumber(v) if val ~= nil then return true, val else return false, "number" end end if oneof(t, { "bool", "boolean", "yesno" }) then local val = yesno(v) if val ~= nil then return true, val else return false, "boolean" end end if oneof(t, { "date", "time", "datetime", "timestamp" }) then local s, r = pcall(lang.formatDate, lang, "c", v) if s then return s, r else return false, "timestamp" end end if oneof(t, { "unixtime" }) then local s, r = pcall(lang.formatDate, lang, "U", v) if s then r = tonumber(r) or error("Could not convert " .. r .. " to a number") return s, r else return false, "Unix timestamp" end end error("Unsupported type: " .. mw.dumpObject(t)) end ---Recursively and safely add items of `keylist` to `args`. --- ---`add_to_args({}, { "a", "b", "c" }, "d")` ---will yield ---`{ a = { b = { c = "d" } } }` ---@param args table ---@param keylist (string | number)[] ---@param value any local function add_to_args(args, keylist, value) local nextvalue = args for i, valuename in ipairs(keylist) do if i == #keylist then nextvalue[valuename] = value else nextvalue[valuename] = nextvalue[valuename] or {} nextvalue = nextvalue[valuename] end end end ---Parse specific key-value combination and modify output table. ---@param out_args table ---@param out_config table ---@param key string ---@param value string ---@return nil function p.parse_args(out_args, out_config, key, value) if type(key) ~= "string" then return end value = mw.text.trim(value) if value == '' then return end -- basic conditions for parser working local optkey, optname = key:match("^([%w_]+)%-(.+)$") -- [%w_] matches all valid bucket field names at time of writing -- (non-exhaustively, i.e. all valid names are matched by [%w_], but [%w_] -- also matches some invalid names) if optkey and optname then if O_ALIASES[optname] then optname = O_ALIASES[optname] end if not oneof(optname, OPTIONS) then local fmt = "Invalid option %s for parameter %s" error(fmt:format(optname, optkey)) end return add_to_args(out_args, { optkey, optname }, value) end local ckey = key:match("^%+(.+)$") if ckey then if not oneof(ckey, CONF_VALS) then error(ckey .. " not a recognised config option") end out_config[ckey] = value -- modify out_config rather than out_args return end return add_to_args(out_args, { key, 1 }, value) -- none of the above apply so treat as raw arg end ---Turn parsed argument object to single value to send to `mw.bucket.put`. ---@param argname string ---@param data table ---@return any function p.get_bucket_arg(argname, data) local item = data[1] if not item then if not yesno(data[O_REQUIRED]) then return end error(("Required argument %s was not given"):format(argname)) end item = mw.text.trim(item) local type = data[O_TYPE] or "text" if not data[O_DELIM] then local success, value_or_typename = p.parse_typed_value(type, item) if success then return value_or_typename -- value else local fmt = "Invalid %s given for parameter %s: %s" error(fmt:format(value_or_typename, mw.dumpObject(argname), mw.dumpObject(item))) -- typename end end local delim = data[O_DELIM] delim = delim:gsub('%f[\\]\\n', '\n') delim = delim:gsub('\\\\n', '\\n') --[[ removes a backslash from start, so: \n -> newline \\n -> \n \\\n -> \\n etc. ]] local items = {} for entry in mw.text.gsplit(item, delim) do entry = mw.text.trim(entry) if entry ~= "" then local success, value_or_typename = p.parse_typed_value(type, entry) if success then table.insert(items, value_or_typename) -- value else local fmt = "Invalid %s given for parameter %s: %s" error(fmt:format(value_or_typename, mw.dumpObject(argname), mw.dumpObject(entry))) -- typename end end end return items end ---Turn list of parsed arguments into `mw.bucket.put` arg table. ---@param out_args table ---@return table function p.get_bucket_args(out_args) local bucket_args = {} for arg, data in pairs(out_args) do bucket_args[arg] = p.get_bucket_arg(arg, data) end return bucket_args end ---Main invokable function. ---@param frame any function p.put(frame) local args = getArgs(frame, { frameOnly = true }) local parent_args = getArgs(frame, { parentOnly = true }) local bucket_name = mw.text.trim(args[1] or '') -- Replicate the behavior of $wgCargoStoreUseTemplateArgsFallback for specified arguments local implicit_store_args = mw.text.trim(args['+' .. C_TARGS] or '') for arg in implicit_store_args:gmatch("[^,]+") do arg = mw.text.trim(arg) args[arg] = parent_args[arg] end -- Convert all arguments to consistent format local out_args = {} local out_config = {} for k, v in pairs(args) do p.parse_args(out_args, out_config, k, v) end local bucket_args = p.get_bucket_args(out_args) if yesno(out_config[C_LOG]) then mw.log("Passed args: " .. mw.dumpObject(args)) mw.log("out_args: " .. mw.dumpObject(out_args)) mw.log("out_config: " .. mw.dumpObject(out_config)) mw.log("bucket_args: " .. mw.dumpObject(bucket_args)) end -- put changes to bucket if not yesno(out_config[C_NOSAVE]) then local bucket = mw.bucket(bucket_name) if out_config[C_SUB] then bucket.sub(out_config[C_SUB]) end bucket.put(bucket_args) end end return p --[[ p.put({ "character", name = "Buck", ["name-required"] = "true", hp = "1000", ["hp-type"] = "int", attack = "50", ["attack-type"] = "int", type = "\nGreen;\n;\nBlue;\n", ["type-delim"] = ";\\n", rarity = "well-done", is_obtainable = "yes", ["is_obtainable-type"] = "bool", ["+sub"] = "random", ["+nosave"] = "true", ["+log"] = "true", }) Should have:

'''Taiki Shuttle''' (タイキシャトル, 23 Maret 1994 – 17 Agustus 2022) adalah kuda pacu ras unggul yang dibiakkan di Amerika dan dilatih di Jepang. Ia memenangkan perlombaan di level tertinggi baik di dalam maupun luar negeri, terutama memenangkan Mile Championship (dua kali), Yasuda Kinen, dan Sprinters Stakes di Jepang serta Prix Jacques Le Marois di Prancis.

Taiki Shuttle mendapat kehormatan sebagai Champion Sprinter Japan Racing Association (JRA) pada tahun 1997 dan 1998, dan dinobatkan sebagai Japan Horse of the Year pada tahun 1998, bersama dengan Champion Older Male Horse. Pada tahun 1999, ia dilantik ke dalam Hall of Fame JRA.[1]

Taiki Shuttle meninggal dunia karena usia lanjut pada tanggal 17 Agustus 2022. Ia mengalami serangan jantung saat sedang tidur.

'''Taiki Shuttle''' (タイキシャトル, 23 Maret 1994 – 17 Agustus 2022) adalah kuda pacu ras unggul yang dibiakkan di Amerika dan dilatih di Jepang. Ia memenangkan perlombaan di level tertinggi baik di dalam maupun luar negeri, terutama memenangkan Mile Championship (dua kali), Yasuda Kinen, dan Sprinters Stakes di Jepang serta Prix Jacques Le Marois di Prancis.

Taiki Shuttle mendapat kehormatan sebagai Champion Sprinter Japan Racing Association (JRA) pada tahun 1997 dan 1998, dan dinobatkan sebagai Japan Horse of the Year pada tahun 1998, bersama dengan Champion Older Male Horse. Pada tahun 1999, ia dilantik ke dalam Hall of Fame JRA.[1]

Taiki Shuttle meninggal dunia karena usia lanjut pada tanggal 17 Agustus 2022. Ia mengalami serangan jantung saat sedang tidur.

== About Me ==
Hello! I am SewingSole31016, a user on this test wiki. My native language is Chinese, and I have achieved native-level proficiency in both English and Russian. I enjoy contributing to wikis, translating content, and collaborating with the community.

== Language Skills ==
{{#babel:zh-N|en-2|zh-hant-5 }}

== Contact Information ==
* '''QQ''': 1365475603 – This is my primary contact method for quick communication. Please note that I do not publicly list my email address to maintain privacy.
* You can also leave a message on my [[User talk:SewingSole31016|talk page]] for discussions related to wiki edits.

== Wiki Contributions ==
I am an active contributor on this test wiki, focusing on:
* Improving and expanding articles with accurate information.
* Translating content between Chinese, English, and Russian to make knowledge accessible.
* Participating in project discussions and providing feedback.
* Helping new users with wiki editing and guidelines.

== Interests and Expertise ==
* **Technology**: Software development, open-source projects, and media platforms.
* **Languages**: Linguistics, language learning, and cross-cultural communication.
* **Editing**: Experienced with MediaWiki, Wikitext markup, templates, and categorisation.
* **Community**: Engaging in wiki governance and collaborative editing.

== Tools and Skills ==
* Proficient in using MediaWiki editing tools, including advanced markup and templates.
* Familiar with wiki project management and quality control processes.
* Skilled in multilingual content creation and proofreading.

== Additional Notes ==
This user page is for the test wiki environment. I believe in open knowledge sharing and respectful collaboration. If you need assistance with translations or edits, feel free to reach out via QQ or my talk page. Let's work together to improve this wiki!

name: Character analysis and learning templates: Uebu Saito
body:
For my Term two project, I will be focusing on the technical side of MediaWiki, alongside the personal aspect of researching and analysing a character that I hold dear to me. If you do not know, I own the Uebu Saito Wiki, a place where I document and analyse the character Uebu Saito from Life Lessons with Uramichi Oniisan.

== Using templates in a wiki ==
Templates are a neccessity for an effective wiki, as they can display general information, simplified answers, and banners in your articles. Almost every MediaWiki article uses a template of some sort, and there are many that you can fork from. My goal for this term is to learn how I can format these templates to suit my own wiki, and possibly, how to make them myself. With a lot of the templates I see, they usually do not translate well onto my wiki, and can be off my a few pixels. I want my articles to be clean.

A few of the templates that I use already are notice banners, infoboxes, and image galleries. Since my wiki is still relatively new, I like to mention that on some pages, I haven't added enough information or even started on it.

name: Module:Sandbox/逆襲的天邪鬼/meow
body:
local p = {}

-- 辅助函数：将二进制字符串转为字符
local function binaryToChar(binStr)
    if #binStr == 0 then return "" end
    local code = tonumber(binStr, 2)
    return code and mw.ustring.char(code) or ""
end

function p.decrypt(frame)
    local text = frame.args[1] or ""
    local output = ""
    
    -- 我们使用 mw.ustring 进行处理以支持 Unicode
    local i = 1
    local len = mw.ustring.len(text)
    
    while i <= len do
        local char = mw.ustring.sub(text, i, i)
        
        if char == '喵' then
            -- 找到包裹的开始，提取中间内容
            local binaryStr = ""
            local j = i + 1
            
            while j <= len do
                local subChar = mw.ustring.sub(text, j, j)
                local codepoint = mw.ustring.codepoint(subChar)
                
                -- U+200B (8203) -> 1, U+200D (8205) -> 0
                if codepoint == 8203 then
                    binaryStr = binaryStr .. '1'
                    j = j + 1
                elseif codepoint == 8205 then
                    binaryStr = binaryStr .. '0'
                    j = j + 1
                else
                    -- 遇到下一个“喵”或结束
                    break
                end
            end
            
            -- 如果提取到了二进制，还原并添加
            if #binaryStr > 0 then
                output = output .. binaryToChar(binaryStr)
            end
            
            -- 跳过已处理部分
            i = j
        else
            -- 不是喵，原样保留
            output = output .. char
            i = i + 1
        end
    end
    
    return output
end

return p

-------------------------------------------------- -- -- 😈 维 基 百 科 破 坏 合 集 😈 -- -------------------------------------------------- local func = {} -------------------------------------------------- -- eatuserbox -------------------------------------------------- function func.eatuserbox(frame) local text = frame.args[1] or '' local output = text output = string.gsub(output, '(
]*class="[^"]*wikipediauserbox[^"]*"[^>]*style=")([^"]*)"', '%1visibility:hidden;%2"') output = string.gsub(output, '(
]*style=")([^"]*)("[^>]*class="[^"]*wikipediauserbox[^"]*")', '%1visibility:hidden;%2%3') output = string.gsub(output, '(
]*)>', function(classPart, otherPart) if not string.find(otherPart, 'style=') then return classPart .. ' style="visibility:hidden;"' .. otherPart .. '>' end return nil end) output = string.gsub(output, '(
%s*{%|%s*cellspacing="0")', '%1;visibility:hidden;%2') -- 專殺{{現在}} output = string.gsub(output, '(
)', '%1;visibility:hidden;%2') -- Hat600的另一个用户框User RDT output = string.gsub(output, '({|[^|]-width:240px;height:47px;background:#C5FCDC !important)', '%1;visibility:hidden;') -- 將「坐等刪除」換成已被刪光 if (not frame.args['notaunt']) or (mw.text.trim(frame.args['notaunt']) == '') then local pattern = '這個用戶正坐等.-刪除用戶框.-' local x, y = string.find(output, pattern) if x then local prefix = string.sub(output, 1, x-1) local suffix = string.sub(output, x) prefix = string.gsub(prefix, '(.*)visibility:hidden;', '%1visibility:visible;') suffix = string.gsub(suffix, pattern, '這個用戶的用戶框全都被人刪光啦！', 1) output = prefix .. suffix end end if (not frame.args['nocat']) or (mw.text.trim(frame.args['nocat']) == '') then output = output .. '[[Category:用戶框被刪光了的維基人]]' end return output end local function rfind(s, pattern, init) local x, y local len = #s local i = init or len x, y = string.find(string.reverse(s), string.reverse(pattern), len-i+1, true) if x then return len-y+1, len-x+1 end end -------------------------------------------------- -- countstars -------------------------------------------------- function func.countstars(frame) local text = frame.args[1] or '' local pattern = frame.args[2] or '%*' local count = 0 for _ in string.gmatch(text, pattern) do count = count + 1 end return count end -------------------------------------------------- -- raw / nowiki / nowiki2 -------------------------------------------------- function func.raw(frame) local content = frame.args[1] or "" local escaped = mw.text.nowiki(content) return "
" .. escaped .. "
" end function func.nowiki(frame) local text = frame.args[1] or '' return mw.text.nowiki(text) end function func.nowiki2(frame) local text = mw.title.new(frame.args[1]):getContent() return mw.text.nowiki(text) end -------------------------------------------------- -- strrev -------------------------------------------------- function func.strrev(frame) local text = frame.args[1] or '' return string.reverse(text) end function func.strreplace(frame) local text = frame.args[1] or '' local i=2 local from, to while frame.args[i] do from = frame.args[i] to = frame.args[i+1] or '' text = string.gsub(text, from, to) i=i+2 end return text end -------------------------------------------------- -- eatlinks -------------------------------------------------- function func.eatlinks(frame) local text = frame.args[1] or '' text = (string.gsub(text, '%[%[([^\n]-)%]%]', function(x) if islinkeatable(x) then local target = string.gsub(x, '^(.-)%|.-$', '%1') local text = string.gsub(x, '^.-%|(.-)$', '%1') if string.find(target, ':') == 1 then if text == target then text = string.sub(text, 2) end return '' .. text .. '' else if (not mw.title.new(target):getContent()) and (not frame.args['nored']) then return '' .. text .. '' else return '' .. text .. '' end end else return '[[' .. x .. ']]' end end)) text = (string.gsub(text, '%[https?://[^\n]- ([^\n]-)%]', function(x) return '' .. x .. '' end)) return text end function func.eatlinks2(frame) local text = frame.args[1] or '' local badtarget = frame.args['target'] or 'Special:Logout' text = (string.gsub(text, '%[%[([^\n]-)%]%]', function(x) if islinkeatable(x) then local target = string.gsub(x, '^(.-)%|.-$', '%1') local text = string.gsub(x, '^.-%|(.-)$', '%1') if string.find(target, ':') == 1 then if text == target then text = string.sub(text, 2) end return '[[' .. badtarget .. '|' .. text .. ']]' else if (not mw.title.new(target):getContent()) and (not frame.args['nored']) then return '[[' .. badtarget .. '|' .. text .. ']]' else return '[[' .. badtarget .. '|' .. text .. ']]' end end else return '[[' .. x .. ']]' end end)) text = (string.gsub(text, '%[https?://[^\n]- ([^\n]-)%]', function(x) return '[[' .. badtarget .. '|' .. x .. ']]' end)) return text end local function islinkeatable(text) local test = string.lower(text) return not (string.find(test, 'category:') == 1 or string.find(test, '分类:') == 1 or string.find(test, '分類:') == 1 or string.find(test, 'file:') == 1 or string.find(test, '文件:') == 1 or string.find(test, '檔案:') == 1 or string.find(test, 'en:') == 1 or string.find(test, 'ja:') == 1) end return func

== Tests ==

* EditorAPIs[ResourceLoader|dependencies=mediawiki.util|hidden]|EditorAPIs.js

name: Module:KudaPut
body:
local p = {}

local function split(str, sep)
    local result = {}
    local pattern = "([^" .. sep .. "]*)" .. sep .. "?"
    for match in str:gmatch(pattern) do
        table.insert(result, match)
    end
    return result
end

local function nilIfEmpty(s)
    s = s and s:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    return (s ~= "") and s or nil
end

local function display(s)
    return nilIfEmpty(s) or ""
end

function p.main(frame)
    local args   = frame.args
    local list   = args.list or ""
    local rows   = {}

    for line in list:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        line = line:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")

        if line ~= "" then
            local col = split(line .. ";", ";")

            -- Simpan ke bucket
            bucket("Kudadb").put({
                race       = nilIfEmpty(args.race),
                class      = nilIfEmpty(args.class),
                distance   = nilIfEmpty(args.distance),
                entry      = nilIfEmpty(args.entry),
                fp         = nilIfEmpty(col[1]),
                hn         = nilIfEmpty(col[2]),
                start      = nilIfEmpty(col[3]),
                horse      = nilIfEmpty(col[4]),
                contingent = nilIfEmpty(col[5]),
                weight     = nilIfEmpty(col[6]),
                jockey     = nilIfEmpty(col[7]),
                trainer    = nilIfEmpty(col[8]),
                breeder    = nilIfEmpty(col[9]),
                owner      = nilIfEmpty(col[10]),
            })

            -- Buat baris tabel
            local row = table.concat({
                "|-",
                "| " .. display(col[1]),
                "| " .. display(col[2]),
                "| " .. display(col[3]),
                "| " .. display(col[4]),
                "| " .. display(col[5]),
                "| " .. display(col[6]),
                "| " .. display(col[7]),
                "| " .. display(col[8]),
                "| " .. display(col[9]),
                "| " .. display(col[10]),
            }, "\n")

            table.insert(rows, row)
        end
    end

    return table.concat(rows, "\n")
end

return p

name: Module:KudaPut
body:
local p = {}

local function split(str, sep)
    local result = {}
    local pattern = "([^" .. sep .. "]*)" .. sep .. "?"
    for match in str:gmatch(pattern) do
        table.insert(result, match)
    end
    return result
end

local function nilIfEmpty(s)
    s = s and s:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    return (s ~= "") and s or nil
end

local function display(s)
    return nilIfEmpty(s) or ""
end

function p.main(frame)
    local args   = frame.args
    local list   = args.list or ""
    local rows   = {}

    for line in list:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        line = line:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")

        if line ~= "" then
            local col = split(line .. ";", ";")

            -- Simpan ke bucket
            bucket("Kudadb").put({
                race       = nilIfEmpty(args.race),
                class      = nilIfEmpty(args.class),
                distance   = nilIfEmpty(args.distance),
                entry      = nilIfEmpty(args.entry),
                date       = nilIfEmpty(args.date),
                racecourse = nilIfEmpty(args.racecourse),
                fp         = nilIfEmpty(col[1]),
                hn         = nilIfEmpty(col[2]),
                start      = nilIfEmpty(col[3]),
                horse      = nilIfEmpty(col[4]),
                contingent = nilIfEmpty(col[5]),
                weight     = nilIfEmpty(col[6]),
                jockey     = nilIfEmpty(col[7]),
                trainer    = nilIfEmpty(col[8]),
                breeder    = nilIfEmpty(col[9]),
                owner      = nilIfEmpty(col[10]),
                time       = nilIfEmpty(col[11]),
            })

            -- Buat baris tabel
            local row = table.concat({
                "|-",
                "| " .. display(col[1]),
                "| " .. display(col[2]),
                "| " .. display(col[3]),
                "| " .. display(col[4]),
                "| " .. display(col[5]),
                "| " .. display(col[6]),
                "| " .. display(col[7]),
                "| " .. display(col[8]),
                "| " .. display(col[9]),
                "| " .. display(col[10]),
                "| " .. display(col[11]),
            }, "\n")

            table.insert(rows, row)
        end
    end

    return table.concat(rows, "\n")
end

return p

body:
local p = {}

function p.winnerRunnerup(frame)
    local args         = frame.args
    local race         = args.race
    local date         = args.date
    local racecourse   = args.racecourse
    local currentFp    = tonumber(args.currentFp)

    local results = bucket("kudadb")
        .select("horse", "fp", "race", "date", "racecourse")
        .where({"race", race})
        .orderBy("fp", "asc")
        .run()

    local winner   = nil
    local runnerup = nil

    for _, row in ipairs(results) do
        local matchDate       = (date == nil or date == "" or row.date == date)
        local matchRacecourse = (racecourse == nil or racecourse == "" or row.racecourse == racecourse)

        if matchDate and matchRacecourse then
            local fp = tonumber(row.fp)
            if fp == 1 then
                winner = row.horse
            elseif fp == 2 then
                runnerup = row.horse
            end
        end
    end

    if currentFp == 1 then
        return runnerup and ("(" .. runnerup .. ")") or "-"
    else
        return winner or "-"
    end
end

function p.history(frame)
    local pageName = mw.title.getCurrentTitle().text

    -- Coba dengan field time dulu, fallback tanpa time
    local ok, results = pcall(function()
        return bucket("kudadb")
            .select(
                "date", "racecourse", "entry", "hn",
                "jockey", "race", "class", "fp", "distance", "time"
            )
            .where({"horse", pageName})
            .orderBy("date", "asc")
            .run()
    end)

    local hasTime = ok

    if not ok then
        results = bucket("kudadb")
            .select(
                "date", "racecourse", "entry", "hn",
                "jockey", "race", "class", "fp", "distance"
            )
            .where({"horse", pageName})
            .orderBy("date", "asc")
            .run()
    end

    if #results == 0 then
        return "No race history found."
    end

    -- Buat tabel
    local t = mw.html.create("table")
        :addClass("wikitable")
        :css("text-align", "center")
        :css("width", "100%")

    -- Header
    local header = t:tag("tr")
    for _, col in ipairs({
        "Date", "Racecourse", "Entry", "HN", "Jockey",
        "Name", "Class", "Finished", "Distance", "Winner (Runner-up)", "Time"
    }) do
        header:tag("th"):wikitext(col)
    end

    -- Baris data
    for _, row in ipairs(results) do
        -- Ambil Winner (Runner-up)
        local wr = frame:callParserFunction{
            name = "#invoke",
            args = {
                "KudaHistory", "winnerRunnerup",
                race         = row.race or "",
                date         = row.date or "",
                racecourse   = row.racecourse or "",
                currentFp    = row.fp or "",
            }
        }

        -- Format Finished
        local fp = tonumber(row.fp)
        local finishedDisplay
        if fp == 1 then
            finishedDisplay = "1st"
        elseif fp == 2 then
            finishedDisplay = "2nd"
        elseif fp == 3 then
            finishedDisplay = "3rd"
        elseif fp then
            finishedDisplay = fp .. "th"
        else
            finishedDisplay = row.fp or "-"
        end

        -- Format Distance
        local distanceDisplay = row.distance and (row.distance .. " m") or "-"

        local tr = t:tag("tr")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.date       or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.racecourse or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.entry      or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.hn         or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.jockey     or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.race       or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.class      or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(finishedDisplay)
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(distanceDisplay)
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(wr             or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(hasTime and (row.time or "-") or "-")
    end

    return tostring(t)
end

return p

name: Module:KudaPut
body:
local p = {}

local function split(str, sep)
    local result = {}
    local pattern = "([^" .. sep .. "]*)" .. sep .. "?"
    for match in str:gmatch(pattern) do
        table.insert(result, match)
    end
    return result
end

local monthMap = {
    ["January"]=1, ["February"]=2, ["March"]=3, ["April"]=4,
    ["May"]=5, ["June"]=6, ["July"]=7, ["August"]=8,
    ["September"]=9, ["October"]=10, ["November"]=11, ["December"]=12
}

local function toISODate(dateStr)
    if not dateStr then return nil end
    local day, month, year = dateStr:match("^(%d+)%s+(%a+)%s+(%d+)$")
    if day and month and year then
        local m = monthMap[month]
        if m then
            return string.format("%04d-%02d-%02d", tonumber(year), m, tonumber(day))
        end
    end
    return dateStr
end

local function nilIfEmpty(s)
    s = s and s:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    return (s ~= "") and s or nil
end

local function display(s)
    return nilIfEmpty(s) or ""
end

function p.main(frame)
    local args   = frame.args
    local list   = args.list or ""
    local rows   = {}

    for line in list:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        line = line:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")

        if line ~= "" then
            local col = split(line .. ";", ";")

            -- Simpan ke bucket
            bucket("Kudadb").put({
                race       = nilIfEmpty(args.race),
                class      = nilIfEmpty(args.class),
                distance   = nilIfEmpty(args.distance),
                entry      = nilIfEmpty(args.entry),
                date       = toISODate(nilIfEmpty(args.date)),
                racecourse = nilIfEmpty(args.racecourse),
                fp         = nilIfEmpty(col[1]),
                hn         = nilIfEmpty(col[2]),
                start      = nilIfEmpty(col[3]),
                horse      = nilIfEmpty(col[4]),
                contingent = nilIfEmpty(col[5]),
                weight     = nilIfEmpty(col[6]),
                jockey     = nilIfEmpty(col[7]),
                trainer    = nilIfEmpty(col[8]),
                breeder    = nilIfEmpty(col[9]),
                owner      = nilIfEmpty(col[10]),
                time       = nilIfEmpty(col[11]),
            })

            -- Buat baris tabel
            local row = table.concat({
                "|-",
                "| " .. display(col[1]),
                "| " .. display(col[2]),
                "| " .. display(col[3]),
                "| " .. display(col[4]),
                "| " .. display(col[5]),
                "| " .. display(col[6]),
                "| " .. display(col[7]),
                "| " .. display(col[8]),
                "| " .. display(col[9]),
                "| " .. display(col[10]),
                "| " .. display(col[11]),
            }, "\n")

            table.insert(rows, row)
        end
    end

    return table.concat(rows, "\n")
end

return p

local p = {}

function p.winnerRunnerup(frame)
    local args         = frame.args
    local race         = args.race
    local date         = args.date
    local racecourse   = args.racecourse
    local currentFp    = tonumber(args.currentFp)

    local results = bucket("Kudadb")
        .select("horse", "fp", "race", "date", "racecourse")
        .where({"race", race})
        .orderBy("fp", "asc")
        .run()

    local winner   = nil
    local runnerup = nil

    for _, row in ipairs(results) do
        local matchDate       = (date == nil or date == "" or row.date == date)
        local matchRacecourse = (racecourse == nil or racecourse == "" or row.racecourse == racecourse)

        if matchDate and matchRacecourse then
            local fp = tonumber(row.fp)
            if fp == 1 then
                winner = row.horse
            elseif fp == 2 then
                runnerup = row.horse
            end
        end
    end

    if currentFp == 1 then
        return runnerup and ("(" .. runnerup .. ")") or "-"
    else
        return winner or "-"
    end
end

function p.history(frame)
    local pageName = mw.title.getCurrentTitle().text

    -- Coba dengan field time dulu, fallback tanpa time
    local ok, results = pcall(function()
        return bucket("Kudadb")
            .select(
                "date", "racecourse", "entry", "hn",
                "jockey", "race", "class", "fp", "distance", "time"
            )
            .where({"horse", pageName})
            .run()
    end)

    local hasTime = ok

    if not ok then
        results = bucket("Kudadb")
            .select(
                "date", "racecourse", "entry", "hn",
                "jockey", "race", "class", "fp", "distance"
            )
            .where({"horse", pageName})
            .run()
    end

    if #results == 0 then
        return "No race history found."
    end

    -- Sort manual berdasarkan date ascending
    table.sort(results, function(a, b)
        return (a.date or "") < (b.date or "")
    end)

    -- Buat tabel
    local t = mw.html.create("table")
        :addClass("wikitable")
        :css("text-align", "center")
        :css("width", "100%")

    -- Header
    local header = t:tag("tr")
    for _, col in ipairs({
        "Date", "Racecourse", "Entry", "HN", "Jockey",
        "Name", "Class", "Finished", "Distance", "Winner (Runner-up)", "Time"
    }) do
        header:tag("th"):wikitext(col)
    end

    -- Baris data
    for _, row in ipairs(results) do
        -- Ambil Winner (Runner-up)
        local wr = frame:callParserFunction{
            name = "#invoke",
            args = {
                "KudaHistory", "winnerRunnerup",
                race         = row.race or "",
                date         = row.date or "",
                racecourse   = row.racecourse or "",
                currentFp    = row.fp or "",
            }
        }

        -- Format Date: 1988-05-01 → 1 May 1988
        local dateDisplay = row.date or "-"
        local y, m, d = dateDisplay:match("^(%d%d%d%d)-(%d%d)-(%d%d)$")
        if y and m and d then
            local monthNames = {
                "January", "February", "March", "April",
                "May", "June", "July", "August",
                "September", "October", "November", "December"
            }
            dateDisplay = tonumber(d) .. " " .. monthNames[tonumber(m)] .. " " .. y
        end

        -- Format Finished
        local fp = tonumber(row.fp)
        local finishedDisplay
        if fp == 1 then
            finishedDisplay = "1st"
        elseif fp == 2 then
            finishedDisplay = "2nd"
        elseif fp == 3 then
            finishedDisplay = "3rd"
        elseif fp then
            finishedDisplay = fp .. "th"
        else
            finishedDisplay = row.fp or "-"
        end

        -- Format Distance
        local distanceDisplay = row.distance and (row.distance .. " m") or "-"

        local tr = t:tag("tr")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(dateDisplay)
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.racecourse or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.entry      or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.hn         or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.jockey     or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.race       or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.class      or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(finishedDisplay)
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(distanceDisplay)
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(wr             or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(hasTime and (row.time or "-") or "-")
    end

    return tostring(t)
end

return p

    local pattern = "([^" .. sep .. "]*)" .. sep .. "?"
    for match in str:gmatch(pattern) do
        table.insert(result, match)
    end
    return result
end

local monthMap = {
    ["January"]=1, ["February"]=2, ["March"]=3, ["April"]=4,
    ["May"]=5, ["June"]=6, ["July"]=7, ["August"]=8,
    ["September"]=9, ["October"]=10, ["November"]=11, ["December"]=12
}

local function toISODate(dateStr)
    if not dateStr then return nil end
    local day, month, year = dateStr:match("^(%d+)%s+(%a+)%s+(%d+)$")
    if day and month and year then
        local m = monthMap[month]
        if m then
            return string.format("%04d-%02d-%02d", tonumber(year), m, tonumber(day))
        end
    end
    return dateStr
end

local function nilIfEmpty(s)
    s = s and s:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    return (s ~= "") and s or nil
end

local function display(s)
    return nilIfEmpty(s) or ""
end

function p.main(frame)
    local args   = frame.args
    local list   = args.list or ""
    local rows   = {}

    for line in list:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        line = line:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")

        if line ~= "" then
            local col = split(line .. ";", ";")

            -- Simpan ke bucket
            bucket("Kudadb").put({
                race       = nilIfEmpty(args.race),
                class      = nilIfEmpty(args.class),
                distance   = nilIfEmpty(args.distance),
                entry      = nilIfEmpty(args.entry),
                date       = toISODate(nilIfEmpty(args.date)),
                racecourse = nilIfEmpty(args.racecourse),
                fp         = nilIfEmpty(col[1]),
                hn         = nilIfEmpty(col[2]),
                start      = nilIfEmpty(col[3]),
                horse      = nilIfEmpty(col[4]),
                contingent = nilIfEmpty(col[5]),
                weight     = nilIfEmpty(col[6]),
                jockey     = nilIfEmpty(col[7]),
                trainer    = nilIfEmpty(col[8]),
                breeder    = nilIfEmpty(col[9]),
                owner      = nilIfEmpty(col[10]),
                time       = nilIfEmpty(col[11]),
            })

            -- Buat baris tabel
            local row = table.concat({
                "|-",
                "| " .. display(col[1]),
                "| " .. display(col[2]),
                "| " .. display(col[3]),
                "| " .. display(col[4]),
                "| " .. display(col[5]),
                "| " .. display(col[6]),
                "| " .. display(col[7]),
                "| " .. display(col[8]),
                "| " .. display(col[9]),
                "| " .. display(col[10]),
                "| " .. display(col[11]),
            }, "\n")

            table.insert(rows, row)
        end
    end

    return table.concat(rows, "\n")
end

return p

name: Module:KudaHistory
body:
local p = {}

function p.winnerRunnerup(frame)
    local args         = frame.args
    local race         = args.race
    local date         = args.date
    local racecourse   = args.racecourse
    local currentFp    = tonumber(args.currentFp)

    local results = bucket("kudadb")
        .select("horse", "fp", "race", "date", "racecourse")
        .where({"race", race})
        .orderBy("fp", "asc")
        .run()

    local winner   = nil
    local runnerup = nil

    for _, row in ipairs(results) do
        local matchDate       = (date == nil or date == "" or row.date == date)
        local matchRacecourse = (racecourse == nil or racecourse == "" or row.racecourse == racecourse)

        if matchDate and matchRacecourse then
            local fp = tonumber(row.fp)
            if fp == 1 then
                winner = row.horse
            elseif fp == 2 then
                runnerup = row.horse
            end
        end
    end

    if currentFp == 1 then
        return runnerup and ("(" .. runnerup .. ")") or "-"
    else
        return winner or "-"
    end
end

function p.history(frame)
    local pageName = mw.title.getCurrentTitle().text

    -- Coba dengan field time dulu, fallback tanpa time
    local ok, results = pcall(function()
        return bucket("Kudadb")
            .select(
                "date", "racecourse", "entry", "hn",
                "jockey", "race", "class", "fp", "distance", "time"
            )
            .where({"horse", pageName})
            .run()
    end)

    local hasTime = ok

    if not ok then
        results = bucket("kudadb")
            .select(
                "date", "racecourse", "entry", "hn",
                "jockey", "race", "class", "fp", "distance"
            )
            .where({"horse", pageName})
            .run()
    end

    if #results == 0 then
        return "No race history found."
    end

    -- Sort manual berdasarkan date ascending
    table.sort(results, function(a, b)
        return (a.date or "") < (b.date or "")
    end)

    -- Buat tabel
    local t = mw.html.create("table")
        :addClass("wikitable")
        :css("text-align", "center")
        :css("width", "100%")

    -- Header
    local header = t:tag("tr")
    for _, col in ipairs({
        "Date", "Racecourse", "Entry", "HN", "Jockey",
        "Name", "Class", "Finished", "Distance", "Winner (Runner-up)", "Time"
    }) do
        header:tag("th"):wikitext(col)
    end

    -- Baris data
    for _, row in ipairs(results) do
        -- Ambil Winner (Runner-up)
        local wr = frame:callParserFunction{
            name = "#invoke",
            args = {
                "KudaHistory", "winnerRunnerup",
                race         = row.race or "",
                date         = row.date or "",
                racecourse   = row.racecourse or "",
                currentFp    = row.fp or "",
            }
        }

        -- Format Date: 1988-05-01 → 1 May 1988
        local dateDisplay = row.date or "-"
        local y, m, d = dateDisplay:match("^(%d%d%d%d)-(%d%d)-(%d%d)$")
        if y and m and d then
            local monthNames = {
                "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr",
                "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug",
                "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"
            }
            dateDisplay = tonumber(d) .. " " .. monthNames[tonumber(m)] .. " " .. y
        end

        -- Format Finished
        local fp = tonumber(row.fp)
        local finishedDisplay
        if fp == 1 then
            finishedDisplay = "1st"
        elseif fp == 2 then
            finishedDisplay = "2nd"
        elseif fp == 3 then
            finishedDisplay = "3rd"
        elseif fp then
            finishedDisplay = fp .. "th"
        else
            finishedDisplay = row.fp or "-"
        end

        -- Format Distance
        local distanceDisplay = row.distance and (row.distance .. " m") or "-"

        local tr = t:tag("tr")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(dateDisplay)
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.racecourse or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.entry      or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.hn         or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.jockey     or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.race       or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.class      or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(finishedDisplay)
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(distanceDisplay)
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(wr             or "-")
        tr:tag("td"):wikitext(hasTime and (row.time or "-") or "-")
    end

    return tostring(t)
end

return p

__NEWSECTIONLINK__ == Abuse filter operator for Codename Noreste == {{discussion top|Successful [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 21:05, 29 September 2024 (UTC)}} :{{userlinks2|Codename Noreste}} Hello, everyone. I have maintained several abuse filters here, on [https://testwiki.wiki/wiki/Special:AbuseFilter Test Wiki] (where I am an abuse filter administrator over there), and [I authored some abuse filters] on [[:w:en:User:Codename Noreste|Wikimedia]] (where I am a global abuse filter helper), and I am applying for the abuse filter operator right to enable restricted actions '''only''' when there is consensus to do so here, and to fix a restricted filter's code if there are false positives. For example, I have a new filter idea that can block NTSAMR spambot accounts and IP addresses on sight who add double linebreaks in various namespaces. I apologize if I am not active as much on this project due to college, but I understand that this is a very high trust permission and can be revoked if used improperly (e.g. setting a filter to block good-faith users). Comments are welcome. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] 🤔 [[User talk:Codename Noreste|''Talk'']] 15:51, 27 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support}} I wouldn't say Codename Noreste is "highly active" here, but they do demonstrate knowledge of the workings of abuse filters. Considering they have been bureaucrat for nine months and made good contributions, I support this. [[User:Spacing form|Spacing form]] ([[User talk:Spacing form|talk]]) 14:02, 28 September 2024 (UTC) :{{support}}, why not? {{ping|AlPaD}} courtesy ping. [[User:Justarandomamerican|Justarandomamerican]] ([[User talk:Justarandomamerican|talk]]) 16:12, 29 September 2024 (UTC) {{discussion bottom}} == Proposal to set filter 76 to block == {{discussion top|{{done}}. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] 🤔 [[User talk:Codename Noreste|''Talk'']] 22:15, 30 September 2024 (UTC)}} As the section title suggests, does anyone have no objections if I enable filter 76 and set it to disallow and block? [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] 🤔 [[User talk:Codename Noreste|''Talk'']] 22:46, 29 September 2024 (UTC) :I don't recall if private filters have public titles when not triggered(Global Admin grants view private filter), but I think that's fine. I apologize if I am not active as much on this project due to college, but I understand that this is a very high trust permission and can be revoked if used improperly (e.g. setting a filter to block good-faith users). Comments are welcome. Overall, TestWiki does not have a huge need for bureaucrats at this time, especially when taking into consideration my previous points. local p = {} function p.winnerRunnerup(frame) local args = frame.args local race = args.race local date = args.date local racecourse = args.racecourse local currentFp = tonumber(args.currentFp) local results = bucket("kudadb") .select("horse", "fp", "race", "date", "racecourse") .where({"race", race}) .orderBy("fp", "asc") .run() local winner = nil local runnerup = nil for _, row in ipairs(results) do local matchDate = (date == nil or date == "" or row.date == date) local matchRacecourse = (racecourse == nil or racecourse == "" or row.racecourse == racecourse) if matchDate and matchRacecourse then local fp = tonumber(row.fp) if fp == 1 then winner = row.horse elseif fp == 2 then runnerup = row.horse end end end if currentFp == 1 then return runnerup and ("([[" .. runnerup .. "]])") or "-" else return winner and ("[[" .. winner .. "]]") or "-" end end function p.history(frame) local pageName = mw.title.getCurrentTitle().text -- Coba dengan field time dulu, fallback tanpa time local ok, results = pcall(function() return bucket("kudadb") .select( "date", "racecourse", "entry", "hn", "jockey", "race", "class", "fp", "distance", "time" ) .where({"horse", pageName}) .run() end) local hasTime = ok if not ok then results = bucket("kudadb") .select( "date", "racecourse", "entry", "hn", "jockey", "race", "class", "fp", "distance" ) .where({"horse", pageName}) .run() end if #results == 0 then return "No race history found." end -- Sort manual berdasarkan date ascending table.sort(results, function(a, b) return (a.date or "") < (b.date or "") end) local monthNames = { "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December" } -- Buat wrapper div + tabel local output = '
' output = output .. tostring( mw.html.create("table") :addClass("wikitable") :css("text-align", "center") :css("width", "100%") :css("font-size", "90%") :css("white-space", "nowrap") ) output = output .. "
" local t = mw.html.create("table") :addClass("wikitable") :css("text-align", "center") :css("width", "100%") :css("font-size", "90%") :css("white-space", "nowrap") -- Header local header = t:tag("tr") for _, col in ipairs({ "Date", "Racecourse", "Entry", "HN", "Jockey", "Name", "Class", "Finished", "Distance", "Winner (Runner-up)", "Time" }) do header:tag("th"):wikitext(col) end -- Baris data for _, row in ipairs(results) do -- Ambil Winner (Runner-up) local wr = frame:callParserFunction{ name = "#invoke", args = { "KudaHistory", "winnerRunnerup", race = row.race or "", date = row.date or "", racecourse = row.racecourse or "", currentFp = row.fp or "", } } -- Format Date: 1988-05-01 → 1 May 1988 local dateDisplay = row.date or "-" local y, m, d = dateDisplay:match("^(%d%d%d%d)-(%d%d)-(%d%d)$") if y and m and d then dateDisplay = tonumber(d) .. " " .. monthNames[tonumber(m)] .. " " .. y end -- Format Finished local fp = tonumber(row.fp) local finishedDisplay if fp == 1 then finishedDisplay = "1st" elseif fp == 2 then finishedDisplay = "2nd" elseif fp == 3 then finishedDisplay = "3rd" elseif fp then finishedDisplay = fp .. "th" else finishedDisplay = row.fp or "-" end -- Format Distance local distanceDisplay = row.distance and (row.distance .. " m") or "-" local tr = t:tag("tr") tr:tag("td"):wikitext(dateDisplay) tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.racecourse and ("[[" .. row.racecourse .. "]]") or "-") tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.entry or "-") tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.hn or "-") tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.jockey and ("[[" .. row.jockey .. "]]") or "-") tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.race and ("[[" .. row.race .. "]]") or "-") tr:tag("td"):wikitext(row.class or "-") tr:tag("td"):wikitext(finishedDisplay) tr:tag("td"):wikitext(distanceDisplay) tr:tag("td"):wikitext(wr or "-") tr:tag("td"):wikitext(hasTime and (row.time or "-") or "-") end return '
' .. tostring(t) .. "
" end return p

__NEWSECTIONLINK__ == Abuse filter operator for Codename Noreste == {{discussion top|Successful [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 21:05, 29 September 2024 (UTC)}} :{{userlinks2|Codename Noreste}} Hello, everyone. I have maintained several abuse filters here, on [https://testwiki.wiki/wiki/Special:AbuseFilter Test Wiki] (where I am an abuse filter administrator over there), and [I authored some abuse filters] on [[:w:en:User:Codename Noreste|Wikimedia]] (where I am a global abuse filter helper), and I am applying for the abuse filter operator right to enable restricted actions '''only''' when there is consensus to do so here, and to fix a restricted filter's code if there are false positives. For example, I have a new filter idea that can block NTSAMR spambot accounts and IP addresses on sight who add double linebreaks in various namespaces. I apologize if I am not active as much on this project due to college, but I understand that this is a very high trust permission and can be revoked if used improperly (e.g. setting a filter to block good-faith users). Comments are welcome. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] 🤔 [[User talk:Codename Noreste|''Talk'']] 15:51, 27 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support}} I wouldn't say Codename Noreste is "highly active" here, but they do demonstrate knowledge of the workings of abuse filters. Considering they have been bureaucrat for nine months and made good contributions, I support this.
