I could be wrong, but generally, we can rollback 1 and if someone has already contributed after your contribution, then rollback is not possible. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 25 February 2025 (UTC) == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 18:36, 3 March 2025 (UTC) :'''Update: the updated [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Blocking policy|blocking policy]]''' is now in effect as of Monday, March 2nd 6:16PM UTC-6. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:45, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] Could you summarize the changes made? Thanks! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::@[[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] Consuls, CVT, and Stewards are the only ones authorized to issue non-test blocks, test blocks can now only be done on accounts the user controls or on approved test accounts, appeals are only done via the blocked user’s talk page, or by emailing the blocking Consul, third party appeals are no longer accepted. I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! I obviously do not object the policy, just wanted your say on what you changed. :) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:08, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::ZPPIX WHY DO YOU KEEP MAKING POLICY CHANGES WITHOUT CONSENSUS! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 21:05, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::I do this as well on a local wiki that isn't the test one as an admin that can enforce and change rules around to keep it up to date like yes communities are needed but not for everything that are granted rights to staff. [[User:339Breakingoof|TheFunny339YoshiPlushGuy]] ([[User talk:339Breakingoof|talk]]) 13:38, 9 May 2025 (UTC) == Request for Consul (PixDeVl) == {{Discussion top|{{done}}, welcome to the Consul team. Please reach out if you have any questions. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 11:26, 9 March 2025 (UTC)}} Hi folks, I’m filing this Request for Consul, frankly because I noticed that we currently have only 2 remotely active Consuls, being Zppix and Reception, and, even with something like PTW, having an official project wiki be run by two folks isn’t great, so I’d thought I’d offer to lend a hand. I am not very active priorly with what exists of the community on PTW, but as a current global functionary, I still think it wouldn’t hurt to have an extra hand helping keep things clean. Feel free to ask any questions regarding this, as always :) —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 03:35, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}}  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   03:39, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} trusted user. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:38, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I looked into his CA. 1270 edits is extremely few for a user who is GA. Unfortunately this lowers my trust in this user even more. Maybe if the user was more involved cross-wiki I would change my mind, but unfortunately that is not the case. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:47, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I get that you look from the ground floor up. I have a more centered view from the MetaWiki and Discord. He is a trusted user who has been a great asset to the broader community. ::::I feel that you are gate keeping the local community, and that is your prerogative, but I think that PTW will benefit from his policy knowhow as well as his activity on the technical side. (Phorge) ::::On the other hand I find that waiting for first comments to arrive before answering on your own RfP doesn't make you to eager, as if one is collecting hats. I can assure you he's not. ::::I cannot take your concerns away, but hope you want to see it from the outside in, instead of the inside out.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:49, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::I do not believe in Quantity, but Quality. I can make 1000's of edits, but they do not tell much.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:50, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::::These are beautiful and classic words... However, can you explain to me why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions? Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW? I can't understand it. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:57, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::I think Zppix explains it perfectly. Being a Consul falls under different policies. Thus he needs to request permission to function here under the localpolcies.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   14:07, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::Hi, [[User:94.254.227.16|      ]] :::::::: I found your questions deeply compelling. As a result, I feel that I have gained a bit more understanding of Test Wiki. :::::::* '''Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW?''' :::::::As I understand it, Bureaucrat and Administrator are testing roles. As such, the roles cannot be used to uphold or enforce policy without creating confusion for the other Non Consuls within the community as to what is acceptable behavior. :::::::* '''why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions?''' :::::::Clearly PixDeVl recognizes that there is a distinction between a Consul role and a Non Consul role and will need the Consul role in order to provide the appropriate executive assistance. :::::::: You have raised a lot of other points that I will take into consideration, such as the low local edit count. Thank you for the extremely helpful and insightful observations. :::::::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:56, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I had far less edits back when I was a Global Sysop on Miraheze. Edits is not the end all be all. Further, it is clear to me that there is either a lack of understanding from you on the differences between having Global user rights and local user rights. For PixDeVI their use of global rights is governed by global Miraheze policy which dictates when and when they cannot use their global rights to intervene, but them asking for local rights it is allowing them to effectively not only help us Consuls, but also allow them to act based on our local policies outside of the governance of global policy requirements which can be restrictive and ultimately lead to relying on myself or another of the very few active Consuls which can lead to delays or even missed violations. ::::Please note my above comment does not reflect a vote but rather an observation of the discussion you have started. I neither endorse or oppose the candidate. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 14:04, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::The concern is not unfair; a user of this few edits both globally and locally seeking such a project leadership role is irregular, even with the precedent of [[Special:CentralAuth/subwayfares|subwayfares]] for wiki creation on Meta. Typically in a wiki that is fully independent this would be stranger as you would hope a leader is representative of the project, although there is merit to onboarding a trusted user in an advisory or supporting capacity. I would argue the key here is that this is ultimately a [[m:miraheze projects|Miraheze Project]]. I believe its identity as such should be a modifier for cases like this and that it is ideal for global functionaries to be more tightly bound with such a project, recommended in queue by wiki creators as it is with a domain currently hosted at WikiTide Foundation's grace. This may not be the ideal way to do it; my theory is to propose stewards as 'at large' consuls should locally invested members need a 'third opinion', more local consuls are involved and so on. Global administrators could perhaps fill the intermediary second line role bureaucrat serves, able to step in if there is backlog or an incident (short of something a GA/steward should step in for anyway). Otherwise there is a strong culture of 'separation of roles' at issue here and which is why pixel can't necessarily just jump in and do these things: it is not GS mandate. Therefore this request is an extension of his capabilities to reduce 'paperwork'. ::Essentially what I'm getting at is this request is reasonable, but skepticism of his investment in ''this'' local project holding such a role is also reasonable. And ideally, better tying the wiki to global operations through a community discussion is the best path in my opinion. The same for other projects such as dev and commons which already sort of act this way - zppix and alpad are local figures, reception and some others are global figures tied in, but as you see with the [[Special:ListUsers/consul|consul list]] it's a bit messy, outdated. ::Finally and drawing back a bit, there is no issue with an IP expressing these opinions. I would support their right to do so. I would also support a blocked user expressing a reasonable opinion to the degree I would offer to relay reasonable thoughts as food for thought even if they are blocked. An occasion where the IP editor and the blocked user overlap however is a very dangerous game that should discontinue immediately. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 23:22, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I agree with Raidarr. Test Wiki is structured very differently from other types of Wikis which makes it more difficult to identify or measure a candidate's qualifications by traditional means. :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:07, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' for {{ping|PixDeVl}}
What is meant by '''an extra hand helping keep things clean'''? What kind of things?
--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:45, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] TestWiki by its nature isn’t in dire need of conventional clean up work, but we have seen a recent uptick in issues where trolls go on mass desysoping sprees or otherwise cause a ruckus(something I believe Zppix has also wanted to address in policy), but as Raidarr said, PTW is an official Miraheze project, and as such, I don’t believe relying on really 2 activish functionaries to keep an eye on the place and make sure it’s tidy is viable or appropriate, hence my offering to take up the bit to properly police when issues come up beyond what’s included in the GA mandate and codified in local policy. Contrary to our anon friend, I do not claim to “need” these rights, I am offering to lend a hand to the small consul team in supplement to my other duties, and believe it would be beneficial to undergo this RFP to be able to do so without having to worry about global role scope ambiguity among other things. [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 15:00, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :::Thank you for answering my first question. :::[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' followup for {{ping|PixDeVl}} :::Hypothetically, if some disruptive activities were committed with the very best of intentions due to questionable judgement, how would you help wayward testers tweak their behavior before further violations take them straight to a permanent ban? :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:47, 6 March 2025 (UTC) ::::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] Should a user unknowingly or mistakenly violate the [[TW:Testing policy|Testing policy]], we should, as with any wiki, [[wp:assume good faith|assume good faith]] that they do not mean to purposely harm the project. That means contacting them in a civil tone to explain what they were doing and why it’s an issue, how to do whatever they want to do properly, and cleaning up. If they are acting in obvious bad faith or continue to be disruptive after multiple escalating warnings, only then should sanctions such as a serious block be applied ideally. I am glad to have the extra support for testwiki. The vast majority of users support the changes of policy with relation to [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats]]. With a successful RfC here, consuls will undertake a review of all active bureaucrats to determine which users will retain rights. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 20:36, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} While Bureaucrat has historically been implemented as a testing role, the low requirements for entry into the role coupled with broad/disruptive permission sets has made it a prime target for bad actors - repeat instances of malicious abuse of Bureaucrat permissions necessitating intervention by global volunteers has made clear that a change is needed. Simultaneously, the relatively small number of active testwiki Consuls has meant that policy enforcement activities haven't always gotten timely action and oversight, and assistance by trusted users is needed to keep testwiki operating as a true testing space. As such, this proposal aims to convert the Bureaucrat role from one of generic testing to one of moderate trust, eliminating the easy abuse vector while remaining readily achievable and providing consuls more support in day-to-day operations. The proposed changes to [[TW:Bureaucrats|TestWiki:Bureaucrats]] can be found [[User:Zppix/Draft/Bureaucrats#Proposed Page Text Changes|on this draft page]] under the Proposed Page Text Changes section. __NEWSECTIONLINK__ == Abuse filter operator for Codename Noreste == {{discussion top|Successful [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 21:05, 29 September 2024 (UTC)}} :{{userlinks2|Codename Noreste}} Hello, everyone. I have maintained several abuse filters here, on [https://testwiki.wiki/wiki/Special:AbuseFilter Test Wiki] (where I am an abuse filter administrator over there), and [I authored some abuse filters] on [[:w:en:User:Codename Noreste|Wikimedia]] (where I am a global abuse filter helper), and I am applying for the abuse filter operator right to enable restricted actions '''only''' when there is consensus to do so here, and to fix a restricted filter's code if there are false positives. For example, I have a new filter idea that can block NTSAMR spambot accounts and IP addresses on sight who add double linebreaks in various namespaces. I apologize if I am not active as much on this project due to college, but I understand that this is a very high trust permission and can be revoked if used improperly (e.g. setting a filter to block good-faith users). Comments are welcome. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] 🤔 [[User talk:Codename Noreste|''Talk'']] 15:51, 27 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support}} I wouldn't say Codename Noreste is "highly active" here, but they do demonstrate knowledge of the workings of abuse filters. Considering they have been bureaucrat for nine months and made good contributions, I support this. body: {{Documentation|content= {{humor}} {{Soft redirect|lzh:User:逆襲のあまのじゃく}} == 用法 == {{User:逆襲のあまのじゃく/Template:LTASeal | size=default | color=white }} * size：印章大小，small（30x30）、default（60x60）、large（120x120）。默认default。 * color：颜色。color白文（红底白字），red朱文（白底红字）。默认白文。 == 说明 == （以下内容使用Gemini生成） 兼美外觀，必考章法。主頁左下，赫然有印，朱紅其底，滿白其文，雙邊環抱，古意盎然。此印非金石所刻，乃常御機算、[[CSS|編層疊樣式]]盲操手刷而成。恐後人流於一瞥，不識其經緯，特作此說以誌之。 其一，法度賡續。此印深得[[印章 (東亞)|漢官印]]「滿白」之神韻，白線方折，紅底沉雄，疏密均勻，穩如磐石。線條轉折皆微帶圓弧，具熟銅水洗、歲月鈍化之質，全無現代網頁之冰冷機械。 其二，章法旋讀。印本三字（[[WP:LTA|LTA]]），然古法方印無三字塌角之理。遂依漢代私印「回文旋讀」之規，納一「印」字以湊四正，闢田字矩陣：右上引西字「L」，縱向拉長，形似古文「凵」； 右下置西字「T」，橫平豎直，體如繆篆「丁」； 左上化西字「A」，去其斜銳，疊為三層，酷似[[青铜器|青銅重器]]之[[饕餮纹|饕餮鼎紋]]；左下則獨運[[篆书|漢篆]]「印」字，上「爪」如鷹攫，下「卩」如屈盤，微帶斜度，乃全印之定海神針。循右上、右下、左下、左上順時針旋讀，清清楚楚，正當為「LTA印」也。 其三，解構反諷。夫「LTA」者，通語維基所謂「[[Wikipedia:LTA|長期破壞者（Long-Term Abuse）]]」也。凡百編者視為社群巨蠹，避之唯恐不及。[[天邪鬼]]則逆施倒行，反以為榮。以至高至雅之金石法度，載至忤至逆之社群黑話。[[Wikipedia:Seija|官方視我為宿孽]]，我便自刻一璽，視為名士之勳章。傲嬌無賴之氣，盡在方寸之間。 凡我分身傀儡，於討論簽章、行文問對之際，皆可調用此模板。代碼如左：{{tl|User:逆襲のあまのじゃく/Template:LTASeal}}。啪然一按，朱砂宛然，狂氣自現。紊亂大典，以此為樂！ == 参见 == * [[User:逆襲のあまのじゃく/Template:WelcomeLTA]] }} [[lzh:User:逆襲のあまのじゃく/印]]

name: TestWiki:Blocking policy/zh
body:
{{TNT|Policy}} {{NoteTA|G1=IT|G2=MediaWiki}} 虽然在TestWiki上封禁很常见，但在执行或解除封禁时，仍有一些细节需要留意。 == 测试封禁 == 通常用于测试的封禁时间应较短。在您自己的账号上进行测试时，封禁时长没有任何限制。您只能对您直接控制的账号进行测试，或对[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Testing policy#Users you can test on|此处列出的测试账号]]
进行测试 '''禁止在其他用户的账号上测试封禁功能，此举可能导致用户权限被撤销。''' == 特殊封禁 == 特殊情况下的封禁只能由Consul、行政员、CVT或监管员执行。若您认为某用户因特殊原因应被封禁，可以在[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Community portal|社区门户]]提出请求，或直接联系执政官。申请封禁时，必须提供符合其他TestWiki政策或Miraheze全球政策中所述的有效且严重的理由，否则可能会被视为骚扰。管理员或行政员若进行非测试性质的封禁，最高可能会被处以包括无限期TestWiki封禁在内的处罚。 == 申诉 == 因特殊原因实施的封禁可通过以下方式提出申诉： *被封禁用户可在其讨论页直接提出申诉， *被封禁用户可直接向实施封禁的执政官发送电子邮件。若封禁由行政员（Bureaucrat）执行，您可联系任何一位行政员进行首次申诉，后续申诉将由Consul审核。若封禁由CVT和/或监管员（Steward）执行，被封禁用户应按照封禁通知中提供的申诉指引进行申诉。 今后第三方的申诉将不予受理，并会立刻驳回。 在对封禁提出申诉时，请务必针对封禁的原因进行说明。但您应该避免攻击他人（例如负责封禁的管理员），或将您的封禁情况与其他被封禁用户的封禁情况进行比较。此类申诉无效，审查管理员将不予考虑。若反复滥用讨论页访问权限，可能会导致该权限在封禁期间被撤销。 == 解封 == 除非满足以下条件，否则请勿移除或修改特殊封禁： *您是consul或行政员。 *您是以官方身份行事的CVT/监管员。 *Miraheze信任与安全团队根据全球政策和/或《使用条款》以官方身份行事。 若您在未满足上述条件的情况下解除封禁或更改特殊封禁，您可能会受到处罚，最高可被无限期封禁TestWiki账号。 == 封禁通知 == 在实施封禁时，建议（但并非强制要求）封禁执行者在用户的讨论页上发布封禁通知，说明封禁原因、申诉步骤及/或其他限制措施。 == 酌情处理 == 若出现本政策未明确规定的情况，Consuls保留根据需要对上述政策进行善意解释的权利。 [[Category:Non-test pages]] [[Category:Policies{{#translation:}}]]
label: Saoutax

body:
Trước tình hình Drama Big Shark với Hungg VN và Dacvucat đang đi đến cao trào thì [[TableProgressTracking|Can Thiệp ACN]] đã nhanh chống can dự vào vụ việc nhầm hỗ trợ phía Hưng và chấm dứt Drama với sự không công bằng về phía Big Shark.

Hành vi xen vào drama của [[Deletion test|Can Thiệp ACN]] được coi là điều hướng dư luận , gây áp lực vào Big Shark. Nhưng ACN không biết bản chất của vụ việc đang diễn ra, có cái nhìn phiến diện phía Big Shark. Big shark sau đó không lên tiếng mà chỉ đăng bài đăng kết thúc Drama.  

Những ngày sau , Hadiez52 lên video cáo buộc ACN chỉ là "một con ếch ngồi đấy giếng" với việc bên vực Hungg VN và Big shark chỉ vì họ có mối quan hệ với ACN. Điều này đã được chứng minh khi ACN đăng video thâm quan công trình map của NejiVN khi map của NejiVN đặt top 1 map công trình trong thử thách của [[Deletion test|Mrbeast]] , trong video đó có sự xuất hiện của Dacvucat và Hungg VN đầu tiên.

name: TestWiki:Tor users
body: {{shortcut|TW:TU}} '''Tor users''' is a very specific, special purpose (mostly) testing permission that allows ''trusted'' users on '''Public Test Wiki''' (usually non-[[TestWiki:Bureaucrats|bureaucrat]] [[TestWiki:Administrators|administrators]]) to bypass the automatic global blocking of [[w:Tor (anonymity network)|Tor]] exit nodes. This user group is primarily used by users who don't want the bureaucrat bit, but it is also granted, from time to time, to a user who is trusted as an ''administrator'' but who is not necessarily trusted yet to have the full bureaucrat bit. Likewise, for administrators who have previously been granted this user group have given cause to have their trustworthiness called into question but not necessarily to the extent of revoking their sysop flag, any consul or bureaucrat ''may'', in their absolute discretion, revoke this user group. Please note that if you are already a [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats|bureaucrat]] (or [[TestWiki:Consuls|consul]], obviously), the user right torunblocked is automatically included within the respective user groups, and that there is no need to add this separate user group. To obtain the [[TestWiki:Tor users|Tor users]] user group to be able to be edit through [[w:Tor (anonymity network)|Tor]], you must: * '''Be trusted by the community'''; and, * '''Have a clear need''' == Granting guidelines == {{ombox | type = notice | image = [[File:Blue check.svg|40px]] | style = width: 1000px; | text = '''This section reflects some of the ''customs'' and ''conventions'' used by [[TestWiki:Consuls|Consuls]] or [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats|Bureaucrats]] in their evaluating a request for the [[TestWiki:Tor users|Tor users]] user group permission.''' Unlike the rest of this page, it does ''not'' represent [[TestWiki:Policies|official community policy]], [[Special:Diff/29946|as adopted]], and, as a result, one's mileage may vary between both the granting consuls or bureaucrats and the requesting users or their articulated reasons for requesting in terms of whether one's request is ultimately granted. }} Since this user group is granted on a '''discretionary basis''' by any [[TestWiki:Consuls|consul]] or [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats|bureaucrat]], the following information reflects some of the ''customs'' and ''conventions'' of those groups in terms of deciding whether to grant this user group: == List of Tor users' user group rights == Tor users' user group rights are as follows: * Bypass automatic blocks of Tor exit nodes (torunblocked) * Remove group from own account: [[TestWiki:Tor users|Tor users]] == List of Tor users == {{Special:ListUsers/torusers}} [[Category:Non-test pages]]

{{Aan}} == Proposal : Demo bot proxy blocking on test wiki == Hello. There's currently an actively ongoing request to block many more proxies globally across all of Miraheze, it's supposed to be done already but in practice hasn't been taken care of that well. There's a new system upcoming designed to block more proxies by using Wikimedia's list. I would like to demo this on test wiki given that 1) it is a test wiki after all 2) there is a huge spam problem here. Any objections? Also, thoughts from consuls [[User:Reception123]] [[User:Void]] [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 21:03, 29 June 2022 (UTC) :I don’t believe this is a vote, but I would {{support}} this request. We can test this out here, and if it works we can expand to the rest of Miraheze in time. If not, no skin off our backs. I have faith this will work as we haven’t been great about blocking proxies in the past. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 23:48, 29 June 2022 (UTC) :: I would ideally like at least one consul to input before I place 40000+ blocks, that kind of thing is not easy to reverse. (Though they can be short i.e. ~1 week during the trial period, and only longer during longterm use). Any thoughts from uninvolved users so far? [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 19:18, 30 June 2022 (UTC) :{{Oppose|Strong}} I can not support this, a bot like this should ONLY be ran by a user whom has experience with global permissions on Miraheze, for example current or former CVT, Stewards, sysadmins, ect. A bot of this type has severe consequences if it has to many false positives, one that only those people would have experience handling. At this moment, Void has been working on a bot to handle this sort of thing. I have also been doing separate work on reviving Proxybot. This request is a complete no from me, and this vote will not change. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 20:31, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :: Void's sources missed proxies, which is why this request was started. There is currently only an import task, which I asked Reception123 to comment on. Also, this isn't a vote, so there's no vote to change. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 21:58, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::Also {{u|Zppix}}, I will note that you don’t have the authority to single-handedly overrule this request. Your comment is noted and has been added to the record, but you cannot overrule this request just because you oppose it. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 22:21, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::: They actually weren't trying to overrule it, they were just "voting" on a thing that wasn't a vote. Though I do note that they specifically defined experience as "current '''or former''' CVT" so that they would qualify but not me. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 22:24, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::::The reason I specified what I did is because those peoples would have experience with global permissions on Miraheze. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:51, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::Not the only one who doesn’t like this idea, consuls do talk to each other you know. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:50, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::From a technical perspective it is almost 100% impossible to not miss open proxies. Simply taking WMF’s block list is disruptive, as there are no checks in place to make sure said blocks are still valid. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:54, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::The entire point of a test wiki is to test. I wouldn’t be opposed to trying it out and seeing if it works. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 19:16, 3 July 2022 (UTC) == Consul request == Hello, I am asking if I could become a consul or not because I have done a lot of things. [[User:Cigaryno|Cigaryno]] ([[User talk:Cigaryno|talk]]) 17:49, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :Users can become consul after being elected. Your request however is very early and much more experienced and users who have been here for a long time aren't consuls. There are probably enough consuls right now as well so there's not really a need for any more. I'd advise against hat collecting. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 18:09, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::I will request in 3-6 weeks. [[User:Cigaryno|Cigaryno]] ([[User talk:Cigaryno|talk]]) 19:49, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::I really wouldn’t recommend that. You’d likely need at least 3-6 months of experience, as well as being an extremely trusted member of the community. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 22:22, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::Either way, as I say there's really no need for other Consuls right now in my opinion. Consul isn't something you set a 'target date' to become. As I say, please do resist the temptation to hat collect. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 13:43, 3 July 2022 (UTC) == Users unblocking themself == Hi all, Recently a user has been evading their topic ban multiple times, without any regard for the seriousness of this and reinforcing why it was made in the first place. I temporarily blocked this user for 3 days, and considered removing their sysop permissions to prevent them from unblocking themself but decided not to because I thought I could trust them not to. Apparently not, because they ended up unblocking themselves. While sysops do have the unblockself permission, my understanding of this is that it is supposed to be because of test blocks by sysops. I certainly don't think it is OK for users to be unblocking themselves as the recipient of actions, and I don't think anyone else would either. It doesn't appear anyone else has commented on this problem, as due to the recent stepping down of the two most active consuls. The only user who had a chance to review this problem only reviewed the technical aspects of it. As a result, I think the community should make a plan on how to handle this situation. Since there isn't an active community at this time, if there are not any objections from anyone (other than BrandonWM themself) I will reinstate the block as an emergency measure. While I was initially under the impression that this would constitute wheel warring, I realized that the policy generally only applies to other sysops reversing actions, and is not intended to apply to users receiving blocks, and this would almost certainly be considered block evasion by any reasonable person. However, I don't have any plans on how to solve this problem long-term, other than either via removing unblockself from sysops (might cause problems for testing blocks?) or a bot that removes them (depending on who blocked). [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 03:39, 19 September 2022 (UTC) :I suggest that only bureaucrats and consuls have this right. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 18:12, 19 September 2022 (UTC) :We may create another blocking level rather than current blocks which only available for crat's and consuls. Current blocks may use for testing purposes. —[[User:MdsShakil|MdsShakil]] ([[User talk:MdsShakil|talk]]) 05:16, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::Since I don't think another blocking level is possible, my suggestion would be to use wgRevokePermissions and to create a new group that can be assigned to users blocked for serious reasons so that they are unable to unblock themselves. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 06:24, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::It's a good idea, I agree! [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 11:32, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::: At that point, why not simply remove the sysop permissions? [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:27, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::: Also, does the community believe BrandonWM's block was valid? I had said before if there were no objections I would reblock them. One user claimed the block was a "clear error" but did not have a convincing case as to why. I think the topic ban violation is clearly verifiable, see [[User_talk:BrandonWM|talk page]] for that, and does not appear to be in error. I would assume by the comments the community agrees it is valid but most people are talking about the problem in general and not this specific case. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:28, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::I forgot to mention, that even if admins don't have the right to unblock themselves, if it's a partial block the user isn't considered "blocked" so they can still do it. Probably only removing administrator permission is feasibility. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 16:35, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::: It's also worth noting that it appears that if you have talk page access on you can also delete and protect your talk page. Also also, a blocked user who is a sysop can still block the person who blocked them, this change is because of compromised sysop accounts. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:40, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::Again, you seem to be ignoring the fact that Void had the hard-line restrictions removed. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 23:40, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::::::BrandonWM, you are correct, as per what is clearly stated on your talk page both by myself and Void. :::::::Everyone else, please check his talk page before jumping to conclusions and give him a break. I regret blocking him.￼ [[User:Kiko4564|Kiko4564]] ([[User talk:Kiko4564|talk]]) 07:41, 21 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::: Void did not remove the restrictions. They removed Kiko4564's block and suggested reducing the restrictions. ''You'' are ignoring the fact that you violated your topic ban and also unblocked yourself, which is a much more important problem. In addition, a consul has already participated in this discussion and proposed a solution to the problem of users unblocking themself, despite Kiko4564 pretending it was completely fine for users to do that as long as they themself believe the block was wrong. And even if they were removed, you still violated them prior to that comment. Trying to excuse the fact that you violated the topic ban and also the fact that the edits were disruptive just reinforces why there was a need for a topic ban to have been made in the first place. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:01, 21 September 2022 (UTC) :Per our conversation on [[mh:m:IRC|IRC]], I am posting my rationale for using the unblockself permission. I believe the block was wrongly made and poorly justified. I had received messages of support from other crats in the hours before using the permission, and as such I felt comfortable in using it. If I had been alone in believing the block was wrong, I wouldn't have removed it, and instead elected to wait for another member of the community to remove the block. Void had also removed the hard-line restrictions, and as my edits were non-disruptive, there was no need for a block. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 04:44, 22 September 2022 (UTC) :: This is not true at all. :: {{tq|I had received messages of support from other crats in the hours before using the permission}} Actually, no, you received [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:BrandonWM&action=history&offset=20220914235959&limit=3 no such messages] between [[special:redirect/logid/25100|being blocked]] and [[special:redirect/logid/25104|unblocking yourself]]. There were no messages of support from other crats when you decided on your own it was wrong and removed it. Even after the fact only one person agreed that it was OK for you to unblock yourself (not "other crats" plural) - with four users including a consul agreeing it was not OK. :: {{tq|and as such I felt comfortable in using it}} You shouldn't have. It will never be OK for a user to unblock themself, especially as seen in this discussion. If it was really that bad someone else will. There's no need for you to remove it yourself. :: {{tq|If I had been alone in believing the block was wrong, I wouldn't have removed it}} You were. And if you weren't, why didn't those people remove it? :: {{tq|Void had also removed the hard-line restrictions}} Again, Void did not remove the restrictions. What Void actually said was: {{tq|I propose the restriction be reduced down to a general recommendation against making any "official" style changes without prior on-wiki approval, and an understanding that less leniency will be given in the event of future disruption. }} - the restrictions were not removed and remain in effect. In addition, I would call this the less leniency in the event of future disruption, as will be seen soon. :: {{tq|s my edits were non-disruptive}} Firstly, it doesn't matter whether they were disruptive. You violated your topic ban and that's not okay. Topic bans are enforced by blocking the user if they violate it. If you believed you could have made good edits in those areas, you should have requested removal, not simply violated it. As explained before, {{tq|A ban is not merely a request to avoid editing "unless they behave". The measure of a ban is that even if the editor were to make good edits, permitting them to edit in those areas is perceived to pose enough risk of disruption, issues, or harm, that they may not edit at all, even if the edits seem good.}}. Amen. I don't think I could have said it better myself. :: And secondly, they '''were''' disruptive. For example [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=TestWiki:Request_permissions&diff=prev&oldid=46125 this unnecessary removal], [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=TestWiki:Request_permissions&diff=44628&oldid=44627 this innapropriate self-handling], and [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=TestWiki:Request_permissions&diff=next&oldid=44780 interacting with other users]. :: Because of this, I do not see any valid justification for your actions. In addition, several users have agreed it is not okay for recipients of non-test blocks to unblock themselves, instead taking any of their concerns to a bureaucrat or consul. In addition, the original block has not been proven to be incorrect, and continues to only show to be more and more justified with the user attempting to justify their topic-ban evasion and justification of self-unblocks, repeating the behavior that led to that in the first place and reminding me of why they were blocked and locked originally in 2020, despite their claims to have changed. Because of this, I propose that the original block is reinstated. Please leave your thoughts and / or concerns below. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 04:58, 22 September 2022 (UTC) :::In which case [[User:Naleksuh]], please wait for a Consul to attend to this incident and deal with this directly, instead of wheel warring with a Consul over whether or not [[User:BrandonWM]] ought to be blocked or not, even partially. I've blocked [[User:BrandonWM]] myself, and all I said was that if [[User:Void]] deemed it fit to remove the block I imposed, then so be it, and if you don't think that [[User:BrandonWM]] should've been unblocked, then you were in the wrong to engage in a wheel war, and therefore (on this occasion) [[User:BrandonWM]] was right to remove the block because: 1) it was wrong, having resulted from clear cut wheel warring and based on restrictions which had already been removed and 2) I agreed that it was right to remove it since I believed that it was a clear cut mistake. If the incident isn't serious enough to warrant desysoping, then my opinion is that it cannot serious enough to warrant a serious block. However I could be wrong. If you disagree, then please discuss the matter civilly instead of wheel warring. I never pretended that it was OK for an admin to unblock themselves just because they disagree with the block. If it were, then almost everyone would unblock themselves. Thanks. [[User:Kiko4564|Kiko4564]] ([[User talk:Kiko4564|talk]]) 23:11, 23 September 2022 (UTC) :::: {{tq|discuss the matter civilly instead of wheel warring}} I did not wheel war. BrandonWM removed the block, and it has not been reinstated since. It may be reinstated when this discussion is closed, as consensus is that it is not okay for users to unblock themself. But I certainly have not wheel warred. In fact, this thread was specifically to avoid doing so. :::: {{tq|BrandonWM was right to remove the block}} Consensus is in this thread that it is never okay for serious-blocked users to unblock themself. There will never be a situation in which '''the user who was blocked''' {{tq|was right to remove the block}}. And even if there was, this situation would not be one of them. :::: {{tq|restrictions which had already been removed}} For the '''''third time''''', Void specifically said they ''proposed'' removing the restrictions, which did not gain much support and I personally would oppose. As of now the restrictions remain in effect. Please stop saying they were removed both because Void did '''not''' say that and even if they did I'm not sure consuls are allowed to unliterally do that. :::: To any uninvolved consuls now is a good time to close this discussion which has already run its course. Four users including a consul agree that self-unblocks are not OK, and by extension I believe they should be considered block evasion. In the words of Reception123 one of the uninvolved participants and a consul, {{tq|[They] should've just asked another bureaucrat or consul though, not taken things into [their] own hands}} [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 00:51, 24 September 2022 (UTC) :::::Alright, we'll agree to disagree then. I'm just saying that had you continued, the result would've been a wheel war. Thanks for not doing that. I'll let Void explain their actions personally. [[User:Kiko4564|Kiko4564]] ([[User talk:Kiko4564|talk]]) 11:14, 24 September 2022 (UTC) == AutoImport and old requests for permissions == Hello! This bot has archived the topics in Archive 12 instead of archive 13. Could someone please see it? Thanks! [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 06:25, 28 September 2022 (UTC) == Request for Consulship == {{discussion top|1=When one dusts off this old request, they find it was successful. -- [[User:Void|Void]] [[User talk:Void|''Whispers'']] 03:21, 31 December 2022 (UTC)}} Hi everyone, I'm Agent Isai and I'm requesting local consul here on testwiki. While I'm not the most active here on TestWiki due to my other global responsibilities such as being a Steward, I do check in every so often and generally have to look in to this wiki every few days due to other cross-wiki cases such as abuse by socks and so on. The reason for requesting the bit is because the current Consuls seem to be inactive. Dmehus used to be the main handler of things like inactivity demotions but he, nor has anyone else, handled this since May which is concerning. There are also a few other tasks which sometimes seem to drag on due to the inactivity of the current consuls so I'd like to help the upkeep of this community which is vital to Miraheze as it serves as a testbed for many users. Thank you for your consideration. [[User:Agent Isai|'''Agent Isai''']] [[m:User talk:Agent Isai|'''Talk to me!''']] 14:46, 4 November 2022 (UTC) #{{Support}} Trusted, experienced, active user and steward. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 14:53, 4 November 2022 (UTC) #{{s}} --[[User:Syunsyunminmin|Syunsyunminmin]] ([[User talk:Syunsyunminmin|talk]]) 14:59, 6 November 2022 (UTC) #Question: Regarding RFP, you declined an RFP who used the reason For testing asking what testing they wanted to do, but accepted an RFP with the reason Testing with no questions just 27 hours later. Any reason for the inconsistency? [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 00:17, 10 November 2022 (UTC) #:As I said on #miraheze-cvt, I asked for clarification about the first user's RfP as they already had an account with bureaucrat and sysop so I was wondering what they needed to test with yet a second account. As for accepting the second user's RfP, our standards for accepting RfPs are rather low. We do seem to grant users sysop (and even bureaucrat it seems) if users request it with a one or two word request. I did also note that I did it in part to see what the second user would do as it was suspected that they were a sockpuppet of a community banned user and it did end up that they were a sock. [[User:Agent Isai|'''Agent Isai''']] [[m:User talk:Agent Isai|'''Talk to me!''']] 03:07, 12 November 2022 (UTC) # {{Support}} Since activity ''doesn't'' really apply here, then AI is good to go. [[User:Ugochimobi|Ugochimobi]] ([[User talk:Ugochimobi|talk]]) 09:31, 12 November 2022 (UTC) # {{Support|strong}} Steward, trusted user. They’re an exceptionally good caretaker of the community. Happy to support. I think the [[m:miraheze projects|miraheze projects]] status of the wiki should be considered, as that would bind it to the [[m:Miraheze Spaces Code of Conduct|MSCoC]] as well. These reasons are why I believe this should have been further discussed and not presented as a project wide decision, when really it was you deciding to do it. :What I call for is that this immediately be subject to community authorization and a consul discussion to ensure this is really what the project would like to do, and if so, think it through. I don't think it needs to be shut down in the meantime, but its presentation as official should be ramped back until these steps take place. This goes to unexplored territory for miraheze projects wikis - should dev and commons have their own servers too? I fear that what is attempted with Discord will essentially just end up as what has occured with IRC, a rarely used server with little real traffic and what's worse, with no real community recognition. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 06:46, 9 December 2025 (UTC)}} *{{RfPStatus|status=|by=}} * User: {{RFP/User|AirmanKitten203}} * Requested group/permission: Bureaucrat * Reason for requesting: Hello! I am AirmanKitten203. I have been a part of PTW for quite a while now. Recently, I used my permissions on the wiki to do translations of some important pages in multiple languages, allowing for users from other countries and nationalities to understand the information they need to use this wiki. I am submitting this request because I feel that I am ready to take on more responsibility in the wiki and assist with the granting of permissions, reversal of vandalism, and the protection of the wiki. [[User:AirmanKitten203|AirmanKitten203]] ([[User talk:AirmanKitten203|talk]]) 13:27, 20 November 2025 (UTC) :Any update? [[User:AirmanKitten203|AirmanKitten203]] ([[User talk:AirmanKitten203|talk]]) 14:34, 3 December 2025 (UTC) ::If I am honest.. I feel you are requesting one after another permission, instead of just being a volunteer who appreciates helping others. ::You requested adminship on Meta, withdrew the request, then requested WikiReviewer without any explanation why or replying to any of the questions I put forward to you. ::And now you request Bureaucrat on this wiki. ::I have had the long held believe that volunteers should ideally be noticed for what they do, and people thinking, ''why are they not "xyz" yet?'' But my thought about you, to be frank, is that you are too eager for getting a status. You've done a lot of translation work, which doesn't need a bureaucrat role. Neither does reversal of vandalism which I cannot see you have been focussed on. You don't become a patroller before you have shown that you can identify vandalism. You start countering vandalism, and people start noticing you. Then you grow with the job, and get more responsibilities in that field. ::If your view is, that you can start doing certain work once you have the role as ''xyz'' then that is the wrong approach unfortunately. ::As we already have [[Special:ListUsers/bureaucrat|16]] bureaucrats, I don't believe you would greatly add to the team, that isn't already present. ::My advice to the staff would be to decline based on the above.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   01:26, 9 December 2025 (UTC) :::I appreciate your reply. Here are 2 things though :::1. I am a former bureaucrat here. :::2. I am not doing it for the status. I am not allowed to issue serious blocks or anything with testing permissions. [[User:AirmanKitten203|AirmanKitten203]] ([[User talk:AirmanKitten203|talk]]) 01:51, 9 December 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == Example7 == How to create user page for this account [[User:DiamondCat12345678|DiamondCat12345678]] ([[User talk:DiamondCat12345678|talk]]) 20:51, 27 January 2026 (UTC) :Hi @[[User:DiamondCat12345678|DiamondCat12345678]] :: Your page has already been created ... :: Your user page is [[User:DiamondCat12345678]] :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 00:59, 28 January 2026 (UTC) ::I am trying to create examplee7’s page [[User:DiamondCat12345678|DiamondCat12345678]] ([[User talk:DiamondCat12345678|talk]]) 08:01, 28 January 2026 (UTC) :::: Thanks ... It looks like you were able to create the User page for Example7 ... :::I am only a User here ... I can only view the User page for Example7 ... :::From what I can see ... it appears that only User can create and edit their own User page ... :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:00, 29 January 2026 (UTC) == Email from Technology Team == We are aware an email was sent out to all users with admin on this wiki about extensions being removed. The Consul team is aware of the removals ahead of time, and it will not adversely affect the wiki, you may feel free to disregard as only Consuls can action on the email. Thanks Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 03:04, 9 February 2026 (UTC) == New Policy/Usergroup == Hello! In an effort to allow Miraheze’s Technology Team a better way of being able to test various things needed using TestWiki without needing to contact a Consul each time, I have created a new usergroup for them with the corresponding new policy which can be found at [[TestWiki:Tech]], this new usergroup and policy is effective immediately. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:45, 10 February 2026 (UTC) :That's a good idea! :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 04:17, 11 February 2026 (UTC) == didn't know where or how to ask == Hi @[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] and anyone else who can look into this ... : In case it matters ... I thought I'd point out some funny test pages such as the Create Notice ... :* [[Special:Contributions/2601:985:4185:2FD0:E89C:B13D:52F5:C095|ip/01]] :* [[Special:Contributions/2601:985:4185:2FD0:31BF:2B81:72B9:9A57|ip/02]] --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:51, 1 March 2026 (UTC) ==Inactive Rights Removal - 03-05-2026== The rights of the following users will be removed on or after 03-31-2026 if they do not return to activity: *{{RFP/User|1108-Kiju}} *{{RFP/User|BahatiBot}} *{{RFP/User|BrandonWM}} *{{RFP/User|Bunnypranav}} *{{RFP/User|C.Syde65}} *{{RFP/User|Cactus2}} *{{RFP/User|Cactusalt}} *{{RFP/User|Chocolatian}} *{{RFP/User|Deltaman.exe}} *{{RFP/User|Ephenster}} *{{RFP/User|EPIC}} *{{RFP/User|FlatLanguage}} *{{RFP/User|IABot}} *{{RFP/User|Iamontheham}} *{{RFP/User|IAX86}} *{{RFP/User|Ikd45421}} *{{RFP/User|Inasfe}} *{{RFP/User|Jianhui67}} *{{RFP/User|LowkeyCoyote}} *{{RFP/User|Masker}} *{{RFP/User|Mioka}} *{{RFP/User|Mortimem}} *{{RFP/User|Mtester}} *{{RFP/User|NotARandomDuck}} *{{RFP/User|Onlyforuser}} *{{RFP/User|Ophyrius}} *{{RFP/User|PrimalPatch}} *{{RFP/User|Proxybot}} *{{RFP/User|Red dust}} *{{RFP/User|Rocketship}} *{{RFP/User|SafetyOperations}} *{{RFP/User|SD hehua}} *{{RFP/User|Singasarská Federativní Republika}} *{{RFP/User|SomeRandomDeveloper}} *{{RFP/User|Super Mario the Editor}} *{{RFP/User|Teafvl}} *{{RFP/User|Test-User-123-456}} *{{RFP/User|Thejoppyloppy}} *{{RFP/User|Thingofme}} *{{RFP/User|ThunderKnight}} *{{RFP/User|ToadetteEdit}} *{{RFP/User|ToastedTwice}} *{{RFP/User|TrulyANebula}} *{{RFP/User|Umbrasblog}} *{{RFP/User|UnwantedReaper}} *{{RFP/User|Vavane}} *{{RFP/User|Vikram Singh344}} *{{RFP/User|Vikxrtt}} *{{RFP/User|Vilgot Ahlborg}} *{{RFP/User|Waki285}} *{{RFP/User|WormEater13}} *{{RFP/User|Xeverything11}} *{{RFP/User|Xqct}} *{{RFP/User|XXTG666}} *{{RFP/User|Zippybonzo}} Thanks, :[[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) :For the Consul Team :04:46, 6 March 2026 (UTC) :{{Done|Rights removed from 48 users}} [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 14:06, 8 April 2026 (UTC)

name: TestWiki:Community portal/Archive 4
body:
{{Aan}} == Proposal : Demo bot proxy blocking on test wiki == Hello. There's currently an actively ongoing request to block many more proxies globally across all of Miraheze, it's supposed to be done already but in practice hasn't been taken care of that well. There's a new system upcoming designed to block more proxies by using Wikimedia's list. I would like to demo this on test wiki given that 1) it is a test wiki after all 2) there is a huge spam problem here. Any objections? Also, thoughts from consuls [[User:Reception123]] [[User:Void]] [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 21:03, 29 June 2022 (UTC) :I don’t believe this is a vote, but I would {{support}} this request. We can test this out here, and if it works we can expand to the rest of Miraheze in time. If not, no skin off our backs. I have faith this will work as we haven’t been great about blocking proxies in the past. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 23:48, 29 June 2022 (UTC) :: I would ideally like at least one consul to input before I place 40000+ blocks, that kind of thing is not easy to reverse. (Though they can be short i.e. ~1 week during the trial period, and only longer during longterm use). Any thoughts from uninvolved users so far? [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 19:18, 30 June 2022 (UTC) :{{Oppose|Strong}} I can not support this, a bot like this should ONLY be ran by a user whom has experience with global permissions on Miraheze, for example current or former CVT, Stewards, sysadmins, ect. A bot of this type has severe consequences if it has to many false positives, one that only those people would have experience handling. At this moment, Void has been working on a bot to handle this sort of thing. I have also been doing separate work on reviving Proxybot. This request is a complete no from me, and this vote will not change. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 20:31, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :: Void's sources missed proxies, which is why this request was started. There is currently only an import task, which I asked Reception123 to comment on. Also, this isn't a vote, so there's no vote to change. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 21:58, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::Also {{u|Zppix}}, I will note that you don’t have the authority to single-handedly overrule this request. Your comment is noted and has been added to the record, but you cannot overrule this request just because you oppose it. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 22:21, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::: They actually weren't trying to overrule it, they were just "voting" on a thing that wasn't a vote. Though I do note that they specifically defined experience as "current '''or former''' CVT" so that they would qualify but not me. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 22:24, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::::The reason I specified what I did is because those peoples would have experience with global permissions on Miraheze. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:51, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::Not the only one who doesn’t like this idea, consuls do talk to each other you know. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:50, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::From a technical perspective it is almost 100% impossible to not miss open proxies. Simply taking WMF’s block list is disruptive, as there are no checks in place to make sure said blocks are still valid. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:54, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::The entire point of a test wiki is to test. I wouldn’t be opposed to trying it out and seeing if it works. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 19:16, 3 July 2022 (UTC) == Consul request == Hello, I am asking if I could become a consul or not because I have done a lot of things. [[User:Cigaryno|Cigaryno]] ([[User talk:Cigaryno|talk]]) 17:49, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :Users can become consul after being elected. Your request however is very early and much more experienced and users who have been here for a long time aren't consuls. There are probably enough consuls right now as well so there's not really a need for any more. I'd advise against hat collecting. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 18:09, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::I will request in 3-6 weeks. [[User:Cigaryno|Cigaryno]] ([[User talk:Cigaryno|talk]]) 19:49, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::I really wouldn’t recommend that. You’d likely need at least 3-6 months of experience, as well as being an extremely trusted member of the community. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 22:22, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::Either way, as I say there's really no need for other Consuls right now in my opinion. Consul isn't something you set a 'target date' to become. As I say, please do resist the temptation to hat collect. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 13:43, 3 July 2022 (UTC) == Users unblocking themself == Hi all, Recently a user has been evading their topic ban multiple times, without any regard for the seriousness of this and reinforcing why it was made in the first place. I temporarily blocked this user for 3 days, and considered removing their sysop permissions to prevent them from unblocking themself but decided not to because I thought I could trust them not to. Apparently not, because they ended up unblocking themselves. While sysops do have the unblockself permission, my understanding of this is that it is supposed to be because of test blocks by sysops. I certainly don't think it is OK for users to be unblocking themselves as the recipient of actions, and I don't think anyone else would either. It doesn't appear anyone else has commented on this problem, as due to the recent stepping down of the two most active consuls. The only user who had a chance to review this problem only reviewed the technical aspects of it. As a result, I think the community should make a plan on how to handle this situation. Since there isn't an active community at this time, if there are not any objections from anyone (other than BrandonWM themself) I will reinstate the block as an emergency measure. While I was initially under the impression that this would constitute wheel warring, I realized that the policy generally only applies to other sysops reversing actions, and is not intended to apply to users receiving blocks, and this would almost certainly be considered block evasion by any reasonable person. However, I don't have any plans on how to solve this problem long-term, other than either via removing unblockself from sysops (might cause problems for testing blocks?) or a bot that removes them (depending on who blocked). [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 03:39, 19 September 2022 (UTC) :I suggest that only bureaucrats and consuls have this right. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 18:12, 19 September 2022 (UTC) :We may create another blocking level rather than current blocks which only available for crat's and consuls. Current blocks may use for testing purposes. —[[User:MdsShakil|MdsShakil]] ([[User talk:MdsShakil|talk]]) 05:16, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::Since I don't think another blocking level is possible, my suggestion would be to use wgRevokePermissions and to create a new group that can be assigned to users blocked for serious reasons so that they are unable to unblock themselves. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 06:24, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::It's a good idea, I agree! [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 11:32, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::: At that point, why not simply remove the sysop permissions? [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:27, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::: Also, does the community believe BrandonWM's block was valid? I had said before if there were no objections I would reblock them. One user claimed the block was a "clear error" but did not have a convincing case as to why. I think the topic ban violation is clearly verifiable, see [[User_talk:BrandonWM|talk page]] for that, and does not appear to be in error. I would assume by the comments the community agrees it is valid but most people are talking about the problem in general and not this specific case. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:28, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::I forgot to mention, that even if admins don't have the right to unblock themselves, if it's a partial block the user isn't considered "blocked" so they can still do it. Probably only removing administrator permission is feasibility. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 16:35, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::: It's also worth noting that it appears that if you have talk page access on you can also delete and protect your talk page. Also also, a blocked user who is a sysop can still block the person who blocked them, this change is because of compromised sysop accounts. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:40, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::Again, you seem to be ignoring the fact that Void had the hard-line restrictions removed. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 23:40, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::::::BrandonWM, you are correct, as per what is clearly stated on your talk page both by myself and Void. :::::::Everyone else, please check his talk page before jumping to conclusions and give him a break. I regret blocking him.￼ [[User:Kiko4564|Kiko4564]] ([[User talk:Kiko4564|talk]]) 07:41, 21 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::: Void did not remove the restrictions. They removed Kiko4564's block and suggested reducing the restrictions. ''You'' are ignoring the fact that you violated your topic ban and also unblocked yourself, which is a much more important problem. In addition, a consul has already participated in this discussion and proposed a solution to the problem of users unblocking themself, despite Kiko4564 pretending it was completely fine for users to do that as long as they themself believe the block was wrong. And even if they were removed, you still violated them prior to that comment. Trying to excuse the fact that you violated the topic ban and also the fact that the edits were disruptive just reinforces why there was a need for a topic ban to have been made in the first place. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:01, 21 September 2022 (UTC) :Per our conversation on [[mh:m:IRC|IRC]], I am posting my rationale for using the unblockself permission. I believe the block was wrongly made and poorly justified. I had received messages of support from other crats in the hours before using the permission, and as such I felt comfortable in using it. If I had been alone in believing the block was wrong, I wouldn't have removed it, and instead elected to wait for another member of the community to remove the block. Void had also removed the hard-line restrictions, and as my edits were non-disruptive, there was no need for a block. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 04:44, 22 September 2022 (UTC) :: This is not true at all. :: {{tq|I had received messages of support from other crats in the hours before using the permission}} Actually, no, you received [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:BrandonWM&action=history&offset=20220914235959&limit=3 no such messages] between [[special:redirect/logid/25100|being blocked]] and [[special:redirect/logid/25104|unblocking yourself]]. There were no messages of support from other crats when you decided on your own it was wrong and removed it. Even after the fact only one person agreed that it was OK for you to unblock yourself (not "other crats" plural) - with four users including a consul agreeing it was not OK. :: {{tq|and as such I felt comfortable in using it}} You shouldn't have. It will never be OK for a user to unblock themself, especially as seen in this discussion. If it was really that bad someone else will. There's no need for you to remove it yourself. :: {{tq|If I had been alone in believing the block was wrong, I wouldn't have removed it}} You were. And if you weren't, why didn't those people remove it? :: {{tq|Void had also removed the hard-line restrictions}} Again, Void did not remove the restrictions. What Void actually said was: {{tq|I propose the restriction be reduced down to a general recommendation against making any "official" style changes without prior on-wiki approval, and an understanding that less leniency will be given in the event of future disruption. }} - the restrictions were not removed and remain in effect. In addition, I would call this the less leniency in the event of future disruption, as will be seen soon. :: {{tq|s my edits were non-disruptive}} Firstly, it doesn't matter whether they were disruptive. You violated your topic ban and that's not okay. Topic bans are enforced by blocking the user if they violate it. If you believed you could have made good edits in those areas, you should have requested removal, not simply violated it. As explained before, {{tq|A ban is not merely a request to avoid editing "unless they behave". The measure of a ban is that even if the editor were to make good edits, permitting them to edit in those areas is perceived to pose enough risk of disruption, issues, or harm, that they may not edit at all, even if the edits seem good.}}. Amen. I don't think I could have said it better myself. :: And secondly, they '''were''' disruptive. For example [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=TestWiki:Request_permissions&diff=prev&oldid=46125 this unnecessary removal], [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=TestWiki:Request_permissions&diff=44628&oldid=44627 this innapropriate self-handling], and [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=TestWiki:Request_permissions&diff=next&oldid=44780 interacting with other users]. :: Because of this, I do not see any valid justification for your actions. In addition, several users have agreed it is not okay for recipients of non-test blocks to unblock themselves, instead taking any of their concerns to a bureaucrat or consul. In addition, the original block has not been proven to be incorrect, and continues to only show to be more and more justified with the user attempting to justify their topic-ban evasion and justification of self-unblocks, repeating the behavior that led to that in the first place and reminding me of why they were blocked and locked originally in 2020, despite their claims to have changed. Because of this, I propose that the original block is reinstated. Please leave your thoughts and / or concerns below. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 04:58, 22 September 2022 (UTC) :::In which case [[User:Naleksuh]], please wait for a Consul to attend to this incident and deal with this directly, instead of wheel warring with a Consul over whether or not [[User:BrandonWM]] ought to be blocked or not, even partially. I've blocked [[User:BrandonWM]] myself, and all I said was that if [[User:Void]] deemed it fit to remove the block I imposed, then so be it, and if you don't think that [[User:BrandonWM]] should've been unblocked, then you were in the wrong to engage in a wheel war, and therefore (on this occasion) [[User:BrandonWM]] was right to remove the block because: 1) it was wrong, having resulted from clear cut wheel warring and based on restrictions which had already been removed and 2) I agreed that it was right to remove it since I believed that it was a clear cut mistake. If the incident isn't serious enough to warrant desysoping, then my opinion is that it cannot serious enough to warrant a serious block. However I could be wrong. If you disagree, then please discuss the matter civilly instead of wheel warring. I never pretended that it was OK for an admin to unblock themselves just because they disagree with the block. If it were, then almost everyone would unblock themselves. Thanks. [[User:Kiko4564|Kiko4564]] ([[User talk:Kiko4564|talk]]) 23:11, 23 September 2022 (UTC) :::: {{tq|discuss the matter civilly instead of wheel warring}} I did not wheel war. BrandonWM removed the block, and it has not been reinstated since. It may be reinstated when this discussion is closed, as consensus is that it is not okay for users to unblock themself. But I certainly have not wheel warred. In fact, this thread was specifically to avoid doing so. :::: {{tq|BrandonWM was right to remove the block}} Consensus is in this thread that it is never okay for serious-blocked users to unblock themself. There will never be a situation in which '''the user who was blocked''' {{tq|was right to remove the block}}. And even if there was, this situation would not be one of them. :::: {{tq|restrictions which had already been removed}} For the '''''third time''''', Void specifically said they ''proposed'' removing the restrictions, which did not gain much support and I personally would oppose. As of now the restrictions remain in effect. Please stop saying they were removed both because Void did '''not''' say that and even if they did I'm not sure consuls are allowed to unliterally do that. :::: To any uninvolved consuls now is a good time to close this discussion which has already run its course. Four users including a consul agree that self-unblocks are not OK, and by extension I believe they should be considered block evasion. In the words of Reception123 one of the uninvolved participants and a consul, {{tq|[They] should've just asked another bureaucrat or consul though, not taken things into [their] own hands}} [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 00:51, 24 September 2022 (UTC) :::::Alright, we'll agree to disagree then. I'm just saying that had you continued, the result would've been a wheel war. Thanks for not doing that. I'll let Void explain their actions personally. [[User:Kiko4564|Kiko4564]] ([[User talk:Kiko4564|talk]]) 11:14, 24 September 2022 (UTC) == AutoImport and old requests for permissions == Hello! This bot has archived the topics in Archive 12 instead of archive 13. Could someone please see it? Thanks! [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 06:25, 28 September 2022 (UTC) == Request for Consulship == {{discussion top|1=When one dusts off this old request, they find it was successful. -- [[User:Void|Void]] [[User talk:Void|''Whispers'']] 03:21, 31 December 2022 (UTC)}} Hi everyone, I'm Agent Isai and I'm requesting local consul here on testwiki. While I'm not the most active here on TestWiki due to my other global responsibilities such as being a Steward, I do check in every so often and generally have to look in to this wiki every few days due to other cross-wiki cases such as abuse by socks and so on. The reason for requesting the bit is because the current Consuls seem to be inactive. Dmehus used to be the main handler of things like inactivity demotions but he, nor has anyone else, handled this since May which is concerning. There are also a few other tasks which sometimes seem to drag on due to the inactivity of the current consuls so I'd like to help the upkeep of this community which is vital to Miraheze as it serves as a testbed for many users. Thank you for your consideration. [[User:Agent Isai|'''Agent Isai''']] [[m:User talk:Agent Isai|'''Talk to me!''']] 14:46, 4 November 2022 (UTC) #{{Support}} Trusted, experienced, active user and steward. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 14:53, 4 November 2022 (UTC) #{{s}} --[[User:Syunsyunminmin|Syunsyunminmin]] ([[User talk:Syunsyunminmin|talk]]) 14:59, 6 November 2022 (UTC) #Question: Regarding RFP, you declined an RFP who used the reason For testing asking what testing they wanted to do, but accepted an RFP with the reason Testing with no questions just 27 hours later.
