This would be similar to the interface administrators, who also have special permissions to carry out essential non-test actions. I'm looking forward to hear your thoughts on this proposal! Regards, [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 06:03, 9 September 2024 (UTC) :Thank you for sharing your proposal on creating an AbuseFilter operator user group. Your idea to extend certain AbuseFilter permissions to non-consul administrators is compelling and could certainly enhance our ability to swiftly address vandalism and other issues. By allowing experienced non-consuls to fully configure important filters, we could potentially improve our responsiveness and effectiveness. I do have a few questions, though, such as what specific permissions this group would have and how we would ensure proper oversight and accountability to prevent misuse. Additionally, outlining any necessary training or criteria for members of this new group might help ensure that they are well-prepared for their responsibilities. Gathering feedback from the wider community on this proposal might also be beneficial to ensure it aligns with broader expectations. I look forward to hearing more about your ideas and the next steps in this discussion. [[User:Xaloria|Xaloria]] ([[User talk:Xaloria|talk]]) 15:00, 9 September 2024 (UTC) ::Thank you for your feedback. In response to your questions: The specific permissions of this group and the criteria for preventing abuse (i.e. revoking the permissions) are listed [[User:BZPN/AbuseFilter operators proposal#Specific user rights|'''here''']] and [[User:BZPN/AbuseFilter operators proposal#Criteria for revocation|'''here''']] (mainly about access to restricted settings). Also, according to the criteria for granting them, the proposal requires the user to ''Demonstrate knowledge of the abuse filter rule language and vandalism prevention'', which will help prove that they know how to use the abuse filter. I agree that users need to be prepared to use these permissions as well - for this purpose, I will create a special help page dedicated to using the abuse filter. Thank you! [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 15:29, 9 September 2024 (UTC) :::{{support}} I agree with this proposal. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 20:33, 9 September 2024 (UTC) :::{{support}} Fully agreed make a good sense. [[User:Xaloria|Xaloria]] ([[User talk:Xaloria|talk]]) 14:14, 11 September 2024 (UTC) ::{{Support}} Delegation is something I will support almost 100% of the time (excessive delegation will be opposed). It allows people who don't want the full toolset to perform useful actions with part of it. [[User:Justarandomamerican|Justarandomamerican]] ([[User talk:Justarandomamerican|talk]]) 20:38, 9 September 2024 (UTC) ::Partial {{Oppose}} I just noticed that the proposal includes access to private details, which is CheckUser access, restricted by global policy to Stewards and those who meet the election requirements for a Steward locally. I don't think they should have that advanced access. [[User:Justarandomamerican|Justarandomamerican]] ([[User talk:Justarandomamerican|talk]]) 08:50, 10 September 2024 (UTC) :::@[[User:Justarandomamerican|Justarandomamerican]], It seems I made a mistake when listing permissions - there is no technical way to grant the abusefilter-privatedetails and abusefilter-privatedetails permissions via ManageWiki, so it would never be enabled anyway. The proposal has been corrected. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 09:12, 10 September 2024 (UTC) ::::As such, I now {{support}}. [[User:Justarandomamerican|Justarandomamerican]] ([[User talk:Justarandomamerican|talk]]) 09:14, 10 September 2024 (UTC) :{{support}} [[User:Cactusisme|Cactusisme]] ([[User talk:Cactusisme|talk]]) 08:27, 18 September 2024 (UTC) :The above discussion is preserved as an archive. Please do not modify it. Subsequent comments should be made in a new section
== Public Test Wiki Discord Server is Live! == Dear users! We are thrilled to announce the launch of the '''Public Test Wiki Discord server'''! This new platform will enhance our communication, support, and community engagement. Whether you need help, want to discuss issues, or just connect with fellow members, our Discord server is the perfect place for you. # '''Features of our Discord server''': #* Roles: Gain access to specific roles compatible with your permissions on TestWiki such as Bureaucrats, Consuls, and Administrators to assist with various requests and issues. #* Community Interaction: Chat with other users, discuss projects, and collaborate. #* Real-time Updates: Stay informed with the latest announcements, recent changes and discussions. To learn more about how to use and join Discord, visit our [[Help:Discord|Help page]]. We look forward to seeing you there! Have a nice day! [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 08:32, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :I have gone into detail with this on discord itself and will summarize my opinions here. :I approve of coming up with initiatives, I have held for a long time that PTW needs reform and perhaps having that come out over discord is the answer. However I do not approve of the way this was installed without even Consul consensus, let alone community consensus. On discord you asserted that it does not change the community. This seems incorrect to me as it will reroute fundamental discussion to discord, serve as an official portal for Consuls, and through its support channel, potentially process requests traditionally done here. These are not necessarily bad ideas, but they are hardly no change at all. I think the [[m:miraheze projects|miraheze projects]] status of the wiki should be considered, as that would bind it to the [[m:Miraheze Spaces Code of Conduct|MSCoC]] as well. These reasons are why I believe this should have been further discussed and not presented as a project wide decision, when really it was you deciding to do it. :What I call for is that this immediately be subject to community authorization and a consul discussion to ensure this is really what the project would like to do, and if so, think it through. I don't think it needs to be shut down in the meantime, but its presentation as official should be ramped back until these steps take place. This goes to unexplored territory for miraheze projects wikis - should dev and commons have their own servers too? Should each project instead have a channel under the Miraheze primary discord, which will bring more people into the central community and possibly expand traffic that way? These are the details to be worked out imo. :--'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 12:44, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :I concur with the above. Evidently, this is well intentioned but the lack of consensus even from the other consuls is jarring. TestWiki has never been a particularly active wiki with a community. Attempts to nurture the local community should be coordinated with the larger Miraheze community which has a much bigger user base. I fear that what is attempted with Discord will essentially just end up as what has occured with IRC, a rarely used server with little real traffic and what's worse, with no real community recognition. [[User:Agent Isai|'''Agent Isai''']] [[m:User talk:Agent Isai|'''Talk to me!''']] 15:55, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :Concur with @[[User:Agent Isai|Agent Isai]] and @[[User:Raidarr|Raidarr]] [[User:Cactusisme|Cactusisme]] ([[User talk:Cactusisme|talk]]) 08:27, 18 September 2024 (UTC) == Discord server ==
:The following discussion is closed. Please do not modify it. Subsequent comments should be made in a new section. ::No consensus to keep the PTW discord server. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 14:10, 20 September 2024 (UTC) Hello! As requested by [[user:Raidarr|Raidarr]] above, I would like to seek the community's opinion on the Discord server I created, the goals of which I described above and on [[Help:Discord]]. What suggestions and opinions do you have on this subject, do you support or oppose it? I'm waiting for your opinion. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 13:34, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :Besides my input above I would like to raise a few options here based on private input I have received and some observations after raising this in the main miraheze discord server. Apparently there is an IRC testwiki channel which goes mostly unused. One answer to bridge the gap would be to have a bridged discord-irc channel on the main miraheze discord, giving more exposure to this wiki and including this wiki more in the global community without requiring a full server. The server already exists so if people here are really into seeing that, it would not be a problem. Or maybe none of the above is needed as I saw alluded to or stated a couple times. So in my mind three options to go on. I would be interesting to see what Consuls have to say from a process standpoint as equal stakeholders in how to go about things here. :I am taking my stance from a miraheze process standpoint, and do not have enough of a stake here to tell this wiki which way it should go. Food for thought. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 13:52, 11 September 2024 (UTC) ::Might actually make a good bit of sense to have a section on Discord for [[m:Miraheze projects|Miraheze project]] wikis. We could take a look at having a channel each for commonswiki, devwiki, and testwiki. Don't know if we'd want to have any criteria for including other wikis. -- [[User:Void|Void]] [[User talk:Void|''Whispers'']] 00:41, 12 September 2024 (UTC) :::Commonswiki and devwiki, could also get bridged to their IRC counterparts. [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 01:46, 12 September 2024 (UTC) :Yes, indeed the IRC channel (#miraheze-testwiki) is never used. If we do want to bridge channels, we could put it on the Miraheze bridge or a separate one. Either way, I’m happy to help out with it. [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 15:59, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :I {{support}} a bridge between the IRC channel and the main Miraheze discord. I'm afraid a full server would probably meet the same fate as the IRC channel. [[User:Justarandomamerican|Justarandomamerican]] ([[User talk:Justarandomamerican|talk]]) 16:13, 11 September 2024 (UTC) ::I agree with the above. [[User:GroupNebula563|GroupNebula563]] ([[User talk:GroupNebula563|talk]]) 22:49, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :::As a consul, I would concur on the points stated by {{u|Raidarr}}, {{u|Void}}, and {{u|Agent Isai}}. Creating a Discord server for the purposes of Test Wiki and this wiki alone would be a mistake. I would instead be open to a Miraheze Project Discord for these channels/separate category in the main server, and to bridge them to their IRC counterparts. However, of course, I'm interested to see what the rest of the community thinks of the idea, and I would like to thank {{u|BZPN}} for taking initiative to launch this. While malformed, it seems to have jump-started a conversation that should have long been had on Test Wiki, which is a good thing in my eyes. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 05:28, 17 September 2024 (UTC) ::::Thank you all for your input. After reviewing the discussion, I think bridging the existing IRC channel to the main Miraheze Discord server seems like the most practical and efficient solution. The IRC channel has been largely inactive, and by integrating it with Discord, we can maintain a connection to the global community without splintering resources into an entirely new server that may face the same inactivity.I believe creating a dedicated Miraheze Project section within the existing server, with specific channels for TestWiki, CommonsWiki, and DevWiki, would enhance collaboration and provide clarity without overwhelming users with additional platforms. This would also allow us to foster engagement across projects while keeping things organized.That said, it's important to strike a balance between flexibility and overcomplication. Bridging IRC channels where possible makes sense, but adding too many layers of communication might dilute participation. I'd be interested in hearing more thoughts, particularly from the Consuls and the broader community, on how to ensure that any integration remains effective and easy to maintain long term.In the end, the success of this initiative will rely on participation, so the more we can streamline and centralize communication without overextending ourselves, the better. Thanks again, @[[User:BZPN|BZPN]], for bringing this to the table and opening up the discussion. [[User:Xaloria|Xaloria]] ([[User talk:Xaloria|talk]]) 11:39, 17 September 2024 (UTC) :: Can a PTW Channel can be started on Miraheze Discord Server? Don't know if we already have such a Channel.
:: Also, I was thinking that offering a Dedicated PTW Channel on the Miraheze Discord Server will also boost awareness of an Official PTW Server.
:: And also, the Channel will make it possible for the PTW group to congregate on the Miraheze Discord Server until the group is called to meet up for official business on the PTW Discord Server. So even when the PTW Discord is quiet and not very active or busy, no one will have to keep tabs on an empty room. They could just wait on Miraheze Server and come over together as a group. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:36, 18 September 2024 (UTC) ::Miraheze server has PTW channel for recent changes. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 11:50, 18 September 2024 (UTC) :The above discussion is preserved as an archive. Please do not modify it. Subsequent comments should be made in a new section
== Request for an [[TestWiki:Inactivity/Exceptions|exception]] from the inactivity policy ==
:The following request is '''successful''' - the predominance of votes (including Consuls votes) and arguments in favor is overwhelming. Congratulations. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 16:20, 11 September 2024 (UTC) ---- Following the request [[M:Steward_requests/Miscellaneous#Request_to_Remove_TestWiki_Consul_Rights|on Meta]] for my removal for inactivity I'm requesting that Consuls grant an exception from the inactivity like I had in the past. I would also request an exception on behalf of Void if he wishes to accept. As you probably know I'm currently a Steward, Director and member of the Technology team at Miraheze and as such have many responsibilities here outside of TestWiki which means that I'm unfortunately not always able to be as active as I might have been during the first years, especially on-wiki. That being said, I'm always available on Discord and if there's ever any issue that requires a Consul I'm able to respond quickly. I would note that another Steward, NotAracham is already exempted from the policy for similar reasons. If you have any other questions, please feel free to ask. You don't need this exception - if you really want to intervene in special cases, you can use your global permissions. You only asked for an exception after I filed a request to revoke your permissions - which means you didn't care about it before. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 15:24, 11 September 2024 (UTC) {{Support}} [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 16:20, 11 September 2024 (UTC) ::That's not true - global permissions aren't to be used to usurp local communities so Stewards only intervene in exceptional cases. I didn't say I would only intervene in special cases, I said if anyone needed me to intervene in ''any'' case I would be available to do so. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 15:27, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :::Why do you need consul permissions? [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 15:34, 11 September 2024 (UTC) ::You DO know that Reception was the original requestor of PublicTestWiki... right? This is such a bizarre claim... ::--[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 15:49, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :::I DO. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 16:04, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support|Strong}} Reception is a huge help in the community, and removing rights is not the correct action to take here, they have more than demonstrated their commitment to Miraheze. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 15:42, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support|Strong}} I'm confused why a user that only got their consul rights yesterday is now so violently opposed to existing precedent of exempting major platform-wide volunteers in a narrow view of local policy. It makes me concerned that perhaps their elevation to consul may have been premature... --[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 15:47, 11 September 2024 (UTC) ::Interesting... Does the fact that I recently became a consul discriminate against me in any way? Does this make my vote invalid? It doesn't matter if the user is the founder of TestWiki, etc., as long as they don't follow the policies. I'm surprised that you want to keep the rights just to have them... [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 15:53, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{support}} Reception has been a huge help globally and on TestWiki (he originally requested the wiki), and I see no reason not to grant an exception. [[User:Justarandomamerican|Justarandomamerican]] ([[User talk:Justarandomamerican|talk]]) 15:52, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support}} To me, it is perfectly reasonable '''for the founder of this very wiki''' to have an exemption to the inactivity policy. Also, it seems like the removal of inactivity exemptions was done with absolutely no input from the community or other consuls? [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 15:54, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{support}} Changing as as didn't know he was the Test Wiki requester and seeing his contributions globally it's very good and make sense. [[User:Xaloria|Xaloria]] ([[User talk:Xaloria|talk]]) 15:54, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support|strongest}} I appreciate BZPN's eagerness to help maintain TestWiki but their recent actions have been a bit brazen. == FYI: Broken Link posted by BZPN.bot == I'm reporting a broken link that was posted to talk pages by [[User:BZPN.bot]]. It doesn't bring the clicker to this thread as intended.
An example of the Image with Broken Link is here: :* https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/User_talk:NDKilla#c-BZPN.bot-20240911090000-Join_the_Public_TestWiki_Discord_server! When I clicked on the giant image, it sent me to Community portal
instead of TestWiki:Community_portal#Discord_server: :* Community portal - TestWiki (publictestwiki.com) :* https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/Community_portal :* [[mh:test:Community portal]] Whereas the Site Notice Join the Discussion brought me to this thread :* Replying on TestWiki:Community portal - TestWiki (publictestwiki.com) :* https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/TestWiki:Community_portal#Discord_server :* [[mh:test:TestWiki:Community_portal#Discord_server]] --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:44, 17 September 2024 (UTC) :TL;DR FYI: Broken Link posted by BZPN.bot :* [[File:Green_check.svg|20px]] Join the Discussion (blue button on Site Notice) :*: Link goes to [[mh:test:TestWiki:Community_portal#Discord_server|TestWiki:Community_portal#Discord_server]] :* [[File:Dark Red x.svg|20px]] [[File:TW Discord.png|100px|link=Community portal]] :*: Link goes to TestWiki:[[mh:test:Community portal|Community_portal]]#Discord_server :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:08, 17 September 2024 (UTC) ::It happened to me [[User:Cactusisme|Cactusisme]] ([[User talk:Cactusisme|talk]]) 08:25, 18 September 2024 (UTC) :::It's now a moot point regardless, consensus based on above conversation is that there will be a PTW specific channel on the main miraheze discord rather than continuing with the standalone discord, the bot notice can be disregarded. --[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 22:34, 20 September 2024 (UTC) ::::hmm okay. [[User:Cactusisme|'''Cactus🌵''']] [[User talk:Cactusisme|spiky]] [[Special:Contributions/Cactusisme|ouch]] 07:17, 22 September 2024 (UTC) == Add PTW Discord Channel to Miraheze Server? == Just continuing my thought shared in * https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/TestWiki:Community_portal#c-Imamy-20240918013600-BZPN-20240911133400 * https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/TestWiki:Community_portal#c-AlPaD-20240918115000-Imamy-20240918013600 ::: Related Topics :::* [[TestWiki:Community_portal#Public_Test_Wiki_Discord_Server_is_Live!|PTW Discord Server is Live!]] :::* [[TestWiki:Community_portal#Discord_server| PTW Discord Server]] I looked at Miraheze Discord Server. I see the PTW channel for Recent Changes. I was thinking more of a Chat Channel similar to "OffTopic" where PTW members can congregate and discuss PTW concerns. They can hang out and then hop over to the PTW Discord together. It will be easier to find PTW related discussions if a PTW Channel were set up on Miraheze Discord Server.
--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 00:28, 22 September 2024 (UTC) :This seems to have adequate support based on the previous discussion, and there is basis to do dev and commons at the same time; the communities to consult are far smaller. When someone discord side has a good moment and/or someone handy to bridge existing irc venues, this will likely be completed. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 18:38, 25 September 2024 (UTC) == Abuse filter operator for Codename Noreste == {{discussion top|Successful [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 21:05, 29 September 2024 (UTC)}} :{{userlinks2|Codename Noreste}} Hello, everyone. I have maintained several abuse filters here, on [https://testwiki.wiki/wiki/Special:AbuseFilter Test Wiki] (where I am an abuse filter administrator over there), and [I authored some abuse filters] on [[:w:en:User:Codename Noreste|Wikimedia]] (where I am a global abuse filter helper), and I am applying for the abuse filter operator right to enable restricted actions '''only''' when there is consensus to do so here, and to fix a restricted filter's code if there are false positives. For example, I have a new filter idea that can block NTSAMR spambot accounts and IP addresses on sight who add double linebreaks in various namespaces. I apologize if I am not active as much on this project due to college, but I understand that this is a very high trust permission and can be revoked if used improperly (e.g. setting a filter to block good-faith users). Comments are welcome. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] 🤔 [[User talk:Codename Noreste|''Talk'']] 15:51, 27 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support}} I wouldn't say Codename Noreste is "highly active" here, but they do demonstrate knowledge of the workings of abuse filters. Considering they have been bureaucrat for nine months and made good contributions, I support this. [[User:Spacing form|Spacing form]] ([[User talk:Spacing form|talk]]) 14:02, 28 September 2024 (UTC) :{{support}}, why not? {{ping|AlPaD}} courtesy ping. [[User:Justarandomamerican|Justarandomamerican]] ([[User talk:Justarandomamerican|talk]]) 16:12, 29 September 2024 (UTC) {{discussion bottom}} == Proposal to set filter 76 to block == {{discussion top|{{done}}. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] 🤔 [[User talk:Codename Noreste|''Talk'']] 22:15, 30 September 2024 (UTC)}} As the section title suggests, does anyone have no objections if I enable filter 76 and set it to disallow and block? [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] 🤔 [[User talk:Codename Noreste|''Talk'']] 22:46, 29 September 2024 (UTC) :I don't recall if private filters have public titles when not triggered(Global Admin grants view private filter), but I think that's fine. Likely not too bad a block, long enough for the spammer to get bored and leave and be indef'ed if we want. I'm not quite sure why & page_id == 0 & is in the filter though? [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 23:09, 29 September 2024 (UTC) ::[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]], page_id == 0 makes the filter detect new page creations. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] 🤔 [[User talk:Codename Noreste|''Talk'']] 23:13, 29 September 2024 (UTC) ::: Oh, makes sense, thanks. I'm not sure if it's explicitly needed(I don't think we have that in the global filter), but I don't really care. I'd leave it to you to decide. {{S}} the idea though. --[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 23:18, 29 September 2024 (UTC) ::::Given that there's no objections to this, I'm implementing the action right now... [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] 🤔 [[User talk:Codename Noreste|''Talk'']] 22:11, 30 September 2024 (UTC) {{discussion bottom}}

[[User:AirmanKitten203|AirmanKitten203]] ([[User talk:AirmanKitten203|talk]]) 14:34, 3 December 2025 (UTC) ::If I am honest.. I feel you are requesting one after another permission, instead of just being a volunteer who appreciates helping others. ::You requested adminship on Meta, withdrew the request, then requested WikiReviewer without any explanation why or replying to any of the questions I put forward to you. ::And now you request Bureaucrat on this wiki. ::I have had the long held believe that volunteers should ideally be noticed for what they do, and people thinking, ''why are they not "xyz" yet?'' But my thought about you, to be frank, is that you are too eager for getting a status. You've done a lot of translation work, which doesn't need a bureaucrat role. Neither does reversal of vandalism which I cannot see you have been focussed on. You don't become a patroller before you have shown that you can identify vandalism. You start countering vandalism, and people start noticing you. Then you grow with the job, and get more responsibilities in that field. ::If your view is, that you can start doing certain work once you have the role as ''xyz'' then that is the wrong approach unfortunately. ::As we already have [[Special:ListUsers/bureaucrat|16]] bureaucrats, I don't believe you would greatly add to the team, that isn't already present. ::My advice to the staff would be to decline based on the above.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   01:26, 9 December 2025 (UTC) :::I appreciate your reply. Here are 2 things though :::1. I am a former bureaucrat here. :::2. I am not doing it for the status. I am not allowed to issue serious blocks or anything with testing permissions. body:
{{Aan}} == Proposal : Demo bot proxy blocking on test wiki == Hello. There's currently an actively ongoing request to block many more proxies globally across all of Miraheze, it's supposed to be done already but in practice hasn't been taken care of that well. There's a new system upcoming designed to block more proxies by using Wikimedia's list. I would like to demo this on test wiki given that 1) it is a test wiki after all 2) there is a huge spam problem here. Any objections? Also, thoughts from consuls [[User:Reception123]] [[User:Void]] [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 21:03, 29 June 2022 (UTC) :I don’t believe this is a vote, but I would {{support}} this request. We can test this out here, and if it works we can expand to the rest of Miraheze in time. If not, no skin off our backs. I have faith this will work as we haven’t been great about blocking proxies in the past. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 23:48, 29 June 2022 (UTC) :: I would ideally like at least one consul to input before I place 40000+ blocks, that kind of thing is not easy to reverse. (Though they can be short i.e. ~1 week during the trial period, and only longer during longterm use). Any thoughts from uninvolved users so far? [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 19:18, 30 June 2022 (UTC) :{{Oppose|Strong}} I can not support this, a bot like this should ONLY be ran by a user whom has experience with global permissions on Miraheze, for example current or former CVT, Stewards, sysadmins, ect. A bot of this type has severe consequences if it has to many false positives, one that only those people would have experience handling. At this moment, Void has been working on a bot to handle this sort of thing. I have also been doing separate work on reviving Proxybot. This request is a complete no from me, and this vote will not change. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 20:31, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :: Void's sources missed proxies, which is why this request was started. There is currently only an import task, which I asked Reception123 to comment on. Also, this isn't a vote, so there's no vote to change. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 21:58, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::Also {{u|Zppix}}, I will note that you don’t have the authority to single-handedly overrule this request. Your comment is noted and has been added to the record, but you cannot overrule this request just because you oppose it. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 22:21, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::: They actually weren't trying to overrule it, they were just "voting" on a thing that wasn't a vote. Though I do note that they specifically defined experience as "current '''or former''' CVT" so that they would qualify but not me. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 22:24, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::::The reason I specified what I did is because those peoples would have experience with global permissions on Miraheze. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:51, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::Not the only one who doesn’t like this idea, consuls do talk to each other you know. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:50, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::From a technical perspective it is almost 100% impossible to not miss open proxies. Simply taking WMF’s block list is disruptive, as there are no checks in place to make sure said blocks are still valid. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:54, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::The entire point of a test wiki is to test. I wouldn’t be opposed to trying it out and seeing if it works. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 19:16, 3 July 2022 (UTC) == Consul request == Hello, I am asking if I could become a consul or not because I have done a lot of things. [[User:Cigaryno|Cigaryno]] ([[User talk:Cigaryno|talk]]) 17:49, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :Users can become consul after being elected. Your request however is very early and much more experienced and users who have been here for a long time aren't consuls. There are probably enough consuls right now as well so there's not really a need for any more. I'd advise against hat collecting. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 18:09, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::I will request in 3-6 weeks. [[User:Cigaryno|Cigaryno]] ([[User talk:Cigaryno|talk]]) 19:49, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::I really wouldn’t recommend that. You’d likely need at least 3-6 months of experience, as well as being an extremely trusted member of the community. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 22:22, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::Either way, as I say there's really no need for other Consuls right now in my opinion. Consul isn't something you set a 'target date' to become. As I say, please do resist the temptation to hat collect. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 13:43, 3 July 2022 (UTC) == Users unblocking themself == Hi all, Recently a user has been evading their topic ban multiple times, without any regard for the seriousness of this and reinforcing why it was made in the first place. I temporarily blocked this user for 3 days, and considered removing their sysop permissions to prevent them from unblocking themself but decided not to because I thought I could trust them not to. Apparently not, because they ended up unblocking themselves. While sysops do have the unblockself permission, my understanding of this is that it is supposed to be because of test blocks by sysops. I certainly don't think it is OK for users to be unblocking themselves as the recipient of actions, and I don't think anyone else would either. It doesn't appear anyone else has commented on this problem, as due to the recent stepping down of the two most active consuls. The only user who had a chance to review this problem only reviewed the technical aspects of it. As a result, I think the community should make a plan on how to handle this situation. Since there isn't an active community at this time, if there are not any objections from anyone (other than BrandonWM themself) I will reinstate the block as an emergency measure. While I was initially under the impression that this would constitute wheel warring, I realized that the policy generally only applies to other sysops reversing actions, and is not intended to apply to users receiving blocks, and this would almost certainly be considered block evasion by any reasonable person. However, I don't have any plans on how to solve this problem long-term, other than either via removing unblockself from sysops (might cause problems for testing blocks?) or a bot that removes them (depending on who blocked). [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 03:39, 19 September 2022 (UTC) :I suggest that only bureaucrats and consuls have this right. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 18:12, 19 September 2022 (UTC) :We may create another blocking level rather than current blocks which only available for crat's and consuls. Current blocks may use for testing purposes. —[[User:MdsShakil|MdsShakil]] ([[User talk:MdsShakil|talk]]) 05:16, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::Since I don't think another blocking level is possible, my suggestion would be to use wgRevokePermissions and to create a new group that can be assigned to users blocked for serious reasons so that they are unable to unblock themselves. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 06:24, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::It's a good idea, I agree! [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 11:32, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::: At that point, why not simply remove the sysop permissions? [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:27, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::: Also, does the community believe BrandonWM's block was valid? I had said before if there were no objections I would reblock them. One user claimed the block was a "clear error" but did not have a convincing case as to why. I think the topic ban violation is clearly verifiable, see [[User_talk:BrandonWM|talk page]] for that, and does not appear to be in error. I would assume by the comments the community agrees it is valid but most people are talking about the problem in general and not this specific case. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:28, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::I forgot to mention, that even if admins don't have the right to unblock themselves, if it's a partial block the user isn't considered "blocked" so they can still do it. Probably only removing administrator permission is feasibility. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 16:35, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::: It's also worth noting that it appears that if you have talk page access on you can also delete and protect your talk page. Also also, a blocked user who is a sysop can still block the person who blocked them, this change is because of compromised sysop accounts. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:40, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::Again, you seem to be ignoring the fact that Void had the hard-line restrictions removed. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 23:40, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::::::BrandonWM, you are correct, as per what is clearly stated on your talk page both by myself and Void. :::::::Everyone else, please check his talk page before jumping to conclusions and give him a break. I regret blocking him.￼ [[User:Kiko4564|Kiko4564]] ([[User talk:Kiko4564|talk]]) 07:41, 21 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::: Void did not remove the restrictions. They removed Kiko4564's block and suggested reducing the restrictions. ''You'' are ignoring the fact that you violated your topic ban and also unblocked yourself, which is a much more important problem. In addition, a consul has already participated in this discussion and proposed a solution to the problem of users unblocking themself, despite Kiko4564 pretending it was completely fine for users to do that as long as they themself believe the block was wrong. And even if they were removed, you still violated them prior to that comment. Trying to excuse the fact that you violated the topic ban and also the fact that the edits were disruptive just reinforces why there was a need for a topic ban to have been made in the first place. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:01, 21 September 2022 (UTC) :Per our conversation on [[mh:m:IRC|IRC]], I am posting my rationale for using the unblockself permission. I believe the block was wrongly made and poorly justified. I had received messages of support from other crats in the hours before using the permission, and as such I felt comfortable in using it. If I had been alone in believing the block was wrong, I wouldn't have removed it, and instead elected to wait for another member of the community to remove the block. Void had also removed the hard-line restrictions, and as my edits were non-disruptive, there was no need for a block. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 04:44, 22 September 2022 (UTC) :: This is not true at all. :: {{tq|I had received messages of support from other crats in the hours before using the permission}} Actually, no, you received [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:BrandonWM&action=history&offset=20220914235959&limit=3 no such messages] between [[special:redirect/logid/25100|being blocked]] and [[special:redirect/logid/25104|unblocking yourself]]. There were no messages of support from other crats when you decided on your own it was wrong and removed it. Even after the fact only one person agreed that it was OK for you to unblock yourself (not "other crats" plural) - with four users including a consul agreeing it was not OK. :: {{tq|and as such I felt comfortable in using it}} You shouldn't have. It will never be OK for a user to unblock themself, especially as seen in this discussion. If it was really that bad someone else will. There's no need for you to remove it yourself. :: {{tq|If I had been alone in believing the block was wrong, I wouldn't have removed it}} You were. And if you weren't, why didn't those people remove it? :: {{tq|Void had also removed the hard-line restrictions}} Again, Void did not remove the restrictions. What Void actually said was: {{tq|I propose the restriction be reduced down to a general recommendation against making any "official" style changes without prior on-wiki approval, and an understanding that less leniency will be given in the event of future disruption. }} - the restrictions were not removed and remain in effect. In addition, I would call this the less leniency in the event of future disruption, as will be seen soon. :: {{tq|s my edits were non-disruptive}} Firstly, it doesn't matter whether they were disruptive. You violated your topic ban and that's not okay. Topic bans are enforced by blocking the user if they violate it. If you believed you could have made good edits in those areas, you should have requested removal, not simply violated it. As explained before, {{tq|A ban is not merely a request to avoid editing "unless they behave". The measure of a ban is that even if the editor were to make good edits, permitting them to edit in those areas is perceived to pose enough risk of disruption, issues, or harm, that they may not edit at all, even if the edits seem good.}}. Amen. I don't think I could have said it better myself. :: And secondly, they '''were''' disruptive. For example [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=TestWiki:Request_permissions&diff=prev&oldid=46125 this unnecessary removal], [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=TestWiki:Request_permissions&diff=44628&oldid=44627 this innapropriate self-handling], and [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=TestWiki:Request_permissions&diff=next&oldid=44780 interacting with other users]. :: Because of this, I do not see any valid justification for your actions. In addition, several users have agreed it is not okay for recipients of non-test blocks to unblock themselves, instead taking any of their concerns to a bureaucrat or consul. In addition, the original block has not been proven to be incorrect, and continues to only show to be more and more justified with the user attempting to justify their topic-ban evasion and justification of self-unblocks, repeating the behavior that led to that in the first place and reminding me of why they were blocked and locked originally in 2020, despite their claims to have changed. Because of this, I propose that the original block is reinstated. Please leave your thoughts and / or concerns below. I even went to contributions and reverted from there, but the pages still exist and have the content [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 04:30, 18 February 2025 (UTC) :Don't know which pages you are referring to. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:45, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] Could you summarize the changes made? Thanks! I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! I obviously do not object the policy, just wanted your say on what you changed. :) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:08, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::ZPPIX WHY DO YOU KEEP MAKING POLICY CHANGES WITHOUT CONSENSUS! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 21:05, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::I do this as well on a local wiki that isn't the test one as an admin that can enforce and change rules around to keep it up to date like yes communities are needed but not for everything that are granted rights to staff. [[User:339Breakingoof|TheFunny339YoshiPlushGuy]] ([[User talk:339Breakingoof|talk]]) 13:38, 9 May 2025 (UTC) == Request for Consul (PixDeVl) == {{Discussion top|{{done}}, welcome to the Consul team. Please reach out if you have any questions. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 11:26, 9 March 2025 (UTC)}} Hi folks, I’m filing this Request for Consul, frankly because I noticed that we currently have only 2 remotely active Consuls, being Zppix and Reception, and, even with something like PTW, having an official project wiki be run by two folks isn’t great, so I’d thought I’d offer to lend a hand. I am not very active priorly with what exists of the community on PTW, but as a current global functionary, I still think it wouldn’t hurt to have an extra hand helping keep things clean. Feel free to ask any questions regarding this, as always :) —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 03:35, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}}  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   03:39, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} trusted user. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:38, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I looked into his CA. 1270 edits is extremely few for a user who is GA. Unfortunately this lowers my trust in this user even more. Maybe if the user was more involved cross-wiki I would change my mind, but unfortunately that is not the case. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:47, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I get that you look from the ground floor up. I have a more centered view from the MetaWiki and Discord. He is a trusted user who has been a great asset to the broader community. ::::I feel that you are gate keeping the local community, and that is your prerogative, but I think that PTW will benefit from his policy knowhow as well as his activity on the technical side. (Phorge) ::::On the other hand I find that waiting for first comments to arrive before answering on your own RfP doesn't make you to eager, as if one is collecting hats. I can assure you he's not. ::::I cannot take your concerns away, but hope you want to see it from the outside in, instead of the inside out.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:49, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::I do not believe in Quantity, but Quality. I can make 1000's of edits, but they do not tell much.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:50, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::::These are beautiful and classic words... However, can you explain to me why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions? Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW? I can't understand it. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:57, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::I think Zppix explains it perfectly. Being a Consul falls under different policies. Thus he needs to request permission to function here under the localpolcies.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   14:07, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::Hi, [[User:94.254.227.16|      ]] :::::::: I found your questions deeply compelling. As a result, I feel that I have gained a bit more understanding of Test Wiki. :::::::* '''Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW?''' :::::::As I understand it, Bureaucrat and Administrator are testing roles. As such, the roles cannot be used to uphold or enforce policy without creating confusion for the other Non Consuls within the community as to what is acceptable behavior. :::::::* '''why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions?''' :::::::Clearly PixDeVl recognizes that there is a distinction between a Consul role and a Non Consul role and will need the Consul role in order to provide the appropriate executive assistance. :::::::: You have raised a lot of other points that I will take into consideration, such as the low local edit count. Thank you for the extremely helpful and insightful observations. :::::::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:56, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I had far less edits back when I was a Global Sysop on Miraheze. Edits is not the end all be all. Further, it is clear to me that there is either a lack of understanding from you on the differences between having Global user rights and local user rights. For PixDeVI their use of global rights is governed by global Miraheze policy which dictates when and when they cannot use their global rights to intervene, but them asking for local rights it is allowing them to effectively not only help us Consuls, but also allow them to act based on our local policies outside of the governance of global policy requirements which can be restrictive and ultimately lead to relying on myself or another of the very few active Consuls which can lead to delays or even missed violations. ::::Please note my above comment does not reflect a vote but rather an observation of the discussion you have started. I neither endorse or oppose the candidate. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 14:04, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::The concern is not unfair; a user of this few edits both globally and locally seeking such a project leadership role is irregular, even with the precedent of [[Special:CentralAuth/subwayfares|subwayfares]] for wiki creation on Meta. Typically in a wiki that is fully independent this would be stranger as you would hope a leader is representative of the project, although there is merit to onboarding a trusted user in an advisory or supporting capacity. I would argue the key here is that this is ultimately a [[m:miraheze projects|Miraheze Project]]. I believe its identity as such should be a modifier for cases like this and that it is ideal for global functionaries to be more tightly bound with such a project, recommended in queue by wiki creators as it is with a domain currently hosted at WikiTide Foundation's grace. This may not be the ideal way to do it; my theory is to propose stewards as 'at large' consuls should locally invested members need a 'third opinion', more local consuls are involved and so on. Global administrators could perhaps fill the intermediary second line role bureaucrat serves, able to step in if there is backlog or an incident (short of something a GA/steward should step in for anyway). Otherwise there is a strong culture of 'separation of roles' at issue here and which is why pixel can't necessarily just jump in and do these things: it is not GS mandate. Therefore this request is an extension of his capabilities to reduce 'paperwork'. ::Essentially what I'm getting at is this request is reasonable, but skepticism of his investment in ''this'' local project holding such a role is also reasonable. And ideally, better tying the wiki to global operations through a community discussion is the best path in my opinion. The same for other projects such as dev and commons which already sort of act this way - zppix and alpad are local figures, reception and some others are global figures tied in, but as you see with the [[Special:ListUsers/consul|consul list]] it's a bit messy, outdated. ::Finally and drawing back a bit, there is no issue with an IP expressing these opinions. I would support their right to do so. I would also support a blocked user expressing a reasonable opinion to the degree I would offer to relay reasonable thoughts as food for thought even if they are blocked. An occasion where the IP editor and the blocked user overlap however is a very dangerous game that should discontinue immediately. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 23:22, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I agree with Raidarr. Test Wiki is structured very differently from other types of Wikis which makes it more difficult to identify or measure a candidate's qualifications by traditional means. :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:07, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' for {{ping|PixDeVl}}
What is meant by '''an extra hand helping keep things clean'''? What kind of things?
--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:45, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] TestWiki by its nature isn’t in dire need of conventional clean up work, but we have seen a recent uptick in issues where trolls go on mass desysoping sprees or otherwise cause a ruckus(something I believe Zppix has also wanted to address in policy), but as Raidarr said, PTW is an official Miraheze project, and as such, I don’t believe relying on really 2 activish functionaries to keep an eye on the place and make sure it’s tidy is viable or appropriate, hence my offering to take up the bit to properly police when issues come up beyond what’s included in the GA mandate and codified in local policy. Contrary to our anon friend, I do not claim to “need” these rights, I am offering to lend a hand to the small consul team in supplement to my other duties, and believe it would be beneficial to undergo this RFP to be able to do so without having to worry about global role scope ambiguity among other things. [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 15:00, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :::Thank you for answering my first question. :::[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' followup for {{ping|PixDeVl}} :::Hypothetically, if some disruptive activities were committed with the very best of intentions due to questionable judgement, how would you help wayward testers tweak their behavior before further violations take them straight to a permanent ban? :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:47, 6 March 2025 (UTC) ::::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] Should a user unknowingly or mistakenly violate the [[TW:Testing policy|Testing policy]], we should, as with any wiki, [[wp:assume good faith|assume good faith]] that they do not mean to purposely harm the project. That means contacting them in a civil tone to explain what they were doing and why it’s an issue, how to do whatever they want to do properly, and cleaning up. If they are acting in obvious bad faith or continue to be disruptive after multiple escalating warnings, only then should sanctions such as a serious block be applied ideally. [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 12:53, 6 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} Pix is one of the most promising young volunteers we've had in the nearly 6 years I've been aorund. I am glad to have the extra support for testwiki. [[User:RhinosF1|RhinosF1]] ([[User talk:RhinosF1|talk]]) 20:20, 7 March 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} ==Inactive Rights Removal - 2025-03-04== The rights of the following users will be removed on or after 2025-03-11 if they do not return to activity: *{{RFP/User|78-Yellowcat}} *{{RFP/User|AirmanKitten203}} *{{RFP/User|BasedKat09}} *{{RFP/User|BunnypranavClone}} *{{RFP/User|Cactus2}} Per my talk page. *{{RFP/User|Cactusalt}} Per my talk page. *{{RFP/User|Chqaz}} *{{RFP/User|Códigonombre Alguien}} *{{RFP/User|DarkMatterMan4500}} *{{RFP/User|Deverettm}} *{{RFP/User|EdwardLennox}} *{{RFP/User|Emmitt}} *{{RFP/User|Ericbomb}} *{{RFP/User|Excelsis}} *{{RFP/User|Fallen}} *{{RFP/User|Felenov}} *{{RFP/User|Harommel Rabbid}} *{{RFP/User|Hauber}} *{{RFP/User|JoséDeJesús}} *{{RFP/User|Ketra}} *{{RFP/User|Kittyguy210}} Per their talk page *{{RFP/User|Lana}} *{{RFP/User|Liaochina}} *{{RFP/User|Manomoney41}} *{{RFP/User|MarkRosenbaum}} *{{RFP/User|MatthewQuinnHui}} *{{RFP/User|MvGulik}} *{{RFP/User|Pasmorade}} *{{RFP/User|Pisces}} *{{RFP/User|Rafdodo}} *{{RFP/User|ShuuGyro}} *{{RFP/User|Talion77}} *{{RFP/User|Sizau}} *{{RFP/User|Skilsdhuo}} *{{RFP/User|Smileboy}} *{{RFP/User|Snowmanonahoe}} *{{RFP/User|Soulwater24}} *{{RFP/User|StellaDiamondMaskedWolf}} *{{RFP/User|Steverino}} *{{RFP/User|Stxrsprxte}} Thanks, :Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) :For the Consul Team :11:46, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ==Request for Feedback: Bureaucrats== {{discussion top|Closing as {{done|successful}}. The vast majority of users support the changes of policy with relation to [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats]]. With a successful RfC here, consuls will undertake a review of all active bureaucrats to determine which users will retain rights. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 20:36, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} While Bureaucrat has historically been implemented as a testing role, the low requirements for entry into the role coupled with broad/disruptive permission sets has made it a prime target for bad actors - repeat instances of malicious abuse of Bureaucrat permissions necessitating intervention by global volunteers has made clear that a change is needed. Simultaneously, the relatively small number of active testwiki Consuls has meant that policy enforcement activities haven't always gotten timely action and oversight, and assistance by trusted users is needed to keep testwiki operating as a true testing space. As such, this proposal aims to convert the Bureaucrat role from one of generic testing to one of moderate trust, eliminating the easy abuse vector while remaining readily achievable and providing consuls more support in day-to-day operations. The proposed changes to [[TW:Bureaucrats|TestWiki:Bureaucrats]] can be found [[User:Zppix/Draft/Bureaucrats#Proposed Page Text Changes|on this draft page]] under the Proposed Page Text Changes section. body:
{{Aan}} == Proposal : Demo bot proxy blocking on test wiki == Hello. There's currently an actively ongoing request to block many more proxies globally across all of Miraheze, it's supposed to be done already but in practice hasn't been taken care of that well. There's a new system upcoming designed to block more proxies by using Wikimedia's list. I would like to demo this on test wiki given that 1) it is a test wiki after all 2) there is a huge spam problem here. Any objections? Also, thoughts from consuls [[User:Reception123]] [[User:Void]] [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 21:03, 29 June 2022 (UTC) :I don’t believe this is a vote, but I would {{support}} this request. We can test this out here, and if it works we can expand to the rest of Miraheze in time. If not, no skin off our backs. I have faith this will work as we haven’t been great about blocking proxies in the past. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 23:48, 29 June 2022 (UTC) :: I would ideally like at least one consul to input before I place 40000+ blocks, that kind of thing is not easy to reverse. (Though they can be short i.e. ~1 week during the trial period, and only longer during longterm use). Any thoughts from uninvolved users so far? [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 19:18, 30 June 2022 (UTC) :{{Oppose|Strong}} I can not support this, a bot like this should ONLY be ran by a user whom has experience with global permissions on Miraheze, for example current or former CVT, Stewards, sysadmins, ect. A bot of this type has severe consequences if it has to many false positives, one that only those people would have experience handling. At this moment, Void has been working on a bot to handle this sort of thing. I have also been doing separate work on reviving Proxybot. This request is a complete no from me, and this vote will not change. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 20:31, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :: Void's sources missed proxies, which is why this request was started. There is currently only an import task, which I asked Reception123 to comment on. Also, this isn't a vote, so there's no vote to change. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 21:58, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::Also {{u|Zppix}}, I will note that you don’t have the authority to single-handedly overrule this request. Your comment is noted and has been added to the record, but you cannot overrule this request just because you oppose it. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 22:21, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::: They actually weren't trying to overrule it, they were just "voting" on a thing that wasn't a vote. Though I do note that they specifically defined experience as "current '''or former''' CVT" so that they would qualify but not me. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 22:24, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::::The reason I specified what I did is because those peoples would have experience with global permissions on Miraheze. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:51, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::Not the only one who doesn’t like this idea, consuls do talk to each other you know. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:50, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::From a technical perspective it is almost 100% impossible to not miss open proxies. Simply taking WMF’s block list is disruptive, as there are no checks in place to make sure said blocks are still valid. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:54, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::The entire point of a test wiki is to test. I wouldn’t be opposed to trying it out and seeing if it works. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 19:16, 3 July 2022 (UTC) == Consul request == Hello, I am asking if I could become a consul or not because I have done a lot of things. [[User:Cigaryno|Cigaryno]] ([[User talk:Cigaryno|talk]]) 17:49, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :Users can become consul after being elected. Your request however is very early and much more experienced and users who have been here for a long time aren't consuls. There are probably enough consuls right now as well so there's not really a need for any more. I'd advise against hat collecting. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 18:09, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::I will request in 3-6 weeks. [[User:Cigaryno|Cigaryno]] ([[User talk:Cigaryno|talk]]) 19:49, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::I really wouldn’t recommend that. You’d likely need at least 3-6 months of experience, as well as being an extremely trusted member of the community. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 22:22, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::Either way, as I say there's really no need for other Consuls right now in my opinion. Consul isn't something you set a 'target date' to become. As I say, please do resist the temptation to hat collect. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 13:43, 3 July 2022 (UTC) == Users unblocking themself == Hi all, Recently a user has been evading their topic ban multiple times, without any regard for the seriousness of this and reinforcing why it was made in the first place. I temporarily blocked this user for 3 days, and considered removing their sysop permissions to prevent them from unblocking themself but decided not to because I thought I could trust them not to. Apparently not, because they ended up unblocking themselves. While sysops do have the unblockself permission, my understanding of this is that it is supposed to be because of test blocks by sysops. I certainly don't think it is OK for users to be unblocking themselves as the recipient of actions, and I don't think anyone else would either. It doesn't appear anyone else has commented on this problem, as due to the recent stepping down of the two most active consuls. The only user who had a chance to review this problem only reviewed the technical aspects of it. As a result, I think the community should make a plan on how to handle this situation. Since there isn't an active community at this time, if there are not any objections from anyone (other than BrandonWM themself) I will reinstate the block as an emergency measure. While I was initially under the impression that this would constitute wheel warring, I realized that the policy generally only applies to other sysops reversing actions, and is not intended to apply to users receiving blocks, and this would almost certainly be considered block evasion by any reasonable person. However, I don't have any plans on how to solve this problem long-term, other than either via removing unblockself from sysops (might cause problems for testing blocks?) or a bot that removes them (depending on who blocked). [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 03:39, 19 September 2022 (UTC) :I suggest that only bureaucrats and consuls have this right. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 18:12, 19 September 2022 (UTC) :We may create another blocking level rather than current blocks which only available for crat's and consuls. Current blocks may use for testing purposes. —[[User:MdsShakil|MdsShakil]] ([[User talk:MdsShakil|talk]]) 05:16, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::Since I don't think another blocking level is possible, my suggestion would be to use wgRevokePermissions and to create a new group that can be assigned to users blocked for serious reasons so that they are unable to unblock themselves. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 06:24, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::It's a good idea, I agree! [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 11:32, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::: At that point, why not simply remove the sysop permissions? [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:27, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::: Also, does the community believe BrandonWM's block was valid? I had said before if there were no objections I would reblock them. One user claimed the block was a "clear error" but did not have a convincing case as to why. I think the topic ban violation is clearly verifiable, see [[User_talk:BrandonWM|talk page]] for that, and does not appear to be in error. I would assume by the comments the community agrees it is valid but most people are talking about the problem in general and not this specific case. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:28, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::I forgot to mention, that even if admins don't have the right to unblock themselves, if it's a partial block the user isn't considered "blocked" so they can still do it. Probably only removing administrator permission is feasibility. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 16:35, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::: It's also worth noting that it appears that if you have talk page access on you can also delete and protect your talk page. For the rest, there is the matter of respect and honor for their either years of service or for founding this wiki. This latest attempt to remove a great base of consuls would radically turn TestWiki upside down by concentrating power with a very small number of newer users who may steer the project contrary to the global project goal. [[User:Agent Isai|'''Agent Isai''']] [[m:User talk:Agent Isai|'''Talk to me!''']] 15:58, 11 September 2024 (UTC)
== FYI: Broken Link posted by BZPN.bot == I'm reporting a broken link that was posted to talk pages by [[User:BZPN.bot]]. It doesn't bring the clicker to this thread as intended.
An example of the Image with Broken Link is here: :* https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/User_talk:NDKilla#c-BZPN.bot-20240911090000-Join_the_Public_TestWiki_Discord_server! When I clicked on the giant image, it sent me to Community portal
instead of TestWiki:Community_portal#Discord_server: :* Community portal - TestWiki (publictestwiki.com) :* https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/Community_portal :* [[mh:test:Community portal]] Whereas the Site Notice Join the Discussion brought me to this thread :* Replying on TestWiki:Community portal - TestWiki (publictestwiki.com) :* https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/TestWiki:Community_portal#Discord_server :* [[mh:test:TestWiki:Community_portal#Discord_server]] --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:44, 17 September 2024 (UTC) :TL;DR FYI: Broken Link posted by BZPN.bot :* [[File:Green_check.svg|20px]] Join the Discussion (blue button on Site Notice) :*: Link goes to [[mh:test:TestWiki:Community_portal#Discord_server|TestWiki:Community_portal#Discord_server]] :* [[File:Dark Red x.svg|20px]] [[File:TW Discord.png|100px|link=Community portal]] :*: Link goes to TestWiki:[[mh:test:Community portal|Community_portal]]#Discord_server :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:08, 17 September 2024 (UTC) ::It happened to me [[User:Cactusisme|Cactusisme]] ([[User talk:Cactusisme|talk]]) 08:25, 18 September 2024 (UTC) :::It's now a moot point regardless, consensus based on above conversation is that there will be a PTW specific channel on the main miraheze discord rather than continuing with the standalone discord, the bot notice can be disregarded. --[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 22:34, 20 September 2024 (UTC) ::::hmm okay. [[User:Cactusisme|'''Cactus🌵''']] [[User talk:Cactusisme|spiky]] [[Special:Contributions/Cactusisme|ouch]] 07:17, 22 September 2024 (UTC) == Add PTW Discord Channel to Miraheze Server? == Just continuing my thought shared in * https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/TestWiki:Community_portal#c-Imamy-20240918013600-BZPN-20240911133400 * https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/TestWiki:Community_portal#c-AlPaD-20240918115000-Imamy-20240918013600 ::: Related Topics :::* [[TestWiki:Community_portal#Public_Test_Wiki_Discord_Server_is_Live!|PTW Discord Server is Live!]] :::* [[TestWiki:Community_portal#Discord_server| PTW Discord Server]] I looked at Miraheze Discord Server. I see the PTW channel for Recent Changes. I was thinking more of a Chat Channel similar to "OffTopic" where PTW members can congregate and discuss PTW concerns. They can hang out and then hop over to the PTW Discord together. It will be easier to find PTW related discussions if a PTW Channel were set up on Miraheze Discord Server.
--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 00:28, 22 September 2024 (UTC) :This seems to have adequate support based on the previous discussion, and there is basis to do dev and commons at the same time; the communities to consult are far smaller. When someone discord side has a good moment and/or someone handy to bridge existing irc venues, this will likely be completed. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 18:38, 25 September 2024 (UTC) == Abuse filter operator for Codename Noreste == {{discussion top|Successful [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 21:05, 29 September 2024 (UTC)}} :{{userlinks2|Codename Noreste}} Hello, everyone. I have maintained several abuse filters here, on [https://testwiki.wiki/wiki/Special:AbuseFilter Test Wiki] (where I am an abuse filter administrator over there), and [I authored some abuse filters] on [[:w:en:User:Codename Noreste|Wikimedia]] (where I am a global abuse filter helper), and I am applying for the abuse filter operator right to enable restricted actions '''only''' when there is consensus to do so here, and to fix a restricted filter's code if there are false positives. For example, I have a new filter idea that can block NTSAMR spambot accounts and IP addresses on sight who add double linebreaks in various namespaces. I apologize if I am not active as much on this project due to college, but I understand that this is a very high trust permission and can be revoked if used improperly (e.g. setting a filter to block good-faith users). Comments are welcome. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] 🤔 [[User talk:Codename Noreste|''Talk'']] 15:51, 27 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support}} I wouldn't say Codename Noreste is "highly active" here, but they do demonstrate knowledge of the workings of abuse filters. Considering they have been bureaucrat for nine months and made good contributions, I support this. [[User:Spacing form|Spacing form]] ([[User talk:Spacing form|talk]]) 14:02, 28 September 2024 (UTC) :{{support}}, why not? {{ping|AlPaD}} courtesy ping. [[User:Justarandomamerican|Justarandomamerican]] ([[User talk:Justarandomamerican|talk]]) 16:12, 29 September 2024 (UTC) {{discussion bottom}} == Proposal to set filter 76 to block == {{discussion top|{{done}}. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] 🤔 [[User talk:Codename Noreste|''Talk'']] 22:15, 30 September 2024 (UTC)}} As the section title suggests, does anyone have no objections if I enable filter 76 and set it to disallow and block? [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] 🤔 [[User talk:Codename Noreste|''Talk'']] 22:46, 29 September 2024 (UTC) :I don't recall if private filters have public titles when not triggered(Global Admin grants view private filter), but I think that's fine. Likely not too bad a block, long enough for the spammer to get bored and leave and be indef'ed if we want. I'm not quite sure why & page_id == 0 & is in the filter though? [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 23:09, 29 September 2024 (UTC) ::[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]], page_id == 0 makes the filter detect new page creations. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] 🤔 [[User talk:Codename Noreste|''Talk'']] 23:13, 29 September 2024 (UTC) ::: Oh, makes sense, thanks. I'm not sure if it's explicitly needed(I don't think we have that in the global filter), but I don't really care. I'd leave it to you to decide. {{S}} the idea though. --[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 23:18, 29 September 2024 (UTC) ::::Given that there's no objections to this, I'm implementing the action right now... [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] 🤔 [[User talk:Codename Noreste|''Talk'']] 22:11, 30 September 2024 (UTC) {{discussion bottom}} == Rename request == Can I be renamed to "TheAstorPastor" as I use it through almost everywhere including Wikimedia? [[User:Harvici|Harvici]] ([[User talk:Harvici|''talk'']]) 14:25, 1 December 2024 (UTC) : Hi {{ping|Harvici}} :: [[m:User:TheAstorPastor]] appears to be taken. :: If it were available, you could make a request [[m:Requesting Username Changes|here]]. : --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 00:53, 2 December 2024 (UTC) ::Well that account is operated by me ; I haven't realized it up until yesterday [[User:Harvici|Harvici]] ([[User talk:Harvici|''talk'']]) 09:21, 2 December 2024 (UTC) ::Is there any option to merge the accounts, and the name TheAstorPastor takes precedence ; I have 0 contribs through TheAstorPastor btw [[User:Harvici|Harvici]] ([[User talk:Harvici|''talk'']]) 09:22, 2 December 2024 (UTC) :::best to take it up with the stewards about it as miraheze Meta is the best place for global stuff [[User:339Breakingoof|TheFunny339YoshiPlushGuy]] ([[User talk:339Breakingoof|talk]]) 19:12, 2 December 2024 (UTC) == Add [[Move Test Target]] == Would be a small change to the [[Move test]] so we have an actual defined target.
