{{/header}} [[Category:Non-test pages]]
__NEWSECTIONLINK__ == New Testing idea == We should have a change content model test page! Do you agree? [[User:MyScratchedAccount|MyScratchedAccount]] ([[User talk:MyScratchedAccount|talk]]) 23:53, 14 December 2024 (UTC) :Hi {{ping|MyScratchedAccount}} How does the content change? :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 00:40, 16 December 2024 (UTC) ::I mean the content change special page where you can select a page to change the type of content model for that spefic page like wiki text and plain text, and a few others, so we could create a page to test that feature on. [[User:MyScratchedAccount|MyScratchedAccount]] ([[User talk:MyScratchedAccount|talk]]) 01:33, 16 December 2024 (UTC) :::That would be cool. That might make it easier to know what pages are okay to change the appearance of. :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:55, 16 December 2024 (UTC) == Help panel question on [[:Sandbox|Sandbox]] (08:25, 26 December 2024) == Test help desk from editor mentor growth too, test --[[User:MyScratchedAccount|MyScratchedAccount]] ([[User talk:MyScratchedAccount|talk]]) 08:25, 26 December 2024 (UTC) == You should use NewUserMessage to put the {{Welcome}} welcome message automatically == You should use the NewUserMessage plugin to put the {{Welcome}} welcome message on everyone’s talk page automatically when they sign up or log in here, without someone having to put the {{Welcome}} template manualky [[User:MyScratchedAccount|MyScratchedAccount]] ([[User talk:MyScratchedAccount|talk]]) 04:33, 29 December 2024 (UTC) == Request for Consul == I have made constructive non-test edits and I am a bureaucrat so should I become a consul? [[User:MiraEdit|MiraEdit]] ([[User talk:MiraEdit|talk]]) 23:04, 2 February 2025 (UTC) :: Please review the terms on the Test Wiki Main page [[TestWiki]], specifically the rules listed in the section [[TestWiki#Things to keep in mind]]. If you are not sure which rule was violated, you should reach out to [[m:Steward requests]] or discuss at the [[m:Community portal]]. : --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:44, 3 February 2025 (UTC) ::: I know my answer didn't really answer your question, but basically, every wiki is different. Please learn more about Test Wiki if you really want to become a Consul. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:47, 3 February 2025 (UTC) == Refreshing created a test page == I was told my test page was labeled abusive because it was short and had "bad words." I opted to use the preview bar instead. Later I refreshed the page (F5) and for some reason that created it. No bad words, but the page will probably be gone by the time you see this. Posting because it said to log an issue [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 01:57, 15 February 2025 (UTC) == Can't undo == All of a sudden, I can't undo. I even went to contributions and reverted from there, but the pages still exist and have the content [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 04:30, 18 February 2025 (UTC) :Don't know which pages you are referring to. I could be wrong, but generally, we can rollback 1 and if someone has already contributed after your contribution, then rollback is not possible. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 25 February 2025 (UTC) == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 18:36, 3 March 2025 (UTC) :'''Update: the updated [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Blocking policy|blocking policy]]''' is now in effect as of Monday, March 2nd 6:16PM UTC-6. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:45, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] Could you summarize the changes made? Thanks! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::@[[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] Consuls, CVT, and Stewards are the only ones authorized to issue non-test blocks, test blocks can now only be done on accounts the user controls or on approved test accounts, appeals are only done via the blocked user’s talk page, or by emailing the blocking Consul, third party appeals are no longer accepted. I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! I obviously do not object the policy, just wanted your say on what you changed. :) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:08, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::ZPPIX WHY DO YOU KEEP MAKING POLICY CHANGES WITHOUT CONSENSUS! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 21:05, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::I do this as well on a local wiki that isn't the test one as an admin that can enforce and change rules around to keep it up to date like yes communities are needed but not for everything that are granted rights to staff. [[User:339Breakingoof|TheFunny339YoshiPlushGuy]] ([[User talk:339Breakingoof|talk]]) 13:38, 9 May 2025 (UTC) == Request for Consul (PixDeVl) == {{Discussion top|{{done}}, welcome to the Consul team. Please reach out if you have any questions. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 11:26, 9 March 2025 (UTC)}} Hi folks, I’m filing this Request for Consul, frankly because I noticed that we currently have only 2 remotely active Consuls, being Zppix and Reception, and, even with something like PTW, having an official project wiki be run by two folks isn’t great, so I’d thought I’d offer to lend a hand. I am not very active priorly with what exists of the community on PTW, but as a current global functionary, I still think it wouldn’t hurt to have an extra hand helping keep things clean. Feel free to ask any questions regarding this, as always :) —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 03:35, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}}  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   03:39, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} trusted user. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:38, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I looked into his CA. 1270 edits is extremely few for a user who is GA. Unfortunately this lowers my trust in this user even more. Maybe if the user was more involved cross-wiki I would change my mind, but unfortunately that is not the case. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:47, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I get that you look from the ground floor up. I have a more centered view from the MetaWiki and Discord. He is a trusted user who has been a great asset to the broader community. ::::I feel that you are gate keeping the local community, and that is your prerogative, but I think that PTW will benefit from his policy knowhow as well as his activity on the technical side. (Phorge) ::::On the other hand I find that waiting for first comments to arrive before answering on your own RfP doesn't make you to eager, as if one is collecting hats. I can assure you he's not. ::::I cannot take your concerns away, but hope you want to see it from the outside in, instead of the inside out.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:49, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::I do not believe in Quantity, but Quality. I can make 1000's of edits, but they do not tell much.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:50, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::::These are beautiful and classic words... However, can you explain to me why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions? Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW? I can't understand it. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:57, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::I think Zppix explains it perfectly. Being a Consul falls under different policies. Thus he needs to request permission to function here under the localpolcies.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   14:07, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::Hi, [[User:94.254.227.16|      ]] :::::::: I found your questions deeply compelling. As a result, I feel that I have gained a bit more understanding of Test Wiki. :::::::* '''Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW?''' :::::::As I understand it, Bureaucrat and Administrator are testing roles. As such, the roles cannot be used to uphold or enforce policy without creating confusion for the other Non Consuls within the community as to what is acceptable behavior. :::::::* '''why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions?''' :::::::Clearly PixDeVl recognizes that there is a distinction between a Consul role and a Non Consul role and will need the Consul role in order to provide the appropriate executive assistance. :::::::: You have raised a lot of other points that I will take into consideration, such as the low local edit count. Thank you for the extremely helpful and insightful observations. :::::::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:56, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I had far less edits back when I was a Global Sysop on Miraheze. Edits is not the end all be all. Further, it is clear to me that there is either a lack of understanding from you on the differences between having Global user rights and local user rights. For PixDeVI their use of global rights is governed by global Miraheze policy which dictates when and when they cannot use their global rights to intervene, but them asking for local rights it is allowing them to effectively not only help us Consuls, but also allow them to act based on our local policies outside of the governance of global policy requirements which can be restrictive and ultimately lead to relying on myself or another of the very few active Consuls which can lead to delays or even missed violations. ::::Please note my above comment does not reflect a vote but rather an observation of the discussion you have started. I neither endorse or oppose the candidate. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 14:04, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::The concern is not unfair; a user of this few edits both globally and locally seeking such a project leadership role is irregular, even with the precedent of [[Special:CentralAuth/subwayfares|subwayfares]] for wiki creation on Meta. Typically in a wiki that is fully independent this would be stranger as you would hope a leader is representative of the project, although there is merit to onboarding a trusted user in an advisory or supporting capacity. I would argue the key here is that this is ultimately a [[m:miraheze projects|Miraheze Project]]. I believe its identity as such should be a modifier for cases like this and that it is ideal for global functionaries to be more tightly bound with such a project, recommended in queue by wiki creators as it is with a domain currently hosted at WikiTide Foundation's grace. This may not be the ideal way to do it; my theory is to propose stewards as 'at large' consuls should locally invested members need a 'third opinion', more local consuls are involved and so on. Global administrators could perhaps fill the intermediary second line role bureaucrat serves, able to step in if there is backlog or an incident (short of something a GA/steward should step in for anyway). Otherwise there is a strong culture of 'separation of roles' at issue here and which is why pixel can't necessarily just jump in and do these things: it is not GS mandate. Therefore this request is an extension of his capabilities to reduce 'paperwork'. ::Essentially what I'm getting at is this request is reasonable, but skepticism of his investment in ''this'' local project holding such a role is also reasonable. And ideally, better tying the wiki to global operations through a community discussion is the best path in my opinion. The same for other projects such as dev and commons which already sort of act this way - zppix and alpad are local figures, reception and some others are global figures tied in, but as you see with the [[Special:ListUsers/consul|consul list]] it's a bit messy, outdated. ::Finally and drawing back a bit, there is no issue with an IP expressing these opinions. I would support their right to do so. I would also support a blocked user expressing a reasonable opinion to the degree I would offer to relay reasonable thoughts as food for thought even if they are blocked. An occasion where the IP editor and the blocked user overlap however is a very dangerous game that should discontinue immediately. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 23:22, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I agree with Raidarr. Test Wiki is structured very differently from other types of Wikis which makes it more difficult to identify or measure a candidate's qualifications by traditional means. :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:07, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' for {{ping|PixDeVl}}

{{Aan}} == Proposal : Demo bot proxy blocking on test wiki == Hello. There's currently an actively ongoing request to block many more proxies globally across all of Miraheze, it's supposed to be done already but in practice hasn't been taken care of that well. There's a new system upcoming designed to block more proxies by using Wikimedia's list. I would like to demo this on test wiki given that 1) it is a test wiki after all 2) there is a huge spam problem here. Any objections? Also, thoughts from consuls [[User:Reception123]] [[User:Void]] [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 21:03, 29 June 2022 (UTC) :I don’t believe this is a vote, but I would {{support}} this request. We can test this out here, and if it works we can expand to the rest of Miraheze in time. If not, no skin off our backs. I have faith this will work as we haven’t been great about blocking proxies in the past. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 23:48, 29 June 2022 (UTC) :: I would ideally like at least one consul to input before I place 40000+ blocks, that kind of thing is not easy to reverse. (Though they can be short i.e. ~1 week during the trial period, and only longer during longterm use). Any thoughts from uninvolved users so far? [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 19:18, 30 June 2022 (UTC) :{{Oppose|Strong}} I can not support this, a bot like this should ONLY be ran by a user whom has experience with global permissions on Miraheze, for example current or former CVT, Stewards, sysadmins, ect. A bot of this type has severe consequences if it has to many false positives, one that only those people would have experience handling. At this moment, Void has been working on a bot to handle this sort of thing. I have also been doing separate work on reviving Proxybot. This request is a complete no from me, and this vote will not change. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 20:31, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :: Void's sources missed proxies, which is why this request was started. There is currently only an import task, which I asked Reception123 to comment on. Also, this isn't a vote, so there's no vote to change. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 21:58, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::Also {{u|Zppix}}, I will note that you don’t have the authority to single-handedly overrule this request. Your comment is noted and has been added to the record, but you cannot overrule this request just because you oppose it. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 22:21, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::: They actually weren't trying to overrule it, they were just "voting" on a thing that wasn't a vote. Though I do note that they specifically defined experience as "current '''or former''' CVT" so that they would qualify but not me. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 22:24, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::::The reason I specified what I did is because those peoples would have experience with global permissions on Miraheze. That being said, I'm always available on Discord and if there's ever any issue that requires a Consul I'm able to respond quickly. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 15:34, 11 September 2024 (UTC) ::You DO know that Reception was the original requestor of PublicTestWiki... right? This is such a bizarre claim... ::--[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 15:49, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :::I DO. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 16:04, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support|Strong}} Reception is a huge help in the community, and removing rights is not the correct action to take here, they have more than demonstrated their commitment to Miraheze. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 15:42, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support|Strong}} I'm confused why a user that only got their consul rights yesterday is now so violently opposed to existing precedent of exempting major platform-wide volunteers in a narrow view of local policy. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 15:53, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{support}} Reception has been a huge help globally and on TestWiki (he originally requested the wiki), and I see no reason not to grant an exception. [[User:Justarandomamerican|Justarandomamerican]] ([[User talk:Justarandomamerican|talk]]) 15:52, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support}} To me, it is perfectly reasonable '''for the founder of this very wiki''' to have an exemption to the inactivity policy. [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 15:54, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{support}} Changing as as didn't know he was the Test Wiki requester and seeing his contributions globally it's very good and make sense. [[User:Xaloria|Xaloria]] ([[User talk:Xaloria|talk]]) 15:54, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support|strongest}} I appreciate BZPN's eagerness to help maintain TestWiki but their recent actions have been a bit brazen. body:
{{Aan}} == Proposal : Demo bot proxy blocking on test wiki == Hello. There's currently an actively ongoing request to block many more proxies globally across all of Miraheze, it's supposed to be done already but in practice hasn't been taken care of that well. There's a new system upcoming designed to block more proxies by using Wikimedia's list. I would like to demo this on test wiki given that 1) it is a test wiki after all 2) there is a huge spam problem here. Any objections? Also, thoughts from consuls [[User:Reception123]] [[User:Void]] [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 21:03, 29 June 2022 (UTC) :I don’t believe this is a vote, but I would {{support}} this request. We can test this out here, and if it works we can expand to the rest of Miraheze in time. If not, no skin off our backs. I have faith this will work as we haven’t been great about blocking proxies in the past. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 23:48, 29 June 2022 (UTC) :: I would ideally like at least one consul to input before I place 40000+ blocks, that kind of thing is not easy to reverse. (Though they can be short i.e. ~1 week during the trial period, and only longer during longterm use). Any thoughts from uninvolved users so far? [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 19:18, 30 June 2022 (UTC) :{{Oppose|Strong}} I can not support this, a bot like this should ONLY be ran by a user whom has experience with global permissions on Miraheze, for example current or former CVT, Stewards, sysadmins, ect. A bot of this type has severe consequences if it has to many false positives, one that only those people would have experience handling. At this moment, Void has been working on a bot to handle this sort of thing. I have also been doing separate work on reviving Proxybot. This request is a complete no from me, and this vote will not change. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 20:31, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :: Void's sources missed proxies, which is why this request was started. There is currently only an import task, which I asked Reception123 to comment on. Also, this isn't a vote, so there's no vote to change. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 21:58, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::Also {{u|Zppix}}, I will note that you don’t have the authority to single-handedly overrule this request. Your comment is noted and has been added to the record, but you cannot overrule this request just because you oppose it. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 22:21, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::: They actually weren't trying to overrule it, they were just "voting" on a thing that wasn't a vote. Though I do note that they specifically defined experience as "current '''or former''' CVT" so that they would qualify but not me. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 22:24, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::::The reason I specified what I did is because those peoples would have experience with global permissions on Miraheze. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:51, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::Not the only one who doesn’t like this idea, consuls do talk to each other you know. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:50, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::From a technical perspective it is almost 100% impossible to not miss open proxies. Simply taking WMF’s block list is disruptive, as there are no checks in place to make sure said blocks are still valid. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:54, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::The entire point of a test wiki is to test. I wouldn’t be opposed to trying it out and seeing if it works. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 19:16, 3 July 2022 (UTC) == Consul request == Hello, I am asking if I could become a consul or not because I have done a lot of things. [[User:Cigaryno|Cigaryno]] ([[User talk:Cigaryno|talk]]) 17:49, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :Users can become consul after being elected. Your request however is very early and much more experienced and users who have been here for a long time aren't consuls. There are probably enough consuls right now as well so there's not really a need for any more. I'd advise against hat collecting. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 18:09, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::I will request in 3-6 weeks. [[User:Cigaryno|Cigaryno]] ([[User talk:Cigaryno|talk]]) 19:49, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::I really wouldn’t recommend that. You’d likely need at least 3-6 months of experience, as well as being an extremely trusted member of the community. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 22:22, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::Either way, as I say there's really no need for other Consuls right now in my opinion. Consul isn't something you set a 'target date' to become. As I say, please do resist the temptation to hat collect. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 13:43, 3 July 2022 (UTC) == Users unblocking themself == Hi all, Recently a user has been evading their topic ban multiple times, without any regard for the seriousness of this and reinforcing why it was made in the first place. I temporarily blocked this user for 3 days, and considered removing their sysop permissions to prevent them from unblocking themself but decided not to because I thought I could trust them not to. Apparently not, because they ended up unblocking themselves. While sysops do have the unblockself permission, my understanding of this is that it is supposed to be because of test blocks by sysops. I certainly don't think it is OK for users to be unblocking themselves as the recipient of actions, and I don't think anyone else would either. It doesn't appear anyone else has commented on this problem, as due to the recent stepping down of the two most active consuls. The only user who had a chance to review this problem only reviewed the technical aspects of it. As a result, I think the community should make a plan on how to handle this situation. Since there isn't an active community at this time, if there are not any objections from anyone (other than BrandonWM themself) I will reinstate the block as an emergency measure. While I was initially under the impression that this would constitute wheel warring, I realized that the policy generally only applies to other sysops reversing actions, and is not intended to apply to users receiving blocks, and this would almost certainly be considered block evasion by any reasonable person. However, I don't have any plans on how to solve this problem long-term, other than either via removing unblockself from sysops (might cause problems for testing blocks?) or a bot that removes them (depending on who blocked). [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 03:39, 19 September 2022 (UTC) :I suggest that only bureaucrats and consuls have this right. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 18:12, 19 September 2022 (UTC) :We may create another blocking level rather than current blocks which only available for crat's and consuls. Current blocks may use for testing purposes. —[[User:MdsShakil|MdsShakil]] ([[User talk:MdsShakil|talk]]) 05:16, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::Since I don't think another blocking level is possible, my suggestion would be to use wgRevokePermissions and to create a new group that can be assigned to users blocked for serious reasons so that they are unable to unblock themselves. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 06:24, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::It's a good idea, I agree! [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 11:32, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::: At that point, why not simply remove the sysop permissions? [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:27, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::: Also, does the community believe BrandonWM's block was valid? I had said before if there were no objections I would reblock them. One user claimed the block was a "clear error" but did not have a convincing case as to why. I think the topic ban violation is clearly verifiable, see [[User_talk:BrandonWM|talk page]] for that, and does not appear to be in error. I would assume by the comments the community agrees it is valid but most people are talking about the problem in general and not this specific case. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:28, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::I forgot to mention, that even if admins don't have the right to unblock themselves, if it's a partial block the user isn't considered "blocked" so they can still do it. Probably only removing administrator permission is feasibility. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 16:35, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::: It's also worth noting that it appears that if you have talk page access on you can also delete and protect your talk page. Also also, a blocked user who is a sysop can still block the person who blocked them, this change is because of compromised sysop accounts. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:40, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::Again, you seem to be ignoring the fact that Void had the hard-line restrictions removed. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 23:40, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::::::BrandonWM, you are correct, as per what is clearly stated on your talk page both by myself and Void. :::::::Everyone else, please check his talk page before jumping to conclusions and give him a break. I regret blocking him.￼ [[User:Kiko4564|Kiko4564]] ([[User talk:Kiko4564|talk]]) 07:41, 21 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::: Void did not remove the restrictions. They removed Kiko4564's block and suggested reducing the restrictions. ''You'' are ignoring the fact that you violated your topic ban and also unblocked yourself, which is a much more important problem. In addition, a consul has already participated in this discussion and proposed a solution to the problem of users unblocking themself, despite Kiko4564 pretending it was completely fine for users to do that as long as they themself believe the block was wrong. And even if they were removed, you still violated them prior to that comment. Trying to excuse the fact that you violated the topic ban and also the fact that the edits were disruptive just reinforces why there was a need for a topic ban to have been made in the first place. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:01, 21 September 2022 (UTC) :Per our conversation on [[mh:m:IRC|IRC]], I am posting my rationale for using the unblockself permission. I believe the block was wrongly made and poorly justified. I had received messages of support from other crats in the hours before using the permission, and as such I felt comfortable in using it. If I had been alone in believing the block was wrong, I wouldn't have removed it, and instead elected to wait for another member of the community to remove the block. Void had also removed the hard-line restrictions, and as my edits were non-disruptive, there was no need for a block. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 04:44, 22 September 2022 (UTC) :: This is not true at all. :: {{tq|I had received messages of support from other crats in the hours before using the permission}} Actually, no, you received [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:BrandonWM&action=history&offset=20220914235959&limit=3 no such messages] between [[special:redirect/logid/25100|being blocked]] and [[special:redirect/logid/25104|unblocking yourself]]. There were no messages of support from other crats when you decided on your own it was wrong and removed it. Even after the fact only one person agreed that it was OK for you to unblock yourself (not "other crats" plural) - with four users including a consul agreeing it was not OK. :: {{tq|and as such I felt comfortable in using it}} You shouldn't have. It will never be OK for a user to unblock themself, especially as seen in this discussion. If it was really that bad someone else will. There's no need for you to remove it yourself. :: {{tq|If I had been alone in believing the block was wrong, I wouldn't have removed it}} You were. And if you weren't, why didn't those people remove it? :: {{tq|Void had also removed the hard-line restrictions}} Again, Void did not remove the restrictions. What Void actually said was: {{tq|I propose the restriction be reduced down to a general recommendation against making any "official" style changes without prior on-wiki approval, and an understanding that less leniency will be given in the event of future disruption. }} - the restrictions were not removed and remain in effect. In addition, I would call this the less leniency in the event of future disruption, as will be seen soon. :: {{tq|s my edits were non-disruptive}} Firstly, it doesn't matter whether they were disruptive. You violated your topic ban and that's not okay. Topic bans are enforced by blocking the user if they violate it. If you believed you could have made good edits in those areas, you should have requested removal, not simply violated it. As explained before, {{tq|A ban is not merely a request to avoid editing "unless they behave". The measure of a ban is that even if the editor were to make good edits, permitting them to edit in those areas is perceived to pose enough risk of disruption, issues, or harm, that they may not edit at all, even if the edits seem good.}}. Amen. I don't think I could have said it better myself. :: And secondly, they '''were''' disruptive. For example [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=TestWiki:Request_permissions&diff=prev&oldid=46125 this unnecessary removal], [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=TestWiki:Request_permissions&diff=44628&oldid=44627 this innapropriate self-handling], and [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=TestWiki:Request_permissions&diff=next&oldid=44780 interacting with other users]. :: Because of this, I do not see any valid justification for your actions. In addition, several users have agreed it is not okay for recipients of non-test blocks to unblock themselves, instead taking any of their concerns to a bureaucrat or consul. In addition, the original block has not been proven to be incorrect, and continues to only show to be more and more justified with the user attempting to justify their topic-ban evasion and justification of self-unblocks, repeating the behavior that led to that in the first place and reminding me of why they were blocked and locked originally in 2020, despite their claims to have changed. Because of this, I propose that the original block is reinstated. Please leave your thoughts and / or concerns below. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 04:58, 22 September 2022 (UTC) :::In which case [[User:Naleksuh]], please wait for a Consul to attend to this incident and deal with this directly, instead of wheel warring with a Consul over whether or not [[User:BrandonWM]] ought to be blocked or not, even partially. I've blocked [[User:BrandonWM]] myself, and all I said was that if [[User:Void]] deemed it fit to remove the block I imposed, then so be it, and if you don't think that [[User:BrandonWM]] should've been unblocked, then you were in the wrong to engage in a wheel war, and therefore (on this occasion) [[User:BrandonWM]] was right to remove the block because: 1) it was wrong, having resulted from clear cut wheel warring and based on restrictions which had already been removed and 2) I agreed that it was right to remove it since I believed that it was a clear cut mistake. If the incident isn't serious enough to warrant desysoping, then my opinion is that it cannot serious enough to warrant a serious block. However I could be wrong. If you disagree, then please discuss the matter civilly instead of wheel warring. I never pretended that it was OK for an admin to unblock themselves just because they disagree with the block. If it were, then almost everyone would unblock themselves. Thanks. [[User:Kiko4564|Kiko4564]] ([[User talk:Kiko4564|talk]]) 23:11, 23 September 2022 (UTC) :::: {{tq|discuss the matter civilly instead of wheel warring}} I did not wheel war. BrandonWM removed the block, and it has not been reinstated since. It may be reinstated when this discussion is closed, as consensus is that it is not okay for users to unblock themself. But I certainly have not wheel warred. In fact, this thread was specifically to avoid doing so. :::: {{tq|BrandonWM was right to remove the block}} Consensus is in this thread that it is never okay for serious-blocked users to unblock themself. There will never be a situation in which '''the user who was blocked''' {{tq|was right to remove the block}}. And even if there was, this situation would not be one of them. :::: {{tq|restrictions which had already been removed}} For the '''''third time''''', Void specifically said they ''proposed'' removing the restrictions, which did not gain much support and I personally would oppose. As of now the restrictions remain in effect. Please stop saying they were removed both because Void did '''not''' say that and even if they did I'm not sure consuls are allowed to unliterally do that. :::: To any uninvolved consuls now is a good time to close this discussion which has already run its course. Four users including a consul agree that self-unblocks are not OK, and by extension I believe they should be considered block evasion. In the words of Reception123 one of the uninvolved participants and a consul, {{tq|[They] should've just asked another bureaucrat or consul though, not taken things into [their] own hands}} [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 00:51, 24 September 2022 (UTC) :::::Alright, we'll agree to disagree then. I'm just saying that had you continued, the result would've been a wheel war. Thanks for not doing that. I'll let Void explain their actions personally. [[User:Kiko4564|Kiko4564]] ([[User talk:Kiko4564|talk]]) 11:14, 24 September 2022 (UTC) == AutoImport and old requests for permissions == Hello! This bot has archived the topics in Archive 12 instead of archive 13. Could someone please see it? Thanks! [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 06:25, 28 September 2022 (UTC) == Request for Consulship == {{discussion top|1=When one dusts off this old request, they find it was successful. -- [[User:Void|Void]] [[User talk:Void|''Whispers'']] 03:21, 31 December 2022 (UTC)}} Hi everyone, I'm Agent Isai and I'm requesting local consul here on testwiki. While I'm not the most active here on TestWiki due to my other global responsibilities such as being a Steward, I do check in every so often and generally have to look in to this wiki every few days due to other cross-wiki cases such as abuse by socks and so on. The reason for requesting the bit is because the current Consuls seem to be inactive. Dmehus used to be the main handler of things like inactivity demotions but he, nor has anyone else, handled this since May which is concerning. There are also a few other tasks which sometimes seem to drag on due to the inactivity of the current consuls so I'd like to help the upkeep of this community which is vital to Miraheze as it serves as a testbed for many users. Thank you for your consideration. [[User:Agent Isai|'''Agent Isai''']] [[m:User talk:Agent Isai|'''Talk to me!''']] 14:46, 4 November 2022 (UTC) #{{Support}} Trusted, experienced, active user and steward. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 14:53, 4 November 2022 (UTC) #{{s}} --[[User:Syunsyunminmin|Syunsyunminmin]] ([[User talk:Syunsyunminmin|talk]]) 14:59, 6 November 2022 (UTC) #Question: Regarding RFP, you declined an RFP who used the reason For testing asking what testing they wanted to do, but accepted an RFP with the reason Testing with no questions just 27 hours later. Any reason for the inconsistency? [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 00:17, 10 November 2022 (UTC) #:As I said on #miraheze-cvt, I asked for clarification about the first user's RfP as they already had an account with bureaucrat and sysop so I was wondering what they needed to test with yet a second account. As for accepting the second user's RfP, our standards for accepting RfPs are rather low. We do seem to grant users sysop (and even bureaucrat it seems) if users request it with a one or two word request. I did also note that I did it in part to see what the second user would do as it was suspected that they were a sockpuppet of a community banned user and it did end up that they were a sock. [[User:Agent Isai|'''Agent Isai''']] [[m:User talk:Agent Isai|'''Talk to me!''']] 03:07, 12 November 2022 (UTC) # {{Support}} Since activity ''doesn't'' really apply here, then AI is good to go. [[User:Ugochimobi|Ugochimobi]] ([[User talk:Ugochimobi|talk]]) 09:31, 12 November 2022 (UTC) # {{Support|strong}} Steward, trusted user. They’re an exceptionally good caretaker of the community. Happy to support. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 00:17, 27 November 2022 (UTC) #{{Support}} Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 00:38, 27 November 2022 (UTC) # {{Support}} [[User:Universal Omega|Universal Omega]] ([[User talk:Universal Omega|talk]]) 00:40, 27 November 2022 (UTC) #{{support}} [[User:Blad|Blad]] ([[User talk:Blad|talk]]) 12:54, 2 December 2022 (UTC) {{discussion bottom}} == Enable PortableInfoboxCreator == I would like to request that a bureaucrat enable this as I need it for template testing and I lack bureaucratic rights. [[User:Blad|Blad]] ([[User talk:Blad|talk]]) 23:44, 7 November 2022 (UTC) :@[[User:Blad|Blad]], do you mean you want bureaucrat permissions? If you want it, you can request it at [[TW:RfP]] after 3 more edits. [[User:Syunsyunminmin|Syunsyunminmin]] ([[User talk:Syunsyunminmin|talk]]) 06:26, 8 November 2022 (UTC) ::I am not. I was requesting a bureaucrat to enable an extension as I lack those rights. If I were able to request bureaucrat, I would've gone there instead. [[User:Blad|Blad]] ([[User talk:Blad|talk]]) 11:48, 8 November 2022 (UTC) :::sorry. I don't understand exactly what you want. I expect a response by other crat or consul. [[User:Syunsyunminmin|Syunsyunminmin]] ([[User talk:Syunsyunminmin|talk]]) 13:08, 8 November 2022 (UTC) ::::Aright, that's fine. [[User:Blad|Blad]] ([[User talk:Blad|talk]]) 13:23, 8 November 2022 (UTC) :What extension is PortableInfoboxCreator? It doesn't seem to exist. [[User:Agent Isai|'''Agent Isai''']] [[m:User talk:Agent Isai|'''Talk to me!''']] 13:28, 8 November 2022 (UTC) ::It should be [[mw:Extension:PortableInfobox|this one]]. Also, according to the criteria for granting them, the proposal requires the user to ''Demonstrate knowledge of the abuse filter rule language and vandalism prevention'', which will help prove that they know how to use the abuse filter. I agree that users need to be prepared to use these permissions as well - for this purpose, I will create a special help page dedicated to using the abuse filter. Thank you! [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 15:29, 9 September 2024 (UTC) :::{{support}} I agree with this proposal. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 20:33, 9 September 2024 (UTC) :::{{support}} Fully agreed make a good sense. [[User:Xaloria|Xaloria]] ([[User talk:Xaloria|talk]]) 14:14, 11 September 2024 (UTC) ::{{Support}} Delegation is something I will support almost 100% of the time (excessive delegation will be opposed). [[User:Justarandomamerican|Justarandomamerican]] ([[User talk:Justarandomamerican|talk]]) 20:38, 9 September 2024 (UTC) ::Partial {{Oppose}} I just noticed that the proposal includes access to private details, which is CheckUser access, restricted by global policy to Stewards and those who meet the election requirements for a Steward locally. == Public Test Wiki Discord Server is Live! == Dear users! We are thrilled to announce the launch of the '''Public Test Wiki Discord server'''! This new platform will enhance our communication, support, and community engagement. Whether you need help, want to discuss issues, or just connect with fellow members, our Discord server is the perfect place for you. # '''Features of our Discord server''': #* Roles: Gain access to specific roles compatible with your permissions on TestWiki such as Bureaucrats, Consuls, and Administrators to assist with various requests and issues. #* Community Interaction: Chat with other users, discuss projects, and collaborate. #* Real-time Updates: Stay informed with the latest announcements, recent changes and discussions. To learn more about how to use and join Discord, visit our [[Help:Discord|Help page]]. We look forward to seeing you there! Have a nice day! [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 08:32, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :I have gone into detail with this on discord itself and will summarize my opinions here. :I approve of coming up with initiatives, I have held for a long time that PTW needs reform and perhaps having that come out over discord is the answer. However I do not approve of the way this was installed without even Consul consensus, let alone community consensus. On discord you asserted that it does not change the community. This seems incorrect to me as it will reroute fundamental discussion to discord, serve as an official portal for Consuls, and through its support channel, potentially process requests traditionally done here. These are not necessarily bad ideas, but they are hardly no change at all. I think the [[m:miraheze projects|miraheze projects]] status of the wiki should be considered, as that would bind it to the [[m:Miraheze Spaces Code of Conduct|MSCoC]] as well. These reasons are why I believe this should have been further discussed and not presented as a project wide decision, when really it was you deciding to do it. :What I call for is that this immediately be subject to community authorization and a consul discussion to ensure this is really what the project would like to do, and if so, think it through. I don't think it needs to be shut down in the meantime, but its presentation as official should be ramped back until these steps take place. This goes to unexplored territory for miraheze projects wikis - should dev and commons have their own servers too? Should each project instead have a channel under the Miraheze primary discord, which will bring more people into the central community and possibly expand traffic that way? These are the details to be worked out imo. :--'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 12:44, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :I concur with the above. Evidently, this is well intentioned but the lack of consensus even from the other consuls is jarring. TestWiki has never been a particularly active wiki with a community. Attempts to nurture the local community should be coordinated with the larger Miraheze community which has a much bigger user base. I fear that what is attempted with Discord will essentially just end up as what has occured with IRC, a rarely used server with little real traffic and what's worse, with no real community recognition. [[User:Agent Isai|'''Agent Isai''']] [[m:User talk:Agent Isai|'''Talk to me!''']] 15:55, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :Concur with @[[User:Agent Isai|Agent Isai]] and @[[User:Raidarr|Raidarr]] [[User:Cactusisme|Cactusisme]] ([[User talk:Cactusisme|talk]]) 08:27, 18 September 2024 (UTC) == Discord server ==
:The following discussion is closed. Please do not modify it. Subsequent comments should be made in a new section. ::No consensus to keep the PTW discord server. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 14:10, 20 September 2024 (UTC) Hello! As requested by [[user:Raidarr|Raidarr]] above, I would like to seek the community's opinion on the Discord server I created, the goals of which I described above and on [[Help:Discord]]. What suggestions and opinions do you have on this subject, do you support or oppose it? I'm waiting for your opinion. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 13:34, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :Besides my input above I would like to raise a few options here based on private input I have received and some observations after raising this in the main miraheze discord server. Apparently there is an IRC testwiki channel which goes mostly unused. One answer to bridge the gap would be to have a bridged discord-irc channel on the main miraheze discord, giving more exposure to this wiki and including this wiki more in the global community without requiring a full server. The server already exists so if people here are really into seeing that, it would not be a problem. Or maybe none of the above is needed as I saw alluded to or stated a couple times. So in my mind three options to go on. I would be interesting to see what Consuls have to say from a process standpoint as equal stakeholders in how to go about things here. :I am taking my stance from a miraheze process standpoint, and do not have enough of a stake here to tell this wiki which way it should go. Food for thought. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 13:52, 11 September 2024 (UTC) ::Might actually make a good bit of sense to have a section on Discord for [[m:Miraheze projects|Miraheze project]] wikis. We could take a look at having a channel each for commonswiki, devwiki, and testwiki. Don't know if we'd want to have any criteria for including other wikis. -- [[User:Void|Void]] [[User talk:Void|''Whispers'']] 00:41, 12 September 2024 (UTC) :::Commonswiki and devwiki, could also get bridged to their IRC counterparts. [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 01:46, 12 September 2024 (UTC) :Yes, indeed the IRC channel (#miraheze-testwiki) is never used. If we do want to bridge channels, we could put it on the Miraheze bridge or a separate one. Either way, I’m happy to help out with it. [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 15:59, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :I {{support}} a bridge between the IRC channel and the main Miraheze discord. I'm afraid a full server would probably meet the same fate as the IRC channel. [[User:Justarandomamerican|Justarandomamerican]] ([[User talk:Justarandomamerican|talk]]) 16:13, 11 September 2024 (UTC) ::I agree with the above. [[User:GroupNebula563|GroupNebula563]] ([[User talk:GroupNebula563|talk]]) 22:49, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :::As a consul, I would concur on the points stated by {{u|Raidarr}}, {{u|Void}}, and {{u|Agent Isai}}. Creating a Discord server for the purposes of Test Wiki and this wiki alone would be a mistake. I would instead be open to a Miraheze Project Discord for these channels/separate category in the main server, and to bridge them to their IRC counterparts. However, of course, I'm interested to see what the rest of the community thinks of the idea, and I would like to thank {{u|BZPN}} for taking initiative to launch this. While malformed, it seems to have jump-started a conversation that should have long been had on Test Wiki, which is a good thing in my eyes. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 05:28, 17 September 2024 (UTC) ::::Thank you all for your input. After reviewing the discussion, I think bridging the existing IRC channel to the main Miraheze Discord server seems like the most practical and efficient solution. The IRC channel has been largely inactive, and by integrating it with Discord, we can maintain a connection to the global community without splintering resources into an entirely new server that may face the same inactivity.I believe creating a dedicated Miraheze Project section within the existing server, with specific channels for TestWiki, CommonsWiki, and DevWiki, would enhance collaboration and provide clarity without overwhelming users with additional platforms. This would also allow us to foster engagement across projects while keeping things organized.That said, it's important to strike a balance between flexibility and overcomplication. Bridging IRC channels where possible makes sense, but adding too many layers of communication might dilute participation. I'd be interested in hearing more thoughts, particularly from the Consuls and the broader community, on how to ensure that any integration remains effective and easy to maintain long term.In the end, the success of this initiative will rely on participation, so the more we can streamline and centralize communication without overextending ourselves, the better. Thanks again, @[[User:BZPN|BZPN]], for bringing this to the table and opening up the discussion. [[User:Xaloria|Xaloria]] ([[User talk:Xaloria|talk]]) 11:39, 17 September 2024 (UTC) :: Can a PTW Channel can be started on Miraheze Discord Server? Don't know if we already have such a Channel.
:: Also, I was thinking that offering a Dedicated PTW Channel on the Miraheze Discord Server will also boost awareness of an Official PTW Server.
:: And also, the Channel will make it possible for the PTW group to congregate on the Miraheze Discord Server until the group is called to meet up for official business on the PTW Discord Server. So even when the PTW Discord is quiet and not very active or busy, no one will have to keep tabs on an empty room. They could just wait on Miraheze Server and come over together as a group. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:36, 18 September 2024 (UTC) ::Miraheze server has PTW channel for recent changes. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 11:50, 18 September 2024 (UTC) :The above discussion is preserved as an archive. Please do not modify it. Subsequent comments should be made in a new section
== Request for an [[TestWiki:Inactivity/Exceptions|exception]] from the inactivity policy ==
:The following request is '''successful''' - the predominance of votes (including Consuls votes) and arguments in favor is overwhelming. Congratulations. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 16:20, 11 September 2024 (UTC) ---- Following the request [[M:Steward_requests/Miscellaneous#Request_to_Remove_TestWiki_Consul_Rights|on Meta]] for my removal for inactivity I'm requesting that Consuls grant an exception from the inactivity like I had in the past. I would also request an exception on behalf of Void if he wishes to accept. As you probably know I'm currently a Steward, Director and member of the Technology team at Miraheze and as such have many responsibilities here outside of TestWiki which means that I'm unfortunately not always able to be as active as I might have been during the first years, especially on-wiki. That being said, I'm always available on Discord and if there's ever any issue that requires a Consul I'm able to respond quickly. I would note that another Steward, NotAracham is already exempted from the policy for similar reasons. If you have any other questions, please feel free to ask. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 15:17, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{O|strong}}. You don't need this exception - if you really want to intervene in special cases, you can use your global permissions. You only asked for an exception after I filed a request to revoke your permissions - which means you didn't care about it before. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 15:24, 11 September 2024 (UTC) {{Support}} [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 16:20, 11 September 2024 (UTC) ::That's not true - global permissions aren't to be used to usurp local communities so Stewards only intervene in exceptional cases. I didn't say I would only intervene in special cases, I said if anyone needed me to intervene in ''any'' case I would be available to do so. It is true that I only asked for an exception after you requested the revocation and I didn't try to hide that, I admitted that other responsibilities have made me have less time for TestWiki. Similar exceptions have been granted in the past so I'm not sure why you are assuming bad faith with no justification. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 15:27, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :::Why do you need consul permissions? Are administrator and bureaucrat rights not enough to perform standard activities? I also see that you only made 172 edits in 6 years. I understand you have more important tasks as a Steward, but that doesn't mean you have to maintain local permissions at all. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 15:34, 11 September 2024 (UTC) ::You DO know that Reception was the original requestor of PublicTestWiki... right? This is such a bizarre claim... ::--[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 15:49, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :::I DO. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 16:04, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support|Strong}} Reception is a huge help in the community, and removing rights is not the correct action to take here, they have more than demonstrated their commitment to Miraheze. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 15:42, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support|Strong}} I'm confused why a user that only got their consul rights yesterday is now so violently opposed to existing precedent of exempting major platform-wide volunteers in a narrow view of local policy. It makes me concerned that perhaps their elevation to consul may have been premature... --[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 15:47, 11 September 2024 (UTC) ::Interesting... Does the fact that I recently became a consul discriminate against me in any way? Does this make my vote invalid? It doesn't matter if the user is the founder of TestWiki, etc., as long as they don't follow the policies. I'm surprised that you want to keep the rights just to have them... [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 15:53, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{support}} Reception has been a huge help globally and on TestWiki (he originally requested the wiki), and I see no reason not to grant an exception. [[User:Justarandomamerican|Justarandomamerican]] ([[User talk:Justarandomamerican|talk]]) 15:52, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support}} To me, it is perfectly reasonable '''for the founder of this very wiki''' to have an exemption to the inactivity policy. Also, it seems like the removal of inactivity exemptions was done with absolutely no input from the community or other consuls? [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 15:54, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{support}} Changing as as didn't know he was the Test Wiki requester and seeing his contributions globally it's very good and make sense. [[User:Xaloria|Xaloria]] ([[User talk:Xaloria|talk]]) 15:54, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :{{Support|strongest}} I appreciate BZPN's eagerness to help maintain TestWiki but their recent actions have been a bit brazen. Sure, none of the consuls are particularly active but many of them are global functionaries and active elsewhere. For the rest, there is the matter of respect and honor for their either years of service or for founding this wiki. This latest attempt to remove a great base of consuls would radically turn TestWiki upside down by concentrating power with a very small number of newer users who may steer the project contrary to the global project goal. [[User:Agent Isai|'''Agent Isai''']] [[m:User talk:Agent Isai|'''Talk to me!''']] 15:58, 11 September 2024 (UTC)

[[User:Bahati11|Bahati11]] ([[User talk:Bahati11|talk]]) 06:07, 15 November 2025 (UTC) == AirmanKitten203 (Bureaucrat) == {{Discussion top|{{Not done}}, unfortunately due to various concerns regarding displayed behavior and constantly pushing PTW administration to review your request, and attempts to bypass PTW administration to get your request reviewed by a third party, I, on behalf of TestWiki’s Consuls do not deem you trustworthy enough to be granted bureaucrat. Furthermore, there is a very apparent concern from myself and other users whom I’ve spoken to that believe behaviors you exhibit are that of a hat collector. Overall, TestWiki does not have a huge need for bureaucrats at this time, especially when taking into consideration my previous points. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 06:46, 9 December 2025 (UTC)}} *{{RfPStatus|status=|by=}} * User: {{RFP/User|AirmanKitten203}} * Requested group/permission: Bureaucrat * Reason for requesting: Hello! I am AirmanKitten203. I have been a part of PTW for quite a while now. Recently, I used my permissions on the wiki to do translations of some important pages in multiple languages, allowing for users from other countries and nationalities to understand the information they need to use this wiki. I am submitting this request because I feel that I am ready to take on more responsibility in the wiki and assist with the granting of permissions, reversal of vandalism, and the protection of the wiki. [[User:AirmanKitten203|AirmanKitten203]] ([[User talk:AirmanKitten203|talk]]) 13:27, 20 November 2025 (UTC) :Any update? [[User:AirmanKitten203|AirmanKitten203]] ([[User talk:AirmanKitten203|talk]]) 14:34, 3 December 2025 (UTC) ::If I am honest.. I feel you are requesting one after another permission, instead of just being a volunteer who appreciates helping others. ::You requested adminship on Meta, withdrew the request, then requested WikiReviewer without any explanation why or replying to any of the questions I put forward to you. ::And now you request Bureaucrat on this wiki. ::I have had the long held believe that volunteers should ideally be noticed for what they do, and people thinking, ''why are they not "xyz" yet?'' But my thought about you, to be frank, is that you are too eager for getting a status. You've done a lot of translation work, which doesn't need a bureaucrat role. Neither does reversal of vandalism which I cannot see you have been focussed on. You don't become a patroller before you have shown that you can identify vandalism. You start countering vandalism, and people start noticing you. Then you grow with the job, and get more responsibilities in that field. ::If your view is, that you can start doing certain work once you have the role as ''xyz'' then that is the wrong approach unfortunately. ::As we already have [[Special:ListUsers/bureaucrat|16]] bureaucrats, I don't believe you would greatly add to the team, that isn't already present. ::My advice to the staff would be to decline based on the above.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   01:26, 9 December 2025 (UTC) :::I appreciate your reply. Here are 2 things though :::1. I am a former bureaucrat here. :::2. I am not doing it for the status. I am not allowed to issue serious blocks or anything with testing permissions. [[User:AirmanKitten203|AirmanKitten203]] ([[User talk:AirmanKitten203|talk]]) 01:51, 9 December 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == Example7 == How to create user page for this account [[User:DiamondCat12345678|DiamondCat12345678]] ([[User talk:DiamondCat12345678|talk]]) 20:51, 27 January 2026 (UTC) :Hi @[[User:DiamondCat12345678|DiamondCat12345678]] :: Your page has already been created ... :: Your user page is [[User:DiamondCat12345678]] :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 00:59, 28 January 2026 (UTC) ::I am trying to create examplee7’s page [[User:DiamondCat12345678|DiamondCat12345678]] ([[User talk:DiamondCat12345678|talk]]) 08:01, 28 January 2026 (UTC) :::: Thanks ... It looks like you were able to create the User page for Example7 ... :::I am only a User here ... I can only view the User page for Example7 ... :::From what I can see ... it appears that only User can create and edit their own User page ... :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:00, 29 January 2026 (UTC) == Email from Technology Team == We are aware an email was sent out to all users with admin on this wiki about extensions being removed. The Consul team is aware of the removals ahead of time, and it will not adversely affect the wiki, you may feel free to disregard as only Consuls can action on the email. Thanks Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 03:04, 9 February 2026 (UTC) == New Policy/Usergroup == Hello! In an effort to allow Miraheze’s Technology Team a better way of being able to test various things needed using TestWiki without needing to contact a Consul each time, I have created a new usergroup for them with the corresponding new policy which can be found at [[TestWiki:Tech]], this new usergroup and policy is effective immediately.
