body:
{{Aan}} == Proposal : Demo bot proxy blocking on test wiki == Hello. There's currently an actively ongoing request to block many more proxies globally across all of Miraheze, it's supposed to be done already but in practice hasn't been taken care of that well. There's a new system upcoming designed to block more proxies by using Wikimedia's list. I would like to demo this on test wiki given that 1) it is a test wiki after all 2) there is a huge spam problem here. Any objections? Also, thoughts from consuls [[User:Reception123]] [[User:Void]] [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 21:03, 29 June 2022 (UTC) :I don’t believe this is a vote, but I would {{support}} this request. We can test this out here, and if it works we can expand to the rest of Miraheze in time. If not, no skin off our backs. I have faith this will work as we haven’t been great about blocking proxies in the past. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 23:48, 29 June 2022 (UTC) :: I would ideally like at least one consul to input before I place 40000+ blocks, that kind of thing is not easy to reverse. (Though they can be short i.e. ~1 week during the trial period, and only longer during longterm use). Any thoughts from uninvolved users so far? [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 19:18, 30 June 2022 (UTC) :{{Oppose|Strong}} I can not support this, a bot like this should ONLY be ran by a user whom has experience with global permissions on Miraheze, for example current or former CVT, Stewards, sysadmins, ect. A bot of this type has severe consequences if it has to many false positives, one that only those people would have experience handling. At this moment, Void has been working on a bot to handle this sort of thing. I have also been doing separate work on reviving Proxybot. This request is a complete no from me, and this vote will not change. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 20:31, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :: Void's sources missed proxies, which is why this request was started. There is currently only an import task, which I asked Reception123 to comment on. Also, this isn't a vote, so there's no vote to change. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 21:58, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::Also {{u|Zppix}}, I will note that you don’t have the authority to single-handedly overrule this request. Your comment is noted and has been added to the record, but you cannot overrule this request just because you oppose it. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 22:21, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::: They actually weren't trying to overrule it, they were just "voting" on a thing that wasn't a vote. Though I do note that they specifically defined experience as "current '''or former''' CVT" so that they would qualify but not me. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 22:24, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::::The reason I specified what I did is because those peoples would have experience with global permissions on Miraheze. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:51, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::Not the only one who doesn’t like this idea, consuls do talk to each other you know. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:50, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::From a technical perspective it is almost 100% impossible to not miss open proxies. Simply taking WMF’s block list is disruptive, as there are no checks in place to make sure said blocks are still valid. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:54, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::The entire point of a test wiki is to test. I wouldn’t be opposed to trying it out and seeing if it works. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 19:16, 3 July 2022 (UTC) == Consul request == Hello, I am asking if I could become a consul or not because I have done a lot of things. [[User:Cigaryno|Cigaryno]] ([[User talk:Cigaryno|talk]]) 17:49, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :Users can become consul after being elected. Your request however is very early and much more experienced and users who have been here for a long time aren't consuls. There are probably enough consuls right now as well so there's not really a need for any more. I'd advise against hat collecting. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 18:09, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::I will request in 3-6 weeks. [[User:Cigaryno|Cigaryno]] ([[User talk:Cigaryno|talk]]) 19:49, 1 July 2022 (UTC) :::I really wouldn’t recommend that. You’d likely need at least 3-6 months of experience, as well as being an extremely trusted member of the community. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 22:22, 1 July 2022 (UTC) ::::Either way, as I say there's really no need for other Consuls right now in my opinion. Consul isn't something you set a 'target date' to become. As I say, please do resist the temptation to hat collect. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 13:43, 3 July 2022 (UTC) == Users unblocking themself == Hi all, Recently a user has been evading their topic ban multiple times, without any regard for the seriousness of this and reinforcing why it was made in the first place. I temporarily blocked this user for 3 days, and considered removing their sysop permissions to prevent them from unblocking themself but decided not to because I thought I could trust them not to. Apparently not, because they ended up unblocking themselves. While sysops do have the unblockself permission, my understanding of this is that it is supposed to be because of test blocks by sysops. I certainly don't think it is OK for users to be unblocking themselves as the recipient of actions, and I don't think anyone else would either. It doesn't appear anyone else has commented on this problem, as due to the recent stepping down of the two most active consuls. The only user who had a chance to review this problem only reviewed the technical aspects of it. As a result, I think the community should make a plan on how to handle this situation. Since there isn't an active community at this time, if there are not any objections from anyone (other than BrandonWM themself) I will reinstate the block as an emergency measure. While I was initially under the impression that this would constitute wheel warring, I realized that the policy generally only applies to other sysops reversing actions, and is not intended to apply to users receiving blocks, and this would almost certainly be considered block evasion by any reasonable person. However, I don't have any plans on how to solve this problem long-term, other than either via removing unblockself from sysops (might cause problems for testing blocks?) or a bot that removes them (depending on who blocked). [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 03:39, 19 September 2022 (UTC) :I suggest that only bureaucrats and consuls have this right. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 18:12, 19 September 2022 (UTC) :We may create another blocking level rather than current blocks which only available for crat's and consuls. Current blocks may use for testing purposes. —[[User:MdsShakil|MdsShakil]] ([[User talk:MdsShakil|talk]]) 05:16, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::Since I don't think another blocking level is possible, my suggestion would be to use wgRevokePermissions and to create a new group that can be assigned to users blocked for serious reasons so that they are unable to unblock themselves. [[User:Reception123|Reception123]] ([[User talk:Reception123|talk]]) 06:24, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::It's a good idea, I agree! [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 11:32, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::: At that point, why not simply remove the sysop permissions? [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:27, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::: Also, does the community believe BrandonWM's block was valid? I had said before if there were no objections I would reblock them. One user claimed the block was a "clear error" but did not have a convincing case as to why. I think the topic ban violation is clearly verifiable, see [[User_talk:BrandonWM|talk page]] for that, and does not appear to be in error. I would assume by the comments the community agrees it is valid but most people are talking about the problem in general and not this specific case. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:28, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::I forgot to mention, that even if admins don't have the right to unblock themselves, if it's a partial block the user isn't considered "blocked" so they can still do it. Probably only removing administrator permission is feasibility. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 16:35, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::: It's also worth noting that it appears that if you have talk page access on you can also delete and protect your talk page. Also also, a blocked user who is a sysop can still block the person who blocked them, this change is because of compromised sysop accounts. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:40, 20 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::Again, you seem to be ignoring the fact that Void had the hard-line restrictions removed. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 23:40, 20 September 2022 (UTC) :::::::BrandonWM, you are correct, as per what is clearly stated on your talk page both by myself and Void. :::::::Everyone else, please check his talk page before jumping to conclusions and give him a break. I regret blocking him.￼ [[User:Kiko4564|Kiko4564]] ([[User talk:Kiko4564|talk]]) 07:41, 21 September 2022 (UTC) ::::::: Void did not remove the restrictions. They removed Kiko4564's block and suggested reducing the restrictions. ''You'' are ignoring the fact that you violated your topic ban and also unblocked yourself, which is a much more important problem. In addition, a consul has already participated in this discussion and proposed a solution to the problem of users unblocking themself, despite Kiko4564 pretending it was completely fine for users to do that as long as they themself believe the block was wrong. And even if they were removed, you still violated them prior to that comment. Trying to excuse the fact that you violated the topic ban and also the fact that the edits were disruptive just reinforces why there was a need for a topic ban to have been made in the first place. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 16:01, 21 September 2022 (UTC) :Per our conversation on [[mh:m:IRC|IRC]], I am posting my rationale for using the unblockself permission. I believe the block was wrongly made and poorly justified. I had received messages of support from other crats in the hours before using the permission, and as such I felt comfortable in using it. If I had been alone in believing the block was wrong, I wouldn't have removed it, and instead elected to wait for another member of the community to remove the block. Void had also removed the hard-line restrictions, and as my edits were non-disruptive, there was no need for a block. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 04:44, 22 September 2022 (UTC) :: This is not true at all. :: {{tq|I had received messages of support from other crats in the hours before using the permission}} Actually, no, you received [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:BrandonWM&action=history&offset=20220914235959&limit=3 no such messages] between [[special:redirect/logid/25100|being blocked]] and [[special:redirect/logid/25104|unblocking yourself]]. There were no messages of support from other crats when you decided on your own it was wrong and removed it. Even after the fact only one person agreed that it was OK for you to unblock yourself (not "other crats" plural) - with four users including a consul agreeing it was not OK. :: {{tq|and as such I felt comfortable in using it}} You shouldn't have. It will never be OK for a user to unblock themself, especially as seen in this discussion. If it was really that bad someone else will. There's no need for you to remove it yourself. :: {{tq|If I had been alone in believing the block was wrong, I wouldn't have removed it}} You were. And if you weren't, why didn't those people remove it? :: {{tq|Void had also removed the hard-line restrictions}} Again, Void did not remove the restrictions. What Void actually said was: {{tq|I propose the restriction be reduced down to a general recommendation against making any "official" style changes without prior on-wiki approval, and an understanding that less leniency will be given in the event of future disruption. }} - the restrictions were not removed and remain in effect. In addition, I would call this the less leniency in the event of future disruption, as will be seen soon. :: {{tq|s my edits were non-disruptive}} Firstly, it doesn't matter whether they were disruptive. You violated your topic ban and that's not okay. Topic bans are enforced by blocking the user if they violate it. If you believed you could have made good edits in those areas, you should have requested removal, not simply violated it. As explained before, {{tq|A ban is not merely a request to avoid editing "unless they behave". The measure of a ban is that even if the editor were to make good edits, permitting them to edit in those areas is perceived to pose enough risk of disruption, issues, or harm, that they may not edit at all, even if the edits seem good.}}. Amen. I don't think I could have said it better myself. :: And secondly, they '''were''' disruptive. For example [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=TestWiki:Request_permissions&diff=prev&oldid=46125 this unnecessary removal], [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=TestWiki:Request_permissions&diff=44628&oldid=44627 this innapropriate self-handling], and [https://test.miraheze.org/w/index.php?title=TestWiki:Request_permissions&diff=next&oldid=44780 interacting with other users]. :: Because of this, I do not see any valid justification for your actions. In addition, several users have agreed it is not okay for recipients of non-test blocks to unblock themselves, instead taking any of their concerns to a bureaucrat or consul. In addition, the original block has not been proven to be incorrect, and continues to only show to be more and more justified with the user attempting to justify their topic-ban evasion and justification of self-unblocks, repeating the behavior that led to that in the first place and reminding me of why they were blocked and locked originally in 2020, despite their claims to have changed. Because of this, I propose that the original block is reinstated. Please leave your thoughts and / or concerns below. [[User:Naleksuh|Naleksuh]] ([[User talk:Naleksuh|talk]]) 04:58, 22 September 2022 (UTC) :::In which case [[User:Naleksuh]], please wait for a Consul to attend to this incident and deal with this directly, instead of wheel warring with a Consul over whether or not [[User:BrandonWM]] ought to be blocked or not, even partially. I've blocked [[User:BrandonWM]] myself, and all I said was that if [[User:Void]] deemed it fit to remove the block I imposed, then so be it, and if you don't think that [[User:BrandonWM]] should've been unblocked, then you were in the wrong to engage in a wheel war, and therefore (on this occasion) [[User:BrandonWM]] was right to remove the block because: 1) it was wrong, having resulted from clear cut wheel warring and based on restrictions which had already been removed and 2) I agreed that it was right to remove it since I believed that it was a clear cut mistake. If the incident isn't serious enough to warrant desysoping, then my opinion is that it cannot serious enough to warrant a serious block. However I could be wrong. If you disagree, then please discuss the matter civilly instead of wheel warring. I never pretended that it was OK for an admin to unblock themselves just because they disagree with the block. If it were, then almost everyone would unblock themselves. Thanks. [[User:Kiko4564|Kiko4564]] ([[User talk:Kiko4564|talk]]) 23:11, 23 September 2022 (UTC) :::: {{tq|discuss the matter civilly instead of wheel warring}} I did not wheel war. BrandonWM removed the block, and it has not been reinstated since. It may be reinstated when this discussion is closed, as consensus is that it is not okay for users to unblock themself. But I certainly have not wheel warred. In fact, this thread was specifically to avoid doing so. :::: {{tq|BrandonWM was right to remove the block}} Consensus is in this thread that it is never okay for serious-blocked users to unblock themself. __NEWSECTIONLINK__ == Request for Consul == I have made constructive non-test edits and I am a bureaucrat so should I become a consul? [[User:MiraEdit|MiraEdit]] ([[User talk:MiraEdit|talk]]) 23:04, 2 February 2025 (UTC) :: Please review the terms on the Test Wiki Main page [[TestWiki]], specifically the rules listed in the section [[TestWiki#Things to keep in mind]]. If you are not sure which rule was violated, you should reach out to [[m:Steward requests]] or discuss at the [[m:Community portal]]. : --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:44, 3 February 2025 (UTC) ::: I know my answer didn't really answer your question, but basically, every wiki is different. Please learn more about Test Wiki if you really want to become a Consul. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:47, 3 February 2025 (UTC) == Refreshing created a test page == I was told my test page was labeled abusive because it was short and had "bad words." I opted to use the preview bar instead. Later I refreshed the page (F5) and for some reason that created it. No bad words, but the page will probably be gone by the time you see this. Posting because it said to log an issue [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 01:57, 15 February 2025 (UTC) == Can't undo == All of a sudden, I can't undo. I even went to contributions and reverted from there, but the pages still exist and have the content [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 04:30, 18 February 2025 (UTC) :Don't know which pages you are referring to. I could be wrong, but generally, we can rollback 1 and if someone has already contributed after your contribution, then rollback is not possible. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 25 February 2025 (UTC) == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 18:36, 3 March 2025 (UTC) :'''Update: the updated [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Blocking policy|blocking policy]]''' is now in effect as of Monday, March 2nd 6:16PM UTC-6. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:45, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] Could you summarize the changes made? Thanks! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::@[[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] Consuls, CVT, and Stewards are the only ones authorized to issue non-test blocks, test blocks can now only be done on accounts the user controls or on approved test accounts, appeals are only done via the blocked user’s talk page, or by emailing the blocking Consul, third party appeals are no longer accepted. I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! I obviously do not object the policy, just wanted your say on what you changed. :) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:08, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::ZPPIX WHY DO YOU KEEP MAKING POLICY CHANGES WITHOUT CONSENSUS! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 21:05, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::I do this as well on a local wiki that isn't the test one as an admin that can enforce and change rules around to keep it up to date like yes communities are needed but not for everything that are granted rights to staff. [[User:339Breakingoof|TheFunny339YoshiPlushGuy]] ([[User talk:339Breakingoof|talk]]) 13:38, 9 May 2025 (UTC) == Request for Consul (PixDeVl) == {{Discussion top|{{done}}, welcome to the Consul team. Please reach out if you have any questions. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 11:26, 9 March 2025 (UTC)}} Hi folks, I’m filing this Request for Consul, frankly because I noticed that we currently have only 2 remotely active Consuls, being Zppix and Reception, and, even with something like PTW, having an official project wiki be run by two folks isn’t great, so I’d thought I’d offer to lend a hand. I am not very active priorly with what exists of the community on PTW, but as a current global functionary, I still think it wouldn’t hurt to have an extra hand helping keep things clean. Feel free to ask any questions regarding this, as always :) —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 03:35, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}}  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   03:39, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} trusted user. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:38, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I looked into his CA. 1270 edits is extremely few for a user who is GA. Unfortunately this lowers my trust in this user even more. Maybe if the user was more involved cross-wiki I would change my mind, but unfortunately that is not the case. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:47, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I get that you look from the ground floor up. I have a more centered view from the MetaWiki and Discord. He is a trusted user who has been a great asset to the broader community. ::::I feel that you are gate keeping the local community, and that is your prerogative, but I think that PTW will benefit from his policy knowhow as well as his activity on the technical side. (Phorge) ::::On the other hand I find that waiting for first comments to arrive before answering on your own RfP doesn't make you to eager, as if one is collecting hats. I can assure you he's not. ::::I cannot take your concerns away, but hope you want to see it from the outside in, instead of the inside out.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:49, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::I do not believe in Quantity, but Quality. I can make 1000's of edits, but they do not tell much.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:50, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::::These are beautiful and classic words... However, can you explain to me why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions? Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW? I can't understand it. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:57, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::I think Zppix explains it perfectly. Being a Consul falls under different policies. Thus he needs to request permission to function here under the localpolcies.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   14:07, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::Hi, [[User:94.254.227.16|      ]] :::::::: I found your questions deeply compelling. As a result, I feel that I have gained a bit more understanding of Test Wiki. :::::::* '''Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW?''' :::::::As I understand it, Bureaucrat and Administrator are testing roles. As such, the roles cannot be used to uphold or enforce policy without creating confusion for the other Non Consuls within the community as to what is acceptable behavior. :::::::* '''why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions?''' :::::::Clearly PixDeVl recognizes that there is a distinction between a Consul role and a Non Consul role and will need the Consul role in order to provide the appropriate executive assistance. :::::::: You have raised a lot of other points that I will take into consideration, such as the low local edit count. Thank you for the extremely helpful and insightful observations. :::::::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:56, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I had far less edits back when I was a Global Sysop on Miraheze. Edits is not the end all be all. Further, it is clear to me that there is either a lack of understanding from you on the differences between having Global user rights and local user rights. For PixDeVI their use of global rights is governed by global Miraheze policy which dictates when and when they cannot use their global rights to intervene, but them asking for local rights it is allowing them to effectively not only help us Consuls, but also allow them to act based on our local policies outside of the governance of global policy requirements which can be restrictive and ultimately lead to relying on myself or another of the very few active Consuls which can lead to delays or even missed violations. ::::Please note my above comment does not reflect a vote but rather an observation of the discussion you have started. I neither endorse or oppose the candidate. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 14:04, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::The concern is not unfair; a user of this few edits both globally and locally seeking such a project leadership role is irregular, even with the precedent of [[Special:CentralAuth/subwayfares|subwayfares]] for wiki creation on Meta. Typically in a wiki that is fully independent this would be stranger as you would hope a leader is representative of the project, although there is merit to onboarding a trusted user in an advisory or supporting capacity. I would argue the key here is that this is ultimately a [[m:miraheze projects|Miraheze Project]]. I believe its identity as such should be a modifier for cases like this and that it is ideal for global functionaries to be more tightly bound with such a project, recommended in queue by wiki creators as it is with a domain currently hosted at WikiTide Foundation's grace. This may not be the ideal way to do it; my theory is to propose stewards as 'at large' consuls should locally invested members need a 'third opinion', more local consuls are involved and so on. Global administrators could perhaps fill the intermediary second line role bureaucrat serves, able to step in if there is backlog or an incident (short of something a GA/steward should step in for anyway). Otherwise there is a strong culture of 'separation of roles' at issue here and which is why pixel can't necessarily just jump in and do these things: it is not GS mandate. Therefore this request is an extension of his capabilities to reduce 'paperwork'. ::Essentially what I'm getting at is this request is reasonable, but skepticism of his investment in ''this'' local project holding such a role is also reasonable. And ideally, better tying the wiki to global operations through a community discussion is the best path in my opinion. The same for other projects such as dev and commons which already sort of act this way - zppix and alpad are local figures, reception and some others are global figures tied in, but as you see with the [[Special:ListUsers/consul|consul list]] it's a bit messy, outdated. ::Finally and drawing back a bit, there is no issue with an IP expressing these opinions. I would support their right to do so. I would also support a blocked user expressing a reasonable opinion to the degree I would offer to relay reasonable thoughts as food for thought even if they are blocked. An occasion where the IP editor and the blocked user overlap however is a very dangerous game that should discontinue immediately. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 23:22, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I agree with Raidarr. Test Wiki is structured very differently from other types of Wikis which makes it more difficult to identify or measure a candidate's qualifications by traditional means. :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:07, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' for {{ping|PixDeVl}}
What is meant by '''an extra hand helping keep things clean'''? What kind of things?
--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:45, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] TestWiki by its nature isn’t in dire need of conventional clean up work, but we have seen a recent uptick in issues where trolls go on mass desysoping sprees or otherwise cause a ruckus(something I believe Zppix has also wanted to address in policy), but as Raidarr said, PTW is an official Miraheze project, and as such, I don’t believe relying on really 2 activish functionaries to keep an eye on the place and make sure it’s tidy is viable or appropriate, hence my offering to take up the bit to properly police when issues come up beyond what’s included in the GA mandate and codified in local policy. Contrary to our anon friend, I do not claim to “need” these rights, I am offering to lend a hand to the small consul team in supplement to my other duties, and believe it would be beneficial to undergo this RFP to be able to do so without having to worry about global role scope ambiguity among other things. [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 15:00, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :::Thank you for answering my first question. :::[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' followup for {{ping|PixDeVl}} :::Hypothetically, if some disruptive activities were committed with the very best of intentions due to questionable judgement, how would you help wayward testers tweak their behavior before further violations take them straight to a permanent ban? :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:47, 6 March 2025 (UTC) ::::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] Should a user unknowingly or mistakenly violate the [[TW:Testing policy|Testing policy]], we should, as with any wiki, [[wp:assume good faith|assume good faith]] that they do not mean to purposely harm the project. That means contacting them in a civil tone to explain what they were doing and why it’s an issue, how to do whatever they want to do properly, and cleaning up. If they are acting in obvious bad faith or continue to be disruptive after multiple escalating warnings, only then should sanctions such as a serious block be applied ideally. [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 12:53, 6 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} Pix is one of the most promising young volunteers we've had in the nearly 6 years I've been aorund. I am glad to have the extra support for testwiki. [[User:RhinosF1|RhinosF1]] ([[User talk:RhinosF1|talk]]) 20:20, 7 March 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} ==Inactive Rights Removal - 2025-03-04== The rights of the following users will be removed on or after 2025-03-11 if they do not return to activity: *{{RFP/User|78-Yellowcat}} *{{RFP/User|AirmanKitten203}} *{{RFP/User|BasedKat09}} *{{RFP/User|BunnypranavClone}} *{{RFP/User|Cactus2}} Per my talk page. *{{RFP/User|Cactusalt}} Per my talk page. *{{RFP/User|Chqaz}} *{{RFP/User|Códigonombre Alguien}} *{{RFP/User|DarkMatterMan4500}} *{{RFP/User|Deverettm}} *{{RFP/User|EdwardLennox}} *{{RFP/User|Emmitt}} *{{RFP/User|Ericbomb}} *{{RFP/User|Excelsis}} *{{RFP/User|Fallen}} *{{RFP/User|Felenov}} *{{RFP/User|Harommel Rabbid}} *{{RFP/User|Hauber}} *{{RFP/User|JoséDeJesús}} *{{RFP/User|Ketra}} *{{RFP/User|Kittyguy210}} Per their talk page *{{RFP/User|Lana}} *{{RFP/User|Liaochina}} *{{RFP/User|Manomoney41}} *{{RFP/User|MarkRosenbaum}} *{{RFP/User|MatthewQuinnHui}} *{{RFP/User|MvGulik}} *{{RFP/User|Pasmorade}} *{{RFP/User|Pisces}} *{{RFP/User|Rafdodo}} *{{RFP/User|ShuuGyro}} *{{RFP/User|Talion77}} *{{RFP/User|Sizau}} *{{RFP/User|Skilsdhuo}} *{{RFP/User|Smileboy}} *{{RFP/User|Snowmanonahoe}} *{{RFP/User|Soulwater24}} *{{RFP/User|StellaDiamondMaskedWolf}} *{{RFP/User|Steverino}} *{{RFP/User|Stxrsprxte}} Thanks, :Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) :For the Consul Team :11:46, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ==Request for Feedback: Bureaucrats== {{discussion top|Closing as {{done|successful}}. The vast majority of users support the changes of policy with relation to [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats]]. With a successful RfC here, consuls will undertake a review of all active bureaucrats to determine which users will retain rights. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 20:36, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} While Bureaucrat has historically been implemented as a testing role, the low requirements for entry into the role coupled with broad/disruptive permission sets has made it a prime target for bad actors - repeat instances of malicious abuse of Bureaucrat permissions necessitating intervention by global volunteers has made clear that a change is needed. Simultaneously, the relatively small number of active testwiki Consuls has meant that policy enforcement activities haven't always gotten timely action and oversight, and assistance by trusted users is needed to keep testwiki operating as a true testing space. As such, this proposal aims to convert the Bureaucrat role from one of generic testing to one of moderate trust, eliminating the easy abuse vector while remaining readily achievable and providing consuls more support in day-to-day operations. The proposed changes to [[TW:Bureaucrats|TestWiki:Bureaucrats]] can be found [[User:Zppix/Draft/Bureaucrats#Proposed Page Text Changes|on this draft page]] under the Proposed Page Text Changes section. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:26, 11 March 2025 (UTC) ===Support=== #{{Support|strong}} as proposer Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:29, 11 March 2025 (UTC) #{{Support|strong}} it was about time! Unfortunately the few are creating issues for the masses.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   10:32, 11 March 2025 (UTC) #{{support}} it's unfortunate that it has to come down to this, but there have been too many recent cases of abuse and I believe it's too easy for people to "farm" their way into getting the bureaucrat right for malicious purposes. I believe these requirements look good. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 13:55, 11 March 2025 (UTC) #{{support}} Per above. [[User:Fusionium|Fusionium]] ([[User talk:Fusionium|talk]]) 19:58, 11 March 2025 (UTC) #{{Support}} Per the above. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:38, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I looked into his CA. 1270 edits is extremely few for a user who is GA. Unfortunately this lowers my trust in this user even more. Maybe if the user was more involved cross-wiki I would change my mind, but unfortunately that is not the case. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:47, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I get that you look from the ground floor up. I have a more centered view from the MetaWiki and Discord. He is a trusted user who has been a great asset to the broader community. ::::I feel that you are gate keeping the local community, and that is your prerogative, but I think that PTW will benefit from his policy knowhow as well as his activity on the technical side. (Phorge) ::::On the other hand I find that waiting for first comments to arrive before answering on your own RfP doesn't make you to eager, as if one is collecting hats. I can assure you he's not. ::::I cannot take your concerns away, but hope you want to see it from the outside in, instead of the inside out.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:49, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::I do not believe in Quantity, but Quality. As a result, I feel that I have gained a bit more understanding of Test Wiki. :::::::* '''Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW?''' :::::::As I understand it, Bureaucrat and Administrator are testing roles. As such, the roles cannot be used to uphold or enforce policy without creating confusion for the other Non Consuls within the community as to what is acceptable behavior. :::::::* '''why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions?''' :::::::Clearly PixDeVl recognizes that there is a distinction between a Consul role and a Non Consul role and will need the Consul role in order to provide the appropriate executive assistance. :::::::: You have raised a lot of other points that I will take into consideration, such as the low local edit count. Thank you for the extremely helpful and insightful observations. :::::::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:56, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I had far less edits back when I was a Global Sysop on Miraheze. Edits is not the end all be all. Further, it is clear to me that there is either a lack of understanding from you on the differences between having Global user rights and local user rights. For PixDeVI their use of global rights is governed by global Miraheze policy which dictates when and when they cannot use their global rights to intervene, but them asking for local rights it is allowing them to effectively not only help us Consuls, but also allow them to act based on our local policies outside of the governance of global policy requirements which can be restrictive and ultimately lead to relying on myself or another of the very few active Consuls which can lead to delays or even missed violations. ::::Please note my above comment does not reflect a vote but rather an observation of the discussion you have started. I neither endorse or oppose the candidate. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 14:04, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::The concern is not unfair; a user of this few edits both globally and locally seeking such a project leadership role is irregular, even with the precedent of [[Special:CentralAuth/subwayfares|subwayfares]] for wiki creation on Meta. Typically in a wiki that is fully independent this would be stranger as you would hope a leader is representative of the project, although there is merit to onboarding a trusted user in an advisory or supporting capacity. I would argue the key here is that this is ultimately a [[m:miraheze projects|Miraheze Project]]. I believe its identity as such should be a modifier for cases like this and that it is ideal for global functionaries to be more tightly bound with such a project, recommended in queue by wiki creators as it is with a domain currently hosted at WikiTide Foundation's grace. This may not be the ideal way to do it; my theory is to propose stewards as 'at large' consuls should locally invested members need a 'third opinion', more local consuls are involved and so on. Global administrators could perhaps fill the intermediary second line role bureaucrat serves, able to step in if there is backlog or an incident (short of something a GA/steward should step in for anyway). Otherwise there is a strong culture of 'separation of roles' at issue here and which is why pixel can't necessarily just jump in and do these things: it is not GS mandate. Therefore this request is an extension of his capabilities to reduce 'paperwork'. ::Essentially what I'm getting at is this request is reasonable, but skepticism of his investment in ''this'' local project holding such a role is also reasonable. And ideally, better tying the wiki to global operations through a community discussion is the best path in my opinion. The same for other projects such as dev and commons which already sort of act this way - zppix and alpad are local figures, reception and some others are global figures tied in, but as you see with the [[Special:ListUsers/consul|consul list]] it's a bit messy, outdated. ::Finally and drawing back a bit, there is no issue with an IP expressing these opinions. I would support their right to do so. I would also support a blocked user expressing a reasonable opinion to the degree I would offer to relay reasonable thoughts as food for thought even if they are blocked. An occasion where the IP editor and the blocked user overlap however is a very dangerous game that should discontinue immediately. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 23:22, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I agree with Raidarr. Test Wiki is structured very differently from other types of Wikis which makes it more difficult to identify or measure a candidate's qualifications by traditional means. :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:07, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' for {{ping|PixDeVl}}
What is meant by '''an extra hand helping keep things clean'''? What kind of things?
--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:45, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] TestWiki by its nature isn’t in dire need of conventional clean up work, but we have seen a recent uptick in issues where trolls go on mass desysoping sprees or otherwise cause a ruckus(something I believe Zppix has also wanted to address in policy), but as Raidarr said, PTW is an official Miraheze project, and as such, I don’t believe relying on really 2 activish functionaries to keep an eye on the place and make sure it’s tidy is viable or appropriate, hence my offering to take up the bit to properly police when issues come up beyond what’s included in the GA mandate and codified in local policy. Contrary to our anon friend, I do not claim to “need” these rights, I am offering to lend a hand to the small consul team in supplement to my other duties, and believe it would be beneficial to undergo this RFP to be able to do so without having to worry about global role scope ambiguity among other things. [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 15:00, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :::Thank you for answering my first question. :::[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' followup for {{ping|PixDeVl}} :::Hypothetically, if some disruptive activities were committed with the very best of intentions due to questionable judgement, how would you help wayward testers tweak their behavior before further violations take them straight to a permanent ban? :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:47, 6 March 2025 (UTC) ::::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] Should a user unknowingly or mistakenly violate the [[TW:Testing policy|Testing policy]], we should, as with any wiki, [[wp:assume good faith|assume good faith]] that they do not mean to purposely harm the project. That means contacting them in a civil tone to explain what they were doing and why it’s an issue, how to do whatever they want to do properly, and cleaning up. If they are acting in obvious bad faith or continue to be disruptive after multiple escalating warnings, only then should sanctions such as a serious block be applied ideally. [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 12:53, 6 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} Pix is one of the most promising young volunteers we've had in the nearly 6 years I've been aorund. I am glad to have the extra support for testwiki. The vast majority of users support the changes of policy with relation to [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats]]. With a successful RfC here, consuls will undertake a review of all active bureaucrats to determine which users will retain rights. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 20:36, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} While Bureaucrat has historically been implemented as a testing role, the low requirements for entry into the role coupled with broad/disruptive permission sets has made it a prime target for bad actors - repeat instances of malicious abuse of Bureaucrat permissions necessitating intervention by global volunteers has made clear that a change is needed. Simultaneously, the relatively small number of active testwiki Consuls has meant that policy enforcement activities haven't always gotten timely action and oversight, and assistance by trusted users is needed to keep testwiki operating as a true testing space. As such, this proposal aims to convert the Bureaucrat role from one of generic testing to one of moderate trust, eliminating the easy abuse vector while remaining readily achievable and providing consuls more support in day-to-day operations. The proposed changes to [[TW:Bureaucrats|TestWiki:Bureaucrats]] can be found [[User:Zppix/Draft/Bureaucrats#Proposed Page Text Changes|on this draft page]] under the Proposed Page Text Changes section. I believe these requirements look good. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 13:55, 11 March 2025 (UTC) #{{support}} Per above. __NEWSECTIONLINK__ == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 18:36, 3 March 2025 (UTC) :'''Update: the updated [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Blocking policy|blocking policy]]''' is now in effect as of Monday, March 2nd 6:16PM UTC-6. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:45, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] Could you summarize the changes made? Thanks! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::@[[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] Consuls, CVT, and Stewards are the only ones authorized to issue non-test blocks, test blocks can now only be done on accounts the user controls or on approved test accounts, appeals are only done via the blocked user’s talk page, or by emailing the blocking Consul, third party appeals are no longer accepted. I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! I obviously do not object the policy, just wanted your say on what you changed. :) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:08, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::ZPPIX WHY DO YOU KEEP MAKING POLICY CHANGES WITHOUT CONSENSUS! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 21:05, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::I do this as well on a local wiki that isn't the test one as an admin that can enforce and change rules around to keep it up to date like yes communities are needed but not for everything that are granted rights to staff. [[User:339Breakingoof|TheFunny339YoshiPlushGuy]] ([[User talk:339Breakingoof|talk]]) 13:38, 9 May 2025 (UTC) == Request for Consul (PixDeVl) == {{Discussion top|{{done}}, welcome to the Consul team. Please reach out if you have any questions. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 11:26, 9 March 2025 (UTC)}} Hi folks, I’m filing this Request for Consul, frankly because I noticed that we currently have only 2 remotely active Consuls, being Zppix and Reception, and, even with something like PTW, having an official project wiki be run by two folks isn’t great, so I’d thought I’d offer to lend a hand. I am not very active priorly with what exists of the community on PTW, but as a current global functionary, I still think it wouldn’t hurt to have an extra hand helping keep things clean. Feel free to ask any questions regarding this, as always :) —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 03:35, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}}  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   03:39, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} trusted user. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:38, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I looked into his CA. 1270 edits is extremely few for a user who is GA. Unfortunately this lowers my trust in this user even more. Maybe if the user was more involved cross-wiki I would change my mind, but unfortunately that is not the case. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:47, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I get that you look from the ground floor up. I have a more centered view from the MetaWiki and Discord. He is a trusted user who has been a great asset to the broader community. ::::I feel that you are gate keeping the local community, and that is your prerogative, but I think that PTW will benefit from his policy knowhow as well as his activity on the technical side. (Phorge) ::::On the other hand I find that waiting for first comments to arrive before answering on your own RfP doesn't make you to eager, as if one is collecting hats. I can assure you he's not. ::::I cannot take your concerns away, but hope you want to see it from the outside in, instead of the inside out.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:49, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::I do not believe in Quantity, but Quality. I can make 1000's of edits, but they do not tell much.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:50, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::::These are beautiful and classic words... == Request for Consul ==

: --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:44, 3 February 2025 (UTC)

::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:47, 3 February 2025 (UTC)

== Refreshing created a test page ==

I was told my test page was labeled abusive because it was short and had "bad words." I opted to use the preview bar instead. Later I refreshed the page (F5) and for some reason that created it. No bad words, but the page will probably be gone by the time you see this. Posting because it said to log an issue [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 01:57, 15 February 2025 (UTC)

== Can't undo ==

It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 11:26, 9 March 2025 (UTC)}} Hi folks, I’m filing this Request for Consul, frankly because I noticed that we currently have only 2 remotely active Consuls, being Zppix and Reception, and, even with something like PTW, having an official project wiki be run by two folks isn’t great, so I’d thought I’d offer to lend a hand. Feel free to ask any questions regarding this, as always :) —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 03:35, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}}  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   03:39, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} trusted user. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:38, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I looked into his CA. 1270 edits is extremely few for a user who is GA. Unfortunately this lowers my trust in this user even more. Maybe if the user was more involved cross-wiki I would change my mind, but unfortunately that is not the case. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:47, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I get that you look from the ground floor up. I have a more centered view from the MetaWiki and Discord. He is a trusted user who has been a great asset to the broader community. ::::I feel that you are gate keeping the local community, and that is your prerogative, but I think that PTW will benefit from his policy knowhow as well as his activity on the technical side. (Phorge) ::::On the other hand I find that waiting for first comments to arrive before answering on your own RfP doesn't make you to eager, as if one is collecting hats. I can assure you he's not. ::::I cannot take your concerns away, but hope you want to see it from the outside in, instead of the inside out.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:49, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::I do not believe in Quantity, but Quality. I can make 1000's of edits, but they do not tell much.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:50, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::::These are beautiful and classic words... However, can you explain to me why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions? Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW? I can't understand it. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:57, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::I think Zppix explains it perfectly. Being a Consul falls under different policies. Thus he needs to request permission to function here under the localpolcies.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   14:07, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::Hi, [[User:94.254.227.16|      ]] :::::::: I found your questions deeply compelling. As a result, I feel that I have gained a bit more understanding of Test Wiki. :::::::* '''Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW?''' :::::::As I understand it, Bureaucrat and Administrator are testing roles. As such, the roles cannot be used to uphold or enforce policy without creating confusion for the other Non Consuls within the community as to what is acceptable behavior. :::::::* '''why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions?''' :::::::Clearly PixDeVl recognizes that there is a distinction between a Consul role and a Non Consul role and will need the Consul role in order to provide the appropriate executive assistance. :::::::: You have raised a lot of other points that I will take into consideration, such as the low local edit count. Thank you for the extremely helpful and insightful observations. :::::::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:56, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I had far less edits back when I was a Global Sysop on Miraheze. Edits is not the end all be all. Further, it is clear to me that there is either a lack of understanding from you on the differences between having Global user rights and local user rights. For PixDeVI their use of global rights is governed by global Miraheze policy which dictates when and when they cannot use their global rights to intervene, but them asking for local rights it is allowing them to effectively not only help us Consuls, but also allow them to act based on our local policies outside of the governance of global policy requirements which can be restrictive and ultimately lead to relying on myself or another of the very few active Consuls which can lead to delays or even missed violations. ::::Please note my above comment does not reflect a vote but rather an observation of the discussion you have started. I neither endorse or oppose the candidate. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 14:04, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::The concern is not unfair; a user of this few edits both globally and locally seeking such a project leadership role is irregular, even with the precedent of [[Special:CentralAuth/subwayfares|subwayfares]] for wiki creation on Meta. Typically in a wiki that is fully independent this would be stranger as you would hope a leader is representative of the project, although there is merit to onboarding a trusted user in an advisory or supporting capacity. I would argue the key here is that this is ultimately a [[m:miraheze projects|Miraheze Project]]. I believe its identity as such should be a modifier for cases like this and that it is ideal for global functionaries to be more tightly bound with such a project, recommended in queue by wiki creators as it is with a domain currently hosted at WikiTide Foundation's grace. This may not be the ideal way to do it; my theory is to propose stewards as 'at large' consuls should locally invested members need a 'third opinion', more local consuls are involved and so on. Global administrators could perhaps fill the intermediary second line role bureaucrat serves, able to step in if there is backlog or an incident (short of something a GA/steward should step in for anyway). Otherwise there is a strong culture of 'separation of roles' at issue here and which is why pixel can't necessarily just jump in and do these things: it is not GS mandate. Therefore this request is an extension of his capabilities to reduce 'paperwork'. ::Essentially what I'm getting at is this request is reasonable, but skepticism of his investment in ''this'' local project holding such a role is also reasonable. And ideally, better tying the wiki to global operations through a community discussion is the best path in my opinion. The same for other projects such as dev and commons which already sort of act this way - zppix and alpad are local figures, reception and some others are global figures tied in, but as you see with the [[Special:ListUsers/consul|consul list]] it's a bit messy, outdated. ::Finally and drawing back a bit, there is no issue with an IP expressing these opinions. I would support their right to do so. I would also support a blocked user expressing a reasonable opinion to the degree I would offer to relay reasonable thoughts as food for thought even if they are blocked. An occasion where the IP editor and the blocked user overlap however is a very dangerous game that should discontinue immediately. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 23:22, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I agree with Raidarr. Test Wiki is structured very differently from other types of Wikis which makes it more difficult to identify or measure a candidate's qualifications by traditional means. :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:07, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' for {{ping|PixDeVl}}
What is meant by '''an extra hand helping keep things clean'''? What kind of things?
--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:45, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] TestWiki by its nature isn’t in dire need of conventional clean up work, but we have seen a recent uptick in issues where trolls go on mass desysoping sprees or otherwise cause a ruckus(something I believe Zppix has also wanted to address in policy), but as Raidarr said, PTW is an official Miraheze project, and as such, I don’t believe relying on really 2 activish functionaries to keep an eye on the place and make sure it’s tidy is viable or appropriate, hence my offering to take up the bit to properly police when issues come up beyond what’s included in the GA mandate and codified in local policy. Contrary to our anon friend, I do not claim to “need” these rights, I am offering to lend a hand to the small consul team in supplement to my other duties, and believe it would be beneficial to undergo this RFP to be able to do so without having to worry about global role scope ambiguity among other things. [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 15:00, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :::Thank you for answering my first question. :::[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' followup for {{ping|PixDeVl}} :::Hypothetically, if some disruptive activities were committed with the very best of intentions due to questionable judgement, how would you help wayward testers tweak their behavior before further violations take them straight to a permanent ban? :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:47, 6 March 2025 (UTC) ::::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] Should a user unknowingly or mistakenly violate the [[TW:Testing policy|Testing policy]], we should, as with any wiki, [[wp:assume good faith|assume good faith]] that they do not mean to purposely harm the project. That means contacting them in a civil tone to explain what they were doing and why it’s an issue, how to do whatever they want to do properly, and cleaning up. If they are acting in obvious bad faith or continue to be disruptive after multiple escalating warnings, only then should sanctions such as a serious block be applied ideally. [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 12:53, 6 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} Pix is one of the most promising young volunteers we've had in the nearly 6 years I've been aorund. I am glad to have the extra support for testwiki. [[User:RhinosF1|RhinosF1]] ([[User talk:RhinosF1|talk]]) 20:20, 7 March 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}}
