[[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]] · [[Special:Contributions/Codename Noreste|contribs]]) 06:08, 24 May 2025 (UTC) == Recent vandalism == There is a fair amount of vandalism from yesterday, that has yet to be undone, mostly because of the complex nature of trying to accurately unmerge page histories. Ultimately this is a Consul decision, but we could try and undo everything, which would be a lot of work, mostly from trying to figure out what goes where, or we could potentially restore from a database or XML backup, where we would inevitably lose some of the latest revisions. Again, this is up to consuls to decide, but we need to think about what would be more practical. [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 13:47, 28 April 2025 (UTC) :If the copy is merged, before any restoring from backup, perhaps review the contributions and identify all the users who contributed. :Then find the history of the contribution from the user's original and there should be a Diff. :Idk about what is practical but if you wish, I can take a look at the merged copy to see if there is a pattern. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 29 April 2025 (UTC) ::From Revisions: ::[https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/User_talk:Void/mangled_page_history?diff=61326&oldid=61235 Reception123] ::[https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/User_talk:Void/mangled_page_history?diff=61524&oldid=61507 AlPaD] ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:54, 29 April 2025 (UTC) :::{{Ping|MacFan4000}} and {{Ping|Imamy}} Hello, I agree with restore the database and I understand that it's necessary [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 17:07, 29 April 2025 (UTC) == Error in filter == I was trying to create a test page but filter disallowed me to page What message I received:This action has been automatically identified as harmful, and therefore disallowed. If you believe your action was constructive, please report this error at the community portal. A brief description of the abuse rule which your action matched is: LTA 60 [[User:Dennis566|Dennis566]] ([[User talk:Dennis566|talk]]) 17:26, 29 April 2025 (UTC) :Hi {{ping|Dennis566}}, :: Test Wiki limits the number of pages that can be created at a time. :: Due to the limit, it's possible that the message you get will be different than messages that the Admins and higher ups will get for the same type of action. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 22:08, 29 April 2025 (UTC) == Request for consulship == I, KahootNickname1234, want to be a consul because I have done non-test actions. There are no eligiblity requirements for consul so I am eligible to place a request. [[Special:Contributions/38.158.220.26|38.158.220.26]] 04:49, 4 May 2025 (UTC) :Declined, all accounts locked and blocked for vandalism on PublicTestWiki. --[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 04:50, 4 May 2025 (UTC) == Administrators Policy update == Due to constant abuse, the policy regarding [[TW:Administrators|administrators]] has been updated to include changes to deter bad actors. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:46, 4 May 2025 (UTC) :Thanks! This was a much needed change considering recent issues. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 15:25, 4 May 2025 (UTC) == Change the bureaucrat requirement == {{Discussion top|1={{Not done}} this is an anti-abuse measure and will not be done. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:47, 4 May 2025 (UTC)}} Change the bureaucrat requirement from 3 months (89-92 days) to 2 months (59-62 days) because that is consistent with Miraheze's Meta Wiki creator. Bureaucrats shouldn't have to wait that long because of the 200 edit requirement and people are impatient. ===Three month edit to day ratio=== 200/92=2.17391304348 and 200/89=2.24719101124 round up to 3 edits per day. ===Two month edit to day ratio=== 200/62=3.22580645161 and 200/59=3.38983050847 round up to 4 edits per day. ===Support=== #{{Support}} per proposer [[User:KahootNickname1234|KahootNickname1234]] ([[User talk:KahootNickname1234|talk]]) 07:51, 3 May 2025 (UTC) ===Neutral=== ===Oppose=== {{Discussion bottom}} == About translate == As a Chinese user and translator, I think "zh-cn" is unnecessary and should be converted to "zh-hans", "zh-hant", etc. After conversion, zh-cn should be deleted. I'd like to know everyone's opinions. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 03:55, 5 May 2025 (UTC) :Hi, as a non Chinese speaker, can you explain the difference and the reasoning behind why you think this should be done so I can understand better? Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 13:25, 5 May 2025 (UTC) ::Simply put, zh-cn is generally only used in mainland China, and these users use simplified Chinese, zh-hans. I don't think there is any big difference between the two. Hans has a wider range of applications, so I think it is possible to only retain hans to improve translation efficiency, and users do not need to think about which language they should choose. I don't know if I'm expressing the difference well with what I mean. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 15:14, 5 May 2025 (UTC) == ManageWiki policy change == {{Discussion top|1={{Not done}} Rollback can still be abused. If a user can simply wait until they are eligible for admin. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 13:23, 5 May 2025 (UTC)}} Can we change policy so that autopatrolled users can have rollback rights. This is because now you have to wait 240 hours for admin which includes rollback. Rollback does not require that much trust unlike delete and block which is in the admin group. ===Support=== ===Neutral=== ===Oppose=== # Hard no, we have enough issues with throwaway accounts being used to cause trouble. --[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 02:09, 5 May 2025 (UTC) # {{Oppose}} Rollback can also easily cause trouble. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 03:24, 5 May 2025 (UTC) # Nope, I don't believe rollback is that necessary. Users should be able to wait for someone to assign administrator rights. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 13:20, 5 May 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == publictestwiki.com or test.miraheze.org == publictestwiki.com or test.miraheze.org? Differences? Preferred link? Does it even matter at all [[User:Clover-not-used|Clover-not-used]] ([[User talk:Clover-not-used|talk]]) 02:36, 6 May 2025 (UTC) :They are the same thing and will lead you to the same site. The only visual difference is one uses a custom domain and one uses the Miraheze subdomain. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 03:14, 6 May 2025 (UTC) == Suggestion: editing here pops up a "big blue button?" or something == Not sure how feasibly it is technically but seeing as I missed the "big blue button"... somehow...? [[User:Clover-not-used|Clover-not-used]] ([[User talk:Clover-not-used|talk]]) 02:48, 6 May 2025 (UTC) :When I edit, I see a blue button that says [[Save changes]]. :If the blue button is missing, maybe the page did not load properly. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 23:24, 6 May 2025 (UTC) ::Oh I meant the big blue button saying "New thread" at the top I missed [[User:Clover-not-used|Clover-not-used]] ([[User talk:Clover-not-used|talk]]) 13:30, 7 May 2025 (UTC) :::I see it now! :::When that button goes unnoticed, it's probably a sign that it's time to archive some messages... :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 00:16, 8 May 2025 (UTC) == Request for bureaucrat == {{Discussion top|Closing this as {{notdone|no consensus}}, given the lack of any !votes in support (or opposition). —'''''[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] [[User Talk:PixDeVl|talk to me!]]''''' 01:22, 19 June 2025 (UTC)}} I served as a previous bureaucrat before the new requirements were implemented, and thus is familiar with the rules and regulations including the new ones. I would like this right for helping with maintenance task, such as with the RFP pages as well as all [https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/TestWiki:Bureaucrats#Responsibilities these]. I am familiar with the relevant policies and will use the tools with care and responsibility. Please feel free to ask any questions or raise concerns.[[User:Cactusisme|'''Cactus🌵''']] [[User talk:Cactusisme|spiky]] [[Special:Contributions/Cactusisme|ouch]] 12:02, 28 May 2025 (UTC) :{{Note}} Please do understand that bureaucrat rights are not for testing. Bureaucrats now serve a functional role in assisting consuls. [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 15:37, 28 May 2025 (UTC) ::Noted--[[User:Cactusisme|'''Cactus🌵''']] [[User talk:Cactusisme|spiky]] [[Special:Contributions/Cactusisme|ouch]] 11:02, 30 May 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}}

{{Aan}} == Request for Consul == I have made constructive non-test edits and I am a bureaucrat so should I become a consul? [[User:MiraEdit|MiraEdit]] ([[User talk:MiraEdit|talk]]) 23:04, 2 February 2025 (UTC) :: Please review the terms on the Test Wiki Main page [[TestWiki]], specifically the rules listed in the section [[TestWiki#Things to keep in mind]]. If you are not sure which rule was violated, you should reach out to [[m:Steward requests]] or discuss at the [[m:Community portal]]. : --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:44, 3 February 2025 (UTC) ::: I know my answer didn't really answer your question, but basically, every wiki is different. Please learn more about Test Wiki if you really want to become a Consul. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:47, 3 February 2025 (UTC) == Refreshing created a test page == I was told my test page was labeled abusive because it was short and had "bad words." I opted to use the preview bar instead. Later I refreshed the page (F5) and for some reason that created it. No bad words, but the page will probably be gone by the time you see this. Posting because it said to log an issue [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 01:57, 15 February 2025 (UTC) == Can't undo == All of a sudden, I can't undo. I even went to contributions and reverted from there, but the pages still exist and have the content [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 04:30, 18 February 2025 (UTC) :Don't know which pages you are referring to. I could be wrong, but generally, we can rollback 1 and if someone has already contributed after your contribution, then rollback is not possible. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 25 February 2025 (UTC) == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 18:36, 3 March 2025 (UTC) :'''Update: the updated [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Blocking policy|blocking policy]]''' is now in effect as of Monday, March 2nd 6:16PM UTC-6. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:45, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] Could you summarize the changes made? Thanks! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::@[[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] Consuls, CVT, and Stewards are the only ones authorized to issue non-test blocks, test blocks can now only be done on accounts the user controls or on approved test accounts, appeals are only done via the blocked user’s talk page, or by emailing the blocking Consul, third party appeals are no longer accepted. I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! I obviously do not object the policy, just wanted your say on what you changed. :) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:08, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::ZPPIX WHY DO YOU KEEP MAKING POLICY CHANGES WITHOUT CONSENSUS! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 21:05, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::I do this as well on a local wiki that isn't the test one as an admin that can enforce and change rules around to keep it up to date like yes communities are needed but not for everything that are granted rights to staff. [[User:339Breakingoof|TheFunny339YoshiPlushGuy]] ([[User talk:339Breakingoof|talk]]) 13:38, 9 May 2025 (UTC) == Request for Consul (PixDeVl) == {{Discussion top|{{done}}, welcome to the Consul team. Please reach out if you have any questions. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 11:26, 9 March 2025 (UTC)}} Hi folks, I’m filing this Request for Consul, frankly because I noticed that we currently have only 2 remotely active Consuls, being Zppix and Reception, and, even with something like PTW, having an official project wiki be run by two folks isn’t great, so I’d thought I’d offer to lend a hand. I am not very active priorly with what exists of the community on PTW, but as a current global functionary, I still think it wouldn’t hurt to have an extra hand helping keep things clean. Feel free to ask any questions regarding this, as always :) —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 03:35, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}}  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   03:39, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} trusted user. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:38, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I looked into his CA. 1270 edits is extremely few for a user who is GA. Unfortunately this lowers my trust in this user even more. Maybe if the user was more involved cross-wiki I would change my mind, but unfortunately that is not the case. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:47, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I get that you look from the ground floor up. I have a more centered view from the MetaWiki and Discord. He is a trusted user who has been a great asset to the broader community. ::::I feel that you are gate keeping the local community, and that is your prerogative, but I think that PTW will benefit from his policy knowhow as well as his activity on the technical side. (Phorge) ::::On the other hand I find that waiting for first comments to arrive before answering on your own RfP doesn't make you to eager, as if one is collecting hats. I can assure you he's not. ::::I cannot take your concerns away, but hope you want to see it from the outside in, instead of the inside out.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:49, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::I do not believe in Quantity, but Quality. I can make 1000's of edits, but they do not tell much.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:50, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::::These are beautiful and classic words... However, can you explain to me why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions? Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW? I can't understand it. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:57, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::I think Zppix explains it perfectly. Being a Consul falls under different policies. Thus he needs to request permission to function here under the localpolcies.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   14:07, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::Hi, [[User:94.254.227.16|      ]] :::::::: I found your questions deeply compelling. As a result, I feel that I have gained a bit more understanding of Test Wiki. :::::::* '''Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW?''' :::::::As I understand it, Bureaucrat and Administrator are testing roles. As such, the roles cannot be used to uphold or enforce policy without creating confusion for the other Non Consuls within the community as to what is acceptable behavior. :::::::* '''why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions?''' :::::::Clearly PixDeVl recognizes that there is a distinction between a Consul role and a Non Consul role and will need the Consul role in order to provide the appropriate executive assistance. :::::::: You have raised a lot of other points that I will take into consideration, such as the low local edit count. Thank you for the extremely helpful and insightful observations. :::::::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:56, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I had far less edits back when I was a Global Sysop on Miraheze. Edits is not the end all be all. Further, it is clear to me that there is either a lack of understanding from you on the differences between having Global user rights and local user rights. For PixDeVI their use of global rights is governed by global Miraheze policy which dictates when and when they cannot use their global rights to intervene, but them asking for local rights it is allowing them to effectively not only help us Consuls, but also allow them to act based on our local policies outside of the governance of global policy requirements which can be restrictive and ultimately lead to relying on myself or another of the very few active Consuls which can lead to delays or even missed violations. ::::Please note my above comment does not reflect a vote but rather an observation of the discussion you have started. I neither endorse or oppose the candidate. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 14:04, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::The concern is not unfair; a user of this few edits both globally and locally seeking such a project leadership role is irregular, even with the precedent of [[Special:CentralAuth/subwayfares|subwayfares]] for wiki creation on Meta. Typically in a wiki that is fully independent this would be stranger as you would hope a leader is representative of the project, although there is merit to onboarding a trusted user in an advisory or supporting capacity. I would argue the key here is that this is ultimately a [[m:miraheze projects|Miraheze Project]]. I believe its identity as such should be a modifier for cases like this and that it is ideal for global functionaries to be more tightly bound with such a project, recommended in queue by wiki creators as it is with a domain currently hosted at WikiTide Foundation's grace. This may not be the ideal way to do it; my theory is to propose stewards as 'at large' consuls should locally invested members need a 'third opinion', more local consuls are involved and so on. Global administrators could perhaps fill the intermediary second line role bureaucrat serves, able to step in if there is backlog or an incident (short of something a GA/steward should step in for anyway). Otherwise there is a strong culture of 'separation of roles' at issue here and which is why pixel can't necessarily just jump in and do these things: it is not GS mandate. Therefore this request is an extension of his capabilities to reduce 'paperwork'. ::Essentially what I'm getting at is this request is reasonable, but skepticism of his investment in ''this'' local project holding such a role is also reasonable. And ideally, better tying the wiki to global operations through a community discussion is the best path in my opinion. The same for other projects such as dev and commons which already sort of act this way - zppix and alpad are local figures, reception and some others are global figures tied in, but as you see with the [[Special:ListUsers/consul|consul list]] it's a bit messy, outdated. ::Finally and drawing back a bit, there is no issue with an IP expressing these opinions. I would support their right to do so. I would also support a blocked user expressing a reasonable opinion to the degree I would offer to relay reasonable thoughts as food for thought even if they are blocked. An occasion where the IP editor and the blocked user overlap however is a very dangerous game that should discontinue immediately. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 23:22, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I agree with Raidarr. Test Wiki is structured very differently from other types of Wikis which makes it more difficult to identify or measure a candidate's qualifications by traditional means. :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:07, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' for {{ping|PixDeVl}}
What is meant by '''an extra hand helping keep things clean'''? What kind of things?

{{Aan}} == Request for Consul == I have made constructive non-test edits and I am a bureaucrat so should I become a consul? [[User:MiraEdit|MiraEdit]] ([[User talk:MiraEdit|talk]]) 23:04, 2 February 2025 (UTC) :: Please review the terms on the Test Wiki Main page [[TestWiki]], specifically the rules listed in the section [[TestWiki#Things to keep in mind]]. If you are not sure which rule was violated, you should reach out to [[m:Steward requests]] or discuss at the [[m:Community portal]]. : --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:44, 3 February 2025 (UTC) ::: I know my answer didn't really answer your question, but basically, every wiki is different. Please learn more about Test Wiki if you really want to become a Consul. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:47, 3 February 2025 (UTC) == Refreshing created a test page == I was told my test page was labeled abusive because it was short and had "bad words." I opted to use the preview bar instead. Later I refreshed the page (F5) and for some reason that created it. No bad words, but the page will probably be gone by the time you see this. Posting because it said to log an issue [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 01:57, 15 February 2025 (UTC) == Can't undo == All of a sudden, I can't undo. I even went to contributions and reverted from there, but the pages still exist and have the content [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 04:30, 18 February 2025 (UTC) :Don't know which pages you are referring to. I could be wrong, but generally, we can rollback 1 and if someone has already contributed after your contribution, then rollback is not possible. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 25 February 2025 (UTC) == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 18:36, 3 March 2025 (UTC) :'''Update: the updated [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Blocking policy|blocking policy]]''' is now in effect as of Monday, March 2nd 6:16PM UTC-6. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:45, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] Could you summarize the changes made? Thanks! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::@[[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] Consuls, CVT, and Stewards are the only ones authorized to issue non-test blocks, test blocks can now only be done on accounts the user controls or on approved test accounts, appeals are only done via the blocked user’s talk page, or by emailing the blocking Consul, third party appeals are no longer accepted. I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! I obviously do not object the policy, just wanted your say on what you changed. :) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:08, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::ZPPIX WHY DO YOU KEEP MAKING POLICY CHANGES WITHOUT CONSENSUS! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 21:05, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::I do this as well on a local wiki that isn't the test one as an admin that can enforce and change rules around to keep it up to date like yes communities are needed but not for everything that are granted rights to staff. [[User:339Breakingoof|TheFunny339YoshiPlushGuy]] ([[User talk:339Breakingoof|talk]]) 13:38, 9 May 2025 (UTC) == Request for Consul (PixDeVl) == {{Discussion top|{{done}}, welcome to the Consul team. Please reach out if you have any questions. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 11:26, 9 March 2025 (UTC)}} Hi folks, I’m filing this Request for Consul, frankly because I noticed that we currently have only 2 remotely active Consuls, being Zppix and Reception, and, even with something like PTW, having an official project wiki be run by two folks isn’t great, so I’d thought I’d offer to lend a hand. I am not very active priorly with what exists of the community on PTW, but as a current global functionary, I still think it wouldn’t hurt to have an extra hand helping keep things clean. Feel free to ask any questions regarding this, as always :) —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 03:35, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}}  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   03:39, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} trusted user. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:38, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I looked into his CA. 1270 edits is extremely few for a user who is GA. Unfortunately this lowers my trust in this user even more. Maybe if the user was more involved cross-wiki I would change my mind, but unfortunately that is not the case. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:47, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I get that you look from the ground floor up. I have a more centered view from the MetaWiki and Discord. He is a trusted user who has been a great asset to the broader community. ::::I feel that you are gate keeping the local community, and that is your prerogative, but I think that PTW will benefit from his policy knowhow as well as his activity on the technical side. (Phorge) ::::On the other hand I find that waiting for first comments to arrive before answering on your own RfP doesn't make you to eager, as if one is collecting hats. I can assure you he's not. ::::I cannot take your concerns away, but hope you want to see it from the outside in, instead of the inside out.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:49, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::I do not believe in Quantity, but Quality. I can make 1000's of edits, but they do not tell much.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:50, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::::These are beautiful and classic words... However, can you explain to me why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions? Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW? I can't understand it. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:57, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::I think Zppix explains it perfectly. Being a Consul falls under different policies. Thus he needs to request permission to function here under the localpolcies.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   14:07, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::Hi, [[User:94.254.227.16|      ]] :::::::: I found your questions deeply compelling. As a result, I feel that I have gained a bit more understanding of Test Wiki. :::::::* '''Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW?''' :::::::As I understand it, Bureaucrat and Administrator are testing roles. As such, the roles cannot be used to uphold or enforce policy without creating confusion for the other Non Consuls within the community as to what is acceptable behavior. :::::::* '''why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions?''' :::::::Clearly PixDeVl recognizes that there is a distinction between a Consul role and a Non Consul role and will need the Consul role in order to provide the appropriate executive assistance. :::::::: You have raised a lot of other points that I will take into consideration, such as the low local edit count. Thank you for the extremely helpful and insightful observations. :::::::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:56, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I had far less edits back when I was a Global Sysop on Miraheze. Edits is not the end all be all. Further, it is clear to me that there is either a lack of understanding from you on the differences between having Global user rights and local user rights. For PixDeVI their use of global rights is governed by global Miraheze policy which dictates when and when they cannot use their global rights to intervene, but them asking for local rights it is allowing them to effectively not only help us Consuls, but also allow them to act based on our local policies outside of the governance of global policy requirements which can be restrictive and ultimately lead to relying on myself or another of the very few active Consuls which can lead to delays or even missed violations. ::::Please note my above comment does not reflect a vote but rather an observation of the discussion you have started. I neither endorse or oppose the candidate. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 14:04, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::The concern is not unfair; a user of this few edits both globally and locally seeking such a project leadership role is irregular, even with the precedent of [[Special:CentralAuth/subwayfares|subwayfares]] for wiki creation on Meta. Typically in a wiki that is fully independent this would be stranger as you would hope a leader is representative of the project, although there is merit to onboarding a trusted user in an advisory or supporting capacity. I would argue the key here is that this is ultimately a [[m:miraheze projects|Miraheze Project]]. I believe its identity as such should be a modifier for cases like this and that it is ideal for global functionaries to be more tightly bound with such a project, recommended in queue by wiki creators as it is with a domain currently hosted at WikiTide Foundation's grace. This may not be the ideal way to do it; my theory is to propose stewards as 'at large' consuls should locally invested members need a 'third opinion', more local consuls are involved and so on. Global administrators could perhaps fill the intermediary second line role bureaucrat serves, able to step in if there is backlog or an incident (short of something a GA/steward should step in for anyway). Otherwise there is a strong culture of 'separation of roles' at issue here and which is why pixel can't necessarily just jump in and do these things: it is not GS mandate. Therefore this request is an extension of his capabilities to reduce 'paperwork'. ::Essentially what I'm getting at is this request is reasonable, but skepticism of his investment in ''this'' local project holding such a role is also reasonable. And ideally, better tying the wiki to global operations through a community discussion is the best path in my opinion. The same for other projects such as dev and commons which already sort of act this way - zppix and alpad are local figures, reception and some others are global figures tied in, but as you see with the [[Special:ListUsers/consul|consul list]] it's a bit messy, outdated. ::Finally and drawing back a bit, there is no issue with an IP expressing these opinions. I would support their right to do so. I would also support a blocked user expressing a reasonable opinion to the degree I would offer to relay reasonable thoughts as food for thought even if they are blocked. An occasion where the IP editor and the blocked user overlap however is a very dangerous game that should discontinue immediately. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 23:22, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I agree with Raidarr. Test Wiki is structured very differently from other types of Wikis which makes it more difficult to identify or measure a candidate's qualifications by traditional means. :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:07, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' for {{ping|PixDeVl}}
What is meant by '''an extra hand helping keep things clean'''? What kind of things?
--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:45, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] TestWiki by its nature isn’t in dire need of conventional clean up work, but we have seen a recent uptick in issues where trolls go on mass desysoping sprees or otherwise cause a ruckus(something I believe Zppix has also wanted to address in policy), but as Raidarr said, PTW is an official Miraheze project, and as such, I don’t believe relying on really 2 activish functionaries to keep an eye on the place and make sure it’s tidy is viable or appropriate, hence my offering to take up the bit to properly police when issues come up beyond what’s included in the GA mandate and codified in local policy. Contrary to our anon friend, I do not claim to “need” these rights, I am offering to lend a hand to the small consul team in supplement to my other duties, and believe it would be beneficial to undergo this RFP to be able to do so without having to worry about global role scope ambiguity among other things. [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 15:00, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :::Thank you for answering my first question. :::[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' followup for {{ping|PixDeVl}} :::Hypothetically, if some disruptive activities were committed with the very best of intentions due to questionable judgement, how would you help wayward testers tweak their behavior before further violations take them straight to a permanent ban? :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:47, 6 March 2025 (UTC) ::::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] Should a user unknowingly or mistakenly violate the [[TW:Testing policy|Testing policy]], we should, as with any wiki, [[wp:assume good faith|assume good faith]] that they do not mean to purposely harm the project. That means contacting them in a civil tone to explain what they were doing and why it’s an issue, how to do whatever they want to do properly, and cleaning up. If they are acting in obvious bad faith or continue to be disruptive after multiple escalating warnings, only then should sanctions such as a serious block be applied ideally. [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 12:53, 6 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} Pix is one of the most promising young volunteers we've had in the nearly 6 years I've been aorund. I am glad to have the extra support for testwiki. [[User:RhinosF1|RhinosF1]] ([[User talk:RhinosF1|talk]]) 20:20, 7 March 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} ==Inactive Rights Removal - 2025-03-04== The rights of the following users will be removed on or after 2025-03-11 if they do not return to activity: *{{RFP/User|78-Yellowcat}} *{{RFP/User|AirmanKitten203}} *{{RFP/User|BasedKat09}} *{{RFP/User|BunnypranavClone}} *{{RFP/User|Cactus2}} Per my talk page. *{{RFP/User|Cactusalt}} Per my talk page. *{{RFP/User|Chqaz}} *{{RFP/User|Códigonombre Alguien}} *{{RFP/User|DarkMatterMan4500}} *{{RFP/User|Deverettm}} *{{RFP/User|EdwardLennox}} *{{RFP/User|Emmitt}} *{{RFP/User|Ericbomb}} *{{RFP/User|Excelsis}} *{{RFP/User|Fallen}} *{{RFP/User|Felenov}} *{{RFP/User|Harommel Rabbid}} *{{RFP/User|Hauber}} *{{RFP/User|JoséDeJesús}} *{{RFP/User|Ketra}} *{{RFP/User|Kittyguy210}} Per their talk page *{{RFP/User|Lana}} *{{RFP/User|Liaochina}} *{{RFP/User|Manomoney41}} *{{RFP/User|MarkRosenbaum}} *{{RFP/User|MatthewQuinnHui}} *{{RFP/User|MvGulik}} *{{RFP/User|Pasmorade}} *{{RFP/User|Pisces}} *{{RFP/User|Rafdodo}} *{{RFP/User|ShuuGyro}} *{{RFP/User|Talion77}} *{{RFP/User|Sizau}} *{{RFP/User|Skilsdhuo}} *{{RFP/User|Smileboy}} *{{RFP/User|Snowmanonahoe}} *{{RFP/User|Soulwater24}} *{{RFP/User|StellaDiamondMaskedWolf}} *{{RFP/User|Steverino}} *{{RFP/User|Stxrsprxte}} Thanks, :Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) :For the Consul Team :11:46, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ==Request for Feedback: Bureaucrats== {{discussion top|Closing as {{done|successful}}. The vast majority of users support the changes of policy with relation to [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats]]. With a successful RfC here, consuls will undertake a review of all active bureaucrats to determine which users will retain rights. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 20:36, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} While Bureaucrat has historically been implemented as a testing role, the low requirements for entry into the role coupled with broad/disruptive permission sets has made it a prime target for bad actors - repeat instances of malicious abuse of Bureaucrat permissions necessitating intervention by global volunteers has made clear that a change is needed. Simultaneously, the relatively small number of active testwiki Consuls has meant that policy enforcement activities haven't always gotten timely action and oversight, and assistance by trusted users is needed to keep testwiki operating as a true testing space. As such, this proposal aims to convert the Bureaucrat role from one of generic testing to one of moderate trust, eliminating the easy abuse vector while remaining readily achievable and providing consuls more support in day-to-day operations. The proposed changes to [[TW:Bureaucrats|TestWiki:Bureaucrats]] can be found [[User:Zppix/Draft/Bureaucrats#Proposed Page Text Changes|on this draft page]] under the Proposed Page Text Changes section. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:26, 11 March 2025 (UTC) ===Support=== #{{Support|strong}} as proposer Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:29, 11 March 2025 (UTC) #{{Support|strong}} it was about time! Unfortunately the few are creating issues for the masses.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   10:32, 11 March 2025 (UTC) #{{support}} it's unfortunate that it has to come down to this, but there have been too many recent cases of abuse and I believe it's too easy for people to "farm" their way into getting the bureaucrat right for malicious purposes. The language here not only gives no real/specific reason for requesting the group, stating you won’t use it for vandalism as a qualification for the role indicates either a misunderstanding of the role’s purpose(what is basically now intended to function as deputy Consul), or of the standards associated with staffing this, or any official Miraheze project. '''''[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] [[User Talk:PixDeVl|talk to me!]]''''' 04:07, 7 April 2025 (UTC) :@[[User:Xaloria|Xaloria]] Could you give a brief of how you wish to use the right and contribute to the wiki? [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 10:47, 7 April 2025 (UTC) :{{comment}} A steward on another test wiki [https://testwiki.wiki/index.php?title=Special:Log&logid=62833 confirmed] two days ago that this user abused multiple accounts (that is, [[User:Nexora|Nexora]]). [[User:PB2008|PB2008]] ([[User talk:PB2008|talk]]) 10:18, 9 April 2025 (UTC) :{{o}} I would think, that anyone who wants to request something, would at least put some effort in to write a decent request. This request lacks grammar and punctuation (although kudos for closing of with a period). Besides that, you give no reasons why you want to be assigned the Crat-role, other than: ''"I wanna again join the team amd and contribute to the wiki"''. As a former crat you know that you do not need to be a crat to contribute to the wiki. The role of the crat is not just to be able to action some decisive outcomes in conflicts, or to guard against vandalism. Most of that can be done already by the admins. The Crat/consul takes the final decision. It's a role of trust, and trust comes slowly, but is quickly lost.
I would suggest to start working on the wiki, and show your worth first.
I always wonder why people think "When I get that role, I will do...". It should be the other way around. A user should start working on a wiki, help out as much as possible, show that you are consistently available, make no arbitrary mistakes, and people will either nominate you, or when you then apply again, support the request.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   11:15, 9 April 2025 (UTC) :{{oppose}} on several grounds. Firstly, the bar for bureaucrat has changed. It is a more clearly outlined position of responsibility and not just a hat after a very low margin, as it was previously. I would not recommend previous membership as an argument in favor unless proactive conduct can be used to support it. Secondly, I do not believe you have the track record of trustworthy conduct that the bureaucrat role wants from candidates. Off plaform is one thing but I am weary based on your record at Miraheze as well. A new account will only exacerbate this concern - to head off a repeat instance, you know what I'm talking about. Third, the request is poorly assembled, though I consider this the last priority. I recommend against attempts to acquire hats, and to instead improve your record both here and elsewhere instead. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 14:40, 9 April 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == [[TestWiki:Request permissions]] be used only for sysop? == Hey folks! Should the [[TestWiki:Request permissions]] be updated to only include admin/sysop perms? Crat already requires a post here, we can ask for the same for IA as well (IA may not need inputs, and consuls can [not]grant at their own discretion). [[Template:Request instructions]] says that crat can be requested by just mentioning that in the template creation, but I think that's not the case anymore. If this passes, the userRights gadget and [[Template:RfP/preload]] can be updated to showcase only request for adminship. TLDR: Limit RfP to only sysop, maybe even move it to a different title, and require other groups IA and other groups to request by a post here (community portal). Open to any variations to the proposals [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 06:57, 12 April 2025 (UTC) :Yep, I agree that the template needs to be updated. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 12:14, 12 April 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Ternera|Ternera]] What do you think about moving RfP to [[TestWiki:Request for adminship]] or a similar title? [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:29, 12 April 2025 (UTC) :::Supposedly confirmed user and autopatrolled rights can be requested at [[TestWiki:Request permissions]], so I don't know if that would be the best plan. I don't think I've ever seen anyone request those rights though since sysop is given out quite liberally. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 12:33, 12 April 2025 (UTC) ::::I see. For now I have updated [[Template:RfP/preload]] to default to admin, and included a comment suggesting to change it if other groups are required. Same change has been done to [[Template:Request instructions]] [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 13:04, 12 April 2025 (UTC) :::::Excellent, thanks for your work! [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 13:07, 12 April 2025 (UTC) :I'm agree with Bunnypranav & Ternera. Confirmed user & autopatrolled rights can be requested at [[TestWiki:Request permissions]] while we can [[TestWiki:Request for adminship]] for admins request. Plus, we need to make some other options regarding other permissions. [[User:Sidrat al-Muntaha|Sidrat al-Muntaha]] ([[User talk:Sidrat al-Muntaha|talk]]) 18:15, 12 April 2025 (UTC) ::To keep it simple, I feel that it would be best to keep [[TestWiki:Request permissions]] as a catch all for all permission requests. The requester can always be advised to put the request for other options to a appropriate forum if available. That will keep us all in the loop with the changes. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:39, 24 April 2025 (UTC) == Proposal for Help:Abuse Filter to be converted into a non-test policy == I propose converting [[Help:Abuse Filter]] to [[TestWiki:Abuse filter]] and convert it into a non-test policy, and merge some of the other abuse filter-related pages into a single page: * [[TestWiki:Abuse filter operators]] * [[TestWiki:Abuse filter policy]] Similarly, I would also like to propose deleting [[Help:Abuse Filter rules]] given that we have [[:mw:Extension:AbuseFilter/Rules_format|a MediaWiki page for instructions on writing an abuse filter]]. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 01:24, 15 April 2025 (UTC) :@[[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] I have boldly redirected the help page to the mw: instruction page. Now we needn't delete it. ;) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 08:42, 18 April 2025 (UTC) ::Until an editor comes along, I've added the related pages to [[Help:Abuse Filter#See also]] section. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 04:04, 24 April 2025 (UTC) == Interface and abuse filter operator changes == With the bureaucrat being a non testing permission, we should have a comment on the permissions between bureaucrat and consul. The interface admin can stay because you can test in your user space but the abuse filter operator should be between administrator and bureaucrat for testing the blocking feature on the abuse filter. ===Support=== {{Support}} my opinion [[User:GamerTester1080|GamerTester1080]] ([[User talk:GamerTester1080|talk]]) 09:15, 18 April 2025 (UTC) ===Neutral=== ===Oppose=== # {{Oppose}} Too complicated and unnecessary.
The more description that is provided to a label, the more likely it will be ignored or misunderstood.
Also, the policies have already been updated to reflect the change.
Also, the requesters will be made aware when they request permissions.
--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 04:16, 24 April 2025 (UTC) == Add extensions == Can I suggest these extension to be installed: [[MediaWikiWiki:Extension:AnonPrivacy]] for testing the extension with anonymous editing. [[MediaWikiWiki:Extension:DeletePagesForGood]] but only in category namespace. (The description of category namespace should be moved to category talk.) if a user moves to category namespace then deletes the page permanently, they can be banned through the move log. [[User:RandomNicknames|RandomNicknames]] ([[User talk:RandomNicknames|talk]]) 03:48, 19 April 2025 (UTC) :{{Not done}} To prevent abuse and to ensure adequate moderation capabilities neither extension will be enabled. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 04:18, 19 April 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] How does it prevent abuse. You can see the ip addresses in anonprivacy by using [[special:export]] and opening the xml file. For deletepagesforgood, you can create a namespace where you can’t move pages in and is used solely for deletion. [[User:RandomNicknames|RandomNicknames]] ([[User talk:RandomNicknames|talk]]) 06:25, 19 April 2025 (UTC) :::1) That is a huge barrier to preventing abuse from anon users. :::2) Deletepageforgood can easily be abused to mass delete pages with no way to restore. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:45, 19 April 2025 (UTC) ::::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] abuse to mass delete. You can create an isolated namespaces where you can’t move pages in used only for permanent deletion testing. [[User:RandomNicknames|RandomNicknames]] ([[User talk:RandomNicknames|talk]]) 19:54, 19 April 2025 (UTC) :::::Final answer is no. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:28, 19 April 2025 (UTC) == Inactive Rights Removal - 04-03-2025 == The rights of the following users will be removed on or after 04-11-2025 if they do not return to activity: *{{RFP/User|Cactus2}} Previously expressed interest im retaining rights. *{{RFP/User|Cactusalt}} same as above. *{{RFP/User|Códigonombre Alguien}} *{{RFP/User|The God}} *{{RFP/User|ToadetteEdit}} *{{RFP/User|Toonlinky Blorb}} *{{RFP/User|Waki285}} Globally active user, exception made on their behalf. *{{RFP/User|WikiTester75}} *{{RFP/User|Wooze}} *{{RFP/User|Zippybonzo}} Holding off for now. *{{RFP/User|Zorrotesla}} *{{RFP/User|水戸特快}} *{{RFP/User|黑茶}} Thanks, :[[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) :For the Consul Team :22:50, 3 April 2025 (UTC) ::{{Done}} all except marked. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:47, 4 May 2025 (UTC)}} Change the bureaucrat requirement from 3 months (89-92 days) to 2 months (59-62 days) because that is consistent with Miraheze's Meta Wiki creator. Bureaucrats shouldn't have to wait that long because of the 200 edit requirement and people are impatient. ===Three month edit to day ratio=== 200/92=2.17391304348 and 200/89=2.24719101124 round up to 3 edits per day. ===Two month edit to day ratio=== 200/62=3.22580645161 and 200/59=3.38983050847 round up to 4 edits per day. ===Support=== #{{Support}} per proposer [[User:KahootNickname1234|KahootNickname1234]] ([[User talk:KahootNickname1234|talk]]) 07:51, 3 May 2025 (UTC) ===Neutral=== ===Oppose=== {{Discussion bottom}} == About translate == As a Chinese user and translator, I think "zh-cn" is unnecessary and should be converted to "zh-hans", "zh-hant", etc. After conversion, zh-cn should be deleted. I don't think there is any big difference between the two. Hans has a wider range of applications, so I think it is possible to only retain hans to improve translation efficiency, and users do not need to think about which language they should choose. I don't know if I'm expressing the difference well with what I mean. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 15:14, 5 May 2025 (UTC) == ManageWiki policy change == {{Discussion top|1={{Not done}} Rollback can still be abused. Users should be able to wait for someone to assign administrator rights. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 03:14, 6 May 2025 (UTC) == Suggestion: editing here pops up a "big blue button?" or something == Not sure how feasibly it is technically but seeing as I missed the "big blue button"... somehow...? [[User:Clover-not-used|Clover-not-used]] ([[User talk:Clover-not-used|talk]]) 02:48, 6 May 2025 (UTC) :When I edit, I see a blue button that says [[Save changes]]. :If the blue button is missing, maybe the page did not load properly. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 23:24, 6 May 2025 (UTC) ::Oh I meant the big blue button saying "New thread" at the top I missed [[User:Clover-not-used|Clover-not-used]] ([[User talk:Clover-not-used|talk]]) 13:30, 7 May 2025 (UTC) :::I see it now! :::When that button goes unnoticed, it's probably a sign that it's time to archive some messages... :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 00:16, 8 May 2025 (UTC) == Edit request == [[MediaWiki:Gadgets-definition]]:
From * Cat-a-lot[ResourceLoader|dependencies=mediawiki.util|rights=edit,editprotected]|Cat-a-lot.js to * Cat-a-lot[ResourceLoader|dependencies=mediawiki.util|rights=edit,editprotected|namespaces=14]|Cat-a-lot.js Because this is a tool for categorization, it should only load on category namespace. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 11:16, 8 June 2025 (UTC) :::I still see the loading of cat-a-lot on my user page, even though I haven't enabled it in any other additional way. While adding the gadget, I followed [[c:Help:Gadget-Cat-a-lot#As your user gadget]] instead of [[c:Help:Gadget-Cat-a-lot#As a project gadget]]. I have done both the changes, since doing only the if (mw.config.get('wgNamespaceNumber') === 14) one seems to not have loaded immediately (maybe due to caching). [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:13, 8 June 2025 (UTC) :::::It works, thanks! —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 12:19, 8 June 2025 (UTC) == Request for bureaucrat == {{Discussion top|Closing this as {{notdone|no consensus}}, given the lack of any !votes in support (or opposition). —'''''[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] [[User Talk:PixDeVl|talk to me!]]''''' 01:22, 19 June 2025 (UTC)}} I served as a previous bureaucrat before the new requirements were implemented, and thus is familiar with the rules and regulations including the new ones. I would like this right for helping with maintenance task, such as with the RFP pages as well as all [https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/TestWiki:Bureaucrats#Responsibilities these]. I am familiar with the relevant policies and will use the tools with care and responsibility. Please feel free to ask any questions or raise concerns.[[User:Cactusisme|'''Cactus🌵''']] [[User talk:Cactusisme|spiky]] [[Special:Contributions/Cactusisme|ouch]] 12:02, 28 May 2025 (UTC) :{{Note}} Please do understand that bureaucrat rights are not for testing. Bureaucrats now serve a functional role in assisting consuls. [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 15:37, 28 May 2025 (UTC) ::Noted--[[User:Cactusisme|'''Cactus🌵''']] [[User talk:Cactusisme|spiky]] [[Special:Contributions/Cactusisme|ouch]] 11:02, 30 May 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == Abuse filter operator for PB2008 == :{{userlinks2|PB2008}} I am an admin on [[:mh:unbooks:|unbookswiki]] and have created some [[mh:unbooks:Special:AbuseFilter|Abuse Filters]] there. I request the Abuse Filter operator flag to enable restriction actions to block cross-wiki and long-term abusers, especially Uwucutesingle and Rebootedpoppy. Additionally, I will check for any false positives. Thank you. [[User:PB2008|PB2008]] ([[User talk:PB2008|talk]]) 14:52, 30 June 2025 (UTC) :{{Done}} Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 15:07, 30 June 2025 (UTC)

{{Aan}} == Request for Consul == I have made constructive non-test edits and I am a bureaucrat so should I become a consul? [[User:MiraEdit|MiraEdit]] ([[User talk:MiraEdit|talk]]) 23:04, 2 February 2025 (UTC) :: Please review the terms on the Test Wiki Main page [[TestWiki]], specifically the rules listed in the section [[TestWiki#Things to keep in mind]]. If you are not sure which rule was violated, you should reach out to [[m:Steward requests]] or discuss at the [[m:Community portal]]. : --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:44, 3 February 2025 (UTC) ::: I know my answer didn't really answer your question, but basically, every wiki is different. Please learn more about Test Wiki if you really want to become a Consul. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:47, 3 February 2025 (UTC) == Refreshing created a test page == I was told my test page was labeled abusive because it was short and had "bad words." I opted to use the preview bar instead. Later I refreshed the page (F5) and for some reason that created it. No bad words, but the page will probably be gone by the time you see this. Posting because it said to log an issue [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 01:57, 15 February 2025 (UTC) == Can't undo == All of a sudden, I can't undo. I even went to contributions and reverted from there, but the pages still exist and have the content [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 04:30, 18 February 2025 (UTC) :Don't know which pages you are referring to.
