That will keep us all in the loop with the changes. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:39, 24 April 2025 (UTC) == Proposal for Help:Abuse Filter to be converted into a non-test policy == I propose converting [[Help:Abuse Filter]] to [[TestWiki:Abuse filter]] and convert it into a non-test policy, and merge some of the other abuse filter-related pages into a single page: * [[TestWiki:Abuse filter operators]] * [[TestWiki:Abuse filter policy]] Similarly, I would also like to propose deleting [[Help:Abuse Filter rules]] given that we have [[:mw:Extension:AbuseFilter/Rules_format|a MediaWiki page for instructions on writing an abuse filter]]. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 01:24, 15 April 2025 (UTC) :@[[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] I have boldly redirected the help page to the mw: instruction page. Now we needn't delete it. ;) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 08:42, 18 April 2025 (UTC) ::Until an editor comes along, I've added the related pages to [[Help:Abuse Filter#See also]] section. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 04:04, 24 April 2025 (UTC) == Interface and abuse filter operator changes == With the bureaucrat being a non testing permission, we should have a comment on the permissions between bureaucrat and consul. The interface admin can stay because you can test in your user space but the abuse filter operator should be between administrator and bureaucrat for testing the blocking feature on the abuse filter. ===Support=== {{Support}} my opinion [[User:GamerTester1080|GamerTester1080]] ([[User talk:GamerTester1080|talk]]) 09:15, 18 April 2025 (UTC) ===Neutral=== ===Oppose=== # {{Oppose}} Too complicated and unnecessary.
The more description that is provided to a label, the more likely it will be ignored or misunderstood.
Also, the policies have already been updated to reflect the change.
Also, the requesters will be made aware when they request permissions.
--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 04:16, 24 April 2025 (UTC) == Add extensions == Can I suggest these extension to be installed: [[MediaWikiWiki:Extension:AnonPrivacy]] for testing the extension with anonymous editing. [[MediaWikiWiki:Extension:DeletePagesForGood]] but only in category namespace. (The description of category namespace should be moved to category talk.) if a user moves to category namespace then deletes the page permanently, they can be banned through the move log. [[User:RandomNicknames|RandomNicknames]] ([[User talk:RandomNicknames|talk]]) 03:48, 19 April 2025 (UTC) :{{Not done}} To prevent abuse and to ensure adequate moderation capabilities neither extension will be enabled. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 04:18, 19 April 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] How does it prevent abuse. You can see the ip addresses in anonprivacy by using [[special:export]] and opening the xml file. For deletepagesforgood, you can create a namespace where you can’t move pages in and is used solely for deletion. [[User:RandomNicknames|RandomNicknames]] ([[User talk:RandomNicknames|talk]]) 06:25, 19 April 2025 (UTC) :::1) That is a huge barrier to preventing abuse from anon users. :::2) Deletepageforgood can easily be abused to mass delete pages with no way to restore. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:45, 19 April 2025 (UTC) ::::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] abuse to mass delete. You can create an isolated namespaces where you can’t move pages in used only for permanent deletion testing. [[User:RandomNicknames|RandomNicknames]] ([[User talk:RandomNicknames|talk]]) 19:54, 19 April 2025 (UTC) :::::Final answer is no. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 22:28, 19 April 2025 (UTC) == Inactive Rights Removal - 04-03-2025 == The rights of the following users will be removed on or after 04-11-2025 if they do not return to activity: *{{RFP/User|Cactus2}} Previously expressed interest im retaining rights. *{{RFP/User|Cactusalt}} same as above. *{{RFP/User|Códigonombre Alguien}} *{{RFP/User|The God}} *{{RFP/User|ToadetteEdit}} *{{RFP/User|Toonlinky Blorb}} *{{RFP/User|Waki285}} Globally active user, exception made on their behalf. *{{RFP/User|WikiTester75}} *{{RFP/User|Wooze}} *{{RFP/User|Zippybonzo}} Holding off for now. *{{RFP/User|Zorrotesla}} *{{RFP/User|水戸特快}} *{{RFP/User|黑茶}} Thanks, :[[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) :For the Consul Team :22:50, 3 April 2025 (UTC) ::{{Done}} all except marked. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:54, 19 April 2025 (UTC) == Error in filter == I was trying to delete my userpage here to enable global user page, but the filter disallowed. Kindly assist, thank you. [[User:Jianhui67|Jianhui67]] ([[User talk:Jianhui67|talk]]) 06:52, 28 April 2025 (UTC) :Hey @[[User:Jianhui67|Jianhui67]], I have now deleted your user page. This seems to have been caused by a new edit filter for protection of user pages against vandalism (cc creator @[[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]]). [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 07:51, 28 April 2025 (UTC) ::Ah, I see. Thanks for deleting! [[User:Jianhui67|Jianhui67]] ([[User talk:Jianhui67|talk]]) 09:02, 28 April 2025 (UTC) :::{{done|Disabled the filter accordingly}}. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 16:07, 28 April 2025 (UTC) ::::... and fixed now. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 16:19, 28 April 2025 (UTC) == Error in filter == What I was trying to do: I was trying to move my sandbox for test purpose) What message I received:This action has been automatically identified as harmful, and therefore disallowed. If you believe your action was constructive, please report this error at the community portal. A brief description of the abuse rule which your action matched is: User and user talk namespace disruption [[User:Vikram Singh344|Vikram Singh344]] ([[User talk:Vikram Singh344|talk]]) 08:37, 28 April 2025 (UTC) :{{done|Fixed so as to not affect your tests again}}. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]] · [[Special:Contributions/Codename Noreste|contribs]]) 06:08, 24 May 2025 (UTC) == Recent vandalism == There is a fair amount of vandalism from yesterday, that has yet to be undone, mostly because of the complex nature of trying to accurately unmerge page histories. Ultimately this is a Consul decision, but we could try and undo everything, which would be a lot of work, mostly from trying to figure out what goes where, or we could potentially restore from a database or XML backup, where we would inevitably lose some of the latest revisions. Again, this is up to consuls to decide, but we need to think about what would be more practical. [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 13:47, 28 April 2025 (UTC) :If the copy is merged, before any restoring from backup, perhaps review the contributions and identify all the users who contributed. :Then find the history of the contribution from the user's original and there should be a Diff. :Idk about what is practical but if you wish, I can take a look at the merged copy to see if there is a pattern. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 29 April 2025 (UTC) ::From Revisions: ::[https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/User_talk:Void/mangled_page_history?diff=61326&oldid=61235 Reception123] ::[https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/User_talk:Void/mangled_page_history?diff=61524&oldid=61507 AlPaD] ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:54, 29 April 2025 (UTC) :::{{Ping|MacFan4000}} and {{Ping|Imamy}} Hello, I agree with restore the database and I understand that it's necessary [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 17:07, 29 April 2025 (UTC) == Error in filter == I was trying to create a test page but filter disallowed me to page What message I received:This action has been automatically identified as harmful, and therefore disallowed. If you believe your action was constructive, please report this error at the community portal. A brief description of the abuse rule which your action matched is: LTA 60 [[User:Dennis566|Dennis566]] ([[User talk:Dennis566|talk]]) 17:26, 29 April 2025 (UTC) :Hi {{ping|Dennis566}}, :: Test Wiki limits the number of pages that can be created at a time. :: Due to the limit, it's possible that the message you get will be different than messages that the Admins and higher ups will get for the same type of action. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 22:08, 29 April 2025 (UTC) == Request for consulship == I, KahootNickname1234, want to be a consul because I have done non-test actions. There are no eligiblity requirements for consul so I am eligible to place a request. [[Special:Contributions/38.158.220.26|38.158.220.26]] 04:49, 4 May 2025 (UTC) :Declined, all accounts locked and blocked for vandalism on PublicTestWiki. --[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 04:50, 4 May 2025 (UTC) == Administrators Policy update == Due to constant abuse, the policy regarding [[TW:Administrators|administrators]] has been updated to include changes to deter bad actors. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:46, 4 May 2025 (UTC) :Thanks! This was a much needed change considering recent issues. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 15:25, 4 May 2025 (UTC) == Change the bureaucrat requirement == {{Discussion top|1={{Not done}} this is an anti-abuse measure and will not be done. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:47, 4 May 2025 (UTC)}} Change the bureaucrat requirement from 3 months (89-92 days) to 2 months (59-62 days) because that is consistent with Miraheze's Meta Wiki creator. Bureaucrats shouldn't have to wait that long because of the 200 edit requirement and people are impatient. ===Three month edit to day ratio=== 200/92=2.17391304348 and 200/89=2.24719101124 round up to 3 edits per day. ===Two month edit to day ratio=== 200/62=3.22580645161 and 200/59=3.38983050847 round up to 4 edits per day. ===Support=== #{{Support}} per proposer [[User:KahootNickname1234|KahootNickname1234]] ([[User talk:KahootNickname1234|talk]]) 07:51, 3 May 2025 (UTC) ===Neutral=== ===Oppose=== {{Discussion bottom}} == About translate == As a Chinese user and translator, I think "zh-cn" is unnecessary and should be converted to "zh-hans", "zh-hant", etc. After conversion, zh-cn should be deleted. I'd like to know everyone's opinions. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 03:55, 5 May 2025 (UTC) :Hi, as a non Chinese speaker, can you explain the difference and the reasoning behind why you think this should be done so I can understand better? Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 13:25, 5 May 2025 (UTC) ::Simply put, zh-cn is generally only used in mainland China, and these users use simplified Chinese, zh-hans. I don't think there is any big difference between the two. Hans has a wider range of applications, so I think it is possible to only retain hans to improve translation efficiency, and users do not need to think about which language they should choose. I don't know if I'm expressing the difference well with what I mean. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 15:14, 5 May 2025 (UTC) == ManageWiki policy change == {{Discussion top|1={{Not done}} Rollback can still be abused. If a user can simply wait until they are eligible for admin. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 13:23, 5 May 2025 (UTC)}} Can we change policy so that autopatrolled users can have rollback rights. This is because now you have to wait 240 hours for admin which includes rollback. Rollback does not require that much trust unlike delete and block which is in the admin group. ===Support=== ===Neutral=== ===Oppose=== # Hard no, we have enough issues with throwaway accounts being used to cause trouble. --[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 02:09, 5 May 2025 (UTC) # {{Oppose}} Rollback can also easily cause trouble. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 03:24, 5 May 2025 (UTC) # Nope, I don't believe rollback is that necessary. Users should be able to wait for someone to assign administrator rights. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 13:20, 5 May 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == publictestwiki.com or test.miraheze.org == publictestwiki.com or test.miraheze.org? Differences? Preferred link? Does it even matter at all [[User:Clover-not-used|Clover-not-used]] ([[User talk:Clover-not-used|talk]]) 02:36, 6 May 2025 (UTC) :They are the same thing and will lead you to the same site. The only visual difference is one uses a custom domain and one uses the Miraheze subdomain. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 03:14, 6 May 2025 (UTC) == Suggestion: editing here pops up a "big blue button?" or something == Not sure how feasibly it is technically but seeing as I missed the "big blue button"... somehow...? [[User:Clover-not-used|Clover-not-used]] ([[User talk:Clover-not-used|talk]]) 02:48, 6 May 2025 (UTC) :When I edit, I see a blue button that says [[Save changes]]. :If the blue button is missing, maybe the page did not load properly. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 23:24, 6 May 2025 (UTC) ::Oh I meant the big blue button saying "New thread" at the top I missed [[User:Clover-not-used|Clover-not-used]] ([[User talk:Clover-not-used|talk]]) 13:30, 7 May 2025 (UTC) :::I see it now! :::When that button goes unnoticed, it's probably a sign that it's time to archive some messages... :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 00:16, 8 May 2025 (UTC) == Edit request == [[MediaWiki:Gadgets-definition]]:
From * Cat-a-lot[ResourceLoader|dependencies=mediawiki.util|rights=edit,editprotected]|Cat-a-lot.js to * Cat-a-lot[ResourceLoader|dependencies=mediawiki.util|rights=edit,editprotected|namespaces=14]|Cat-a-lot.js Because this is a tool for categorization, it should only load on category namespace. Although this is indeed optional content, I think it's better this way. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 10:20, 8 June 2025 (UTC) :It's also possible to add if (mw.config.get('wgNamespaceNumber') === 14) {} directly to [[MediaWiki:Gadget-Cat-a-lot.js]]. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 10:22, 8 June 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Saoutax|Saoutax]] I think the original file at commons already has the code for loading on cat NS, since we can't currently see it activated on any other NS. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 11:16, 8 June 2025 (UTC) :::I still see the loading of cat-a-lot on my user page, even though I haven't enabled it in any other additional way. Also, I have confirmed that after turning it off in the preferences, the display on the user page also disappears. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 11:33, 8 June 2025 (UTC) ::::Ah, my bad. While adding the gadget, I followed [[c:Help:Gadget-Cat-a-lot#As your user gadget]] instead of [[c:Help:Gadget-Cat-a-lot#As a project gadget]]. I have done both the changes, since doing only the if (mw.config.get('wgNamespaceNumber') === 14) one seems to not have loaded immediately (maybe due to caching). [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:13, 8 June 2025 (UTC) :::::It works, thanks! —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 12:19, 8 June 2025 (UTC) == Request for bureaucrat == {{Discussion top|Closing this as {{notdone|no consensus}}, given the lack of any !votes in support (or opposition). —'''''[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] [[User Talk:PixDeVl|talk to me!]]''''' 01:22, 19 June 2025 (UTC)}} I served as a previous bureaucrat before the new requirements were implemented, and thus is familiar with the rules and regulations including the new ones. I would like this right for helping with maintenance task, such as with the RFP pages as well as all [https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/TestWiki:Bureaucrats#Responsibilities these]. I am familiar with the relevant policies and will use the tools with care and responsibility. Please feel free to ask any questions or raise concerns.[[User:Cactusisme|'''Cactus🌵''']] [[User talk:Cactusisme|spiky]] [[Special:Contributions/Cactusisme|ouch]] 12:02, 28 May 2025 (UTC) :{{Note}} Please do understand that bureaucrat rights are not for testing. Bureaucrats now serve a functional role in assisting consuls. [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 15:37, 28 May 2025 (UTC) ::Noted--[[User:Cactusisme|'''Cactus🌵''']] [[User talk:Cactusisme|spiky]] [[Special:Contributions/Cactusisme|ouch]] 11:02, 30 May 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == Abuse filter operator for PB2008 == :{{userlinks2|PB2008}} I am an admin on [[:mh:unbooks:|unbookswiki]] and have created some [[mh:unbooks:Special:AbuseFilter|Abuse Filters]] there. I request the Abuse Filter operator flag to enable restriction actions to block cross-wiki and long-term abusers, especially Uwucutesingle and Rebootedpoppy. Additionally, I will check for any false positives. Thank you. [[User:PB2008|PB2008]] ([[User talk:PB2008|talk]]) 14:52, 30 June 2025 (UTC) :{{Done}} Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 15:07, 30 June 2025 (UTC) == Bureaucrat for -Stickman- == {{Discussion top|User-closing this as {{notdone|invalid}}, as [[Special:CentralAuth/-Stickman-|requester]] does not meet [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats#Eligibility|eligibility requirements]]. --[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 19:02, 17 July 2025 (UTC)}} :{{userlinks2|-Stickman-}} I see discussions on Request Permissions that don't have been handled by a bureaucrat. I want to check the Request Permissions and see the requests and handle them. But that's not all. I will check the Recent Changes and revert the tests that are done, because not all users revert their tests. I see also that the bureaucrats are not very active. That is because i request this high trusted role. [[User:-Stickman-|-Stickman-]] ([[User talk:-Stickman-|talk]]) 13:23, 3 July 2025 (UTC) :{{oppose}} barely has any experience on this project and anyone can watch recent changes to revert tests that users leave up. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 13:29, 3 July 2025 (UTC) ::i know it [[User:-Stickman-|-Stickman-]] ([[User talk:-Stickman-|talk]]) 13:49, 3 July 2025 (UTC) :{{oppose|strong}} Sorry, but you need more experience to get crat perm. I think we can consider the crats to be active enough, since the eligible perm requesters are being fulfilled within 24-48 hours, a good enough time according to me. Feel free to help with reverts of test edits though. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 13:38, 3 July 2025 (UTC) :{{oppose}} Although it’s uncommon for bureaucrats to handle the request for permissions page and deal with backlogs, we currently have enough bureaucrats available. Most users requesting admin permissions are new and haven’t yet met the [[TW:A#Eligibility|guidelines]] of being a registered user for at least ten (10) days or providing a valid reason for needing the permission. As for recent changes, any user can easily undo edits made by others without needing bureaucrat permissions. [[User:PB2008|PB2008]] ([[User talk:PB2008|talk]]) 13:49, 3 July 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}}

{{Aan}} == Request for Consul == I have made constructive non-test edits and I am a bureaucrat so should I become a consul? [[User:MiraEdit|MiraEdit]] ([[User talk:MiraEdit|talk]]) 23:04, 2 February 2025 (UTC) :: Please review the terms on the Test Wiki Main page [[TestWiki]], specifically the rules listed in the section [[TestWiki#Things to keep in mind]]. If you are not sure which rule was violated, you should reach out to [[m:Steward requests]] or discuss at the [[m:Community portal]]. : --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:44, 3 February 2025 (UTC) ::: I know my answer didn't really answer your question, but basically, every wiki is different. Please learn more about Test Wiki if you really want to become a Consul. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:47, 3 February 2025 (UTC) == Refreshing created a test page == I was told my test page was labeled abusive because it was short and had "bad words." I opted to use the preview bar instead. Later I refreshed the page (F5) and for some reason that created it. No bad words, but the page will probably be gone by the time you see this. Posting because it said to log an issue [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 01:57, 15 February 2025 (UTC) == Can't undo == All of a sudden, I can't undo. I even went to contributions and reverted from there, but the pages still exist and have the content [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 04:30, 18 February 2025 (UTC) :Don't know which pages you are referring to. I could be wrong, but generally, we can rollback 1 and if someone has already contributed after your contribution, then rollback is not possible. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 25 February 2025 (UTC) == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 18:36, 3 March 2025 (UTC) :'''Update: the updated [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Blocking policy|blocking policy]]''' is now in effect as of Monday, March 2nd 6:16PM UTC-6. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:45, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] Could you summarize the changes made? Thanks! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::@[[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] Consuls, CVT, and Stewards are the only ones authorized to issue non-test blocks, test blocks can now only be done on accounts the user controls or on approved test accounts, appeals are only done via the blocked user’s talk page, or by emailing the blocking Consul, third party appeals are no longer accepted. I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! I obviously do not object the policy, just wanted your say on what you changed. :) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:08, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::ZPPIX WHY DO YOU KEEP MAKING POLICY CHANGES WITHOUT CONSENSUS! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 21:05, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::I do this as well on a local wiki that isn't the test one as an admin that can enforce and change rules around to keep it up to date like yes communities are needed but not for everything that are granted rights to staff. [[User:339Breakingoof|TheFunny339YoshiPlushGuy]] ([[User talk:339Breakingoof|talk]]) 13:38, 9 May 2025 (UTC) == Request for Consul (PixDeVl) == {{Discussion top|{{done}}, welcome to the Consul team. Please reach out if you have any questions. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 11:26, 9 March 2025 (UTC)}} Hi folks, I’m filing this Request for Consul, frankly because I noticed that we currently have only 2 remotely active Consuls, being Zppix and Reception, and, even with something like PTW, having an official project wiki be run by two folks isn’t great, so I’d thought I’d offer to lend a hand. I am not very active priorly with what exists of the community on PTW, but as a current global functionary, I still think it wouldn’t hurt to have an extra hand helping keep things clean. Feel free to ask any questions regarding this, as always :) —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 03:35, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}}  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   03:39, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} trusted user. A brief description of the abuse rule which your action matched is: User and user talk namespace disruption [[User:Vikram Singh344|Vikram Singh344]] ([[User talk:Vikram Singh344|talk]]) 08:37, 28 April 2025 (UTC) :{{done|Fixed so as to not affect your tests again}}. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:46, 4 May 2025 (UTC) :Thanks! This was a much needed change considering recent issues. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 15:25, 4 May 2025 (UTC) == Change the bureaucrat requirement == {{Discussion top|1={{Not done}} this is an anti-abuse measure and will not be done. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:47, 4 May 2025 (UTC)}} Change the bureaucrat requirement from 3 months (89-92 days) to 2 months (59-62 days) because that is consistent with Miraheze's Meta Wiki creator. Bureaucrats shouldn't have to wait that long because of the 200 edit requirement and people are impatient. ===Three month edit to day ratio=== 200/92=2.17391304348 and 200/89=2.24719101124 round up to 3 edits per day. ===Two month edit to day ratio=== 200/62=3.22580645161 and 200/59=3.38983050847 round up to 4 edits per day. ===Support=== #{{Support}} per proposer [[User:KahootNickname1234|KahootNickname1234]] ([[User talk:KahootNickname1234|talk]]) 07:51, 3 May 2025 (UTC) ===Neutral=== ===Oppose=== {{Discussion bottom}} == About translate == As a Chinese user and translator, I think "zh-cn" is unnecessary and should be converted to "zh-hans", "zh-hant", etc. After conversion, zh-cn should be deleted. I'd like to know everyone's opinions. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 03:55, 5 May 2025 (UTC) :Hi, as a non Chinese speaker, can you explain the difference and the reasoning behind why you think this should be done so I can understand better? Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 13:25, 5 May 2025 (UTC) ::Simply put, zh-cn is generally only used in mainland China, and these users use simplified Chinese, zh-hans. I don't think there is any big difference between the two. Hans has a wider range of applications, so I think it is possible to only retain hans to improve translation efficiency, and users do not need to think about which language they should choose. I don't know if I'm expressing the difference well with what I mean. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 15:14, 5 May 2025 (UTC) == ManageWiki policy change == {{Discussion top|1={{Not done}} Rollback can still be abused. If a user can simply wait until they are eligible for admin. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 13:23, 5 May 2025 (UTC)}} Can we change policy so that autopatrolled users can have rollback rights. This is because now you have to wait 240 hours for admin which includes rollback. Rollback does not require that much trust unlike delete and block which is in the admin group. ===Support=== ===Neutral=== ===Oppose=== # Hard no, we have enough issues with throwaway accounts being used to cause trouble. --[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 02:09, 5 May 2025 (UTC) # {{Oppose}} Rollback can also easily cause trouble. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 03:24, 5 May 2025 (UTC) # Nope, I don't believe rollback is that necessary. Users should be able to wait for someone to assign administrator rights. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 13:20, 5 May 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == publictestwiki.com or test.miraheze.org == publictestwiki.com or test.miraheze.org? Differences? Preferred link? Does it even matter at all [[User:Clover-not-used|Clover-not-used]] ([[User talk:Clover-not-used|talk]]) 02:36, 6 May 2025 (UTC) :They are the same thing and will lead you to the same site. The only visual difference is one uses a custom domain and one uses the Miraheze subdomain. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 03:14, 6 May 2025 (UTC) == Suggestion: editing here pops up a "big blue button?" or something == Not sure how feasibly it is technically but seeing as I missed the "big blue button"... somehow...? [[User:Clover-not-used|Clover-not-used]] ([[User talk:Clover-not-used|talk]]) 02:48, 6 May 2025 (UTC) :When I edit, I see a blue button that says [[Save changes]]. :If the blue button is missing, maybe the page did not load properly. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 23:24, 6 May 2025 (UTC) ::Oh I meant the big blue button saying "New thread" at the top I missed [[User:Clover-not-used|Clover-not-used]] ([[User talk:Clover-not-used|talk]]) 13:30, 7 May 2025 (UTC) :::I see it now! :::When that button goes unnoticed, it's probably a sign that it's time to archive some messages... :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 00:16, 8 May 2025 (UTC) == Edit request == [[MediaWiki:Gadgets-definition]]:
From * Cat-a-lot[ResourceLoader|dependencies=mediawiki.util|rights=edit,editprotected]|Cat-a-lot.js to * Cat-a-lot[ResourceLoader|dependencies=mediawiki.util|rights=edit,editprotected|namespaces=14]|Cat-a-lot.js Because this is a tool for categorization, it should only load on category namespace. Although this is indeed optional content, I think it's better this way. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 10:20, 8 June 2025 (UTC) :It's also possible to add if (mw.config.get('wgNamespaceNumber') === 14) {} directly to [[MediaWiki:Gadget-Cat-a-lot.js]]. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 10:22, 8 June 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Saoutax|Saoutax]] I think the original file at commons already has the code for loading on cat NS, since we can't currently see it activated on any other NS. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 11:16, 8 June 2025 (UTC) :::I still see the loading of cat-a-lot on my user page, even though I haven't enabled it in any other additional way. Also, I have confirmed that after turning it off in the preferences, the display on the user page also disappears. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 11:33, 8 June 2025 (UTC) ::::Ah, my bad. While adding the gadget, I followed [[c:Help:Gadget-Cat-a-lot#As your user gadget]] instead of [[c:Help:Gadget-Cat-a-lot#As a project gadget]]. I have done both the changes, since doing only the if (mw.config.get('wgNamespaceNumber') === 14) one seems to not have loaded immediately (maybe due to caching). [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:13, 8 June 2025 (UTC) :::::It works, thanks! —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 12:19, 8 June 2025 (UTC) == Request for bureaucrat == {{Discussion top|Closing this as {{notdone|no consensus}}, given the lack of any !votes in support (or opposition). —'''''[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] [[User Talk:PixDeVl|talk to me!]]''''' 01:22, 19 June 2025 (UTC)}} I served as a previous bureaucrat before the new requirements were implemented, and thus is familiar with the rules and regulations including the new ones. I would like this right for helping with maintenance task, such as with the RFP pages as well as all [https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/TestWiki:Bureaucrats#Responsibilities these]. I am familiar with the relevant policies and will use the tools with care and responsibility. Please feel free to ask any questions or raise concerns.[[User:Cactusisme|'''Cactus🌵''']] [[User talk:Cactusisme|spiky]] [[Special:Contributions/Cactusisme|ouch]] 12:02, 28 May 2025 (UTC) :{{Note}} Please do understand that bureaucrat rights are not for testing. Bureaucrats now serve a functional role in assisting consuls. [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 15:37, 28 May 2025 (UTC) ::Noted--[[User:Cactusisme|'''Cactus🌵''']] [[User talk:Cactusisme|spiky]] [[Special:Contributions/Cactusisme|ouch]] 11:02, 30 May 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == Abuse filter operator for PB2008 == :{{userlinks2|PB2008}} I am an admin on [[:mh:unbooks:|unbookswiki]] and have created some [[mh:unbooks:Special:AbuseFilter|Abuse Filters]] there. I request the Abuse Filter operator flag to enable restriction actions to block cross-wiki and long-term abusers, especially Uwucutesingle and Rebootedpoppy. Additionally, I will check for any false positives. Thank you. [[User:PB2008|PB2008]] ([[User talk:PB2008|talk]]) 14:52, 30 June 2025 (UTC) :{{Done}} Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 15:07, 30 June 2025 (UTC) == Edit request == Please removed {{Namespace detect}} From [[Template:Mbox]]. Those pages have no content, and the required CSS has already been included in [[MediaWiki:Common.css]]. Due to this, some pages such as [[Create protection test]] display errors. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 13:39, 17 July 2025 (UTC) :{{done}} [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 13:42, 17 July 2025 (UTC) == Bureaucrat for -Stickman- == {{Discussion top|User-closing this as {{notdone|invalid}}, as [[Special:CentralAuth/-Stickman-|requester]] does not meet [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats#Eligibility|eligibility requirements]]. --[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 19:02, 17 July 2025 (UTC)}} :{{userlinks2|-Stickman-}} I see discussions on Request Permissions that don't have been handled by a bureaucrat. I want to check the Request Permissions and see the requests and handle them. But that's not all. I will check the Recent Changes and revert the tests that are done, because not all users revert their tests. I see also that the bureaucrats are not very active. That is because i request this high trusted role. [[User:-Stickman-|-Stickman-]] ([[User talk:-Stickman-|talk]]) 13:23, 3 July 2025 (UTC) :{{oppose}} barely has any experience on this project and anyone can watch recent changes to revert tests that users leave up. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 13:29, 3 July 2025 (UTC) ::i know it [[User:-Stickman-|-Stickman-]] ([[User talk:-Stickman-|talk]]) 13:49, 3 July 2025 (UTC) :{{oppose|strong}} Sorry, but you need more experience to get crat perm. I think we can consider the crats to be active enough, since the eligible perm requesters are being fulfilled within 24-48 hours, a good enough time according to me. Feel free to help with reverts of test edits though. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 13:38, 3 July 2025 (UTC) :{{oppose}} Although it’s uncommon for bureaucrats to handle the request for permissions page and deal with backlogs, we currently have enough bureaucrats available. Most users requesting admin permissions are new and haven’t yet met the [[TW:A#Eligibility|guidelines]] of being a registered user for at least ten (10) days or providing a valid reason for needing the permission. As for recent changes, any user can easily undo edits made by others without needing bureaucrat permissions. [[User:PB2008|PB2008]] ([[User talk:PB2008|talk]]) 13:49, 3 July 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}}

{{Aan}} == Request for Consul == I have made constructive non-test edits and I am a bureaucrat so should I become a consul? [[User:MiraEdit|MiraEdit]] ([[User talk:MiraEdit|talk]]) 23:04, 2 February 2025 (UTC) :: Please review the terms on the Test Wiki Main page [[TestWiki]], specifically the rules listed in the section [[TestWiki#Things to keep in mind]]. If you are not sure which rule was violated, you should reach out to [[m:Steward requests]] or discuss at the [[m:Community portal]]. : --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:44, 3 February 2025 (UTC) ::: I know my answer didn't really answer your question, but basically, every wiki is different. Please learn more about Test Wiki if you really want to become a Consul. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:47, 3 February 2025 (UTC) == Refreshing created a test page == I was told my test page was labeled abusive because it was short and had "bad words." I opted to use the preview bar instead. Later I refreshed the page (F5) and for some reason that created it. No bad words, but the page will probably be gone by the time you see this. Posting because it said to log an issue [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 01:57, 15 February 2025 (UTC) == Can't undo == All of a sudden, I can't undo. I even went to contributions and reverted from there, but the pages still exist and have the content [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 04:30, 18 February 2025 (UTC) :Don't know which pages you are referring to. I could be wrong, but generally, we can rollback 1 and if someone has already contributed after your contribution, then rollback is not possible. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 25 February 2025 (UTC) == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 18:36, 3 March 2025 (UTC) :'''Update: the updated [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Blocking policy|blocking policy]]''' is now in effect as of Monday, March 2nd 6:16PM UTC-6. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:45, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] Could you summarize the changes made? Thanks! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::@[[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] Consuls, CVT, and Stewards are the only ones authorized to issue non-test blocks, test blocks can now only be done on accounts the user controls or on approved test accounts, appeals are only done via the blocked user’s talk page, or by emailing the blocking Consul, third party appeals are no longer accepted. I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! I obviously do not object the policy, just wanted your say on what you changed. :) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:08, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::ZPPIX WHY DO YOU KEEP MAKING POLICY CHANGES WITHOUT CONSENSUS! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 21:05, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::I do this as well on a local wiki that isn't the test one as an admin that can enforce and change rules around to keep it up to date like yes communities are needed but not for everything that are granted rights to staff. [[User:339Breakingoof|TheFunny339YoshiPlushGuy]] ([[User talk:339Breakingoof|talk]]) 13:38, 9 May 2025 (UTC) == Request for Consul (PixDeVl) == {{Discussion top|{{done}}, welcome to the Consul team. Please reach out if you have any questions. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 11:26, 9 March 2025 (UTC)}} Hi folks, I’m filing this Request for Consul, frankly because I noticed that we currently have only 2 remotely active Consuls, being Zppix and Reception, and, even with something like PTW, having an official project wiki be run by two folks isn’t great, so I’d thought I’d offer to lend a hand. I am not very active priorly with what exists of the community on PTW, but as a current global functionary, I still think it wouldn’t hurt to have an extra hand helping keep things clean. Feel free to ask any questions regarding this, as always :) —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 03:35, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}}  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   03:39, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} trusted user. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:38, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I looked into his CA. 1270 edits is extremely few for a user who is GA. Unfortunately this lowers my trust in this user even more. Maybe if the user was more involved cross-wiki I would change my mind, but unfortunately that is not the case. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:47, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I get that you look from the ground floor up. I have a more centered view from the MetaWiki and Discord. [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 13:47, 28 April 2025 (UTC) :If the copy is merged, before any restoring from backup, perhaps review the contributions and identify all the users who contributed. :Then find the history of the contribution from the user's original and there should be a Diff. :Idk about what is practical but if you wish, I can take a look at the merged copy to see if there is a pattern. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 29 April 2025 (UTC) ::From Revisions: ::[https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/User_talk:Void/mangled_page_history?diff=61326&oldid=61235 Reception123] ::[https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/User_talk:Void/mangled_page_history?diff=61524&oldid=61507 AlPaD] ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:54, 29 April 2025 (UTC) :::{{Ping|MacFan4000}} and {{Ping|Imamy}} Hello, I agree with restore the database and I understand that it's necessary [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 17:07, 29 April 2025 (UTC) == Error in filter == I was trying to create a test page but filter disallowed me to page What message I received:This action has been automatically identified as harmful, and therefore disallowed. If you believe your action was constructive, please report this error at the community portal. A brief description of the abuse rule which your action matched is: LTA 60 [[User:Dennis566|Dennis566]] ([[User talk:Dennis566|talk]]) 17:26, 29 April 2025 (UTC) :Hi {{ping|Dennis566}}, :: Test Wiki limits the number of pages that can be created at a time. :: Due to the limit, it's possible that the message you get will be different than messages that the Admins and higher ups will get for the same type of action. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 22:08, 29 April 2025 (UTC) == Request for consulship == I, KahootNickname1234, want to be a consul because I have done non-test actions. There are no eligiblity requirements for consul so I am eligible to place a request. [[Special:Contributions/38.158.220.26|38.158.220.26]] 04:49, 4 May 2025 (UTC) :Declined, all accounts locked and blocked for vandalism on PublicTestWiki. --[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 04:50, 4 May 2025 (UTC) == Administrators Policy update == Due to constant abuse, the policy regarding [[TW:Administrators|administrators]] has been updated to include changes to deter bad actors. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:46, 4 May 2025 (UTC) :Thanks! This was a much needed change considering recent issues. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 15:25, 4 May 2025 (UTC) == Change the bureaucrat requirement == {{Discussion top|1={{Not done}} this is an anti-abuse measure and will not be done. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:47, 4 May 2025 (UTC)}} Change the bureaucrat requirement from 3 months (89-92 days) to 2 months (59-62 days) because that is consistent with Miraheze's Meta Wiki creator. Bureaucrats shouldn't have to wait that long because of the 200 edit requirement and people are impatient. ===Three month edit to day ratio=== 200/92=2.17391304348 and 200/89=2.24719101124 round up to 3 edits per day. ===Two month edit to day ratio=== 200/62=3.22580645161 and 200/59=3.38983050847 round up to 4 edits per day. ===Support=== #{{Support}} per proposer [[User:KahootNickname1234|KahootNickname1234]] ([[User talk:KahootNickname1234|talk]]) 07:51, 3 May 2025 (UTC) ===Neutral=== ===Oppose=== {{Discussion bottom}} == About translate == As a Chinese user and translator, I think "zh-cn" is unnecessary and should be converted to "zh-hans", "zh-hant", etc. After conversion, zh-cn should be deleted. I'd like to know everyone's opinions. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 03:55, 5 May 2025 (UTC) :Hi, as a non Chinese speaker, can you explain the difference and the reasoning behind why you think this should be done so I can understand better? Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 13:25, 5 May 2025 (UTC) ::Simply put, zh-cn is generally only used in mainland China, and these users use simplified Chinese, zh-hans. I don't think there is any big difference between the two. Hans has a wider range of applications, so I think it is possible to only retain hans to improve translation efficiency, and users do not need to think about which language they should choose. I don't know if I'm expressing the difference well with what I mean. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 15:14, 5 May 2025 (UTC) == ManageWiki policy change == {{Discussion top|1={{Not done}} Rollback can still be abused. If a user can simply wait until they are eligible for admin. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 13:23, 5 May 2025 (UTC)}} Can we change policy so that autopatrolled users can have rollback rights. This is because now you have to wait 240 hours for admin which includes rollback. Rollback does not require that much trust unlike delete and block which is in the admin group. ===Support=== ===Neutral=== ===Oppose=== # Hard no, we have enough issues with throwaway accounts being used to cause trouble. --[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 02:09, 5 May 2025 (UTC) # {{Oppose}} Rollback can also easily cause trouble. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 03:24, 5 May 2025 (UTC) # Nope, I don't believe rollback is that necessary. Users should be able to wait for someone to assign administrator rights. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 13:20, 5 May 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == publictestwiki.com or test.miraheze.org == publictestwiki.com or test.miraheze.org? Differences? Preferred link? Does it even matter at all [[User:Clover-not-used|Clover-not-used]] ([[User talk:Clover-not-used|talk]]) 02:36, 6 May 2025 (UTC) :They are the same thing and will lead you to the same site. The only visual difference is one uses a custom domain and one uses the Miraheze subdomain. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 03:14, 6 May 2025 (UTC) == Suggestion: editing here pops up a "big blue button?" or something == Not sure how feasibly it is technically but seeing as I missed the "big blue button"... somehow...? [[User:Clover-not-used|Clover-not-used]] ([[User talk:Clover-not-used|talk]]) 02:48, 6 May 2025 (UTC) :When I edit, I see a blue button that says [[Save changes]]. :If the blue button is missing, maybe the page did not load properly. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 23:24, 6 May 2025 (UTC) ::Oh I meant the big blue button saying "New thread" at the top I missed [[User:Clover-not-used|Clover-not-used]] ([[User talk:Clover-not-used|talk]]) 13:30, 7 May 2025 (UTC) :::I see it now! :::When that button goes unnoticed, it's probably a sign that it's time to archive some messages... :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 00:16, 8 May 2025 (UTC) == Edit request == [[MediaWiki:Gadgets-definition]]:
From * Cat-a-lot[ResourceLoader|dependencies=mediawiki.util|rights=edit,editprotected]|Cat-a-lot.js to * Cat-a-lot[ResourceLoader|dependencies=mediawiki.util|rights=edit,editprotected|namespaces=14]|Cat-a-lot.js Because this is a tool for categorization, it should only load on category namespace. Although this is indeed optional content, I think it's better this way. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 10:20, 8 June 2025 (UTC) :It's also possible to add if (mw.config.get('wgNamespaceNumber') === 14) {} directly to [[MediaWiki:Gadget-Cat-a-lot.js]]. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 10:22, 8 June 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Saoutax|Saoutax]] I think the original file at commons already has the code for loading on cat NS, since we can't currently see it activated on any other NS. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 11:16, 8 June 2025 (UTC) :::I still see the loading of cat-a-lot on my user page, even though I haven't enabled it in any other additional way. Also, I have confirmed that after turning it off in the preferences, the display on the user page also disappears. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 11:33, 8 June 2025 (UTC) ::::Ah, my bad. While adding the gadget, I followed [[c:Help:Gadget-Cat-a-lot#As your user gadget]] instead of [[c:Help:Gadget-Cat-a-lot#As a project gadget]]. I have done both the changes, since doing only the if (mw.config.get('wgNamespaceNumber') === 14) one seems to not have loaded immediately (maybe due to caching). [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:13, 8 June 2025 (UTC) :::::It works, thanks! —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 12:19, 8 June 2025 (UTC) == Request for bureaucrat == {{Discussion top|Closing this as {{notdone|no consensus}}, given the lack of any !votes in support (or opposition). —'''''[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] [[User Talk:PixDeVl|talk to me!]]''''' 01:22, 19 June 2025 (UTC)}} I served as a previous bureaucrat before the new requirements were implemented, and thus is familiar with the rules and regulations including the new ones. I would like this right for helping with maintenance task, such as with the RFP pages as well as all [https://publictestwiki.com/wiki/TestWiki:Bureaucrats#Responsibilities these]. I am familiar with the relevant policies and will use the tools with care and responsibility. Please feel free to ask any questions or raise concerns.[[User:Cactusisme|'''Cactus🌵''']] [[User talk:Cactusisme|spiky]] [[Special:Contributions/Cactusisme|ouch]] 12:02, 28 May 2025 (UTC) :{{Note}} Please do understand that bureaucrat rights are not for testing. Bureaucrats now serve a functional role in assisting consuls. [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 15:37, 28 May 2025 (UTC) ::Noted--[[User:Cactusisme|'''Cactus🌵''']] [[User talk:Cactusisme|spiky]] [[Special:Contributions/Cactusisme|ouch]] 11:02, 30 May 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == Abuse filter operator for PB2008 == :{{userlinks2|PB2008}} I am an admin on [[:mh:unbooks:|unbookswiki]] and have created some [[mh:unbooks:Special:AbuseFilter|Abuse Filters]] there. I request the Abuse Filter operator flag to enable restriction actions to block cross-wiki and long-term abusers, especially Uwucutesingle and Rebootedpoppy. Additionally, I will check for any false positives. Thank you. [[User:PB2008|PB2008]] ([[User talk:PB2008|talk]]) 14:52, 30 June 2025 (UTC) :{{Done}} Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 15:07, 30 June 2025 (UTC) == Edit request == Please removed {{Namespace detect}} From [[Template:Mbox]]. Those pages have no content, and the required CSS has already been included in [[MediaWiki:Common.css]]. Due to this, some pages such as [[Create protection test]] display errors. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 13:39, 17 July 2025 (UTC) :{{done}} [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 13:42, 17 July 2025 (UTC) == Bureaucrat for -Stickman- == {{Discussion top|User-closing this as {{notdone|invalid}}, as [[Special:CentralAuth/-Stickman-|requester]] does not meet [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats#Eligibility|eligibility requirements]]. --[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 19:02, 17 July 2025 (UTC)}} :{{userlinks2|-Stickman-}} I see discussions on Request Permissions that don't have been handled by a bureaucrat. I want to check the Request Permissions and see the requests and handle them. But that's not all. I will check the Recent Changes and revert the tests that are done, because not all users revert their tests. I see also that the bureaucrats are not very active. That is because i request this high trusted role. [[User:-Stickman-|-Stickman-]] ([[User talk:-Stickman-|talk]]) 13:23, 3 July 2025 (UTC) :{{oppose}} barely has any experience on this project and anyone can watch recent changes to revert tests that users leave up. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 13:29, 3 July 2025 (UTC) ::i know it [[User:-Stickman-|-Stickman-]] ([[User talk:-Stickman-|talk]]) 13:49, 3 July 2025 (UTC) :{{oppose|strong}} Sorry, but you need more experience to get crat perm. I think we can consider the crats to be active enough, since the eligible perm requesters are being fulfilled within 24-48 hours, a good enough time according to me. Feel free to help with reverts of test edits though. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 13:38, 3 July 2025 (UTC) :{{oppose}} Although it’s uncommon for bureaucrats to handle the request for permissions page and deal with backlogs, we currently have enough bureaucrats available. Most users requesting admin permissions are new and haven’t yet met the [[TW:A#Eligibility|guidelines]] of being a registered user for at least ten (10) days or providing a valid reason for needing the permission. As for recent changes, any user can easily undo edits made by others without needing bureaucrat permissions. [[User:PB2008|PB2008]] ([[User talk:PB2008|talk]]) 13:49, 3 July 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == Edit request == Please replace the content of [[TestWiki]] with that of [[User:Saoutax/TestWiki]], correcting the incorrect line breaks caused by markup issues. You can verify this by checking the existing translation styles of both pages. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 00:07, 18 July 2025 (UTC) :Pinging some recently active consuls @[[User:Zppix|Zppix]], @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]], @[[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]]. [[Special:Diff/69855/74083]] shows the diff between the current version of the mainpage and Saoutax's version. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 07:19, 19 July 2025 (UTC) ::{{Ping|Saoutax}} I guess I am a bit confused, I see no visual difference in the pages, what exactly is this correcting? For me the line breaks look normal. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 20:47, 22 July 2025 (UTC) :::Actually, I'm not entirely sure about this either. From the current homepage translations, many languages (e.g., [[TestWiki/mt]], [[TestWiki/de]], [[TestWiki/ca]]) have unexpected line breaks, or is it because they haven't been fully translated yet? I'd like to know if these appear normal to others. If the display is fine, please ignore my edit request. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 22:15, 22 July 2025 (UTC)

{{Aan}} == Request for Consul == I have made constructive non-test edits and I am a bureaucrat so should I become a consul? [[User:MiraEdit|MiraEdit]] ([[User talk:MiraEdit|talk]]) 23:04, 2 February 2025 (UTC) :: Please review the terms on the Test Wiki Main page [[TestWiki]], specifically the rules listed in the section [[TestWiki#Things to keep in mind]]. If you are not sure which rule was violated, you should reach out to [[m:Steward requests]] or discuss at the [[m:Community portal]]. : --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:44, 3 February 2025 (UTC) ::: I know my answer didn't really answer your question, but basically, every wiki is different. Please learn more about Test Wiki if you really want to become a Consul. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:47, 3 February 2025 (UTC) == Refreshing created a test page == I was told my test page was labeled abusive because it was short and had "bad words." I opted to use the preview bar instead. Later I refreshed the page (F5) and for some reason that created it. No bad words, but the page will probably be gone by the time you see this. Posting because it said to log an issue [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 01:57, 15 February 2025 (UTC) == Can't undo == All of a sudden, I can't undo. I even went to contributions and reverted from there, but the pages still exist and have the content [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 04:30, 18 February 2025 (UTC) :Don't know which pages you are referring to. I could be wrong, but generally, we can rollback 1 and if someone has already contributed after your contribution, then rollback is not possible. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 25 February 2025 (UTC) == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 18:36, 3 March 2025 (UTC) :'''Update: the updated [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Blocking policy|blocking policy]]''' is now in effect as of Monday, March 2nd 6:16PM UTC-6. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:45, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] Could you summarize the changes made? Thanks! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::@[[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] Consuls, CVT, and Stewards are the only ones authorized to issue non-test blocks, test blocks can now only be done on accounts the user controls or on approved test accounts, appeals are only done via the blocked user’s talk page, or by emailing the blocking Consul, third party appeals are no longer accepted. I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! I obviously do not object the policy, just wanted your say on what you changed. :) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:08, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::ZPPIX WHY DO YOU KEEP MAKING POLICY CHANGES WITHOUT CONSENSUS! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 21:05, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::I do this as well on a local wiki that isn't the test one as an admin that can enforce and change rules around to keep it up to date like yes communities are needed but not for everything that are granted rights to staff. [[User:339Breakingoof|TheFunny339YoshiPlushGuy]] ([[User talk:339Breakingoof|talk]]) 13:38, 9 May 2025 (UTC) == Request for Consul (PixDeVl) == {{Discussion top|{{done}}, welcome to the Consul team. Please reach out if you have any questions. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 11:26, 9 March 2025 (UTC)}} Hi folks, I’m filing this Request for Consul, frankly because I noticed that we currently have only 2 remotely active Consuls, being Zppix and Reception, and, even with something like PTW, having an official project wiki be run by two folks isn’t great, so I’d thought I’d offer to lend a hand. I am not very active priorly with what exists of the community on PTW, but as a current global functionary, I still think it wouldn’t hurt to have an extra hand helping keep things clean. Feel free to ask any questions regarding this, as always :) —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 03:35, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}}  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   03:39, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} trusted user. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:38, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I looked into his CA. 1270 edits is extremely few for a user who is GA. Unfortunately this lowers my trust in this user even more. Maybe if the user was more involved cross-wiki I would change my mind, but unfortunately that is not the case. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:47, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I get that you look from the ground floor up. I have a more centered view from the MetaWiki and Discord. He is a trusted user who has been a great asset to the broader community. ::::I feel that you are gate keeping the local community, and that is your prerogative, but I think that PTW will benefit from his policy knowhow as well as his activity on the technical side. (Phorge) ::::On the other hand I find that waiting for first comments to arrive before answering on your own RfP doesn't make you to eager, as if one is collecting hats. I can assure you he's not. ::::I cannot take your concerns away, but hope you want to see it from the outside in, instead of the inside out.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:49, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::I do not believe in Quantity, but Quality. I can make 1000's of edits, but they do not tell much.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:50, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::::These are beautiful and classic words...
