{{Aan}} == Request for Consul == I have made constructive non-test edits and I am a bureaucrat so should I become a consul? [[User:MiraEdit|MiraEdit]] ([[User talk:MiraEdit|talk]]) 23:04, 2 February 2025 (UTC) :: Please review the terms on the Test Wiki Main page [[TestWiki]], specifically the rules listed in the section [[TestWiki#Things to keep in mind]]. If you are not sure which rule was violated, you should reach out to [[m:Steward requests]] or discuss at the [[m:Community portal]]. : --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:44, 3 February 2025 (UTC) ::: I know my answer didn't really answer your question, but basically, every wiki is different. Please learn more about Test Wiki if you really want to become a Consul. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:47, 3 February 2025 (UTC) == Refreshing created a test page == I was told my test page was labeled abusive because it was short and had "bad words." I opted to use the preview bar instead. Later I refreshed the page (F5) and for some reason that created it. No bad words, but the page will probably be gone by the time you see this. Posting because it said to log an issue [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 01:57, 15 February 2025 (UTC) == Can't undo == All of a sudden, I can't undo. I even went to contributions and reverted from there, but the pages still exist and have the content [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 04:30, 18 February 2025 (UTC) :Don't know which pages you are referring to. I could be wrong, but generally, we can rollback 1 and if someone has already contributed after your contribution, then rollback is not possible. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 25 February 2025 (UTC) == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 18:36, 3 March 2025 (UTC) :'''Update: the updated [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Blocking policy|blocking policy]]''' is now in effect as of Monday, March 2nd 6:16PM UTC-6. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:45, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] Could you summarize the changes made? Thanks! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::@[[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] Consuls, CVT, and Stewards are the only ones authorized to issue non-test blocks, test blocks can now only be done on accounts the user controls or on approved test accounts, appeals are only done via the blocked user’s talk page, or by emailing the blocking Consul, third party appeals are no longer accepted. I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! I obviously do not object the policy, just wanted your say on what you changed. :) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:08, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::ZPPIX WHY DO YOU KEEP MAKING POLICY CHANGES WITHOUT CONSENSUS! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 21:05, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::I do this as well on a local wiki that isn't the test one as an admin that can enforce and change rules around to keep it up to date like yes communities are needed but not for everything that are granted rights to staff. [[User:339Breakingoof|TheFunny339YoshiPlushGuy]] ([[User talk:339Breakingoof|talk]]) 13:38, 9 May 2025 (UTC) == Request for Consul (PixDeVl) == {{Discussion top|{{done}}, welcome to the Consul team. Please reach out if you have any questions. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 11:26, 9 March 2025 (UTC)}} Hi folks, I’m filing this Request for Consul, frankly because I noticed that we currently have only 2 remotely active Consuls, being Zppix and Reception, and, even with something like PTW, having an official project wiki be run by two folks isn’t great, so I’d thought I’d offer to lend a hand. I am not very active priorly with what exists of the community on PTW, but as a current global functionary, I still think it wouldn’t hurt to have an extra hand helping keep things clean. Feel free to ask any questions regarding this, as always :) —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 03:35, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}}  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   03:39, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} trusted user. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:38, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I looked into his CA. 1270 edits is extremely few for a user who is GA. Unfortunately this lowers my trust in this user even more. Maybe if the user was more involved cross-wiki I would change my mind, but unfortunately that is not the case. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:47, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I get that you look from the ground floor up. I have a more centered view from the MetaWiki and Discord. He is a trusted user who has been a great asset to the broader community. ::::I feel that you are gate keeping the local community, and that is your prerogative, but I think that PTW will benefit from his policy knowhow as well as his activity on the technical side. (Phorge) ::::On the other hand I find that waiting for first comments to arrive before answering on your own RfP doesn't make you to eager, as if one is collecting hats. I can assure you he's not. ::::I cannot take your concerns away, but hope you want to see it from the outside in, instead of the inside out.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:49, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::I do not believe in Quantity, but Quality. I can make 1000's of edits, but they do not tell much.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:50, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::::These are beautiful and classic words... However, can you explain to me why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions? Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW? I can't understand it. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:57, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::I think Zppix explains it perfectly. Being a Consul falls under different policies. Thus he needs to request permission to function here under the localpolcies.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   14:07, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::Hi, [[User:94.254.227.16|      ]] :::::::: I found your questions deeply compelling. As a result, I feel that I have gained a bit more understanding of Test Wiki. :::::::* '''Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW?''' :::::::As I understand it, Bureaucrat and Administrator are testing roles. As such, the roles cannot be used to uphold or enforce policy without creating confusion for the other Non Consuls within the community as to what is acceptable behavior. :::::::* '''why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions?''' :::::::Clearly PixDeVl recognizes that there is a distinction between a Consul role and a Non Consul role and will need the Consul role in order to provide the appropriate executive assistance. :::::::: You have raised a lot of other points that I will take into consideration, such as the low local edit count. I'd like to know everyone's opinions. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 03:55, 5 May 2025 (UTC) :Hi, as a non Chinese speaker, can you explain the difference and the reasoning behind why you think this should be done so I can understand better? Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 13:25, 5 May 2025 (UTC) ::Simply put, zh-cn is generally only used in mainland China, and these users use simplified Chinese, zh-hans. I don't think there is any big difference between the two. Hans has a wider range of applications, so I think it is possible to only retain hans to improve translation efficiency, and users do not need to think about which language they should choose. I don't know if I'm expressing the difference well with what I mean. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 15:14, 5 May 2025 (UTC) == ManageWiki policy change == {{Discussion top|1={{Not done}} Rollback can still be abused. If a user can simply wait until they are eligible for admin. This is because now you have to wait 240 hours for admin which includes rollback. Rollback does not require that much trust unlike delete and block which is in the admin group. ===Support=== ===Neutral=== ===Oppose=== # Hard no, we have enough issues with throwaway accounts being used to cause trouble. --[[User:NotAracham|NotAracham]] ([[User talk:NotAracham|talk]]) 02:09, 5 May 2025 (UTC) # {{Oppose}} Rollback can also easily cause trouble. —— From [[User:Saoutax|SAOUTAX]] the Dual Blades Sysop 03:24, 5 May 2025 (UTC) # Nope, I don't believe rollback is that necessary. Users should be able to wait for someone to assign administrator rights. {{Aan}} == Request for Consul == I have made constructive non-test edits and I am a bureaucrat so should I become a consul? [[User:MiraEdit|MiraEdit]] ([[User talk:MiraEdit|talk]]) 23:04, 2 February 2025 (UTC) :: Please review the terms on the Test Wiki Main page [[TestWiki]], specifically the rules listed in the section [[TestWiki#Things to keep in mind]]. If you are not sure which rule was violated, you should reach out to [[m:Steward requests]] or discuss at the [[m:Community portal]]. : --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:44, 3 February 2025 (UTC) ::: I know my answer didn't really answer your question, but basically, every wiki is different. Please learn more about Test Wiki if you really want to become a Consul. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:47, 3 February 2025 (UTC) == Refreshing created a test page == I was told my test page was labeled abusive because it was short and had "bad words." I opted to use the preview bar instead. Later I refreshed the page (F5) and for some reason that created it. No bad words, but the page will probably be gone by the time you see this. Posting because it said to log an issue [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 01:57, 15 February 2025 (UTC) == Can't undo == All of a sudden, I can't undo. I even went to contributions and reverted from there, but the pages still exist and have the content [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 04:30, 18 February 2025 (UTC) :Don't know which pages you are referring to. I could be wrong, but generally, we can rollback 1 and if someone has already contributed after your contribution, then rollback is not possible. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 25 February 2025 (UTC) == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 18:36, 3 March 2025 (UTC) :'''Update: the updated [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Blocking policy|blocking policy]]''' is now in effect as of Monday, March 2nd 6:16PM UTC-6. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:45, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] Could you summarize the changes made? Thanks! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::@[[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] Consuls, CVT, and Stewards are the only ones authorized to issue non-test blocks, test blocks can now only be done on accounts the user controls or on approved test accounts, appeals are only done via the blocked user’s talk page, or by emailing the blocking Consul, third party appeals are no longer accepted. I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! I obviously do not object the policy, just wanted your say on what you changed. :) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:08, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::ZPPIX WHY DO YOU KEEP MAKING POLICY CHANGES WITHOUT CONSENSUS! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 21:05, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::I do this as well on a local wiki that isn't the test one as an admin that can enforce and change rules around to keep it up to date like yes communities are needed but not for everything that are granted rights to staff. [[User:339Breakingoof|TheFunny339YoshiPlushGuy]] ([[User talk:339Breakingoof|talk]]) 13:38, 9 May 2025 (UTC) == Request for Consul (PixDeVl) == {{Discussion top|{{done}}, welcome to the Consul team. Please reach out if you have any questions. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 11:26, 9 March 2025 (UTC)}} Hi folks, I’m filing this Request for Consul, frankly because I noticed that we currently have only 2 remotely active Consuls, being Zppix and Reception, and, even with something like PTW, having an official project wiki be run by two folks isn’t great, so I’d thought I’d offer to lend a hand. I am not very active priorly with what exists of the community on PTW, but as a current global functionary, I still think it wouldn’t hurt to have an extra hand helping keep things clean. Feel free to ask any questions regarding this, as always :) —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 03:35, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}}  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   03:39, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} trusted user. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. I don't think there is any big difference between the two. Hans has a wider range of applications, so I think it is possible to only retain hans to improve translation efficiency, and users do not need to think about which language they should choose. {{Aan}} == Request for Consul == I have made constructive non-test edits and I am a bureaucrat so should I become a consul? [[User:MiraEdit|MiraEdit]] ([[User talk:MiraEdit|talk]]) 23:04, 2 February 2025 (UTC) :: Please review the terms on the Test Wiki Main page [[TestWiki]], specifically the rules listed in the section [[TestWiki#Things to keep in mind]]. If you are not sure which rule was violated, you should reach out to [[m:Steward requests]] or discuss at the [[m:Community portal]]. : --- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:44, 3 February 2025 (UTC) ::: I know my answer didn't really answer your question, but basically, every wiki is different. Please learn more about Test Wiki if you really want to become a Consul. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:47, 3 February 2025 (UTC) == Refreshing created a test page == I was told my test page was labeled abusive because it was short and had "bad words." I opted to use the preview bar instead. Later I refreshed the page (F5) and for some reason that created it. No bad words, but the page will probably be gone by the time you see this. Posting because it said to log an issue [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 01:57, 15 February 2025 (UTC) == Can't undo == All of a sudden, I can't undo. I even went to contributions and reverted from there, but the pages still exist and have the content [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 04:30, 18 February 2025 (UTC) :Don't know which pages you are referring to. I could be wrong, but generally, we can rollback 1 and if someone has already contributed after your contribution, then rollback is not possible. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 25 February 2025 (UTC) == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 18:36, 3 March 2025 (UTC) :'''Update: the updated [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Blocking policy|blocking policy]]''' is now in effect as of Monday, March 2nd 6:16PM UTC-6. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:45, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] Could you summarize the changes made? Thanks! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::@[[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] Consuls, CVT, and Stewards are the only ones authorized to issue non-test blocks, test blocks can now only be done on accounts the user controls or on approved test accounts, appeals are only done via the blocked user’s talk page, or by emailing the blocking Consul, third party appeals are no longer accepted. I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! I obviously do not object the policy, just wanted your say on what you changed. :) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:08, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::ZPPIX WHY DO YOU KEEP MAKING POLICY CHANGES WITHOUT CONSENSUS! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 21:05, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::I do this as well on a local wiki that isn't the test one as an admin that can enforce and change rules around to keep it up to date like yes communities are needed but not for everything that are granted rights to staff. [[User:339Breakingoof|TheFunny339YoshiPlushGuy]] ([[User talk:339Breakingoof|talk]]) 13:38, 9 May 2025 (UTC) == Request for Consul (PixDeVl) == {{Discussion top|{{done}}, welcome to the Consul team. Please reach out if you have any questions. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 20:36, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} While Bureaucrat has historically been implemented as a testing role, the low requirements for entry into the role coupled with broad/disruptive permission sets has made it a prime target for bad actors - repeat instances of malicious abuse of Bureaucrat permissions necessitating intervention by global volunteers has made clear that a change is needed. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. Thank you for the extremely helpful and insightful observations. :::::::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:56, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I had far less edits back when I was a Global Sysop on Miraheze. Edits is not the end all be all. Further, it is clear to me that there is either a lack of understanding from you on the differences between having Global user rights and local user rights. For PixDeVI their use of global rights is governed by global Miraheze policy which dictates when and when they cannot use their global rights to intervene, but them asking for local rights it is allowing them to effectively not only help us Consuls, but also allow them to act based on our local policies outside of the governance of global policy requirements which can be restrictive and ultimately lead to relying on myself or another of the very few active Consuls which can lead to delays or even missed violations. ::::Please note my above comment does not reflect a vote but rather an observation of the discussion you have started. I neither endorse or oppose the candidate. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 14:04, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::The concern is not unfair; a user of this few edits both globally and locally seeking such a project leadership role is irregular, even with the precedent of [[Special:CentralAuth/subwayfares|subwayfares]] for wiki creation on Meta. Typically in a wiki that is fully independent this would be stranger as you would hope a leader is representative of the project, although there is merit to onboarding a trusted user in an advisory or supporting capacity. I would argue the key here is that this is ultimately a [[m:miraheze projects|Miraheze Project]]. I believe its identity as such should be a modifier for cases like this and that it is ideal for global functionaries to be more tightly bound with such a project, recommended in queue by wiki creators as it is with a domain currently hosted at WikiTide Foundation's grace. This may not be the ideal way to do it; my theory is to propose stewards as 'at large' consuls should locally invested members need a 'third opinion', more local consuls are involved and so on. Global administrators could perhaps fill the intermediary second line role bureaucrat serves, able to step in if there is backlog or an incident (short of something a GA/steward should step in for anyway). Otherwise there is a strong culture of 'separation of roles' at issue here and which is why pixel can't necessarily just jump in and do these things: it is not GS mandate. Therefore this request is an extension of his capabilities to reduce 'paperwork'. ::Essentially what I'm getting at is this request is reasonable, but skepticism of his investment in ''this'' local project holding such a role is also reasonable. And ideally, better tying the wiki to global operations through a community discussion is the best path in my opinion. The same for other projects such as dev and commons which already sort of act this way - zppix and alpad are local figures, reception and some others are global figures tied in, but as you see with the [[Special:ListUsers/consul|consul list]] it's a bit messy, outdated. ::Finally and drawing back a bit, there is no issue with an IP expressing these opinions. I would support their right to do so. I would also support a blocked user expressing a reasonable opinion to the degree I would offer to relay reasonable thoughts as food for thought even if they are blocked. An occasion where the IP editor and the blocked user overlap however is a very dangerous game that should discontinue immediately. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 23:22, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I agree with Raidarr. Test Wiki is structured very differently from other types of Wikis which makes it more difficult to identify or measure a candidate's qualifications by traditional means. :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:07, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' for {{ping|PixDeVl}}

--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:45, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] TestWiki by its nature isn’t in dire need of conventional clean up work, but we have seen a recent uptick in issues where trolls go on mass desysoping sprees or otherwise cause a ruckus(something I believe Zppix has also wanted to address in policy), but as Raidarr said, PTW is an official Miraheze project, and as such, I don’t believe relying on really 2 activish functionaries to keep an eye on the place and make sure it’s tidy is viable or appropriate, hence my offering to take up the bit to properly police when issues come up beyond what’s included in the GA mandate and codified in local policy. Contrary to our anon friend, I do not claim to “need” these rights, I am offering to lend a hand to the small consul team in supplement to my other duties, and believe it would be beneficial to undergo this RFP to be able to do so without having to worry about global role scope ambiguity among other things. [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 15:00, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :::Thank you for answering my first question. :::[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' followup for {{ping|PixDeVl}} :::Hypothetically, if some disruptive activities were committed with the very best of intentions due to questionable judgement, how would you help wayward testers tweak their behavior before further violations take them straight to a permanent ban? :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:47, 6 March 2025 (UTC) ::::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] Should a user unknowingly or mistakenly violate the [[TW:Testing policy|Testing policy]], we should, as with any wiki, [[wp:assume good faith|assume good faith]] that they do not mean to purposely harm the project. That means contacting them in a civil tone to explain what they were doing and why it’s an issue, how to do whatever they want to do properly, and cleaning up. If they are acting in obvious bad faith or continue to be disruptive after multiple escalating warnings, only then should sanctions such as a serious block be applied ideally. I am glad to have the extra support for testwiki. The vast majority of users support the changes of policy with relation to [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats]]. With a successful RfC here, consuls will undertake a review of all active bureaucrats to determine which users will retain rights. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 20:36, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} While Bureaucrat has historically been implemented as a testing role, the low requirements for entry into the role coupled with broad/disruptive permission sets has made it a prime target for bad actors - repeat instances of malicious abuse of Bureaucrat permissions necessitating intervention by global volunteers has made clear that a change is needed. Simultaneously, the relatively small number of active testwiki Consuls has meant that policy enforcement activities haven't always gotten timely action and oversight, and assistance by trusted users is needed to keep testwiki operating as a true testing space. As such, this proposal aims to convert the Bureaucrat role from one of generic testing to one of moderate trust, eliminating the easy abuse vector while remaining readily achievable and providing consuls more support in day-to-day operations. The proposed changes to [[TW:Bureaucrats|TestWiki:Bureaucrats]] can be found [[User:Zppix/Draft/Bureaucrats#Proposed Page Text Changes|on this draft page]] under the Proposed Page Text Changes section. I could be wrong, but generally, we can rollback 1 and if someone has already contributed after your contribution, then rollback is not possible. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 25 February 2025 (UTC) == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:38, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I looked into his CA. 1270 edits is extremely few for a user who is GA. Unfortunately this lowers my trust in this user even more. Maybe if the user was more involved cross-wiki I would change my mind, but unfortunately that is not the case. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:47, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I get that you look from the ground floor up. I have a more centered view from the MetaWiki and Discord. He is a trusted user who has been a great asset to the broader community. ::::I feel that you are gate keeping the local community, and that is your prerogative, but I think that PTW will benefit from his policy knowhow as well as his activity on the technical side. (Phorge) ::::On the other hand I find that waiting for first comments to arrive before answering on your own RfP doesn't make you to eager, as if one is collecting hats. I can assure you he's not. ::::I cannot take your concerns away, but hope you want to see it from the outside in, instead of the inside out.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:49, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::I do not believe in Quantity, but Quality. I can make 1000's of edits, but they do not tell much.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:50, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::::These are beautiful and classic words... However, can you explain to me why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions? Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW? I can't understand it. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:57, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::I think Zppix explains it perfectly. Being a Consul falls under different policies. Thus he needs to request permission to function here under the localpolcies.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   14:07, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::Hi, [[User:94.254.227.16|      ]] :::::::: I found your questions deeply compelling. As a result, I feel that I have gained a bit more understanding of Test Wiki. :::::::* '''Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW?''' :::::::As I understand it, Bureaucrat and Administrator are testing roles. As such, the roles cannot be used to uphold or enforce policy without creating confusion for the other Non Consuls within the community as to what is acceptable behavior. :::::::* '''why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions?''' :::::::Clearly PixDeVl recognizes that there is a distinction between a Consul role and a Non Consul role and will need the Consul role in order to provide the appropriate executive assistance. :::::::: You have raised a lot of other points that I will take into consideration, such as the low local edit count. Thank you for the extremely helpful and insightful observations. :::::::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:56, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I had far less edits back when I was a Global Sysop on Miraheze. Edits is not the end all be all. Further, it is clear to me that there is either a lack of understanding from you on the differences between having Global user rights and local user rights. For PixDeVI their use of global rights is governed by global Miraheze policy which dictates when and when they cannot use their global rights to intervene, but them asking for local rights it is allowing them to effectively not only help us Consuls, but also allow them to act based on our local policies outside of the governance of global policy requirements which can be restrictive and ultimately lead to relying on myself or another of the very few active Consuls which can lead to delays or even missed violations. ::::Please note my above comment does not reflect a vote but rather an observation of the discussion you have started. I neither endorse or oppose the candidate. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 14:04, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::The concern is not unfair; a user of this few edits both globally and locally seeking such a project leadership role is irregular, even with the precedent of [[Special:CentralAuth/subwayfares|subwayfares]] for wiki creation on Meta. Typically in a wiki that is fully independent this would be stranger as you would hope a leader is representative of the project, although there is merit to onboarding a trusted user in an advisory or supporting capacity. I would argue the key here is that this is ultimately a [[m:miraheze projects|Miraheze Project]]. I believe its identity as such should be a modifier for cases like this and that it is ideal for global functionaries to be more tightly bound with such a project, recommended in queue by wiki creators as it is with a domain currently hosted at WikiTide Foundation's grace. This may not be the ideal way to do it; my theory is to propose stewards as 'at large' consuls should locally invested members need a 'third opinion', more local consuls are involved and so on. Global administrators could perhaps fill the intermediary second line role bureaucrat serves, able to step in if there is backlog or an incident (short of something a GA/steward should step in for anyway). Otherwise there is a strong culture of 'separation of roles' at issue here and which is why pixel can't necessarily just jump in and do these things: it is not GS mandate. Therefore this request is an extension of his capabilities to reduce 'paperwork'. ::Essentially what I'm getting at is this request is reasonable, but skepticism of his investment in ''this'' local project holding such a role is also reasonable. And ideally, better tying the wiki to global operations through a community discussion is the best path in my opinion. The same for other projects such as dev and commons which already sort of act this way - zppix and alpad are local figures, reception and some others are global figures tied in, but as you see with the [[Special:ListUsers/consul|consul list]] it's a bit messy, outdated. ::Finally and drawing back a bit, there is no issue with an IP expressing these opinions. I would support their right to do so. I would also support a blocked user expressing a reasonable opinion to the degree I would offer to relay reasonable thoughts as food for thought even if they are blocked. An occasion where the IP editor and the blocked user overlap however is a very dangerous game that should discontinue immediately. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 23:22, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I agree with Raidarr. Test Wiki is structured very differently from other types of Wikis which makes it more difficult to identify or measure a candidate's qualifications by traditional means. :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:07, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' for {{ping|PixDeVl}}
What is meant by '''an extra hand helping keep things clean'''? What kind of things?

I could be wrong, but generally, we can rollback 1 and if someone has already contributed after your contribution, then rollback is not possible. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 25 February 2025 (UTC) == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Please learn more about Test Wiki if you really want to become a Consul. ::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:47, 3 February 2025 (UTC) == Refreshing created a test page == I was told my test page was labeled abusive because it was short and had "bad words." I opted to use the preview bar instead. Later I refreshed the page (F5) and for some reason that created it. No bad words, but the page will probably be gone by the time you see this. I even went to contributions and reverted from there, but the pages still exist and have the content [[User:CivicLessons|CivicLessons]] ([[User talk:CivicLessons|talk]]) 04:30, 18 February 2025 (UTC) :Don't know which pages you are referring to. I could be wrong, but generally, we can rollback 1 and if someone has already contributed after your contribution, then rollback is not possible. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 25 February 2025 (UTC) == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 18:36, 3 March 2025 (UTC) :'''Update: the updated [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Blocking policy|blocking policy]]''' is now in effect as of Monday, March 2nd 6:16PM UTC-6. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 10:45, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Zppix|Zppix]] Could you summarize the changes made? Thanks! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::@[[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] Consuls, CVT, and Stewards are the only ones authorized to issue non-test blocks, test blocks can now only be done on accounts the user controls or on approved test accounts, appeals are only done via the blocked user’s talk page, or by emailing the blocking Consul, third party appeals are no longer accepted. I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! I obviously do not object the policy, just wanted your say on what you changed. :) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:08, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::ZPPIX WHY DO YOU KEEP MAKING POLICY CHANGES WITHOUT CONSENSUS! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 21:05, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::I do this as well on a local wiki that isn't the test one as an admin that can enforce and change rules around to keep it up to date like yes communities are needed but not for everything that are granted rights to staff. [[User:339Breakingoof|TheFunny339YoshiPlushGuy]] ([[User talk:339Breakingoof|talk]]) 13:38, 9 May 2025 (UTC) == Request for Consul (PixDeVl) == {{Discussion top|{{done}}, welcome to the Consul team. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 11:26, 9 March 2025 (UTC)}} Hi folks, I’m filing this Request for Consul, frankly because I noticed that we currently have only 2 remotely active Consuls, being Zppix and Reception, and, even with something like PTW, having an official project wiki be run by two folks isn’t great, so I’d thought I’d offer to lend a hand. I am not very active priorly with what exists of the community on PTW, but as a current global functionary, I still think it wouldn’t hurt to have an extra hand helping keep things clean. Feel free to ask any questions regarding this, as always :) —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 03:35, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}}  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   03:39, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} trusted user. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:38, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I looked into his CA. 1270 edits is extremely few for a user who is GA. Unfortunately this lowers my trust in this user even more. Maybe if the user was more involved cross-wiki I would change my mind, but unfortunately that is not the case. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:47, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I get that you look from the ground floor up. I have a more centered view from the MetaWiki and Discord. He is a trusted user who has been a great asset to the broader community. ::::I feel that you are gate keeping the local community, and that is your prerogative, but I think that PTW will benefit from his policy knowhow as well as his activity on the technical side. (Phorge) ::::On the other hand I find that waiting for first comments to arrive before answering on your own RfP doesn't make you to eager, as if one is collecting hats. I can assure you he's not. ::::I cannot take your concerns away, but hope you want to see it from the outside in, instead of the inside out.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:49, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::I do not believe in Quantity, but Quality. I can make 1000's of edits, but they do not tell much.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:50, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::::These are beautiful and classic words... However, can you explain to me why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions? Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW? I can't understand it. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:57, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::I think Zppix explains it perfectly. Being a Consul falls under different policies. Thus he needs to request permission to function here under the localpolcies.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   14:07, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::Hi, [[User:94.254.227.16|      ]] :::::::: I found your questions deeply compelling. As a result, I feel that I have gained a bit more understanding of Test Wiki. :::::::* '''Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW?''' :::::::As I understand it, Bureaucrat and Administrator are testing roles. As such, the roles cannot be used to uphold or enforce policy without creating confusion for the other Non Consuls within the community as to what is acceptable behavior. :::::::* '''why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions?''' :::::::Clearly PixDeVl recognizes that there is a distinction between a Consul role and a Non Consul role and will need the Consul role in order to provide the appropriate executive assistance. :::::::: You have raised a lot of other points that I will take into consideration, such as the low local edit count. Thank you for the extremely helpful and insightful observations. :::::::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:56, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I had far less edits back when I was a Global Sysop on Miraheze. Edits is not the end all be all. Further, it is clear to me that there is either a lack of understanding from you on the differences between having Global user rights and local user rights. For PixDeVI their use of global rights is governed by global Miraheze policy which dictates when and when they cannot use their global rights to intervene, but them asking for local rights it is allowing them to effectively not only help us Consuls, but also allow them to act based on our local policies outside of the governance of global policy requirements which can be restrictive and ultimately lead to relying on myself or another of the very few active Consuls which can lead to delays or even missed violations. ::::Please note my above comment does not reflect a vote but rather an observation of the discussion you have started. I neither endorse or oppose the candidate. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 14:04, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::The concern is not unfair; a user of this few edits both globally and locally seeking such a project leadership role is irregular, even with the precedent of [[Special:CentralAuth/subwayfares|subwayfares]] for wiki creation on Meta. Typically in a wiki that is fully independent this would be stranger as you would hope a leader is representative of the project, although there is merit to onboarding a trusted user in an advisory or supporting capacity. I would argue the key here is that this is ultimately a [[m:miraheze projects|Miraheze Project]]. I believe its identity as such should be a modifier for cases like this and that it is ideal for global functionaries to be more tightly bound with such a project, recommended in queue by wiki creators as it is with a domain currently hosted at WikiTide Foundation's grace. This may not be the ideal way to do it; my theory is to propose stewards as 'at large' consuls should locally invested members need a 'third opinion', more local consuls are involved and so on. Global administrators could perhaps fill the intermediary second line role bureaucrat serves, able to step in if there is backlog or an incident (short of something a GA/steward should step in for anyway). Otherwise there is a strong culture of 'separation of roles' at issue here and which is why pixel can't necessarily just jump in and do these things: it is not GS mandate. Therefore this request is an extension of his capabilities to reduce 'paperwork'. ::Essentially what I'm getting at is this request is reasonable, but skepticism of his investment in ''this'' local project holding such a role is also reasonable. And ideally, better tying the wiki to global operations through a community discussion is the best path in my opinion. The same for other projects such as dev and commons which already sort of act this way - zppix and alpad are local figures, reception and some others are global figures tied in, but as you see with the [[Special:ListUsers/consul|consul list]] it's a bit messy, outdated. ::Finally and drawing back a bit, there is no issue with an IP expressing these opinions. I would support their right to do so. I would also support a blocked user expressing a reasonable opinion to the degree I would offer to relay reasonable thoughts as food for thought even if they are blocked. An occasion where the IP editor and the blocked user overlap however is a very dangerous game that should discontinue immediately. --'''[[User:Raidarr|raidarr]]''' '''('''[[User_talk:Raidarr|💬]]''')''' 23:22, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I agree with Raidarr. Test Wiki is structured very differently from other types of Wikis which makes it more difficult to identify or measure a candidate's qualifications by traditional means. :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:07, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' for {{ping|PixDeVl}}
What is meant by '''an extra hand helping keep things clean'''? What kind of things?
--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:45, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] TestWiki by its nature isn’t in dire need of conventional clean up work, but we have seen a recent uptick in issues where trolls go on mass desysoping sprees or otherwise cause a ruckus(something I believe Zppix has also wanted to address in policy), but as Raidarr said, PTW is an official Miraheze project, and as such, I don’t believe relying on really 2 activish functionaries to keep an eye on the place and make sure it’s tidy is viable or appropriate, hence my offering to take up the bit to properly police when issues come up beyond what’s included in the GA mandate and codified in local policy. Contrary to our anon friend, I do not claim to “need” these rights, I am offering to lend a hand to the small consul team in supplement to my other duties, and believe it would be beneficial to undergo this RFP to be able to do so without having to worry about global role scope ambiguity among other things. [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 15:00, 5 March 2025 (UTC) :::Thank you for answering my first question. :::[[File:OOjs_UI_icon_help-ltr-progressive.svg|18px|link=]] '''Question''' followup for {{ping|PixDeVl}} :::Hypothetically, if some disruptive activities were committed with the very best of intentions due to questionable judgement, how would you help wayward testers tweak their behavior before further violations take them straight to a permanent ban? :::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 03:47, 6 March 2025 (UTC) ::::@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] Should a user unknowingly or mistakenly violate the [[TW:Testing policy|Testing policy]], we should, as with any wiki, [[wp:assume good faith|assume good faith]] that they do not mean to purposely harm the project. That means contacting them in a civil tone to explain what they were doing and why it’s an issue, how to do whatever they want to do properly, and cleaning up. If they are acting in obvious bad faith or continue to be disruptive after multiple escalating warnings, only then should sanctions such as a serious block be applied ideally. [[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 12:53, 6 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} Pix is one of the most promising young volunteers we've had in the nearly 6 years I've been aorund. I am glad to have the extra support for testwiki. [[User:RhinosF1|RhinosF1]] ([[User talk:RhinosF1|talk]]) 20:20, 7 March 2025 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} ==Inactive Rights Removal - 2025-03-04== The rights of the following users will be removed on or after 2025-03-11 if they do not return to activity: *{{RFP/User|78-Yellowcat}} *{{RFP/User|AirmanKitten203}} *{{RFP/User|BasedKat09}} *{{RFP/User|BunnypranavClone}} *{{RFP/User|Cactus2}} Per my talk page. *{{RFP/User|Cactusalt}} Per my talk page. *{{RFP/User|Chqaz}} *{{RFP/User|Códigonombre Alguien}} *{{RFP/User|DarkMatterMan4500}} *{{RFP/User|Deverettm}} *{{RFP/User|EdwardLennox}} *{{RFP/User|Emmitt}} *{{RFP/User|Ericbomb}} *{{RFP/User|Excelsis}} *{{RFP/User|Fallen}} *{{RFP/User|Felenov}} *{{RFP/User|Harommel Rabbid}} *{{RFP/User|Hauber}} *{{RFP/User|JoséDeJesús}} *{{RFP/User|Ketra}} *{{RFP/User|Kittyguy210}} Per their talk page *{{RFP/User|Lana}} *{{RFP/User|Liaochina}} *{{RFP/User|Manomoney41}} *{{RFP/User|MarkRosenbaum}} *{{RFP/User|MatthewQuinnHui}} *{{RFP/User|MvGulik}} *{{RFP/User|Pasmorade}} *{{RFP/User|Pisces}} *{{RFP/User|Rafdodo}} *{{RFP/User|ShuuGyro}} *{{RFP/User|Talion77}} *{{RFP/User|Sizau}} *{{RFP/User|Skilsdhuo}} *{{RFP/User|Smileboy}} *{{RFP/User|Snowmanonahoe}} *{{RFP/User|Soulwater24}} *{{RFP/User|StellaDiamondMaskedWolf}} *{{RFP/User|Steverino}} *{{RFP/User|Stxrsprxte}} Thanks, :Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) :For the Consul Team :11:46, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ==Request for Feedback: Bureaucrats== {{discussion top|Closing as {{done|successful}}. The vast majority of users support the changes of policy with relation to [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats]]. With a successful RfC here, consuls will undertake a review of all active bureaucrats to determine which users will retain rights. [[User:BrandonWM|BrandonWM]] ([[User talk:BrandonWM|talk]] - [[Special:Contributions/BrandonWM|contribs]]) 20:36, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} While Bureaucrat has historically been implemented as a testing role, the low requirements for entry into the role coupled with broad/disruptive permission sets has made it a prime target for bad actors - repeat instances of malicious abuse of Bureaucrat permissions necessitating intervention by global volunteers has made clear that a change is needed. Simultaneously, the relatively small number of active testwiki Consuls has meant that policy enforcement activities haven't always gotten timely action and oversight, and assistance by trusted users is needed to keep testwiki operating as a true testing space. As such, this proposal aims to convert the Bureaucrat role from one of generic testing to one of moderate trust, eliminating the easy abuse vector while remaining readily achievable and providing consuls more support in day-to-day operations. The proposed changes to [[TW:Bureaucrats|TestWiki:Bureaucrats]] can be found [[User:Zppix/Draft/Bureaucrats#Proposed Page Text Changes|on this draft page]] under the Proposed Page Text Changes section. I believe these requirements look good. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 13:55, 11 March 2025 (UTC) #{{support}} Per above. [[User:Fusionium|Fusionium]] ([[User talk:Fusionium|talk]]) 19:58, 11 March 2025 (UTC) #{{Support}} Per the above. [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] ([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]]) 03:34, 13 March 2025 (UTC) # Because a similar situation happened over there at Test Wiki (a non-Miraheze project) from a rights abuser, I {{support}} this. [[User:Codename Noreste|'''''Codename Noreste''''']] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 05:00, 13 March 2025 (UTC) ===Oppose=== # {{Oppose|Strong}} Per my comments below [[User:Harvici|Harvici]] ([[User talk:Harvici|''talk'']]) 11:07, 13 March 2025 (UTC) ===Comments=== # {{Comment}} while I do support this proposal overall, I am unsure if it is necessary to grant crats abuse filter rights, instead of keeping [[TestWiki:Abuse filter operators]] as a separate role. Also not entirely sure as to the need for global lock-whitelist. —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 16:20, 11 March 2025 (UTC) #:@[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] The idea behind this change is an in between Consuls and the non-testing rights, for a lack of a better analogy think GA vs Stewards. Regarding the globalblock-whitelist, that right is already currently given to crats as is. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 16:40, 11 March 2025 (UTC) # {{Comment}} I would prefer to stop or suspend granting bureaucrat rights to new requestors or restrict the promotion until another criteria is met.
---[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 04:18, 12 March 2025 (UTC) #:@[[User:Imamy|Imamy]] There is currently no precedence or policy for suspending granting rights in this type of situation, and I do not believe that this warrants changing that. This discussion will likely only remain open for 7 days, and which it will be closed. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 08:55, 12 March 2025 (UTC) #::I preferred to stop or suspend new additions so that the role could remain a Test Role. A reason such as maintenance would be sufficient, such as the paring down the list comprised of inactives. I could be wrong, but generally, we can rollback 1 and if someone has already contributed after your contribution, then rollback is not possible. :--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 02:24, 25 February 2025 (UTC) == Blocking Policy == Hey all, I am working on rewriting the blocking policy, you can see the proposed changes at [[User:Zppix/Draft/Blocking policy]]. This is '''not''' a vote, but rather a thread where people can share thoughts. The plan is to implement this either later this evening or by Tuesday, March 4th. I recommend reading the full policy to ensure you know the entire policy. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 12:05, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::Thanks for that! I obviously do not object the policy, just wanted your say on what you changed. :) [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 12:08, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::ZPPIX WHY DO YOU KEEP MAKING POLICY CHANGES WITHOUT CONSENSUS! THIS IS TYRANNY! THIS IS UNFAIR BECAUSE PEOPLE MAY HAVE VOTED A DIFFERENT OPTION! [[User:Lobby123|Lobby123]] ([[User talk:Lobby123|talk]]) 20:07, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::::::I agree on you lobby123 [[Special:Contributions/194.195.254.140|194.195.254.140]] 20:28, 8 May 2025 (UTC) :Just for clarification to the broader TestWiki community, Consuls are the users whom have the full decision making capabilities for Public Test Wiki, and as such updating policies or otherwise are within the scope of the role. Preventing abuse is a must have on Test Wiki, so by doing so it was a Consul decision to unilaterally bring policies up to date with fresh changes to prevent bad actors. It is not Tyranny, it is how a wiki works. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 21:05, 8 May 2025 (UTC) ::I do this as well on a local wiki that isn't the test one as an admin that can enforce and change rules around to keep it up to date like yes communities are needed but not for everything that are granted rights to staff.
