Please reach out if you have any questions. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 11:26, 9 March 2025 (UTC)}} Hi folks, I’m filing this Request for Consul, frankly because I noticed that we currently have only 2 remotely active Consuls, being Zppix and Reception, and, even with something like PTW, having an official project wiki be run by two folks isn’t great, so I’d thought I’d offer to lend a hand. I am not very active priorly with what exists of the community on PTW, but as a current global functionary, I still think it wouldn’t hurt to have an extra hand helping keep things clean. Feel free to ask any questions regarding this, as always :) —[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] ([[User talk:PixDeVl|talk]]) 03:35, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}}  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   03:39, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :{{support}} trusted user. [[User:Ternera|Ternera]] ([[User talk:Ternera|talk]]) 04:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :You are not active here at all, and you have only 5 edits. Your administrator and bureaucrat permissions were enabled without a proper request and in a way that is against the rules (you cannot enable bureaucrat privileges immediately along with admin privileges, because that violates [[TW:Bureaucrats]]). I see '''[[:w:WP:HATSHOP]]''' here. Just because you have GA permissions does not automatically give you the ability to bypass local rules and jump over community norms. I cannot formally participate in the vote as an IP, but I am personally very much against this request, for the good of PTW and respect for its users. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 12:41, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::When you know that @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] is very active on Discord, Meta, Phorge, etc. you would understand that wanting to help out colleagues that need extra help, is a good thing. 5 edits here would not be a limiting factor, as you need to look at @[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]]'s activity throughout the whole of Miraheze. Not sure why you are against him, but I hope you will look at [[Special:CentralAuth/PixDeVl]] and rethink your comment, which I find a bit aggressive. And yes, the same goes for me. I am not very active here. But I am a Mirahezian at heart!  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:01, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::Are we considering granting global or local permissions here? As far as I know, consul permissions are local permissions on PTW - so the candidate's '''local contributions''' should be considered first, not other global contributions. Also, PixDeVl claims to want to help, but has '''not actually done anything for PTW''' - do you grant very advanced permissions based on willingness and promises, and not on actual contribution? This is rather unusual. If PixDeVl really wanted to help, he could do so with the permissions he currently has. Please note that his activity, e.g. on RfP is none, and that is pretty much the basic form of helping PTW. PixDeVl does not need consul permissions to help on PTW. I do not rule it out in the future, but I would like to see more involvement, experience, and activity on PTW. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:34, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::P.S. my comment is not ''aggressive'', just honest and true. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:38, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::I looked into his CA. 1270 edits is extremely few for a user who is GA. Unfortunately this lowers my trust in this user even more. Maybe if the user was more involved cross-wiki I would change my mind, but unfortunately that is not the case. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:47, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I get that you look from the ground floor up. I have a more centered view from the MetaWiki and Discord. He is a trusted user who has been a great asset to the broader community. ::::I feel that you are gate keeping the local community, and that is your prerogative, but I think that PTW will benefit from his policy knowhow as well as his activity on the technical side. (Phorge) ::::On the other hand I find that waiting for first comments to arrive before answering on your own RfP doesn't make you to eager, as if one is collecting hats. I can assure you he's not. ::::I cannot take your concerns away, but hope you want to see it from the outside in, instead of the inside out.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:49, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::I do not believe in Quantity, but Quality. I can make 1000's of edits, but they do not tell much.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   13:50, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::::::These are beautiful and classic words... However, can you explain to me why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions? Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW? I can't understand it. [[Special:Contributions/94.254.227.16|94.254.227.16]] 13:57, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::I think Zppix explains it perfectly. Being a Consul falls under different policies. Thus he needs to request permission to function here under the localpolcies.  Kind regards,   [[User:Rodejong|'''Rodejong''']]   [[User talk:Rodejong|💬 Talk]] [[:Special:Emailuser/Rodejong|✉️ Email]]  [[:Special:Contributions/Rodejong|📝 Edits]]  '''יהוה‎'''  [[File:Ponishare-verified.png|18px|link={{SERVER}}/wiki/mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong]][[mh:meta:Special:CentralAuth/Rodejong| Auth]]   14:07, 4 March 2025 (UTC) :::::::Hi, [[User:94.254.227.16|      ]] :::::::: I found your questions deeply compelling. As a result, I feel that I have gained a bit more understanding of Test Wiki. :::::::* '''Why won't he use his current permissions to help PTW?''' :::::::As I understand it, Bureaucrat and Administrator are testing roles. As such, the roles cannot be used to uphold or enforce policy without creating confusion for the other Non Consuls within the community as to what is acceptable behavior. :::::::* '''why PixDeVl needs (as he believes) consul permissions?''' :::::::Clearly PixDeVl recognizes that there is a distinction between a Consul role and a Non Consul role and will need the Consul role in order to provide the appropriate executive assistance. :::::::: You have raised a lot of other points that I will take into consideration, such as the low local edit count. Thank you for the extremely helpful and insightful observations. :::::::--- [[User:Imamy|Imamy]] ([[User talk:Imamy|talk]]) 01:56, 5 March 2025 (UTC) ::::I had far less edits back when I was a Global Sysop on Miraheze. Edits is not the end all be all. Further, it is clear to me that there is either a lack of understanding from you on the differences between having Global user rights and local user rights. For PixDeVI their use of global rights is governed by global Miraheze policy which dictates when and when they cannot use their global rights to intervene, but them asking for local rights it is allowing them to effectively not only help us Consuls, but also allow them to act based on our local policies outside of the governance of global policy requirements which can be restrictive and ultimately lead to relying on myself or another of the very few active Consuls which can lead to delays or even missed violations. ::::Please note my above comment does not reflect a vote but rather an observation of the discussion you have started. I neither endorse or oppose the candidate. Zppix ([[:meta:User:Zppix|Meta]] | [[User talk:Zppix|talk to me]]) 14:04, 4 March 2025 (UTC) ::The concern is not unfair; a user of this few edits both globally and locally seeking such a project leadership role is irregular, even with the precedent of [[Special:CentralAuth/subwayfares|subwayfares]] for wiki creation on Meta. Typically in a wiki that is fully independent this would be stranger as you would hope a leader is representative of the project, although there is merit to onboarding a trusted user in an advisory or supporting capacity. I would argue the key here is that this is ultimately a [[m:miraheze projects|Miraheze Project]]. I believe its identity as such should be a modifier for cases like this and that it is ideal for global functionaries to be more tightly bound with such a project, recommended in queue by wiki creators as it is with a domain currently hosted at WikiTide Foundation's grace. This may not be the ideal way to do it; my theory is to propose stewards as 'at large' consuls should locally invested members need a 'third opinion', more local consuls are involved and so on. Global administrators could perhaps fill the intermediary second line role bureaucrat serves, able to step in if there is backlog or an incident (short of something a GA/steward should step in for anyway). Otherwise there is a strong culture of 'separation of roles' at issue here and which is why pixel can't necessarily just jump in and do these things: it is not GS mandate. Therefore this request is an extension of his capabilities to reduce 'paperwork'. ::Essentially what I'm getting at is this request is reasonable, but skepticism of his investment in ''this'' local project holding such a role is also reasonable. And ideally, better tying the wiki to global operations through a community discussion is the best path in my opinion. The same for other projects such as dev and commons which already sort of act this way - zppix and alpad are local figures, reception and some others are global figures tied in, but as you see with the [[Special:ListUsers/consul|consul list]] it's a bit messy, outdated. ::Finally and drawing back a bit, there is no issue with an IP expressing these opinions. name: TestWiki:Testing pages/bn
body:
This is a list of already-existing testing pages, which you can use to test specific things. Feel free to create your own testing pages as well, provided you tag them for deletion or delete them later.
'''অনুগ্রহপূর্বক এই পাতায় পরীক্ষা-নিরীক্ষা করবেন না'''। * [[AutoWikiBrowser test]] - For testing the [[w:Wikipedia:AutoWikiBrowser|AutoWikiBrowser]] * [[Category test]] - For adding and removing categories * [[Comment test]] - For testing the [[mw:Extension:Comments|Comments]] extension by adding new comments, editing one's own existing comments, and removing comments * [[Deletion test]] - Testing [[Special:DeletePage/Deletion test|deleting]] and [[Special:Undelete/Test Delete|undeleting]] of pages * [[Displaytitle test]] - For testing the [[mw:Extension:ParserFunctions|parser function]] {{DISPLAYTITLE}} * [[Abuse filter test]] - For testing [[mw:Extension:AbuseFilter|abuse filters]] ** Abuse filters do not necesarily need to be applied to specific pages, but if possible it would be appreciated to be used to this page only. * [[User:Example]] - For testing block/unblock and user rights management on example user. * [[Merge history test]] - For testing the [[Special:MergeHistory|history merge feature]] * [[Move test]] - For testing the [[Special:MovePage|page move feature]] * [[Redirect test]] - For testing the #REDIRECT (redirecting the page to other pages) * [[Rollback test]] - For testing the Rollback feature * [[Revision deletion test]] - Testing of the [[Special:RevisionDelete|revision deletion]] feature * [[SVG test]] - Description in progress (page won't load) * [[Protection test]] - Testing [[Special:ProtectPage/Protection test|protecting and unprotecting]] of pages * [[test:Create protection test|Create protection test]] - Testing protection on a nonexistent page ("create protection") * [[Translating test]] - Testing the translation tool * [[URL shortener test]] - Testing creation, deletion, and restoration of [[Special:UrlShortener|short URLs]] through [[Special:ManageShortUrls|Special:ManageShortUrls]] * [[Change content model test]] - Testing the [[special:ChangeContentModel|Change content model]] feature
Feel free to create any testing page not on this list if it is deleted later, or do general tests from the [[Sandbox|public sandbox]] or your [[Special:MyPage/Sandbox|private sandbox]]. But participation on the [[Project_talk:Testing pages|talk page]] before creating permanent test pages, while not required, would be appreciated :)

ئەمە پێرستی پەڕەکانی ئێستای تاقیکردنەوەیە، کە تۆ ئەتوانی تاقیکردنەوە لەسەر چەن شتێکی دیاریکراو بکەیت. ئاسوودە لەوەی پەڕەی تایبەتی خۆشت دروست بکەیت بۆ تاقیکردنەوەکردن لەسەریان، و دواتر تاگی سڕینەوەیان بخە سەر یان بیانسڕەوە.
'''تکایە تاقیکردنەوە لەم پەڕەیە مەکە'''. * [[AutoWikiBrowser test]] - بۆ تاقیکردنەوە لەسەر [[w:Wikipedia:AutoWikiBrowser|ئۆتۆ ویکی براوزەر]] * [[Category test]] - بۆ زیادکردن و لابردنی پۆلەکان * [[Comment test]] - بۆ تاقیکردنەوە لەسەر [[mw:Extension:Comments|لێدوانەکان]] زیادکراوێکە بەکاردێت بۆ زیادکردنی کۆمێنت,و دەستکاری کردنی کۆمێنتی تایبەتی خۆت,و سڕینەوەی کۆمێنتی تایبەت بەخۆت * [[Deletion test]] - Testing [[Special:DeletePage/Deletion test|deleting]] and [[Special:Undelete/Test Delete|undeleting]] of pages * [[Displaytitle test]] - بۆ تاقیکردنەوە کردن لەسەر ناونیشانی پەڕە[[mw:Extension:ParserFunctions|parser function]] {{DISPLAYTITLE}} * [[Abuse filter test]] - For testing [[mw:Extension:AbuseFilter|abuse filters]] ** Abuse filters do not necesarily need to be applied to specific pages, but if possible it would be appreciated to be used to this page only. * [[User:Example]] - For testing block/unblock and user rights management on example user. * [[Merge history test]] - For testing the [[Special:MergeHistory|history merge feature]] * [[Move test]] - بۆ تاقیکردنەوە کردن لەسەر [[Special:MovePage| تایبەمەندییەکانی گواستنەوە]] * [[Redirect test]] - بۆ تاقیکردنەوە کردن لەسەر #REDIRECT (ڕەوانەکردنی پەڕەیەک بۆ پەڕەیەکی تر) * [[Rollback test]] - بۆ تاقیکردنەوە کردن لەسەر مافی گەڕێنەرەوە * [[Revision deletion test]] - Testing of the [[Special:RevisionDelete|revision deletion]] feature * [[SVG test]] - Description in progress (page won't load) * [[Protection test]] - Testing [[Special:ProtectPage/Protection test|protecting and unprotecting]] of pages * [[test:Create protection test|Create protection test]] - Testing protection on a nonexistent page ("create protection") * [[Translating test]] - Testing the translation tool * [[URL shortener test]] - Testing creation, deletion, and restoration of [[Special:UrlShortener|short URLs]] through [[Special:ManageShortUrls|Special:ManageShortUrls]] * [[Change content model test]] - Testing the [[special:ChangeContentModel|Change content model]] feature
Feel free to create any testing page not on this list if it is deleted later, or do general tests from the [[Sandbox|public sandbox]] or your [[Special:MyPage/Sandbox|private sandbox]]. But participation on the [[Project_talk:Testing pages|talk page]] before creating permanent test pages, while not required, would be appreciated :)
[[Category:Non-test pages{{translation}}]]
label: FuzzyBot
change_summary: Updating to match new version of source page

name: TestWiki:Testing pages/da
body:
Dette er en liste over allerede eksisterende testsider, som du kan bruge til at teste specifikke ting. Du er også velkommen til at oprette dine egne testsider, forudsat at du tagger dem til sletning eller sletter dem senere.
'''Lad være med at teste på denne side'''. * [[AutoWikiBrowser test]] - for at teste [[w:Wikipedia:AutoWikiBrowser|AutoWikiBrowser]] * [[Category test]] - for at tilføje og fjerne kategorier * [[Comment test]] - for at teste [[mw:Extension:Comments|Kommentarextensionet]] ved at tilføje nye kommentarer, redigere ens egne eksisterende kommentarer og fjerne kommentarer. * [[Deletion test]] - Testing [[Special:DeletePage/Deletion test|deleting]] and [[Special:Undelete/Test Delete|undeleting]] of pages * [[Displaytitle test]] - For testing the [[mw:Extension:ParserFunctions|parser function]] {{DISPLAYTITLE}} * [[Abuse filter test]] - For testing [[mw:Extension:AbuseFilter|abuse filters]] ** Abuse filters do not necesarily need to be applied to specific pages, but if possible it would be appreciated to be used to this page only. * [[User:Example]] - For testing block/unblock and user rights management on example user. * [[Merge history test]] - For testing the [[Special:MergeHistory|history merge feature]] * [[Move test]] - For testing the [[Special:MovePage|page move feature]] * [[Redirect test]] - For testing the #REDIRECT (redirecting the page to other pages) * [[Rollback test]] - For testing the Rollback feature * [[Revision deletion test]] - Testing of the [[Special:RevisionDelete|revision deletion]] feature * [[SVG test]] - Description in progress (page won't load) * [[Protection test]] - Testing [[Special:ProtectPage/Protection test|protecting and unprotecting]] of pages * [[test:Create protection test|Create protection test]] - Testing protection on a nonexistent page ("create protection") * [[Translating test]] - Testing the translation tool * [[URL shortener test]] - Testing creation, deletion, and restoration of [[Special:UrlShortener|short URLs]] through [[Special:ManageShortUrls|Special:ManageShortUrls]] * [[Change content model test]] - Testing the [[special:ChangeContentModel|Change content model]] feature
Du er velkommen til at oprette enhver testside, der ikke er på denne liste, hvis den slettes senere, eller lav generelle test fra den [[Sandbox|offentlige sandkasse]] eller din [[Special:MyPage/Sandbox|private sandbox]]. Men deltagelse på [[Project_talk:Testing pages|diskussionsside]] før oprettelse af permanente testsider, selvom det ikke er påkrævet, ville blive værdsat :)
[[Category:Non-test pages{{translation}}]]
label: FuzzyBot

name: TestWiki:Testing pages/de
body: Dies ist eine Liste von bereits existierenden Testseiten, die du nutzen kannst, um bestimmte Dinge zu testen. Du kannst auch deine eigenen Testseiten erstellen, vorausgesetzt, du markierst sie zum Löschen oder löschst sie später. '''Bitte nicht auf dieser Seite testen'''. * [[AutoWikiBrowser test]] - Zum Testen des [[w:Wikipedia:AutoWikiBrowser|AutoWikiBrowser]] * [[Category test]] - Zum Hinzufügen und Entfernen von Kategorien * [[Comment test]] - Zum Testen der [[mw:Extension:Comments|Kommentare]]-Erweiterung, indem du neue Kommentare hinzufügst, deine eigenen bestehenden Kommentare bearbeitest und Kommentare entfernst * [[Deletion test]] - Testen von [[Special:DeletePage/Deletion test|Löschen]] und [[Special:Undelete/Test Delete|Entlöschen]] von Seiten * [[Displaytitle test]] - Zum Testen der [[mw:Extension:ParserFunctions|Parserfunktion]] {{DISPLAYTITLE}} * [[Abuse filter test]] - Zum Testen von [[mw:Extension:AbuseFilter|Missbrauchsfiltern]] ** Missbrauchsfilter müssen nicht unbedingt auf bestimmte Seiten angewandt werden, aber wenn es möglich ist, wäre es gut, wenn sie nur auf dieser Seite verwendet werden. * [[User:Example]] - For testing block/unblock and user rights management on example user. * [[Merge history test]] - Zum Testen der [[Special:MergeHistory|Verlauf-Zusammenführen-Funktion]] * [[Move test]] - Zum Testen der [[Special:MovePage|Seitenverschiebungsfunktion]] * [[Redirect test]] - Zum Testen des #REDIRECT (Weiterleitung der Seite auf andere Seiten) * [[Rollback test]] - Zum Testen der Rollback-Funktion * [[Revision deletion test]] - Testen der Funktion [[Special:RevisionDelete|Revisionslöschung]] * [[SVG test]] - Beschreibung in Bearbeitung (Seite wird nicht geladen) * [[Protection test]] - Testen von [[Special:ProtectPage/Protection test|Schützen und Aufheben des Schutzes]] von Seiten * [[test:Create protection test|Create protection test]] - Schutz auf einer nicht existierenden Seite testen ("Schutz erstellen") * [[Translating test]] - Testen des Übersetzungstools * [[URL shortener test]] - Testen der Erstellung, Löschung und Wiederherstellung von [[Special:UrlShortener|Kurz-URLs]] durch [[Special:ManageShortUrls|Special:ManageShortUrls]] * [[Change content model test]] - Testing the [[special:ChangeContentModel|Change content model]] feature Es steht dir frei, eine Testseite zu erstellen, die nicht auf dieser Liste steht, falls sie später gelöscht wird, oder allgemeine Tests in der [[Sandbox|öffentlichen Sandbox]] oder deiner [[Special:MyPage/Sandbox|privaten Sandbox]] durchzuführen. Die Teilnahme an der [[Project_talk:Testing pages|Diskussionsseite]] vor der Erstellung von permanenten Testseiten ist zwar nicht erforderlich, wird jedoch gerne gesehen :) [[Category:Non-test pages{{translation}}]]
label: FuzzyBot
change_summary: Updating to match new version of source page

name: TestWiki:Testing pages/es
body: Esta es una lista de páginas de prueba ya existentes, que puede utilizar para probar cosas específicas. Siéntase libre de crear también sus propias páginas de prueba, siempre que las etiquete para eliminarlas o las elimine más tarde. '''Por favor no pruebes en esta página''' * [[AutoWikiBrowser test]] - Para probar [[w:Wikipedia:AutoWikiBrowser|AutoWikiBrowser]]. * [[Category test]] - Para añadir o borrar categorías. * [[Comment test]] - Para probar la extensión [[mw:Extension:Comments|Comments]] al añadir nuevos comentarios, editar tus propios mensajes, y al eliminar mensajes. * [[Deletion test]] - Probar [[Special:DeletePage/Deletion test|borrar]] y [[Special:Undelete/Test Delete|restaurar]] páginas. * [[Displaytitle test]] - Para probar la función [[mw:Extension:ParserFunctions|parser]] {{DISPLAYTITLE}} * [[Abuse filter test]] - Para probar [[mw:Extension:AbuseFilter|filtros de edición]] ** No es necesario que los filtros de edición se apliquen a páginas específicas, pero si es posible, se agradecería que se utilizarán solo en esta página. * [[User:Example]] - For testing block/unblock and user rights management on example user. * [[Merge history test]] - Para probar la [[Special:MergeHistory|función de combinación de historial]] * [[Move test]] - Para probar la función de [[Special:MovePage|trasladar una página]]. * [[Redirect test]] - Para probar #REDIRECT (redireccionando la página a otra). * [[Rollback test]] - Para probar la función Rollback. * [[Revision deletion test]] - Prueba de la función [[Special:RevisionDelete|eliminación de revisión]] * [[SVG test]] - Descripción en progreso (la página no cargará). * [[Protection test]] - Probar [[Special:ProtectPage/Protection test proteger y cambiar la protección]] de una página. * [[test:Create protection test|Create protection test]] - Probar protección en una página inexistente ("crear protección"). * [[Translating test]] - Probar la herramienta de traducción. * [[URL shortener test]] - Probando la creación, eliminación y restauración de [[Special:UrlShortener|URL cortas]] a través de [[Special:ManageShortUrls|Special:ManageShortUrls]] * [[Change content model test]] - Testing the [[special:ChangeContentModel|Change content model]] feature Siéntete libre de crear cualquier página de prueba que no esté en esta lista si se elimina más adelante, o haz pruebas generales desde el [[Sandbox|sandbox público]] o tu [[Special:MyPage/Sandbox|sandbox privado]]. Pero se agradecería la participación en la [[Project_talk:Testing pages|página de discusión]] antes de crear páginas de prueba permanentes, aunque no es obligatoria :) [[Category:Non-test pages{{translation}}]]

name: TestWiki:Testing pages/ja
body:
これは、特定のものをテストするために使用できる既存のテストページのリストです。削除用のタグを付けるか、後で削除する場合は、独自のテストページも自由に作成してください。
'''このページで投稿のテストをしないでください'''。 * [[AutoWikiBrowser test]] - [[w:ja:Wikipedia:AutoWikiBrowser|AutoWikiBrowser]]のテスト用 * [[Category test]] - カテゴリの追加と削除用 * [[Comment test]] - [[mw:Extension:Comments|Comments]]拡張機能をテストするために、新しいコメントを追加し、自分の既存のコメントを編集し、コメントを削除する用 * [[Deletion test]] - [[Special:DeletePage/Deletion test|ページの削除]]と[[Special:Undelete/Test Delete|ページの復元]]のテスト * [[Displaytitle test]] - [[mw:Extension:ParserFunctions|パーサー関数拡張機能]]の{{DISPLAYTITLE}}をテストする用 * [[Abuse filter test]] - [[mw:Extension:AbuseFilter|編集フィルター]]のテスト用 ** 編集フィルターは必ずしも特定のページに適用する必要はありませんが、可能であれば、このページのみに使用することをお勧めします。 * [[User:Example]] - For testing block/unblock and user rights management on example user. * [[Merge history test]] - [[Special:MergeHistory|履歴統合機能]]をテストする用 * [[Move test]] - [[Special:MovePage|ページ移動機能]]をテストする用 * [[Redirect test]] - #REDIRECTのテスト用(ページを他のページにリダイレクトする) * [[Rollback test]] - 巻き戻し機能のテスト用 * [[Revision deletion test]] - [[Special:RevisionDelete|版指定削除]]機能のテスト用 * [[SVG test]] - 説明が進行中です（ページが読み込まれません） * [[Protection test]] - [[Special:ProtectPage/Protection test|保護および保護解除]]のテスト * [[test:Create protection test|Create protection test]] - 存在しないページでの保護のテスト(「白紙保護、作成保護」) * [[Translating test]] - 翻訳ツールのテスト * [[URL shortener test]] - [[Special:ManageShortUrls|Special:ManageShortUrls]]を介した[[Special:UrlShortener|短縮URL]]の作成、削除、復元のテスト * [[Change content model test]] - Testing the [[special:ChangeContentModel|Change content model]] feature 後で削除する場合は、このリストにないテストページを自由に作成するか、[[Sandbox|publicsandbox]]または[[Special:MyPage/Sandbox|privatesandbox]]から一般的なテストを実行してください。ただし、永続的なテストページを作成する前に[[Project_talk:Testing pages|talk page]]に参加することは必須ではありませんが、よろしくお願いします:) [[Category:Non-test pages{{translation}}]]
label: FuzzyBot
change_summary: Updating to match new version of source page

name: TestWiki:Testing pages/ru
body:
Это список уже существующих страниц тестирования, которые вы можете использовать для тестирования определенных вещей. Не стесняйтесь создавать свои собственные страницы тестирования, при условии, что вы пометите их для удаления или удалите позже.
'''Пожалуйста, не тестируйте на этой странице'''. * [[AutoWikiBrowser test]] - для тестирования [[w:Wikipedia:AutoWikiBrowser|AutoWikiBrowser]] * [[Category test]] - Для добавления и удаления категорий * [[Comment test]] - Для тестирования расширения [[mw:Extension:Comments|Comments]] добавляя новые комментарии, редактируя свои собственные существующие и удаляя комментарии * [[Deletion test]] - Тестирование [[Special:DeletePage/Deletion test|удаления]] и [[Special:Undelete/Test Delete|отмены удаления]] страниц * [[Displaytitle test]] - Для тестирования [[mw:Extension:ParserFunctions|функции синтаксического анализатора]] {{DISPLAYTITLE}} * [[Abuse filter test]] - Для тестирования [[mw:Extension:AbuseFilter|фильтров правки]]. ** Фильтры правки не обязательно должны применяться к конкретным страницам, но если возможно, было бы желательно, чтобы они применялись только к этой странице * [[User:Example]] - For testing block/unblock and user rights management on example user. * [[Merge history test]] - Для тестирования функции [[Special:MergeHistory|слиятия историй]]. * [[Move test]] - Для тестирования функции [[Special:MovePage|Переименовать страницу]] * [[Redirect test]] - Для тестирования #REDIRECT (перенаправление на другие страницы) * [[Rollback test]] - Для тестирования функции отката * [[Revision deletion test]] - Testing of the [[Special:RevisionDelete|revision deletion]] feature * [[SVG test]] - Описание в процессе (страница не загружается) * [[Protection test]] - Тестирование [[Special:ProtectPage/Protection test|защиты и снятия защиты]] страниц * [[test:Create protection test|Create protection test]] - Тестирование защиты на несуществующей странице ("создать защиту") * [[Translating test]] - Тестирование инструмента перевода * [[URL shortener test]] - Тестирование создания, удаления и восстановления [[Special:UrlShortener|коротких URL]] через [[Special:ManageShortUrls|Special:ManageShortUrls]]. * [[Change content model test]] - Testing the [[special:ChangeContentModel|Change content model]] feature

Dette er en liste over allerede eksisterende testsider, som du kan bruge til at teste specifikke ting. Du er også velkommen til at oprette dine egne testsider, forudsat at du tagger dem til sletning eller sletter dem senere.
'''Lad være med at teste på denne side'''. * [[AutoWikiBrowser test]] - for at teste [[w:Wikipedia:AutoWikiBrowser|AutoWikiBrowser]] * [[Category test]] - for at tilføje og fjerne kategorier * [[Comment test]] - for at teste [[mw:Extension:Comments|Kommentarextensionet]] ved at tilføje nye kommentarer, redigere ens egne eksisterende kommentarer og fjerne kommentarer. * [[Deletion test]] - Testing [[Special:DeletePage/Deletion test|deleting]] and [[Special:Undelete/Test Delete|undeleting]] of pages * [[Displaytitle test]] - For testing the [[mw:Extension:ParserFunctions|parser function]] {{DISPLAYTITLE}} * [[Abuse filter test]] - For testing [[mw:Extension:AbuseFilter|abuse filters]] ** Abuse filters do not necesarily need to be applied to specific pages, but if possible it would be appreciated to be used to this page only. * [[User:Example]] - For testing block/unblock and user rights management on example user. * [[Merge history test]] - For testing the [[Special:MergeHistory|history merge feature]] * [[Move test]] - For testing the [[Special:MovePage|page move feature]] * [[Redirect test]] - For testing the #REDIRECT (redirecting the page to other pages) * [[Rollback test]] - For testing the Rollback feature * [[Revision deletion test]] - Testing of the [[Special:RevisionDelete|revision deletion]] feature * [[SVG test]] - Description in progress (page won't load) * [[Protection test]] - Testing [[Special:ProtectPage/Protection test|protecting and unprotecting]] of pages * [[test:Create protection test|Create protection test]] - Testing protection on a nonexistent page ("create protection") * [[Translating test]] - Testing the translation tool * [[URL shortener test]] - Testing creation, deletion, and restoration of [[Special:UrlShortener|short URLs]] through [[Special:ManageShortUrls|Special:ManageShortUrls]] * [[Change content model test]] - Testing the [[Special:ChangeContentModel|content model change]] feature
Du er velkommen til at oprette enhver testside, der ikke er på denne liste, hvis den slettes senere, eller lav generelle test fra den [[Sandbox|offentlige sandkasse]] eller din [[Special:MyPage/Sandbox|private sandbox]]. Men deltagelse på [[Project_talk:Testing pages|diskussionsside]] før oprettelse af permanente testsider, selvom det ikke er påkrævet, ville blive værdsat :)

== Proposal to modify user rights for bureaucrats and consuls ==

Currently, bureaucrats can remove the bureaucrat right from their own account, and consuls have the ability, among the listed user groups to grant and remove, to remove the consul user group from their own account and add and remove interface administrator from their own account as well, even though they can grant and remove the latter user group.

I would like to propose that bureaucrats may no longer remove the bureaucrat user group from their own account, and that consuls may no longer remove the consul user group from their own account, nor can they add and remove the interface administrator permission from their own account (as consuls can already grant and remove IA, doing that for one's own account is redundant).

In addition to the above, because bureaucrat and consul permissions are non-testing permissions, perhaps we might consider adding most/all bureaucrat user rights to the consul user group? I would arguably consider consuls to be the non-testing bureaucrats of this wiki.

Thoughts? [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 14:14, 7 June 2026 (UTC)
label: Codename Noreste

===Relative links=== On pages with many subpages, using relative links is highly recommended. This shortens the code and ensures that pages remain linked together, even if the overall system is moved or reorganised. The three formats are [[/subpage]] (subpage), [[../]] (parent), and [[../sibling]] (sibling); see the example usage below. Note that [[../]] will expand to the title of the parent page, which is ideal if the page is renamed at a later time.

== Proposal to modify user rights for bureaucrats and consuls ==

Currently, bureaucrats can remove the bureaucrat right from their own account, and consuls have the ability, among the listed user groups to grant and remove, to remove the consul user group from their own account and add and remove interface administrator from their own account as well, even though they can grant and remove the latter user group.

I would like to propose that bureaucrats may no longer remove the bureaucrat user group from their own account, and that consuls may no longer remove the consul user group from their own account, nor can they add and remove the interface administrator permission from their own account (as consuls can already grant and remove IA, doing that for one's own account is redundant).

In addition to the above, because bureaucrat and consul permissions are non-testing permissions, perhaps we might consider adding most/all bureaucrat user rights to the consul user group? I would arguably consider consuls to be the non-testing bureaucrats of this wiki.

Thoughts? [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 14:14, 7 June 2026 (UTC)
: One more thing to note, consuls do not need to assign themselves the interface administrator user group as they can already edit all CSS/JS/JSON/interface pages. [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 14:39, 7 June 2026 (UTC)

body: Esta es una lista de páginas de prueba ya existentes, que puede utilizar para probar cosas específicas. Siéntase libre de crear también sus propias páginas de prueba, siempre que las etiquete para eliminarlas o las elimine más tarde. '''Por favor no pruebes en esta página''' * [[AutoWikiBrowser test]] - Para probar [[w:Wikipedia:AutoWikiBrowser|AutoWikiBrowser]]. * [[Category test]] - Para añadir o borrar categorías. * [[Comment test]] - Para probar la extensión [[mw:Extension:Comments|Comments]] al añadir nuevos comentarios, editar tus propios mensajes, y al eliminar mensajes. * [[Deletion test]] - Probar [[Special:DeletePage/Deletion test|borrar]] y [[Special:Undelete/Test Delete|restaurar]] páginas. * [[Displaytitle test]] - Para probar la función [[mw:Extension:ParserFunctions|parser]] {{DISPLAYTITLE}} * [[Abuse filter test]] - Para probar [[mw:Extension:AbuseFilter|filtros de edición]] ** No es necesario que los filtros de edición se apliquen a páginas específicas, pero si es posible, se agradecería que se utilizarán solo en esta página. * [[User:Example]] - For testing block/unblock and user rights management on example user. * [[Merge history test]] - Para probar la [[Special:MergeHistory|función de combinación de historial]] * [[Move test]] - Para probar la función de [[Special:MovePage|trasladar una página]]. * [[Redirect test]] - Para probar #REDIRECT (redireccionando la página a otra). * [[Rollback test]] - Para probar la función Rollback. * [[Revision deletion test]] - Prueba de la función [[Special:RevisionDelete|eliminación de revisión]] * [[SVG test]] - Descripción en progreso (la página no cargará). * [[Protection test]] - Probar [[Special:ProtectPage/Protection test proteger y cambiar la protección]] de una página. * [[test:Create protection test|Create protection test]] - Probar protección en una página inexistente ("crear protección"). * [[Translating test]] - Probar la herramienta de traducción. * [[URL shortener test]] - Probando la creación, eliminación y restauración de [[Special:UrlShortener|URL cortas]] a través de [[Special:ManageShortUrls|Special:ManageShortUrls]] * [[Change content model test]] - Probando la función del [[Special:ChangeContentModel|cambio del modelo de contenido]] Siéntete libre de crear cualquier página de prueba que no esté en esta lista si se elimina más adelante, o haz pruebas generales desde el [[Sandbox|sandbox público]] o tu [[Special:MyPage/Sandbox|sandbox privado]]. Pero se agradecería la participación en la [[Project_talk:Testing pages|página de discusión]] antes de crear páginas de prueba permanentes, aunque no es obligatoria :) [[Category:Non-test pages{{translation}}]]

') w('') -- Header navigation w('') -- Day headers w('') local headers = {'Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'} for i, h in ipairs(headers) do local cls = (i==6 and ' class="cal-sat"') or (i==7 and ' class="cal-sun"') or '' w(''..h..'') end w('') -- Calendar cells local firstDay = firstDayOfMonth(year, month) local totalDays = daysInMonth(year, month) local day = 1 local started = false for _ = 1, 6 do if day > totalDays then break end w('') for dow = 1, 7 do local cls = (dow==6 and ' class="cal-sat-cell"') or (dow==7 and ' class="cal-sun-cell"') or '' if not started and dow==firstDay then started=true end if started and day<=totalDays then w('') w('
'..day..'

') for _, ev in ipairs(events) do w(''..ev.label..'') end w('
') end w('') day = day + 1 else w('') end end w('') end w('
') w('◀') w(''..monthNames[month]..' '..year..'') w('▶') w('
') return table.concat(out) end return p

local p = {} local calData = mw.loadData("Module:CalendarData") -- Serialize all event data to JSON string local function serializeEvents() local yearParts = {} for year, months in pairs(calData) do local monthParts = {} for month, days in pairs(months) do local dayParts = {} for day, events in pairs(days) do local evParts = {} for _, ev in ipairs(events) do evParts[#evParts+1] = string.format( '{"label":"%s","color":"%s"}', ev.label, ev.color ) end dayParts[#dayParts+1] = string.format( '"%d":[%s]', day, table.concat(evParts, ",") ) end monthParts[#monthParts+1] = string.format( '"%s":{%s}', month, table.concat(dayParts, ",") ) end yearParts[#yearParts+1] = string.format( '"%s":{%s}', year, table.concat(monthParts, ",") ) end return string.format("{%s}", table.concat(yearParts, ",")) end function p.render(frame) local args = frame.args local year = tonumber(args.year) or 2026 local month = tonumber(args.month) or 6 -- Embed JSON into data attribute; mw.text.encode makes it HTML-safe return string.format( '
', year, month, mw.text.encode(serializeEvents()) ) end return p

body:
{{Short description|第二次世界大战中各国的伤亡统计数据}}
[[File:World War II casualties.svg|thumb|right|300px|按现代国家国界（2000年代边界）划分的第二次世界大战伤亡情况地图，显示军事和平民死亡人数。数字为估计值，各国来源不同。]]

'''第二次世界大战'''（World War II）是人类历史上'''伤亡最为惨重'''的军事冲突，估计造成'''7000万至8500万'''人死亡，其中绝大多数是平民。<ref>{{cite web |title=World War II casualties |url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_War_II_casualties |website=Wikipedia |access-date=2026-06-15}} 死亡直接由战争造成（包括军事和平民）估计为5000万至5600万，另有1900万至2800万死于战争相关的疾病和饥荒。</ref> 伤亡人数约占1940年全球23亿人口的3%。<ref>{{cite web |title=The Enduring Impact of World War II |url=https://www.pacificwarmuseum.org |website=Pacific War Museum |date=2021-03-05 |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>

据中国政府战后统计，中国军民伤亡'''3500万人'''以上，其中军队伤亡380余万人，平民死亡超过2000万人。<ref name="china35m">{{cite web |title=抗战胜利80周年：中国以巨大民族牺牲支撑起东方主战场 |url=https://news.cri.cn/2025-06-24/31cc3881-fe0c-1118-c074-751110c2eace.html |website=中央广电总台央视新闻 |date=2025-06-24 |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=王军代总领事发表署名文章《以史为鉴，面向未来》 |url=https://vladivostok.china-consulate.gov.cn/chn/zlgdt/202509/t20250902_11700480.htm |website=中华人民共和国驻符拉迪沃斯托克总领事馆 |date=2025-09-02 |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref> 中国战场歼灭日军'''150余万'''人，占日本二战总伤亡的70%以上。<ref name="chinadaily35m">{{cite web |title=China's contribution to WWII victory under-valued: war historian |url=http://ex.chinadaily.com.cn |website=China Daily |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>

苏联（含俄罗斯及其他前加盟共和国）的官方估计为'''2600万至2700万'''人死亡。<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Ellman |first1=Michael |last2=Maksudov |first2=Sergei |title=Soviet deaths in the Great Patriotic War: a note |journal=Europe-Asia Studies |volume=46 |issue=4 |year=1994 |pages=671-680 |url=https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12288331/ |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref> 据俄罗斯国防部数据，不可挽回的总损失为2660万人，包括约1800万平民和约870万军人。<ref>{{cite web |title=27 million lives lost: Meduza takes a closer look at the Soviet Union’s official death toll in World War II |url=https://meduza.io/en/feature/2025/05/09/27-million-lives-lost |website=Meduza |date=2025-05-09 |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>

== 总体估计 ==

=== 全球统计 ===
根据美国国家二战博物馆的数据，全球总伤亡估计如下：<ref name="nationalww2">{{cite web |title=Research Starters: Worldwide Deaths in World War II |url=https://www.nationalww2museum.org/students-teachers/student-resources/research-starters/research-starters-worldwide-deaths-world-war |website=The National WWII Museum |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>

* '''战斗死亡（Battle Deaths）'''：15,000,000人
* '''战斗受伤（Battle Wounded）'''：25,000,000人
* '''平民死亡（Civilian Deaths）'''：45,000,000人

总体来看，二战共造成约'''7000万至8500万'''人死亡，约占1940年地球人口的3%。其中，战争直接导致的死亡（包括军事和平民）估计为5000万至5600万，另有1900万至2800万死于战争相关的疾病和饥荒。<ref>{{cite web |title=World War II casualties |url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_War_II_casualties |website=Wikipedia |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>

{{Blockquote|"World War II was by far the deadliest conflict in human history; it resulted in 70 to 85 million fatalities, a majority being civilians."|source=Wikipedia<ref>{{cite web |title=World War II |url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_War_II |website=Wikipedia |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>}}

== 主要国家伤亡 ==

=== 同盟国 ===

==== 苏联 ====
苏联是二战中损失最惨重的国家，其官方损失数据如下：
* '''军事死亡'''：8,668,400人（Krivosheev研究数据）<ref name="krivosheev">Krivosheev, G. I. (1997). ''Soviet Casualties and Combat Losses in the Twentieth Century''. Greenhill Books.</ref>
* '''平民死亡'''：约16,400,000至17,400,000人
* '''总死亡'''：27,000,000人（1990年戈尔巴乔夫首次公开引用）<ref name="meduza27m">{{cite web |title=27 million lives lost: Meduza takes a closer look at the Soviet Union’s official death toll in World War II |url=https://meduza.io/en/feature/2025/05/09/27-million-lives-lost |website=Meduza |date=2025-05-09 |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>

根据俄罗斯国防部数据，不可挽回的总损失为26.6百万人。<ref>{{cite web |title=27 million lives lost |url=https://meduza.io/en/feature/2025/05/09/27-million-lives-lost |website=Meduza |date=2025-05-09 |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>

苏联的损失按民族划分如下：<ref name="lumen">{{cite web |title=Casualties of World War II |url=https://courses.lumenlearning.com |website=Lumen Learning |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>
* 俄罗斯族：5.7百万
* 乌克兰族：1.3百万
* 其他民族：1.7百万

==== 中国 ====
根据中国政府战后统计，中国在抗日战争中的损失如下：<ref name="china35m" /><ref name="scio35m">{{cite web |title=80 years on, echoes of WWII victory ring out in calls for peace |url=https://english.scio.gov.cn |website=State Council Information Office of China |date=2025-09-01 |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>
* '''总伤亡'''：3500万人以上
* '''军队伤亡'''：380余万人
* '''平民死亡'''：2000万人以上
* '''歼灭日军'''：150余万人（占日本二战总伤亡70%以上）<ref name="chinadaily35m" />

按1937年价格水平计算，日本军国主义给中国造成了1000亿美元的直接经济损失和5000亿美元的间接经济损失。<ref name="scio35m" />

==== 波兰 ====
根据波兰政府官方数据：<ref name="poland6m">{{cite web |title=Polish PM discusses Poland's WW2 role with world leaders |url=https://www.pap.pl |website=Polska Agencja Prasowa |date=2019-07-06 |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>
* '''总死亡'''：约6,000,000人
* 其中犹太人：约3,000,000人
* 约占战前人口的六分之一<ref>{{cite web |title=Deutsches Historisches Museum Berlin - Germans and Poles |url=https://www.dhm.de |website=DHM |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>

波兰平均每天约有3000人死亡，每个波兰家庭几乎都有损失。<ref name="poland6m" /> 波兰的物质损失估计为8600亿美元。<ref>{{cite web |title=75th anniversary of the end of World War II |url=https://instytutpolski.pl |website=Instytut Polski w Brukseli |date=2020-05-29 |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>

==== 英国 ====

* '''军事死亡'''：384,000人
* '''平民死亡'''：70,000人（其中40,000人死于闪电战期间，近一半在伦敦）
* '''总死亡'''：约450,900人

* '''死亡总人数'''：418,500人
* 其中军人死亡：416,800人
* 平民死亡：1,700人

在1600万服役美国人中，407,316名军人和5,662名商船海员死亡。另有670,000人重伤，130,000人被俘或失踪。<ref>{{cite web |title=America’s fallen soldiers remembered during World War II Museum ceremony |url=https://www.wafb.com |website=WAFB |date=2026-05-25 |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>

* '''总死亡'''：1,000,000人

* '''总死亡'''：2,600,000至3,100,000人

== 平民伤亡 ==

=== 大屠杀 ===
德国法西斯对犹太人采取种族灭绝政策。<ref name="ushmm">{{cite web |title=How Many People did the Nazis Murder? |url=https://encyclopedia.ushmm.org/content/en/article/documenting-numbers-of-victims-of-the-holocaust |website=United States Holocaust Memorial Museum |date=2023-09-26 |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref><ref name="yadvashem">{{cite web |title=FAQs - Names' Database |url=https://www.yadvashem.org |website=Yad Vashem |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>
* 约'''600万'''犹太人在大屠杀中丧生
* 其中约150万是儿童
* 有约5000个犹太社区被摧毁

反犹主义是大屠杀的意识形态基础，纳粹认为日耳曼人是"优等种族"。<ref name="ushmm" />

=== 战略轰炸 ===
* '''日本'''：对日本最后9个月的战略轰炸，平民死亡约330,000人（不包括原子弹）。原子弹轰炸广岛和长崎，到1945年底共造成约200,000人死亡。<ref name="nps">{{cite web |title=Atomic Bomb Survivors |url=https://www.nps.gov |website=National Park Service |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Hiroshima-Nagasaki Bombing: How Many Lives Were Lost During Atomic Attack? |url=https://thedailyguardian.com |website=The Daily Guardian |date=2025-08-06 |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>
* '''德国'''：德累斯顿轰炸等战略轰炸造成约400,000至500,000名德国平民死亡。<ref>{{cite web |title=Strategic bombing during World War II |url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strategic_bombing_during_World_War_II |website=Wikipedia |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>

=== 战俘死亡率 ===
* '''德军手中的苏联战俘'''：在被俘的约570万苏联军人中，超过300万死亡，死亡率高达58%。<ref name="sovietpow">{{cite web |title=The Extermination of Red Army Soldiers in German Captivity, 1941–1945 |url=https://scholar.oversea.cnki.net |website=CNKI Scholar |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref><ref name="ushmmpow">{{cite web |title=Soviet POWs in German Captivity |url=https://perspectives.ushmm.org |website=United States Holocaust Memorial Museum |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>
* '''日军手中的盟军战俘'''：太平洋战争初期，日军共俘虏盟军战俘约35万人，死亡率高达27.1%。<ref>{{cite web |title=35万盟军战俘遭受日军残暴奴役 死亡率高达27% |url=https://www.chinanews.com.cn |website=中国新闻网 |date=2015-08-31 |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>

== 统计方法说明 ==

=== 苏联损失的计算方法 ===
苏联损失数据的统计基于两种根本不同的方法：<ref name="krivosheev" />
1. **军事死亡**：根据战时军事记录确定，包括国防部档案中的伤亡报告
2. **平民和游击队员死亡**：通过比较战前和战后人口规模来估算

本研究分为三个不同类别：战斗人员死亡、战斗死亡（包括军人和平民）、战争死亡（所有由战争造成的死亡）。战争死亡的分类位于军事史和人口学的交叉点。

=== 德国损失统计 ===
德国军事死亡数据的计算主要由Rüdiger Overmans博士完成，提供了德军死亡531.8万的数据。战时德军建立了两套上报系统：<ref name="overmans" />
1. **数字上报**：每日上报，每10天汇总
2. **名字上报**：精确记录，但战争结束时积压了100万待处理的死亡案例

=== 中国损失统计 ===
中国损失统计数据主要来自战后政府统计和后续历史研究。中国的统计口径偏向总体战争伤亡人数，包括军人和平民的总和。这一数据既包括战斗死亡，也包括因战争导致的间接死亡（如饥荒、疾病等）。<ref name="china35m" />

根据美国国家二战博物馆的数据，全球总伤亡估计如下：<ref name="nationalww2">{{cite web |title=Research Starters: Worldwide Deaths in World War II |url=https://www.nationalww2museum.org/students-teachers/student-resources/research-starters/research-starters-worldwide-deaths-world-war |website=The National WWII Museum |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>

* 其中约150万是儿童
* 有约5000个犹太社区被摧毁

反犹主义是大屠杀的意识形态基础，纳粹认为日耳曼人是"优等种族"。<ref name="ushmm" />

=== 战略轰炸 ===
* '''日本'''：对日本最后9个月的战略轰炸，平民死亡约330,000人（不包括原子弹）。原子弹轰炸广岛和长崎，到1945年底共造成约200,000人死亡。<ref name="nps">{{cite web |title=Atomic Bomb Survivors |url=https://www.nps.gov |website=National Park Service |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Hiroshima-Nagasaki Bombing: How Many Lives Were Lost During Atomic Attack? |url=https://thedailyguardian.com |website=The Daily Guardian |date=2025-08-06 |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>
* '''德国'''：德累斯顿轰炸等战略轰炸造成约400,000至500,000名德国平民死亡。<ref>{{cite web |title=Strategic bombing during World War II |url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strategic_bombing_during_World_War_II |website=Wikipedia |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>

=== 战俘死亡率 ===
* '''德军手中的苏联战俘'''：在被俘的约570万苏联军人中，超过300万死亡，死亡率高达58%。<ref name="sovietpow">{{cite web |title=The Extermination of Red Army Soldiers in German Captivity, 1941–1945 |url=https://scholar.oversea.cnki.net |website=CNKI Scholar |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref><ref name="ushmmpow">{{cite web |title=Soviet POWs in German Captivity |url=https://perspectives.ushmm.org |website=United States Holocaust Memorial Museum |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>
* '''日军手中的盟军战俘'''：太平洋战争初期，日军共俘虏盟军战俘约35万人，死亡率高达27.1%。<ref>{{cite web |title=35万盟军战俘遭受日军残暴奴役 死亡率高达27% |url=https://www.chinanews.com.cn |website=中国新闻网 |date=2015-08-31 |access-date=2026-06-15}}</ref>

== 统计方法说明 ==

=== 苏联损失的计算方法 ===
苏联损失数据的统计基于两种根本不同的方法：<ref name="krivosheev" />
1. **军事死亡**：根据战时军事记录确定，包括国防部档案中的伤亡报告
2. **平民和游击队员死亡**：通过比较战前和战后人口规模来估算

本研究分为三个不同类别：战斗人员死亡、战斗死亡（包括军人和平民）、战争死亡（所有由战争造成的死亡）。战争死亡的分类位于军事史和人口学的交叉点。

=== 德国损失统计 ===
德国军事死亡数据的计算主要由Rüdiger Overmans博士完成，提供了德军死亡531.8万的数据。战时德军建立了两套上报系统：<ref name="overmans" />
1. **数字上报**：每日上报，每10天汇总
2. **名字上报**：精确记录，但战争结束时积压了100万待处理的死亡案例

=== 中国损失统计 ===
中国损失统计数据主要来自战后政府统计和后续历史研究。中国的统计口径偏向总体战争伤亡人数，包括军人和平民的总和。这一数据既包括战斗死亡，也包括因战争导致的间接死亡（如饥荒、疾病等）。<ref name="china35m" />

body: -- 中文的此模块对比英文维基多解析了overimage, overcaption, -- overimagerowclass以及header/labal/data*style参数。 local p = {} local args = {} local origArgs = {} local root local empty_row_categories = {} local category_in_empty_row_pattern = '%[%[%s*[Cc][Aa][Tt][Ee][Gg][Oo][Rr][Yy]%s*:[^]]*]]' local has_rows = false local lists = { plainlist_t = { patterns = { '^plainlist$', '%splainlist$', '^plainlist%s', '%splainlist%s' }, found = false, styles = 'Plainlist/styles.css' }, hlist_t = { patterns = { '^hlist$', '%shlist$', '^hlist%s', '%shlist%s' }, found = false, styles = 'Hlist/styles.css' } } local function has_list_class(args_to_check) for _, list in pairs(lists) do if not list.found then for _, arg in pairs(args_to_check) do for _, pattern in ipairs(list.patterns) do if mw.ustring.find(arg or '', pattern) then list.found = true break end end if list.found then break end end end end end local function fixChildBoxes(sval, tt) local function notempty( s ) return s and s:match( '%S' ) end if notempty(sval) then local marker = '' local s = sval -- start moving templatestyles and categories inside of table rows local slast = '' while slast ~= s do slast = s s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '(%s*)(%[%[%s*[Cc][Aa][Tt][Ee][Gg][Oo][Rr][Yy]%s*:[^]]*%]%])', '%2%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '(%s*)(\127[^\127]*UNIQ%-%-templatestyles%-%x+%-QINU[^\127]*\127)', '%2%1') end -- end moving templatestyles and categories inside of table rows s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '(<%s*[Tt][Rr])', marker .. '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '()', '%1' .. marker) if s:match(marker) then s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, marker .. '%s*' .. marker, '') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '([\r\n]|-[^\r\n]*[\r\n])%s*' .. marker, '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, marker .. '%s*([\r\n]|-)', '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '(%s*)' .. marker, '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '(<%s*[Tt][Aa][Bb][Ll][Ee][^<>]*>%s*)' .. marker, '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '^(%{|[^\r\n]*[\r\n]%s*)' .. marker, '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '([\r\n]%{|[^\r\n]*[\r\n]%s*)' .. marker, '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, marker .. '(%s*)', '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, marker .. '(%s*\n|%})', '%1') end if s:match(marker) then local subcells = mw.text.split(s, marker) s = '' for k = 1, #subcells do if k == 1 then s = s .. subcells[k] .. '' elseif k == #subcells then local rowstyle = ' style="display:none"' if notempty(subcells[k]) then rowstyle = '' end s = s .. '<' .. tt .. ' colspan=2>\n' .. subcells[k] elseif notempty(subcells[k]) then if (k % 2) == 0 then s = s .. subcells[k] else s = s .. '<' .. tt .. ' colspan=2>\n' .. subcells[k] .. '' end end end end -- the next two lines add a newline at the end of lists for the PHP parser -- [[Special:Diff/849054481]] -- remove when [[:phab:T191516]] is fixed or OBE s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '([\r\n][%*#;:][^\r\n]*)$', '%1\n') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '^([%*#;:][^\r\n]*)$', '%1\n') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '^([%*#;:])', '\n%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '^(%{%|)', '\n%1') return s else return sval end end -- Cleans empty tables local function cleanInfobox() root = tostring(root) if has_rows == false then root = mw.ustring.gsub(root, ']*>%s*', '') end end -- Returns the union of the values of two tables, as a sequence. local function union(t1, t2) local vals = {} for k, v in pairs(t1) do vals[v] = true end for k, v in pairs(t2) do vals[v] = true end local ret = {} for k, v in pairs(vals) do table.insert(ret, k) end return ret end -- Returns a table containing the numbers of the arguments that exist -- for the specified prefix. For example, if the prefix was 'data', and -- 'data1', 'data2', and 'data5' exist, it would return {1, 2, 5}. local function getArgNums(prefix) local nums = {} for k, v in pairs(args) do local num = tostring(k):match('^' .. prefix .. '([1-9]%d*)$') if num then table.insert(nums, tonumber(num)) end end table.sort(nums) return nums end -- Adds a row to the infobox, with either a header cell -- or a label/data cell combination. local function addRow(rowArgs) if rowArgs.header and rowArgs.header ~= '_BLANK_' then has_rows = true has_list_class({ rowArgs.rowclass, rowArgs.class, args.headerclass }) root :tag('tr') :addClass(rowArgs.rowclass) :cssText(rowArgs.rowstyle) :tag('th') :attr('colspan', '2') :addClass('infobox-header') :addClass(rowArgs.class) :addClass(args.headerclass) -- @deprecated next; target .infobox- .infobox-header -- for individual headerstyle: target .infobox- .infobox--row > .infobox-header :cssText(rowArgs.headerstyle) :cssText(rowArgs.rowcellstyle) :wikitext(fixChildBoxes(rowArgs.header, 'th')) if rowArgs.data then root:wikitext( '[[Category:使用已忽略数据行信息框模板的条目]]' ) end elseif rowArgs.data and rowArgs.data:gsub(category_in_empty_row_pattern, ''):match('^%S') then has_rows = true has_list_class({ rowArgs.rowclass, rowArgs.class }) local row = root:tag('tr') row:addClass(rowArgs.rowclass) row:cssText(rowArgs.rowstyle) if rowArgs.label then row :tag('th') :attr('scope', 'row') :addClass('infobox-label') -- @deprecated next; target .infobox- .infobox-label -- for individual labelstyle: target .infobox- .infobox--row > .infobox-label :cssText(rowArgs.labelstyle) :cssText(rowArgs.rowcellstyle) :wikitext(rowArgs.label) :done() end local dataCell = row:tag('td') dataCell :attr('colspan', not rowArgs.label and '2' or nil) :addClass(not rowArgs.label and 'infobox-full-data' or 'infobox-data') :addClass(rowArgs.class) -- @deprecated next; target .infobox- .infobox(-full)-data -- for individual datastyle: target .infobox- .infobox--row > .infobox(-full)-data :cssText(rowArgs.datastyle) :cssText(rowArgs.rowcellstyle) :wikitext(fixChildBoxes(rowArgs.data, 'td')) else table.insert(empty_row_categories, rowArgs.data or '') end end local function renderTitle() if not args.title then return end has_rows = true has_list_class({args.titleclass}) root :tag('caption') :addClass('infobox-title') :addClass(args.titleclass) -- @deprecated next; target .infobox- .infobox-title :cssText(args.titlestyle) :wikitext(args.title) end local function renderAboveRow() if not args.above then return end has_rows = true has_list_class({ args.aboveclass }) root :tag('tr') :tag('th') :attr('colspan', '2') :addClass('infobox-above') :addClass(args.aboveclass) -- @deprecated next; target .infobox- .infobox-above :cssText(args.abovestyle) :wikitext(fixChildBoxes(args.above,'th')) end local function renderBelowRow() if not args.below then return end has_rows = true has_list_class({ args.belowclass }) root :tag('tr') :tag('td') :attr('colspan', '2') :addClass('infobox-below') :addClass(args.belowclass) -- @deprecated next; target .infobox- .infobox-below :cssText(args.belowstyle) :wikitext(fixChildBoxes(args.below,'td')) end local function addSubheaderRow(subheaderArgs) if subheaderArgs.data and subheaderArgs.data:gsub(category_in_empty_row_pattern, ''):match('^%S') then has_rows = true has_list_class({ subheaderArgs.rowclass, subheaderArgs.class }) local row = root:tag('tr') row:addClass(subheaderArgs.rowclass) local dataCell = row:tag('td') dataCell :attr('colspan', '2') :addClass('infobox-subheader') :addClass(subheaderArgs.class) :cssText(subheaderArgs.datastyle) :cssText(subheaderArgs.rowcellstyle) :wikitext(fixChildBoxes(subheaderArgs.data, 'td')) else table.insert(empty_row_categories, subheaderArgs.data or '') end end local function renderSubheaders() if args.subheader then args.subheader1 = args.subheader end if args.subheaderrowclass then args.subheaderrowclass1 = args.subheaderrowclass end local subheadernums = getArgNums('subheader') for k, num in ipairs(subheadernums) do addSubheaderRow({ data = args['subheader' .. tostring(num)], -- @deprecated next; target .infobox- .infobox-subheader datastyle = args.subheaderstyle, rowcellstyle = args['subheaderstyle' .. tostring(num)], class = args.subheaderclass, rowclass = args['subheaderrowclass' .. tostring(num)] }) end end local function addImageRow(imageArgs) if imageArgs.data and imageArgs.data:gsub(category_in_empty_row_pattern, ''):match('^%S') then has_rows = true has_list_class({ imageArgs.rowclass, imageArgs.class }) local row = root:tag('tr') row:addClass(imageArgs.rowclass) local dataCell = row:tag('td') dataCell :attr('colspan', '2') :addClass('infobox-image') :addClass(imageArgs.class) :cssText(imageArgs.datastyle) :wikitext(fixChildBoxes(imageArgs.data, 'td')) else table.insert(empty_row_categories, imageArgs.data or '') end end local function renderOverImage() local caption = args.overcaption local data = mw.html.create():wikitext(args.overimage) if caption then data :tag('div') :addClass('infobox-caption') -- @deprecated next; target .infobox- .infobox-caption :cssText(args.captionstyle) :wikitext(caption) end addImageRow({ data = tostring(data), -- @deprecated next; target .infobox- .infobox-image datastyle = args.imagestyle, class = args.imageclass, rowclass = args.overimagerowclass }) end local function renderImages() if args.image then args.image1 = args.image end if args.caption then args.caption1 = args.caption end local imagenums = getArgNums('image') for k, num in ipairs(imagenums) do local caption = args['caption' .. tostring(num)] local data = mw.html.create():wikitext(args['image' .. tostring(num)]) if caption then data :tag('div') :addClass('infobox-caption') -- @deprecated next; target .infobox- .infobox-caption :cssText(args.captionstyle) :wikitext(caption) end addImageRow({ data = tostring(data), -- @deprecated next; target .infobox- .infobox-image datastyle = args.imagestyle, class = args.imageclass, rowclass = args['imagerowclass' .. tostring(num)] }) end end -- When autoheaders are turned on, preprocesses the rows local function preprocessRows() if not args.autoheaders then return end local rownums = union(getArgNums('header'), getArgNums('data')) table.sort(rownums) local lastheader for k, num in ipairs(rownums) do if args['header' .. tostring(num)] then if lastheader then args['header' .. tostring(lastheader)] = nil end lastheader = num elseif args['data' .. tostring(num)] and args['data' .. tostring(num)]:gsub( category_in_empty_row_pattern, '' ):match('^%S') then local data = args['data' .. tostring(num)] if data:gsub(category_in_empty_row_pattern, ''):match('%S') then lastheader = nil end end end if lastheader then args['header' .. tostring(lastheader)] = nil end end -- Gets the union of the header and data argument numbers, -- and renders them all in order local function renderRows() local rownums = union(getArgNums('header'), getArgNums('data')) table.sort(rownums) for k, num in ipairs(rownums) do addRow({ header = args['header' .. tostring(num)], headerstyle = (args.headerstyle or '') .. (args.headerstyle and ';' or '') .. (args['header' .. tostring(num) .. 'style'] or ''), label = args['label' .. tostring(num)], labelstyle = (args.labelstyle or '') .. (args.labelstyle and ';' or '') .. (args['label' .. tostring(num) .. 'style'] or ''), data = args['data' .. tostring(num)], datastyle = (args.datastyle or '') .. (args.datastyle and ';' or '') .. (args['data' .. tostring(num) .. 'style'] or ''), class = args['class' .. tostring(num)], rowclass = args['rowclass' .. tostring(num)], -- @deprecated next; target .infobox- rowclass rowstyle = args['rowstyle' .. tostring(num)], rowcellstyle = args['rowcellstyle' .. tostring(num)] }) end end local function renderNavBar() if not args.name then return end has_rows = true root :tag('tr') :tag('td') :attr('colspan', '2') :addClass('infobox-navbar') :wikitext(require('Module:Navbar')._navbar{ args.name, mini = 1, }) end local function renderItalicTitle() local italicTitle = args['italic title'] and mw.ustring.lower(args['italic title']) if italicTitle == '' or italicTitle == 'force' or italicTitle == 'yes' then root:wikitext(require('Module:Italic title')._main({})) end end -- Categories in otherwise empty rows are collected in empty_row_categories. -- This function adds them to the module output. It is not affected by -- args.decat because this module should not prevent module-external categories -- from rendering. local function renderEmptyRowCategories() for _, s in ipairs(empty_row_categories) do root:wikitext(s) end end -- Render tracking categories. args.decat == turns off tracking categories. local function renderTrackingCategories() if args.decat == 'yes' then return end if args.child == 'yes' then if args.title then root:wikitext( '[[Category:使用带有标题参数的嵌入式信息框模板的条目]]' ) end elseif #(getArgNums('data')) == 0 and mw.title.getCurrentTitle().namespace == 0 then root:wikitext('[[Category:使用无数据行信息框模板的条目]]') end end --[=[ Loads the templatestyles for the infobox. TODO: FINISH loading base templatestyles here rather than in MediaWiki:Common.css. There are 4-5000 pages with 'raw' infobox tables. See [[Mediawiki_talk:Common.css/to_do#Infobox]] and/or come help :). When we do this we should clean up the inline CSS below too. Will have to do some bizarre conversion category like with sidebar. ]=] local function loadTemplateStyles() local frame = mw.getCurrentFrame() local hlist_templatestyles = '' if lists.hlist_t.found then hlist_templatestyles = frame:extensionTag{ name = 'templatestyles', args = { src = lists.hlist_t.styles } } end local plainlist_templatestyles = '' if lists.plainlist_t.found then plainlist_templatestyles = frame:extensionTag{ name = 'templatestyles', args = { src = lists.plainlist_t.styles } } end -- See function description local base_templatestyles = frame:extensionTag{ name = 'templatestyles', args = { src = 'Module:Infobox/styles.css' } } local templatestyles = '' if args['templatestyles'] then templatestyles = frame:extensionTag{ name = 'templatestyles', args = { src = args['templatestyles'] } } end local child_templatestyles = '' if args['child templatestyles'] then child_templatestyles = frame:extensionTag{ name = 'templatestyles', args = { src = args['child templatestyles'] } } end local grandchild_templatestyles = '' if args['grandchild templatestyles'] then grandchild_templatestyles = frame:extensionTag{ name = 'templatestyles', args = { src = args['grandchild templatestyles'] } } end return table.concat({ -- hlist -> plainlist -> base is best-effort to preserve old Common.css ordering. -- this ordering is not a guarantee because the rows of interest invoking -- each class may not be on a specific page hlist_templatestyles, plainlist_templatestyles, base_templatestyles, templatestyles, child_templatestyles, grandchild_templatestyles }) end -- common functions between the child and non child cases local function structure_infobox_common() renderSubheaders() renderImages() preprocessRows() renderRows() renderBelowRow() renderNavBar() renderItalicTitle() renderEmptyRowCategories() renderTrackingCategories() cleanInfobox() end -- Specify the overall layout of the infobox, with special settings if the -- infobox is used as a 'child' inside another infobox. local function _infobox() if args.child ~= 'yes' then root = mw.html.create('table') root :addClass(args.subbox == 'yes' and 'infobox-subbox' or 'infobox') :addClass(args.bodyclass) -- @deprecated next; target .infobox- :cssText(args.bodystyle) has_list_class({ args.bodyclass }) renderTitle() renderOverImage() renderAboveRow() else root = mw.html.create() root :wikitext(args.title) end structure_infobox_common() return loadTemplateStyles() .. root end -- If the argument exists and isn't blank, add it to the argument table. -- Blank arguments are treated as nil to match the behaviour of ParserFunctions. local function preprocessSingleArg(argName) if origArgs[argName] and origArgs[argName] ~= '' then args[argName] = origArgs[argName] end end -- Assign the parameters with the given prefixes to the args table, in order, in -- batches of the step size specified. This is to prevent references etc. from -- appearing in the wrong order. The prefixTable should be an array containing -- tables, each of which has two possible fields, a "prefix" string and a -- "depend" table. The function always parses parameters containing the "prefix" -- string, but only parses parameters in the "depend" table if the prefix -- parameter is present and non-blank. local function preprocessArgs(prefixTable, step) if type(prefixTable) ~= 'table' then error("Non-table value detected for the prefix table", 2) end if type(step) ~= 'number' then error("Invalid step value detected", 2) end -- Get arguments without a number suffix, and check for bad input. for i,v in ipairs(prefixTable) do if type(v) ~= 'table' or type(v.prefix) ~= "string" or (v.depend and type(v.depend) ~= 'table') then error('Invalid input detected to preprocessArgs prefix table', 2) end preprocessSingleArg(v.prefix) -- Only parse the depend parameter if the prefix parameter is present -- and not blank. if args[v.prefix] and v.depend then for j, dependValue in ipairs(v.depend) do if type(dependValue) ~= 'string' then error('Invalid "depend" parameter value detected in preprocessArgs') end preprocessSingleArg(dependValue) end end end -- Get arguments with number suffixes. local a = 1 -- Counter variable. local moreArgumentsExist = true while moreArgumentsExist == true do moreArgumentsExist = false for i = a, a + step - 1 do for j,v in ipairs(prefixTable) do local prefixArgName = v.prefix .. tostring(i) if origArgs[prefixArgName] then -- Do another loop if any arguments are found, even blank ones. moreArgumentsExist = true preprocessSingleArg(prefixArgName) end -- Process the depend table if the prefix argument is present -- and not blank, or we are processing "prefix1" and "prefix" is -- present and not blank, and if the depend table is present. if v.depend and (args[prefixArgName] or (i == 1 and args[v.prefix])) then for j,dependValue in ipairs(v.depend) do local dependArgName = dependValue .. tostring(i) preprocessSingleArg(dependArgName) end end end end a = a + step end end -- Assign the parameters *style to the args table local function preprocessSpecificStyle(styleTable, step) local a = 1 -- Counter variable. local moreArgumentsExist = true while moreArgumentsExist == true do moreArgumentsExist = false for i = a,a + step - 1 do for j,v in ipairs(styleTable) do local styleArgName = v.arg .. tostring(i) .. 'style' if origArgs[styleArgName] then -- Do another loop if any arguments are found, even blank ones. moreArgumentsExist = true preprocessSingleArg(styleArgName) end end end a = a + step end end -- Parse the data parameters in the same order that the old {{infobox}} did, so -- that references etc. will display in the expected places. Parameters that -- depend on another parameter are only processed if that parameter is present, -- to avoid phantom references appearing in article reference lists. local function parseDataParameters() preprocessSingleArg('autoheaders') preprocessSingleArg('child') preprocessSingleArg('bodyclass') preprocessSingleArg('subbox') preprocessSingleArg('bodystyle') preprocessSingleArg('overimage') preprocessSingleArg('overcaption') preprocessSingleArg('overimagerowclass') preprocessSingleArg('title') preprocessSingleArg('titleclass') preprocessSingleArg('titlestyle') preprocessSingleArg('above') preprocessSingleArg('aboveclass') preprocessSingleArg('abovestyle') preprocessArgs({ {prefix = 'subheader', depend = {'subheaderstyle', 'subheaderrowclass'}} }, 10) preprocessSingleArg('subheaderstyle') preprocessSingleArg('subheaderclass') preprocessArgs({ {prefix = 'image', depend = {'caption', 'imagerowclass'}} }, 10) preprocessSingleArg('captionstyle') preprocessSingleArg('imagestyle') preprocessSingleArg('imageclass') preprocessArgs({ {prefix = 'header'}, {prefix = 'data', depend = {'label'}}, {prefix = 'rowclass'}, {prefix = 'rowstyle'}, {prefix = 'rowcellstyle'}, {prefix = 'class'} }, 80) preprocessSpecificStyle({ {arg = 'header'}, {arg = 'label'}, {arg = 'data'} }, 80) preprocessSingleArg('headerclass') preprocessSingleArg('headerstyle') preprocessSingleArg('labelstyle') preprocessSingleArg('datastyle') preprocessSingleArg('below') preprocessSingleArg('belowclass') preprocessSingleArg('belowstyle') preprocessSingleArg('name') -- different behaviour for italics if blank or absent args['italic title'] = origArgs['italic title'] preprocessSingleArg('decat') preprocessSingleArg('templatestyles') preprocessSingleArg('child templatestyles') preprocessSingleArg('grandchild templatestyles') end -- If called via #invoke, use the args passed into the invoking template. -- Otherwise, for testing purposes, assume args are being passed directly in. function p.infobox(frame) if frame == mw.getCurrentFrame() then origArgs = frame:getParent().args else origArgs = frame end parseDataParameters() return _infobox() end -- For calling via #invoke within a template function p.infoboxTemplate(frame) origArgs = {} for k,v in pairs(frame.args) do origArgs[k] = -- 输入： - 輸入：
--    image - 纯文件名（带有File:/Image:前缀与否皆可）或完全格式化的图片链接 - 純檔案名（帶有File:/Image:字首與否皆可）或完全格式化的圖片連結
--    page - page to display for multipage images (DjVu)
--    size - 显示图像大小 - 顯示影像大小
--    maxsize - 图像最大大小 - 影像最大大小
--    sizedefault - 如果size参数留空，默认显示图像大小 - 如果size參數留空，預設顯示影像大小
--    alt - 图像替换文本 - 影像替換文字
--    title - 图像标题文本 - 影像標題文字
--    border - 有边框则设为yes - 有邊框則設為yes
--    center - 图像需居中则设为yes - 影像需居中則設為yes
--    upright - 垂直图像参数 - 垂直影像參數 
--    suppressplaceholder - 设为yes则检查图像是否为占位符并停用 - 設為yes則檢查影像是否為佔位符並停用
--    link - 点击图像时访问的页面 - 點選影像時訪問的頁面
-- 输出： - 輸出：
--    格式化图像 - 格式化影像
-- 详情请参阅"Module:InfoboxImage/doc"页面 - 詳情請參閱"Module:InfoboxImage/doc"頁面

function i.IsPlaceholder(image)
    -- change underscores to spaces
    image = mw.ustring.gsub(image, "_", " ");
    assert(image ~= nil, 'mw.ustring.gsub(image, "_", " ") must not return nil')
    -- if image starts with [[ then remove that and anything after |
    if mw.ustring.sub(image,1,2) == "[[" then
        image = mw.ustring.sub(image,3);
        image = mw.ustring.gsub(image, "([^|]*)|.*", "%1");
        assert(image ~= nil, 'mw.ustring.gsub(image, "([^|]*)|.*", "%1") must not return nil')
    end
    -- Trim spaces
    image = mw.ustring.gsub(image, '^[ ]*(.-)[ ]*$', '%1');
    assert(image ~= nil, "mw.ustring.gsub(image, '^[ ]*(.-)[ ]*$', '%1') must not return nil")
    -- remove prefix if exists
    local allNames = mw.site.namespaces[6].aliases
    allNames[#allNames + 1] = mw.site.namespaces[6].name
    allNames[#allNames + 1] = mw.site.namespaces[6].canonicalName
    for i, name in ipairs(allNames) do
        if mw.ustring.lower(mw.ustring.sub(image, 1, mw.ustring.len(name) + 1)) == mw.ustring.lower(name .. ":") then
            image = mw.ustring.sub(image, mw.ustring.len(name) + 2);
            break
        end
    end
    -- Trim spaces
    image = mw.ustring.gsub(image, '^[ ]*(.-)[ ]*$', '%1');
    -- capitalise first letter
    image = mw.ustring.upper(mw.ustring.sub(image,1,1)) .. mw.ustring.sub(image,2);

    for i,j in pairs(placeholder_image) do
        if image == j then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function i.InfoboxImage(frame)
    local image = frame.args["image"];
    
    if image == "" or image == nil then
        return "";
    end
    if image == " " then
        return image;
    end
    if frame.args["suppressplaceholder"] ~= "no" then
        if i.IsPlaceholder(image) == true then
            return "";
        end
    end

    if mw.ustring.lower(mw.ustring.sub(image,1,5)) == "http:" then
        return "";
    end
    if mw.ustring.lower(mw.ustring.sub(image,1,6)) == "[http:" then
        return "";
    end
    if mw.ustring.lower(mw.ustring.sub(image,1,7)) == "[[http:" then
        return "";
    end
    if mw.ustring.lower(mw.ustring.sub(image,1,6)) == "https:" then
        return "";
    end
    if mw.ustring.lower(mw.ustring.sub(image,1,7)) == "[https:" then
        return "";
    end
    if mw.ustring.lower(mw.ustring.sub(image,1,8)) == "[[https:" then
        return "";
    end

    if mw.ustring.sub(image,1,2) == "[[" then
        -- search for thumbnail images and add to tracking cat if found
        if mw.title.getCurrentTitle().namespace == 0 and (mw.ustring.find(image, "|%s*thumb%s*[|%]]") or mw.ustring.find(image, "|%s*thumbnail%s*[|%]]")) then
            return image .. "[[Category:信息框內使用縮圖語法的頁面]]";
        elseif mw.title.getCurrentTitle().namespace == 0 then
            return image .. "[[Category:使用过时图像语法的页面]]";
        else
            return image;
        end
    elseif mw.ustring.sub(image,1,2) == "{{" and mw.ustring.sub(image,1,3) ~= "{{{" then
        return image;
    elseif mw.ustring.sub(image,1,1) == "<" then
        return image;
    elseif mw.ustring.sub(image,1,5) == mw.ustring.char(127).."UNIQ" then
        -- Found strip marker at begining, so pass don't process at all
        return image;
    elseif mw.ustring.sub(image,4,9) == "`UNIQ-" then
        -- Found strip marker at begining, so pass don't process at all
        return image;
    else
        local result = "";
        local page = frame.args["page"];
        local size = frame.args["size"];
        local maxsize = frame.args["maxsize"];
        local sizedefault = frame.args["sizedefault"];
        local alt = frame.args["alt"];
        local link = frame.args["link"];
        local title = frame.args["title"];
        local border = frame.args["border"];
        local upright = frame.args["upright"] or "";
        local thumbtime = frame.args["thumbtime"] or "";
        local center= frame.args["center"];
        local class= frame.args["class"];        
        
        -- remove prefix if exists
        local allNames = mw.site.namespaces[6].aliases
        allNames[#allNames + 1] = mw.site.namespaces[6].name
        allNames[#allNames + 1] = mw.site.namespaces[6].canonicalName
        for i, name in ipairs(allNames) do
            if mw.ustring.lower(mw.ustring.sub(image, 1, mw.ustring.len(name) + 1)) == mw.ustring.lower(name .. ":") then
                image = mw.ustring.sub(image, mw.ustring.len(name) + 2);
                break
            end
        end
        
        if maxsize ~= "" and maxsize ~= nil then
            -- if no sizedefault then set to maxsize
            if sizedefault == "" or sizedefault == nil then
                sizedefault = maxsize
            end
            -- check to see if size bigger than maxsize
            if size ~= "" and size ~= nil then
                local sizenumber = tonumber(mw.ustring.match(size,"%d*")) or 0;
                local maxsizenumber = tonumber(mw.ustring.match(maxsize,"%d*")) or 0;
                if sizenumber>maxsizenumber and maxsizenumber>0 then
                    size = maxsize;
                end
            end
        end
        -- add px to size if just a number
        if (tonumber(size) or 0) > 0 then
            size = size .. "px";
        end
        -- add px to sizedefault if just a number
        if (tonumber(sizedefault) or 0) > 0 then
            sizedefault = sizedefault .. "px";
        end
        
        result = "[[File:" .. image;
        if page ~= "" and page ~= nil then
            result = result .. "|page=" .. page;
        end
        if size ~= "" and size ~= nil then
            result = result .. "|" .. size;
        elseif sizedefault ~= "" and sizedefault ~= nil then
            result = result .. "|" .. sizedefault;
        else
            result = result .. "|frameless";
        end
        if center == "yes" then
            result = result .. "|center"
        end
        if alt ~= "" and alt ~= nil then
            result = result .. "|alt=" .. alt;
        end
        if link ~= "" and link ~= nil then
            result = result .. "|link=" .. link;
        end
        if border == "yes" then
            result = result .. "|border";
        end
        if upright == "yes" then
            result = result .. "|upright";
        elseif upright ~= "" then
            result = result .. "|upright=" .. upright;
        end
        if thumbtime ~= "" then
            result = result .. "|thumbtime=" .. thumbtime;
        end
        if title ~= "" and title ~= nil then
            result = result .. "|" .. title;
        elseif alt ~= "" and alt ~= nil then
            result = result .. "|" .. alt;
        end
        if class ~= "" and class ~= nil then
            result = result .. "|class=" .. class;
        end
        result = result .. "]]";
        
        return result;
    end
end

return i;

require('strict')
return setmetatable({}, {
	__index = function(t, k)
		local what = mw.ustring[k]
		if type(what) ~= "function" then
			return what
		end
		return function(frame)
			local fargs = frame.args
			local fargsused = { tag = true }
			local args = {}
			local str_i = 1
			while fargs['s' .. str_i] do
				fargsused['s' .. str_i] = true
				args[str_i] = fargs['s' .. str_i]
				str_i = str_i + 1
			end
			for i, v in ipairs(fargs) do
				fargsused[i] = true
				args[i + str_i - 1] = tonumber(v) or v:gsub("^\\", "", 1)
			end
			if not fargs.tag then
				return (what(unpack(args)))		-- Outside parens truncate to first result avoiding tail call
			end
			local tagargs = {}
			for x, y in pairs(fargs) do
				if not fargsused[x] then tagargs[x] = y end
			end
			return frame:extensionTag{name = fargs.tag, content = what(unpack(args)), args = tagargs}
		end
	end
