body:
__NOTOC__ {| style="width: 100%;" |- | class="shortcut" style="background: rgb(58,28,113); background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(58,28,113,1) 0%, rgba(215,109,119,1) 50%, rgba(255,175,123,1) 100%); display: revert !important;" |
'''
Willkommen bei TestWiki!
'''
Eine entspannte Testumgebung, in der du MediaWiki zusammen mit Administratortools testen kannst.

[[Special:CreateAccount|Ein Konto erstellen]] [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Request permissions|Rechte beantragen]]

|} {| style="width: 100%;" | class="shortcut" style="border-top: 4px solid #67540F; background-color: #FFFDF5; padding: 5px 15px 10px 15px; vertical-align:top; width: 50%; display: revert !important;" |

[[File:OOjs UI icon userGroup-ltr.svg|40px|link=]] Weshalb trittst du dem TestWiki bei?

TestWiki bietet eine entspannte Umgebung, in der du viele Aspekte von MediaWiki ausprobieren kannst. Überlege dir ein paar Gründe, uns beizutreten: *
[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administratoren|Administrator]] und [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Bürokraten|Bürokraten]] zum Testen zur Verfügung.
*Dutzende von Erweiterungen und Skins zum Ausprobieren. *In einer Umgebung, in der Fehler nicht bestraft werden, sondern eine Erfahrung sind, aus der man lernt. *Hilfreiche Nutzer/innen, die dir Ratschläge geben und dich durch deine Testerfahrung führen können. *Die neueste Version von MediaWiki ist zum Testen verfügbar. *Nutze die Vorteile des Miraheze-Netzwerks, wie z.B. die Möglichkeit, dein Konto auf jedem Miraheze-Wiki zu verwenden. | style="height:10px" | | class="shortcut" style="border-top: 4px solid #6F6F6F; background-color: #F6F6F6; padding: 5px 15px 10px 15px; vertical-align:top; width: 50%; display: revert !important;" |

[[File:OOjs UI icon lightbulb.svg|40px|link=]] Dinge, die du beachten solltest

TestWiki ist ein entspannter Ort zum Testen, jedoch solltest du einige einfache Regeln beachten. Diese Regeln tragen dazu bei, dass die Gemeinschaft ein freundlicher und angenehmer Ort ist. * Stelle sicher, dass deine Bearbeitungen nicht die Aktivitäten anderer Nutzer/innen beeinträchtigen. * Stelle sicher, dass du nach dem Testen aufräumst. Mach alle Änderungen rückgängig und lösche die Seiten, die du erstellt hast, sobald du fertig bist. * Nutze den [[w:WP:COMMONSENSE|gesunden Menschenverstand]] um zu entscheiden, ob etwas erlaubt ist oder nicht. Wenn du Fragen dazu hast, was hier erlaubt ist, lies bitte die [[Spezial:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Richtlinien zum Testen|Richtlinien zum Testen]], bevor du im Community-Portal fragst. |} {| | style="height:10px" | |- | class="shortcut" style="border-top: 4px solid #180F67; background-color: #F7F6FF; padding: 5px 15px 10px 15px; vertical-align: top; width: 50%; display: revert !important;" |

[[File:OOjs UI icon referenceExisting-ltr.svg|40px|link=]] Was kann ich testen?

Das TestWiki bietet eine große Vielfalt an Dingen zum Testen! Überlege dir, was du im TestWiki alles tun kannst: *
[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administratoren|Administrator]] und [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Bürokraten|Bürokraten]] Rechte und Werkzeuge.
*Erstelle Seiten und Vorlagen zum Testen oder verwende eine unserer bereits erstellten [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Testing pages|Testseiten]]. *Dutzende von Erweiterungen und Skins zum Testen, ohne Einschränkungen. *Teste deine eigenen CSS oder Skripte auf deinem eigenen Konto. | style="height:10px" | | class="shortcut" style="border-top: 4px solid #67440F; background-color: #FFF2F6; padding: 5px 15px 10px 15px; vertical-align: top; width: 50%; display: revert !important;" |

[[File:Info black.png|40px|link=]] Über uns

'''TestWiki''' bietet eine Umgebung, in der Benutzer mit [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administratoren|Administrator]] und [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Bürokraten|Bürokraten]] Berechtigungen, Vorlagen, Erweiterungen und anderen Funktionen der [[mw:MediaWiki|MediaWiki]]-Software experimentieren können. TestWiki erfordert keine "Bestätigungsbearbeitungen" in anderen Projekten, bevor die Berechtigungen erteilt werden.
Auch wenn dies ein Testwiki ist, verfügen wir über Richtlinien. Siehe dazu [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Richtlinien|TestWiki:Richtlinien]].
|} [[Category:Public Test Wiki]] [[Category:Non-test pages]]

name: TestWiki:Confirmed users
body: The [[TestWiki:Confirmed|Confirmed]] user group provides most of the same user group rights as the [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed users]] group, with the '''exception''' of the following user group rights that are generally not required for this manual group: * autopatrol * comment * comment-delete-own * createaccount * mwoauthproposeconsumer * mwoauthupdateownconsumer Any [[TestWiki:Administrators|administrator]] may grant a requesting user, including themselves, this user permission; however, because most users are automatically promoted to [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed]] upon their account becoming more than four days old and them having made at least ten ''edits'', it is rarely ''needed''. The most common ''need'' for [[TestWiki:Confirmed|confirmed]] permission is for a user's legitimate alternate account or approved bot account that will make few, if any, ''edits''. The [[TestWiki:Confirmed|Confirmed]] user group has the following rights: * Edit pages protected as "Allow only autoconfirmed users" (editsemiprotected) * Not be affected by IP-based rate limits (autoconfirmed) * Perform CAPTCHA-triggering actions without having to go through the CAPTCHA (skipcaptcha) == List of confirmed users == {{Special:ListUsers/confirmed}} [[Category:Non-test pages]]

== Edit request ==

Remove Override the disallowed titles or usernames list (tboverride) because the policy has changed. [[User:AprilFallsDay|AprilFallsDay]] ([[User talk:AprilFallsDay|talk]]) 23:00, 26 April 2025 (UTC)
:{{Done}} [[User:MacFan4000|MacFan4000]] <sup>([[User talk:MacFan4000|Talk]] [[Special:Contributions/MacFan4000|Contribs]])</sup> 23:11, 26 April 2025 (UTC)

== About "registered users" ==

This policy states that you need to be a registered user for at least ten (10) days to obtain sysop permission, but it does not clearly specify whether these "10 days" refer to having created a local account on PublicTestWiki for 10 days, or simply having held a Miraheze global account for 10 days—regardless of the age of their local account? Based on experience, I believe the community's enforcement standard is that it counts as having a global account for 10 days. If that is the case, I think this should at least be reflected in the policy. Any views? --[[User:AM9|AM9]] ([[User talk:AM9|talk]])  05:24, 21 June 2026 (UTC)

name: TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users/bn
body:
'''Autoconfirmed users''' is a user group that is automatically assigned by the [[mw:MediaWiki|MediaWiki]] software to any user account that is at least four (4) days old and has made at least ten (10) ''edits''. It cannot be assigned manually via [[Special:UserRights|Special:UserRights]], and promotions to this user group are not logged. Only the [[User:Abuse filter|abuse filter]] user can revoke [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed]] rights, and only then in exceptional cases which is configured by an abuse filter operator or consul and only temporarily (usually five days).
As a result of a [[mh:meta|Miraheze]]-specific [[phab:T5940|MediaWiki configuration issue]] having to do with [[TestWiki:Users|users]] who were previously either an [[TestWiki:Autopatrolled|autopatrolled]] user or an [[TestWiki:Administrators|administrator]] and subsequently lost that user group saw their edits made while they were a member of either of those user groups became unpatrolled, which thus created an unneeded patrol backlog, a [[Special:Diff/27347|community proposal]] was launched by an active [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats|bureaucrat]] to add the autopatrol user group right to the [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed]] user group indefinitely. It was added indefinitely for two reasons, namely that (a) there was no known date for when the configuration issue/software bug would be fixed and (b) any [[TestWiki:Users|registered user]] who is logged in can request [[TestWiki:Administrators|administrator]] tools.
The following are the user rights included within the [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed]] user group:
* Create new user accounts (createaccount) * Delete own comments (comment-delete-own) * Edit pages protected as "Allow only autoconfirmed users" (editsemiprotected) * Have one's own edits automatically marked as patrolled (autopatrol) * Not be affected by IP-based rate limits (autoconfirmed) * Perform CAPTCHA-triggering actions without having to go through the CAPTCHA (skipcaptcha) * Propose new OAuth consumers (mwoauthproposeconsumer) * Submit comments (comment) * Update OAuth consumers you control (mwoauthupdateownconsumer)
== আরও দেখুন ==
* [[Special:ListUsers/autoconfirmed|Special:ListUsers/autoconfirmed]], an automatically generated list of all registered users assigned implicitly to the autoconfirmed user group on '''Public Test Wiki''' * [[Special:ListUsers/confirmed]], an automatically generally list of all registered users who have been granted the confirmed user group as they don't otherwise qualify for the [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed]] implicit user group (commonly approved bot accounts and legitimate alternate accounts of existing users)

name: TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users/de
body:
'''Automatischbestätigte Benutzer''' ist eine Benutzergruppe, die von der [[mw:MediaWiki|MediaWiki]]-Software automatisch jedem Benutzerkonto zugewiesen wird, das mindestens vier (4) Tage alt ist und mindestens zehn (10) ''Bearbeitungen'' erstellt hat. Sie kann nicht manuell über [[Special:UserRights|Special:UserRights]] zugewiesen werden und Beförderungen zu dieser Benutzergruppe werden nicht protokolliert. Nur der [[User:Abuse filter|abuse filter]]-Benutzer kann [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed]]-Rechte entziehen, und auch das nur in Ausnahmefällen.
Aufgrund eines [[mh:meta|Miraheze]]-spezifischen [[phab:T5940|Konfigurationsproblems mit der MediaWiki-Software]] mit Bezug zu [[TestWiki:Users|Benutzern]], die zuvor [[TestWiki:Autopatrolled|automatische Kontrollierer]] oder [[TestWiki:Administrators|Administratoren]] waren und diese Rechte verloren haben, woraufhin ihre vorherigen Bearbeitungen unkontrolliert wurden, entstand ein unnötig Kontrollier-Rückstand. Daraufhin machte ein aktiver [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats|Bürokrat]] den [[Special:Diff/27347|Gemeinschaftsvorschlag]], allen [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|automatisch bestätigten Benutzern]] dauerhaft das autopatrol-Recht zu geben. Es wurde dauerhaft vergeben, da (a) kein Datum bekannt war, an dem das Konfigurationsproblem / der Softwarefehler behoben sein würde und da (b) jeder [[TestWiki:Users|registrierte Benutzer]] während er angemeldet ist [[TestWiki:Administrators|Administrator]]-Rechte beantragen kann. Die folgenden Rechte sind in der Benutzergruppe der [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|automatisch bestätigten Benutzer]] enthalten: * Benutzerkonto erstellen (createaccount) * Eigene Kommentare löschen (comment-delete-own) * Seiten bearbeiten, die als „Nur automatisch bestätigten Benutzern erlauben“ geschützt sind (editsemiprotected) * Eigene Bearbeitungen automatisch als kontrolliert markieren (autopatrol) * Keine Beschränkung durch IP-basierte Limits (autoconfirmed) * Überspringen der CAPTCHA-Eingabe (skipcaptcha) * Neue OAuth-Anwendungen vorschlagen (mwoauthproposeconsumer) * Kommentar abgeben (comment) * Kontrollierte OAuth-Anwendungen aktualisieren (mwoauthupdateownconsumer) == Siehe auch == * [[Special:ListUsers/autoconfirmed|Special:ListUsers/autoconfirmed]], eine automatische Liste aller registrierten Benutzer, denen die Benutzergruppe autoconfirmed im '''Public Test Wiki''' implizit zugewiesen wurde * [[Special:ListUsers/confirmed]], eine Liste aller registrierten Benutzer, denen die Benutzergruppe confirmed zugewiesen wurde, da sie nicht für die Benutzergruppe [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|automatisch bestätigte Benutzer]] qualifiziert sind (normalerweise genehmigte Botkonten und erlaubte Alternativkonten existierender Benutzer) {{User groups}} [[Category:Non-test pages{{translation}}]]

'''自動承認された利用者'''は、[[mw:MediaWiki|MediaWiki]]ソフトウェアによって、4日以上経過し、10回以上''編集''した利用者アカウントに自動的に割り当てられる利用者グループです。 [[Special:UserRights|特別:利用者権限]]を介して手動で割り当てることはできず、この利用者グループへの自動昇格はログに記録されません。[[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|自動承認された利用者]]の権限を取り消すことができるのは[[User:Abuse filter|不正利用フィルター]]の利用者のみであり、かつ例外的な場合に限られます。
[[mh:meta|Miraheze]]固有の[[phab:T5940|MediaWiki構成の問題]]は、かつて[[TestWiki:Autopatrolled|自動巡回者]]または[[TestWiki:Administrators|管理者]]であった[[TestWiki:Users|利用者]]がその後その利用者グループを失い、これらの利用者グループのメンバーである間に行われた編集が巡回されず、不要な巡回バックログが発生したことです。このため、アクティブな[[TestWiki:Bureaucrats|ビューロクラット]]によって、autopatrol利用者グループ権限を[[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|自動承認された利用者]]グループに無期限に追加するという[[Special:Diff/27347|コミュニティの提案]]が開始されました。無期限に追加された理由は2つあり、一つは(a)構成の問題やソフトウェアのバグが修正される日付が不明であったこと、もう一つは(b)ログインしている[[TestWiki:Users|登録利用者]]であれば[[TestWiki:Administrators|管理者]]ツールを要求できることです。 [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|自動承認された利用者]]グループに含まれる権限は次のとおりです:
* Create new user accounts (createaccount) * Delete own comments (comment-delete-own) * Edit pages protected as "Allow only autoconfirmed users" (editsemiprotected) * Have one's own edits automatically marked as patrolled (autopatrol) * Not be affected by IP-based rate limits (autoconfirmed) * Perform CAPTCHA-triggering actions without having to go through the CAPTCHA (skipcaptcha) * Propose new OAuth consumers (mwoauthproposeconsumer) * Submit comments (comment) * Update OAuth consumers you control (mwoauthupdateownconsumer)

'''Public Test Wiki'''のautoconfirmed利用者グループに暗黙的に割り当てられたすべての登録利用者の自動生成リスト * [[Special:ListUsers/confirmed]]...[[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|自動承認された利用者]]の資格がないため、confirmedユーザーグループが付与されたすべての登録ユーザーの自動リストです。暗黙のユーザーグループ（一般的に承認されたボットアカウントと既存のユーザーの正当な代替アカウント） {{User groups}} [[Category:Non-test pages{{translation}}]]

name: TestWiki:Testing policy/ckb
body:
{{TNT|Policy}} بەکارهێنەران تا ڕادەیەکی زۆر ئازادن لێرەدا هەر شتێک کە حەز ئەکەن بیکەن، بە مەرجێک کارەکانیان پێچەوانەی ئەم سیاسەتە نەبێت. بۆ یارمەتیدان لە ڕێنماییکردنی ئەو کۆمەڵگەیەی کە کردارەکان بەتایبەتیی لەسەری قەدەغەکراون، ئەم '''سیاسەتی تاقیکردنەوە''' دروستکراوە. تکایە ئاگاداربن ئەم سیاسەتە یەکێکە لەو سیاسەتە کەمانەی کە لەسەر ئەم پڕۆژەیە دانراوە، بۆیە تکایە هەموو هەوڵێکتان بدەن بۆ پەیڕەوکردنی. == داواکردنی مافەکان == بەکارهێنەران ئازادن داوای هەر مافێک بکەن کە بۆ تاقیکردنەوە بەردەستە بە 1$ و بۆ مەبەستی تاقیکردنەوە بەکاری بێنن. لیستی مافە بەردەستەکان لە خودی پەڕەی داواکاریی مافەکاندا دابین کراوە. لە کاتی داوای مافەکەدا، ڕەنگە پێویست بێت کە تۆ زانیاریی لەسەر ئەو ئەکاونتانەی تر بدەیت کە لەوانەیە لە پڕۆژەکانی تردا هەتبێت، بەڵام ئەوە هەمیشە پێویست نییە. وەک یاسایەکی گەورە، ئامانجمان ئەوەیە کە هەر بەکارهێنەرێک هەر مافێک داوای بکات، بیدەین. ئەگەر هەر بەربەستێکی هەڵپەسێردراو لەسەر پڕۆژەکانی تری ناو تۆڕەکە هەبێت، لەوانەیە داوات لێ بکرێت پێش ئەوەی مافی تاقیکردنەوەکە بدرێت، ئەوانە چارەسەر بکەیت. ئەگەر پێشتر مافی تاقیکردنەوەت هەیە کە توانای پێدانی مافەکان بە بەکارهێنەرانی تر هەیە، ئازادانە مافی تاقیکردنەوەی زیادە بە خۆت بدە. تکایە ئاگاداربە کە تۆش ئازادیت لە پێدانی مافی تاقیکردنەوە بە بەکارهێنەرانی تر، بەڵام تەنیا ئەگەر لە ویکیدا داوای کردبێت. هەرچۆنێک بێت، ئەگەر داواکارییەکە مشتومڕی لەسەر بوو، داوا ئەکەین ئەو داواکارییە بۆ بەڕێوەبەری پڕۆژەیەک بەجێبێڵیت. == بەربەستکردنی بەکارهێنەرەکان ==
زۆرجار بەربەستکردن لەلایەن بەڕێوەبەرانەوە لەسەر پڕۆژە ڕاستەوخۆکان ئەنجام ئەدرێت، بۆیە بەسروشتی ئێمە ئەوەی لێرەدا بەردەستە بۆ تاقیکردنەوەیە! بەڵام بەو پێیەی '''تێست ویکی''' خۆی پڕۆژەیە، لێرەدا بەربەستی ڕاستەقینەش لە شوێنی خۆیدا ئەبێ. هەموو بەربەستە بەڕێوەبەرییە "ڕاستەقینەکان" لێرەدا بە ڕوونی لە پوختەی بەربەستەکان و لە پەڕەی وتووێژی بەکارهێنەردا ئاماژەی پێ ئەکرێ بۆ کەمکردنەوەی سەرلێشێواوی. داوا لە بەکارهێنەران ئەکەین کە فەنکشنەکانی بەربەست و کردنەوەی بەربەستەکان تاقی ئەکەنەوە، ئەم بەربەستە ڕاستەقینانە پشتگوێ بخەن و خۆیان لە کردنەوەی بەربەستی بەکارهێنەری بەربەستکراق بەدوور بگرن.
== ئەو بەکارهێنەرانەی کە ئەتوانیت تاقیکردنەوەیان لەسەر بکەیت ==
We have created a few user accounts for you to test on. These users are:
* [[User:Example]] * [[User:Example2]] * [[User:Example3]] * [[User:TestUser (BZPN)|TestUser]]
You may block and unblock these accounts at will, as well as test adding and removing permissions. However, after a number of incidents involving Example, the accounts were locked to prevent vandalism. It is therefore recommended that you [[Special:CreateAccount|create another account]] if you need an account to test with/on.
== دەستکاری و سڕینەوەی پەڕەکان ==
Edit and delete away! Just please don't delete important pages like this one or the user and user talk pages of other users. Also, please do not delete your own user talk page in an attempt to clear messages. It's best to simply blank the content. Pages that should not be deleted as a test are marked with the category [[:Category:Non-test pages|Non-test pages]].
== Non-test pages ==
Pages that should not be tested on are placed in the ''non-test'' category. As the name suggests, please don't test on these pages.
== Behavioral guidelines ==
As always, please treat other users with respect. Harassment and other forms of intimidation are not allowed and should be reported to a Consul or Bureaucrat.
== After testing ==
Please always '''[[TestWiki:Revert|revert]]''' your edits after testing and say ''test done''.
== Use common sense ==
Using common sense is important on any project, but even more so here. Due to the nature of this project, it's very important that you use common sense when carrying out your tests. If you have any questions regarding this policy or the project in general, feel free to post in the community portal or join us on IRC at #miraheze-testwiki on Libera.chat.

name: TestWiki:Testing policy/de
body:
{{TNT|Policy}} Die Nutzer/innen können hier so ziemlich alles tun, was sie wollen, solange ihre Handlungen nicht gegen diese Richtlinie verstoßen. Um der Gemeinschaft zu zeigen, welche Handlungen ausdrücklich verboten sind, wurde diese '''Testrichtlinie''' erstellt. Bitte beachte, dass diese Richtlinie eine der wenigen Richtlinien in diesem Projekt ist, also tu dein Bestes, um sie zu befolgen. == Beantragung von Genehmigungen == Es steht den Nutzern frei, jede zum Testen verfügbare Berechtigung auf [[TestWiki:Request permissions]] anzufordern und sie zu Testzwecken zu verwenden. Eine Liste der verfügbaren Berechtigungen findest du auf der Seite zur Beantragung von Berechtigungen selbst. Wenn du eine Berechtigung anforderst, kann es sein, dass du Informationen über andere Konten in anderen Projekten angeben musst, aber das ist nicht immer erforderlich. Als Faustregel gilt: Wir versuchen, jedem Nutzer das Recht zu geben, das er beantragt. Wenn es noch offene Sperren bei anderen Projekten innerhalb des Netzwerks gibt, kann es sein, dass du aufgefordert wirst, diese zu lösen, bevor die Testrechte erteilt werden. Wenn du bereits eine Testberechtigung hast, mit der du anderen Nutzern Rechte erteilen kannst, kannst du dir selbst zusätzliche Testrechte erteilen. Bitte beachte, dass es dir auch freisteht, anderen Nutzern Testrechte zu erteilen, aber nur, wenn sie es im Wiki beantragt haben. Wenn die Anfrage jedoch umstritten ist, bitten wir dich, diese Anfrage einem Projektmanager zu überlassen. == Benutzer sperren ==
Sperren werden häufig von Administratoren in laufenden Projekten durchgeführt, also haben wir sie natürlich auch hier zum Testen zur Verfügung! Da das TestWiki jedoch selbst ein Projekt ist, existieren hier zudem auch echte Sperren. Alle "echten" administrativen Sperren werden in der Zusammenfassung der Sperren und auf der Diskussionsseite des Benutzers deutlich gekennzeichnet, um Verwirrung zu vermeiden. Wir bitten die Benutzer/innen, die die Funktionen zum Sperren und Entsperren testen, diese echten Sperren zu ignorieren und den/die gesperrte/n Benutzer/in nicht zu entsperren.
== Benutzer, an denen du testen kannst == Wir haben ein paar Benutzerkonten zum Testen eingerichtet. Diese Benutzer sind: * [[User:Example]] * [[User:Example2]] * [[User:Example3]] * [[User:TestUser (BZPN)|TestUser]] Du kannst diese Konten nach Belieben sperren und entsperren sowie das Hinzufügen und Entfernen von Berechtigungen testen. Nach einer Reihe von Vorfällen mit Example wurden die Konten jedoch gesperrt, um Vandalismus zu verhindern. Es wird daher empfohlen, dass du ein anderes Konto anlegst, wenn du ein Konto zum Testen brauchst. == Bearbeiten und Löschen von Seiten == Bearbeite und lösche alles! Aber bitte lösche keine wichtigen Seiten wie diese hier oder die Benutzer- und Benutzer-Talk-Seiten anderer Benutzer. Bitte lösche auch nicht deine eigene Benutzer-Talk-Seite, um Nachrichten zu löschen. Es ist am besten, den Inhalt einfach zu löschen. Seiten, die nicht zu Testzwecken gelöscht werden sollten, sind mit der Kategorie [[:Category:Non-test pages|Nicht-Testseiten]] gekennzeichnet. == Nicht-Testseiten == Seiten, auf denen nicht getestet werden sollte, werden in die Kategorie "Nicht-testen" eingeordnet. Wie der Name schon sagt, solltest du auf diesen Seiten nicht testen. == Verhaltensrichtlinien ==
Wie immer solltest du andere Nutzer/innen mit Respekt behandeln. Belästigungen und andere Formen der Einschüchterung sind nicht erlaubt und sollten einem Projektmanager gemeldet werden.
== Nach dem testen ==
Bitte mache deine Änderungen nach dem Testen immer rückgängig und sage "Test erledigt".
== Den gesunden Menschenverstand verwenden ==
Die Verwendung von gesundem Menschenverstand ist bei jedem Projekt wichtig, hier jedoch umso mehr. Aufgrund der Natur dieses Projekts ist es sehr wichtig, dass du bei der Durchführung deiner Tests deinen gesunden Menschenverstand verwendest. Wenn du Fragen zu dieser Richtlinie oder dem Projekt im Allgemeinen hast, kannst du sie im Community-Portal stellen oder uns im IRC unter #miraheze-testwiki auf freenode beitreten.

As always, please treat other users with respect. Harassment and other forms of intimidation are not allowed and should be reported to a Consul or Bureaucrat.
== After testing ==
Please always '''[[TestWiki:Revert|revert]]''' your edits after testing and say ''test done''.
== Use common sense ==
Using common sense is important on any project, but even more so here. Due to the nature of this project, it's very important that you use common sense when carrying out your tests. If you have any questions regarding this policy or the project in general, feel free to post in the community portal or join us on IRC at #miraheze-testwiki on Libera.chat.

name: TestWiki:Testing policy/ja
body:
{{TNT|Policy}} ※この文章は英語版(原文)の方針を翻訳したものです。原文と差が生じている場合は原文が優先されます。 利用者がこの方針に反しない限り、利用者はここで好きなことを自由に行うことができます。アクションが特に禁止されているコミュニティをガイドするために、この '''テストの方針'''が作成されました。この方針は、このプロジェクトで実施されている数少ない方針の1つであります。それに従って、最善を尽くしてください。 == 権限のリクエスト ==
利用者は、[[TestWiki:Request permissions]]でテストに利用できるアクセス許可を自由にリクエストしてテスト目的で使用できます。使用可能なアクセス許可のリストは、アクセス許可要求ページ自体にあります。許可を要求するとき、他のプロジェクトで保持している可能性のある他のアカウントに関する情報を提供する必要がある場合がありますが、それは必ずしも必要ではありません。経験則として、私たちはすべての利用者に彼らが要求するどんな権利も与えることを目指しています。
ネットワーク内の他のプロジェクトに未解決のブロックがある場合、テスト権限が付与される前にそれらに対処するように求められる場合があります。 他の利用者に権限を付与できるテスト権限を既にお持ちの場合は、追加のテスト権限を自由に付与してください。他の利用者にもテスト権限を自由に付与できますが、ウィキでリクエストした場合に限ります。ただし、物議を醸すリクエストの場合は、プロジェクトマネージャーにお任せください。 == 利用者のブロック ==
ブロックはライブプロジェクトの管理者によって頻繁に行われるため、当然、ここでテストできます。ただし、TestWiki自体がプロジェクトであるため、ここにもテストではないガチのブロックが配置されます。ここにあるすべての「ガチの」管理ブロックは、混乱を最小限に抑えるために、ブロックの概要と利用者のトークページで明確にラベル付けされます。ブロックおよびブロック解除機能をテストしている利用者には、これらのガチのブロックを無視し、ブロックされた利用者のブロックを解除しないようにお願いします。
== テストできる利用者 ==
テスト用にいくつかのアカウントを作成しました。これらの利用者は次のとおりです。 * [[User:Example]] * [[User:Example2]] これらのアカウントを自由にブロックおよびブロック解除したり、権限の追加と削除をテストしたりできます。しかし、例に関連する多くの事件の後、荒らしを防ぐためにアカウントはロックされました。したがって、テストに使用するアカウントが必要な場合は、[[{{#Special:CreateAccount}}|別のアカウントを作成]]することをお勧めします。
* [[User:Example]] * [[User:Example2]] * [[User:Example3]] * [[User:TestUser (BZPN)|TestUser]]
You may block and unblock these accounts at will, as well as test adding and removing permissions. However, after a number of incidents involving Example, the accounts were locked to prevent vandalism. It is therefore recommended that you [[Special:CreateAccount|create another account]] if you need an account to test with/on.
== ページの編集と削除 ==
自由に編集したり削除してください!このような重要なページや、他の利用者の利用者ページおよび利用者のトークページは削除しないでください。また、メッセージを無かったことにするために、自分の利用者のトークページを削除しないでください。単にトークを白紙化にするのが最善です。テストとして削除してはならないページは、カテゴリ[[:Category:Non-test pages|Non-test pages]]でマークされます。
== テストしてはいけないページ == テストをしてはいけないページは、「非テスト」カテゴリに分類されます。名前が示すように、これらのページではテストしないでください。 == 行動についてのガイドライン ==
常に、他のユーザーには敬意を持って接してください。嫌がらせ行為や脅迫などの迷惑行為は許可されていないため、プロジェクトマネージャーに報告する必要があります。
== テストの後 ==
テスト後は常に編集内容を'''元に戻し'''、「テスト完了」と要約欄に記入してください。
== 常識を持って考える ==
常識的に考えるのはどのプロジェクトでも重要ですが、ここではさらに重要です。このプロジェクトの性質上、テストを実行するときは常識的に考えることが非常に重要です。この方針またはプロジェクト全般に関して質問がある場合は、コミュニティポータルに投稿するか、freenodeの#miraheze-testwikiでIRCに参加してください。

name: TestWiki:Testing policy/zh
body:
{{TNT|Policy}} 用户可以在此维基上做任何事，只要他们的行为不违反此方针。此测试政策是为了帮助指导社区明确禁止哪些行为而制定的。此政策是测试维基最少数的政策之一，因此请确保你没有违反此政策。 == 请求权限 == 用户可以以[[TestWiki:Request permissions]]自由请求任何可用于测试的权限，并将其用于测试目的。权限请求页面本身提供了可用权限列表。请求权限时，您可能需要提供您在其他项目中持有的其他帐户的信息，但这并不总是必需的。根据经验，我们的目标是授予每个用户他们请求的任何权限。 如果网络中的其他项目存在任何未解决的问题，您可能会在在获得测试权限之前被要求解决这些问题。 如果您已经拥有能够授予其他用户权限的测试权限，请随意授予自己额外的测试权限。请注意，您也可以自由授予其他用户测试权限，但前提是他们在wiki上提出了请求。但是，如果请求有争议，我们要求您将该请求留给项目经理。 == 封禁用户 ==
参见[[TestWiki:Blocking policy|封禁方针]].
== 可供用户测试的帐户 == 我们已经创建了几个用户账户供您测试。这些用户是： * [[User:Example]] * [[User:Example2]] * [[User:Example3]] * [[User:TestUser (BZPN)|TestUser]] 您可以随意封禁和解封这些账户，以及测试添加和删除权限。然而，在发生了一些涉及Example的事件后，这些账户被锁定以防止恶意破坏。因此，如果您需要一个单独的账号进行测试，建议您[[Special:CreateAccount|创建其他账号]]。 == 编辑与删除页面 == 请随意编辑和删除内容吧！ 但请不要删除本页这类重要页面，也不可删除其他用户的用户页及用户讨论页。 同时，切勿为清空留言而删除自身的用户讨论页，直接清空页面内容即可。 标注分类为[[:Category:Non-test pages|非测试页面]]的页面，禁止用作测试删除对象。 == 非测试页面 == 不可用于测试的页面，均被归入''非测试''分类。顾名思义，请勿在这些页面上进行任何测试操作。
== Behavioral guidelines ==
As always, please treat other users with respect. Harassment and other forms of intimidation are not allowed and should be reported to a Consul or Bureaucrat.
== 测试后 == 请务必在测试结束后'''[[TestWiki:Revert|回退]]'''你所做的编辑，并标注''测试完成''。
== Use common sense ==
Using common sense is important on any project, but even more so here. Due to the nature of this project, it's very important that you use common sense when carrying out your tests. If you have any questions regarding this policy or the project in general, feel free to post in the community portal or join us on IRC at #miraheze-testwiki on Libera.chat.

body:
{{Policy}} '''ধ্বংসপ্রবণতা''' টেস্টউইকিতে স্বীকৃত '''নয়'''। যদি আমরা এই উইকিতে ধ্বংসপ্রবণতা দেখতে পাই (বিশেষত দাপ্তরিক পৃষ্ঠাগুলিতে) আপনার অধিকার অপসারণ করা হবে এবং আপনাকে তৎক্ষণাৎ বাধা দেওয়া হবে। == যাকে আমরা ধ্বংসপ্রবণতা বলি ==
আমাদের জন্য ধ্বংসপ্রবণতার অন্তর্ভুক্ত: * বাজে/অনাকাঙ্ক্ষিতমন্তব্য সহ কোনও ব্যবহারকারীর ব্যবহারকারীর পৃষ্ঠা সম্পাদনা করা * আজেবাজে কথা বা পৃষ্ঠার সাথে সম্পর্কিত না এমন কিছু দিয়ে একটি অফিসিয়াল পৃষ্ঠা সম্পাদনা করা * '''যেকোনও''' পৃষ্ঠায় কোনও ব্যবহারকারীকে অপমান করা (এটি যদি পরীক্ষার পৃষ্ঠাও হয়) * কোনও নীতিকে সম্মান না করা (একটি সতর্কতার পরে) বাকির জন্য অনুগ্রহ করে সাধারণ জ্ঞান ব্যবহার করুন।

name: TestWiki:Vandalism/de
body:
{{Policy}} '''Vandalismus''' wird im TestWiki '''nicht''' akzeptiert. Wenn wir feststellen, dass du Vandalismus in diesem Wiki betreibst (vor allem auf offiziellen Seiten), werden dir deine Berechtigungen entzogen und du wirst sofort für das Bearbeiten gesperrt. == Was wir Vandalismus nennen ==
Für uns beinhaltet Vandalismus: * die Benutzerseite eines Benutzers mit unsinnigen/unerwünschten Stellungsnahmen zu bearbeiten * die [[Category:Non-test pages|eine offizielle Seite]] mit Unsinn oder etwas, das nichts mit der Seite zu tun hat, zu bearbeiten * einen Benutzer auf einer '''beliebigen''' Seite beleidigen (auch wenn es sich um eine Testseite handelt) * Nichtbeachtung einer Richtlinie (nach einer Verwarnung) Für den Rest verwende bitte den gesunden Menschenverstand.

name: TestWiki:Vandalism/ckb
body:
{{Policy}} '''خراپەکاری''' یان '''تێکدان''' لە تێست ویکی قبوڵ ناکرێ. ئەگەر لەم ویکییەدا (بەتایبەت لە پەڕە فەرمییەکان) خراپەکاریی ببینین، مۆڵەتەکانت لائەبرێن و یەکسەر ڕێگریت لێ ئەکرێت لە دەستکاریکردن. == ئەوەی ئێمە پێی ئەڵێین خراپەکاری ==
بۆ ئێمە خراپەکاریی بریتییە لە: * دەستکاریکردنی پەڕەی بەکارهێنەری بەکارهێنەرێک بە سەرنجی بێمانا/نەخوازراو * دەستکاریی [[:Category:Non-test pages|پەڕەیەکی فەرمی]] لە ناوەوە بە قسەی بێمانا یان شتێک کە پەیوەندی بە پەڕەکەوە نییە * سووکایەتیکردن بە بەکارهێنەرێک لە '''هەر''' پەڕەیەک (تەنانەت ئەگەر پەڕەی تاقیکردنەوەش بێت) * ڕێزنەگرتن لە سیاسەتێک (دوای ئاگادارکردنەوە) تکایە بۆ هەر شتێکی تر ڕاوبۆچوونی گشتیی بەکاربێنە.

body:
{{Policy}} '''Вандализм''' на TestWiki '''не допускается'''. Если мы увидим вандализм на этой вики (особенно на официальных страницах), ваши права будут отозваны, а вы немедленно заблокированы. == Что мы называем вандализмом ==
Для нас, вандализм включает в себя: * редактирование страницы пользователя с бессмысленными/нежелательными комментариями * добавление на [[:Category:Non-test pages|официальные страницы]] бессмыслицу или что-то, что не имеет отношение к странице * оскорбление пользователя на '''любой''' странице (даже если это тестовая страница) * несоблюдение правил (после предупреждения). В остальных случаях руководствуйтесь здравым смыслом.
[[Category:Policies{{#translation:}}]] [[Category:Non-test pages{{#translation:}}]]
label: FuzzyBot

{{Policy}} '''荒らし'''は、TestWikiで受け入れられて'''いません'''。このウィキ(特に公式ページ)で荒らしが見られる場合、あなたの権限は剥奪され、あなたはすぐに編集をブロックされます。 == 私たちが荒らしと定義するもの ==
私たちにとって、破壊行為には次のものが含まれます。 * ナンセンス/望ましくないコメントで利用者の利用者ページを編集する * ナンセンスまたはページに関係のない何かで公式ページを編集する * '''任意の'''ページでユーザーを侮辱する(テストページであっても) * 方針を尊重しない(警告後) 残りは常識を働かせてください。
[[Category:Policies{{#translation:}}]] [[Category:Non-test pages{{#translation:}}]]

{{Policy}} {{NoteTA|G1=MediaWiki}} '''破坏'''是在TestWiki上'''不'''允许的。如果我们发现在这个wiki上存在破坏行为（尤其是在官方页面上），你的权限将会被撤销并且被封禁。 == 如何判定破坏 ==
对于本wiki，破坏包括： * 对用户页面进行无意义、不受欢迎的原文如此：undesirable评论的编辑。 * 编辑[[:Category:Non-test pages|官方页面]]且存在废话或与页面无关的内容 * 在任何页面中侮辱用户（即使是测试页面） * 不遵守方针（警告后） 其余部分以常识为准。

보통 x.y.00 형태로 출시된다. 여러 콘텐츠와 이벤트를 추가하고 변경한다.

** [[안치홍]], 2루수 -> 1루수
** [[임병욱]], 좌익수 -> 우익수
** [[김웅빈]], 지명타자 -> 3루수
** [[이민우]], 중계 -> 마무리
** [[이도윤]], 유격수 -> 2루수

;이벤트
* 가정의 달 기념 지원 이벤트가 종료되었다.

;기타
* 리그 모드 AI 라인업이 최신화되었다.
* 2026 v1 라이브 선수 카드의 스탯이 변경되었다.
* 라이브 히트 올히트 보상이 골든글러브 트로피 랜덤 박스로 변경되었다.
** 확률에 따라 100개, 150개, 200개, 300개, 500개, 1000개, 3000개, 5000개, 10000개의 골든글러브 트로피를 얻을 수 있다.

== 버그 수정 ==
*일부 선수의 응원가가 적용되지 않는 버그가 수정되었다.

'''
Добро пожаловать на PublicTestWiki!
'''
Бесплатный сайт, позволяющий легко протестировать программное обеспечение MediaWiki, включая инструменты Администратора.

[[Special:CreateAccount|Создайте учётную запись]] [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Request permissions|Запросить права]]

|} {| style="width: 100%;" | class="shortcut" style="border-top: 4px solid #67540F; background-color: #FFFDF5; padding: 5px 15px 10px 15px; vertical-align:top; width: 50%; display: revert !important;" |

[[File:OOjs UI icon userGroup-ltr.svg|40px|link=]] Что мы предлагаем?

Мы предлагаем спокойную атмосферу, в которой вы можете проверить и испытать множество функций движка MediaWiki. Что мы предлагаем: *
Тестирование прав [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|администратора]].
*Множество расширений для тестирования. *Среде, где за ошибки не наказывают, а учат. *Опытных пользователей, которые могут дать совет и помочь вам в процессе тестирования. *Возможность тестирования самой последней версии MediaWiki. *Возможность [[m:Special:MyLanguage/Single user login|использовать]] аккаунт во всех вики Miraheze. | style="height:10px" | | class="shortcut" style="border-top: 4px solid #6F6F6F; background-color: #F6F6F6; padding: 5px 15px 10px 15px; vertical-align:top; width: 50%; display: revert !important;" |

[[File:OOjs UI icon lightbulb.svg|40px|link=]] Некоторые вещи которые следует иметь ввиду:

Пока вы тестируете, пожалуйста, помните о нескольких правилах, чтобы сохранить дружелюбную атмосферу в нашем проекте. * Пожалуйста, убедитесь, что ваши правки не мешают другим пользователям. * Пожалуйста, не забывайте отменять свои тестовые правки и действия, возвращая каждое действие журнала тестов в обратном порядке, в котором тесты были выполнены изначально. * Используйте [[w:WP:COMMONSENSE|здравый смысл]] и не играйте с правилами. Это сокращенная версия политики тестирования, которая содержит рекомендации о том, что здесь разрешено и что запрещено. Если у вас есть вопросы, пожалуйста, прочитайте [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Testing policy|нашу политику]], прежде чем спрашивать у сообщества. |} {| | style="height:10px" | |- | class="shortcut" style="border-top: 4px solid #180F67; background-color: #F7F6FF; padding: 5px 15px 10px 15px; vertical-align: top; width: 50%; display: revert !important;" |

[[File:OOjs UI icon referenceExisting-ltr.svg|40px|link=]] Что я могу испробовать?

Мы предлагаем множество вещей которые можно протестировать. Вот некоторые из них: *
Тестирование прав [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|администратора]].
*Создание страниц и шаблонов, или же использование уже созданных [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Testing pages|страниц для тестирования]]. *Множество расширений для тестирования без ограничений. *Проверка собственных скриптов и CSS на собственном аккаунте. | style="height:10px" | | class="shortcut" style="border-top: 4px solid #67440F; background-color: #FFF2F6; padding: 5px 15px 10px 15px; vertical-align: top; width: 50%; display: revert !important;" |

[[File:Info black.png|40px|link=]] О нас

'''TestWiki''' - это проект, который предоставляет пользователям среду для экспериментов с разрешениями [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|администратора]], шаблонами, расширениями и другими возможностями, предоставляемыми программным обеспечением [[mw:MediaWiki|MediaWiki]]. TestWiki не требует "подтверждающих правок" в других проектах перед предоставлением разрешений.
Тем не менее, у нас все равно есть правила. Пожалуйста, прочитайте их [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Policies|тут]].
|} [[Category:Public Test Wiki]] [[Category:Non-test pages]]

[[File:OOjs UI icon userGroup-ltr.svg|40px|link=]] Pourquoi rejoindre TestWiki ?

TestWiki propose un environnement détendu où vous pouvez tester de nombreux aspects de MediaWiki, voici quelques raisons de nous rejoindre: *
Possibilité de tester des outils d'[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|administrateur]] et de[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Bureaucrats|bureaucrate]].
*Des dizaines d'extensions et d'habillages à essayer. *Un environnement où les erreurs ne sont pas punies, elles sont une expérience d'apprentisage. *Des utilisateurs prêts à aider qui peuvent vous donner des conseils et vous guider tout au long de vos tests. *La dernière version de MediaWiki est disponible peut être testée. *Profite des bénéfices du réseau Miraheze, notamment la possibilité d'[[m:Special:MyLanguage/Single user login|utiliser votre compte sur n'importe que Wiki Miraheze]]. | style="height:10px" | | class="shortcut" style="border-top: 4px solid #6F6F6F; background-color: #F6F6F6; padding: 5px 15px 10px 15px; vertical-align:top; width: 50%; display: revert !important;" |

[[File:OOjs UI icon lightbulb.svg|40px|link=]] Des choses à garder en tête

TestWiki est un espace de test détendu mais assurez-vous de garder ces quelques règles simples à l'esprit. Celles-ci permettent à la communauté de demeurer dans un lieu amical et agréable. * Assurez-vous que vos modifications n'interfèrent pas avec les activités des autres utilisateurs. * Assurez-vous de nettoyer derrière vous lorsque vous avez fini vos tests. Révoquez toutes vos modifications et supprimez les pages que vous avez créées quand vous avez terminé. * Faîtes appel au [[w:WP:COMMONSENSE|bon sens]] pour savoir ce qui est autorisé ou non. Si vous avez des questions sur ce qui est autorisé ici, merci de vous référer à la [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Testing policy|politique de test]] avant de demander sur le portail communautaire. |} {| | style="height:10px" | |- | class="shortcut" style="border-top: 4px solid #180F67; background-color: #F7F6FF; padding: 5px 15px 10px 15px; vertical-align: top; width: 50%; display: revert !important;" |

[[File:OOjs UI icon referenceExisting-ltr.svg|40px|link=]] Que puis-je tester ?

TestWiki propose une large variété de choses à tester! Voici ce que vous pouvez faire sur TestWiki: *
Droits et outils d'[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|Administrateur]] et [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Bureaucrats|bureaucrate]].
*Créer des pages et modèles pour faire des tests ou utiliser une de nos [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Testing pages|pages de test]] déjà créées. *Des dizaines d'extensions et d'habillages à essayer sans limitations. *Tester vos propres CSS ou scripts sur votre compte. | style="height:10px" | | class="shortcut" style="border-top: 4px solid #67440F; background-color: #FFF2F6; padding: 5px 15px 10px 15px; vertical-align: top; width: 50%; display: revert !important;" |

[[File:Info black.png|40px|link=]] À propos de nous

'''TestWiki''' fournit un environnement dans lequel les utilisateurs peuvent tester les permissions d'[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|administrateur]] et [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Bureaucrats|bureaucrate]], les modèles, extensions, et autres fonctionnalités fournies par le logiciel [[mw:MediaWiki|MediaWiki]]. TestWiki ne nécessite pas de "modififcations de confirmation" sur d'autres projets pour obtenir ces permissions.
Même s'il s'agit d'un wiki de test, nous avons tout de même une politique. Merci de lire [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Policies|TestWiki:Policies]].
|} [[Category:Public Test Wiki]] [[Category:Non-test pages]]

name: TestWiki:Flooders/zh
body:
'''Flooders''', or sometimes called '''pseudo-bots''', have limited use on '''Public Test Wiki''' in that virtually anyone can request either the [[TestWiki:Administrators|administrator]] bit, which, among other things, include the ability to bypass rate-limiting edit restrictions. However, its chief purpose is to prevent [[Special:RecentChanges|RC]] flooding for a generally high number of non-controversial, and usually minor, logged actions and/or edits. Note that edits, unless edited through the API, are '''not''' marked as bot edits, though. On TestWiki, any [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats|bureaucrat]] can add themselves or another user to the [[TestWiki:Flooders|flood]] user group, for testing and to prevent flooding; however, after testing, please remember to '''''remove''''' your access. The key, though, is the access [[rfc:2119|'''must''']] be temporary. As a "[[wikt:rule of thumb|rule of thumb]]," this is ''usually'' for a few hours, but ''may'' be for up to several days.
Flooders have the permission to be treated as an automated process
(bot)
To request to operate a full bot account, please make a request [[TestWiki:Bot approval requests|here]]. Any [[TestWiki:Consuls|Consul]] will review your request for completeness and your attached source code for potential problems, errors, or vulnerabilities.
[[Category:Non-test pages]] [[Category:User groups]]

name: Translations:TestWiki:Flooders/1/zh
body: '''机器用户'''（Flooder），有时也称为'''伪机器人'''，在'''Public Test Wiki'''上的用途有限。基本上任何人都可以申请[[$admin|管理员]]权限，该权限除其他功能外，还包含绕过编辑速率限制的能力。但“机器用户”组的设立初衷，是为了针对大量通常无争议、且多为小规模的已记录操作及/或编辑，防止[[$rc|最近更改]]被冲刷。需要注意的是，除非通过API进行编辑，否则这些编辑'''不会'''被标记为 机器人编辑。在Test Wiki上，任何[[$bureaucrat|行政员]]均可将自己或其他用户加入[[$flood|机器用户组]]，用于测试并避免冲刷；但测试结束后，请务必'''''移除'''''该权限。关键在于该权限[[$1|'''必须''']]是临时性的。按照“[[$rot|经验法则]]”，''通常''有效期仅为几小时，但在特殊情况下也''可能''会长达数天。

name: Translations:TestWiki:Flooders/1/zh
body: {{NoteTA/MediaWiki}} '''机器用户'''（Flooder），有时也称为'''伪机器人'''，在'''Public Test Wiki'''上的用途有限。基本上任何人都可以申请[[$admin|管理员]]权限，该权限除其他功能外，还包含绕过编辑速率限制的能力。但“机器用户”组的设立初衷，是为了针对大量通常无争议、且多为小规模的已记录操作及/或编辑，防止[[$rc|最近更改]]被冲刷。需要注意的是，除非通过API进行编辑，否则这些编辑'''不会'''被标记为 机器人编辑。在Test Wiki上，任何[[$bureaucrat|行政员]]均可将自己或其他用户加入[[$flood|机器用户组]]，用于测试并避免冲刷；但测试结束后，请务必'''''移除'''''该权限。关键在于该权限[[$1|'''必须''']]是临时性的。按照“[[$rot|经验法则]]”，''通常''有效期仅为几小时，但在特殊情况下也''可能''会长达数天。
label: Peterxy

name: TestWiki:Flooders/zh
body: {{NoteTA/MediaWiki}} '''机器用户'''（Flooder），有时也称为'''伪机器人'''，在'''Public Test Wiki'''上的用途有限。基本上任何人都可以申请[[TestWiki:Administrators|管理员]]权限，该权限除其他功能外，还包含绕过编辑速率限制的能力。但“机器用户”组的设立初衷，是为了针对大量通常无争议、且多为小规模的已记录操作及/或编辑，防止[[Special:RecentChanges|最近更改]]被冲刷。需要注意的是，除非通过API进行编辑，否则这些编辑'''不会'''被标记为 机器人编辑。在Test Wiki上，任何[[TestWiki:Bureaucrats|行政员]]均可将自己或其他用户加入[[TestWiki:Flooders|机器用户组]]，用于测试并避免冲刷；但测试结束后，请务必'''''移除'''''该权限。关键在于该权限[[rfc:2119|'''必须''']]是临时性的。按照“[[wikt:rule of thumb|经验法则]]”，''通常''有效期仅为几小时，但在特殊情况下也''可能''会长达数天。 机器用户拥有被视为自动化过程的权限 (bot) 要请求操作一个完整的机器人账户，请在此处[[TestWiki:Bot approval requests|这里]]提出请求。任何[[TestWiki:Consuls|执政员]]将审查您的请求的完整性以及您附加的源代码，以检查潜在的问题、错误或漏洞。 [[Category:Non-test pages]] [[Category:User groups]]
label: Peterxy

name: TestWiki:Tech/zh
body:
{{TNT|policy}}
'''Tech''' is a usergroup on Public Test Wiki given to current members of Miraheze’s Technology Team.
==Overview==
The Tech usergroup is given by Consuls to current Miraheze Technology Team members to give direct permission to manage Public Test Wiki’s [[Special:ManageWiki/extensions|extensions]] and [[Special:ManageWiki/settings|settings]] to allow them to easily test various things without explicitly requiring [[TestWiki:Consuls|Consul]] intervention. This usergroup will also allow the Technology Team to self-assign themselves sysop on Public Test Wiki without needing to meet the standard criteria for requesting [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|administrator]].
==Eligibility==
To be granted the Tech usergroup, the user must meet the following criteria: * Must be listed as an official member of the Technology Team, * Must have production level access within the Technology Team, * Will only be granted to the user’s official Miraheze account.
==Revocation==
A user will be removed from the Tech usergroup, if any of the following criteria are met: * Resignation, or removal from the Technology Team, * Loss of production level access within the Technology Team, * By request of the Director of Technology, or the Director of Trust and Safety.
label: Peterxy

{{TNT|Policy}} {{shortcut|TW:A}}
'''Administrators''' are the primary user group for testing the '''administrator''' toolkit. It is granted, upon request (usually at [[TestWiki:Request permissions|Request permissions]]), to users who meet the listed eligibility criterion.
The administrator permission has most of the same user group rights as an administrator on most other projects. Though we use a lot of [[w:WP:COMMONSENSE|common sense]] here and ask that all administrators and registered users do the same, prospective or new administrators are encouraged to read the official policies listed at [[TestWiki:Policies]] (especially [[TestWiki:Main policy]]). In general terms, this means undoing or otherwise reverting any tests you do and performing test blocks on either [[TestWiki:Testing policy#Users you can test on|an approved test account]] or yourself.

name: TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users/zh
body:
'''Autoconfirmed users''' is a user group that is automatically assigned by the [[mw:MediaWiki|MediaWiki]] software to any user account that is at least four (4) days old and has made at least ten (10) ''edits''. It cannot be assigned manually via [[Special:UserRights|Special:UserRights]], and promotions to this user group are not logged. Only the [[User:Abuse filter|abuse filter]] user can revoke [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed]] rights, and only then in exceptional cases which is configured by an abuse filter operator or consul and only temporarily (usually five days).
As a result of a [[mh:meta|Miraheze]]-specific [[phab:T5940|MediaWiki configuration issue]] having to do with [[TestWiki:Users|users]] who were previously either an [[TestWiki:Autopatrolled|autopatrolled]] user or an [[TestWiki:Administrators|administrator]] and subsequently lost that user group saw their edits made while they were a member of either of those user groups became unpatrolled, which thus created an unneeded patrol backlog, a [[Special:Diff/27347|community proposal]] was launched by an active [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats|bureaucrat]] to add the autopatrol user group right to the [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed]] user group indefinitely. It was added indefinitely for two reasons, namely that (a) there was no known date for when the configuration issue/software bug would be fixed and (b) any [[TestWiki:Users|registered user]] who is logged in can request [[TestWiki:Administrators|administrator]] tools.
The following are the user rights included within the [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed]] user group:

[[]] end -- create rejected for i = 1, total - approve do -- total - approve is basically rejected grid = grid .. [[]] end else -- TOTAL VOTES IS MORE THAN 30 -- first, generate the approve square grid = grid .. [[]] -- show the amount of approved votes grid = grid .. [[

]] .. approve .. "

" -- this feels like a fever dream -- second, generate the oppose square grid = grid .. [[]] -- show the amount of oppose votes grid = grid .. [[

]] .. total - approve .. "

" end -- add div for grid grid = grid .. "

" -- closes the center whole = whole.."
" -- adds a breakline at the end -- have to use a custom p tag as mediawiki likes putting the p tag there -- it also ruins the break line whole = whole..[[


]] return whole -- finishes everything end return M -- gives back everything

'''自动确认用户'''是由[[mw:MediaWiki|MediaWiki]]软件为任何至少做出4天且10次''编辑''的用户账号被自动授予的一个用户组。它不能通过[[Special:UserRights|Slecial:UserRights]]进行手动授予以及为未登录用户提升该用户组。仅[[User:Abuse filter|滥用过滤器]]用户能移除[[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|自动确认权限]]，并只在由滥用过滤器操作员或执政员的特殊情况下才会生效，且仅为临时措施（通常为五天）。
As a result of a [[mh:meta|Miraheze]]-specific [[phab:T5940|MediaWiki configuration issue]] having to do with [[TestWiki:Users|users]] who were previously either an [[TestWiki:Autopatrolled|autopatrolled]] user or an [[TestWiki:Administrators|administrator]] and subsequently lost that user group saw their edits made while they were a member of either of those user groups became unpatrolled, which thus created an unneeded patrol backlog, a [[Special:Diff/27347|community proposal]] was launched by an active [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats|bureaucrat]] to add the autopatrol user group right to the [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed]] user group indefinitely. It was added indefinitely for two reasons, namely that (a) there was no known date for when the configuration issue/software bug would be fixed and (b) any [[TestWiki:Users|registered user]] who is logged in can request [[TestWiki:Administrators|administrator]] tools.
The following are the user rights included within the [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed]] user group:
* Create new user accounts (createaccount) * Delete own comments (comment-delete-own) * Edit pages protected as "Allow only autoconfirmed users" (editsemiprotected) * Have one's own edits automatically marked as patrolled (autopatrol) * Not be affected by IP-based rate limits (autoconfirmed) * Perform CAPTCHA-triggering actions without having to go through the CAPTCHA (skipcaptcha) * Propose new OAuth consumers (mwoauthproposeconsumer) * Submit comments (comment) * Update OAuth consumers you control (mwoauthupdateownconsumer)
== See also ==
* [[Special:ListUsers/autoconfirmed|Special:ListUsers/autoconfirmed]], an automatically generated list of all registered users assigned implicitly to the autoconfirmed user group on '''Public Test Wiki''' * [[Special:ListUsers/confirmed]], an automatically generally list of all registered users who have been granted the confirmed user group as they don't otherwise qualify for the [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed]] implicit user group (commonly approved bot accounts and legitimate alternate accounts of existing users)

name: TestWiki:Testing pages/zh
body:
This is a list of already-existing testing pages, which you can use to test specific things. Feel free to create your own testing pages as well, provided you tag them for deletion or delete them later.
'''Please do not test on this page'''.
* [[AutoWikiBrowser test]] - For testing the [[w:Wikipedia:AutoWikiBrowser|AutoWikiBrowser]] * [[Category test]] - For adding and removing categories * [[Comment test]] - For testing the [[mw:Extension:Comments|Comments]] extension by adding new comments, editing one's own existing comments, and removing comments * [[Deletion test]] - Testing [[Special:DeletePage/Deletion test|deleting]] and [[Special:Undelete/Test Delete|undeleting]] of pages * [[Displaytitle test]] - For testing the [[mw:Extension:ParserFunctions|parser function]] {{DISPLAYTITLE}} * [[Abuse filter test]] - For testing [[mw:Extension:AbuseFilter|abuse filters]] ** Abuse filters do not necesarily need to be applied to specific pages, but if possible it would be appreciated to be used to this page only. * [[User:Example]] - For testing block/unblock and user rights management on example user. * [[Merge history test]] - For testing the [[Special:MergeHistory|history merge feature]] * [[Move test]] - For testing the [[Special:MovePage|page move feature]] * [[Redirect test]] - For testing the #REDIRECT (redirecting the page to other pages) * [[Rollback test]] - For testing the Rollback feature * [[Revision deletion test]] - Testing of the [[Special:RevisionDelete|revision deletion]] feature * [[SVG test]] - Description in progress (page won't load) * [[Protection test]] - Testing [[Special:ProtectPage/Protection test|protecting and unprotecting]] of pages * [[test:Create protection test|Create protection test]] - Testing protection on a nonexistent page ("create protection") * [[Translating test]] - Testing the translation tool * [[URL shortener test]] - Testing creation, deletion, and restoration of [[Special:UrlShortener|short URLs]] through [[Special:ManageShortUrls|Special:ManageShortUrls]] * [[Change content model test]] - Testing the [[Special:ChangeContentModel|content model change]] feature
Feel free to create any testing page not on this list if it is deleted later, or do general tests from the [[Sandbox|public sandbox]] or your [[Special:MyPage/Sandbox|private sandbox]]. But participation on the [[Project_talk:Testing pages|talk page]] before creating permanent test pages, while not required, would be appreciated :)
[[Category:Non-test pages{{translation}}]]
label: Peterxy

这是一个已经存在的测试页面列表，你可以用它来测试特定的内容。你也可以自由创建自己的测试页面，但需标记它们以便删除，或者之后将它们删除。 '''请不要在本页面进行测试'''。 * [[AutoWikiBrowser test]] - 测试[[w:Wikipedia:AutoWikiBrowser|自动维基浏览器]] * [[Category test]] - 添加或移除分类 * [[Comment test]] - 通过添加新留言以测试[[mw:Extension:Comments|留言扩展]]，编辑自己现有的留言，并删除留言 * [[Deletion test]] - 测试[[Special:DeletePage/Deletion test|删除]]或者[[Special:Undelete/Test Delete|还原]]页面。 * [[Displaytitle test]] - 测试[[mw:Extension:ParserFunctions|解析器函数]]{{DISPLAYTITLE}} * [[Abuse filter test]] - For testing [[mw:Extension:AbuseFilter|abuse filters]] ** Abuse filters do not necesarily need to be applied to specific pages, but if possible it would be appreciated to be used to this page only. * [[User:Example]] - For testing block/unblock and user rights management on example user. * [[Merge history test]] - For testing the [[Special:MergeHistory|history merge feature]] * [[Move test]] - For testing the [[Special:MovePage|page move feature]] * [[Redirect test]] - For testing the #REDIRECT (redirecting the page to other pages) * [[Rollback test]] - For testing the Rollback feature * [[Revision deletion test]] - Testing of the [[Special:RevisionDelete|revision deletion]] feature * [[SVG test]] - Description in progress (page won't load) * [[Protection test]] - Testing [[Special:ProtectPage/Protection test|protecting and unprotecting]] of pages * [[test:Create protection test|Create protection test]] - Testing protection on a nonexistent page ("create protection") * [[Translating test]] - Testing the translation tool * [[URL shortener test]] - Testing creation, deletion, and restoration of [[Special:UrlShortener|short URLs]] through [[Special:ManageShortUrls|Special:ManageShortUrls]] * [[Change content model test]] - Testing the [[Special:ChangeContentModel|content model change]] feature
Feel free to create any testing page not on this list if it is deleted later, or do general tests from the [[Sandbox|public sandbox]] or your [[Special:MyPage/Sandbox|private sandbox]]. But participation on the [[Project_talk:Testing pages|talk page]] before creating permanent test pages, while not required, would be appreciated :)
[[Category:Non-test pages{{translation}}]]

change_summary: Created page with "测试[[$1|解析器函数]]$code"

这是一个已经存在的测试页面列表，你可以用它来测试特定的内容。你也可以自由创建自己的测试页面，但需标记它们以便删除，或者之后将它们删除。 '''请不要在本页面进行测试'''。 * [[AutoWikiBrowser test]] - 测试[[w:Wikipedia:AutoWikiBrowser|自动维基浏览器]] * [[Category test]] - 添加或移除分类 * [[Comment test]] - 通过添加新留言以测试[[mw:Extension:Comments|留言扩展]]，编辑自己现有的留言，并删除留言 * [[Deletion test]] - 测试[[Special:DeletePage/Deletion test|删除]]或者[[Special:Undelete/Test Delete|还原]]页面。 * [[Displaytitle test]] - 测试[[mw:Extension:ParserFunctions|解析器函数]]{{DISPLAYTITLE}} * [[Abuse filter test]] - 测试[[mw:Extension:AbuseFilter|滥用过滤器]] ** 滥用过滤器不一定需要应用到特定的页面，但如果可能的话，希望只将其应用于此页面。 * [[User:Example]] - For testing block/unblock and user rights management on example user. * [[Merge history test]] - 测试[[Special:MergeHistory|合并历史功能]] * [[Move test]] - 测试[[Special:MovePage|页面移动功能]] * [[Redirect test]] - 测试#REDIRECT（重定向至其它页面） * [[Rollback test]] - 测试回退功能 * [[Revision deletion test]] - 测试[[Special:RevisionDelete|修订版本删除]]功能 * [[SVG test]] - 描述进行中（页面无法加载） * [[Protection test]] - 测试页面[[Special:ProtectPage/Protection test|保护与解除保护]] * [[test:Create protection test|Create protection test]] - Testing protection on a nonexistent page ("create protection") * [[Translating test]] - Testing the translation tool * [[URL shortener test]] - Testing creation, deletion, and restoration of [[Special:UrlShortener|short URLs]] through [[Special:ManageShortUrls|Special:ManageShortUrls]] * [[Change content model test]] - Testing the [[Special:ChangeContentModel|content model change]] feature
Feel free to create any testing page not on this list if it is deleted later, or do general tests from the [[Sandbox|public sandbox]] or your [[Special:MyPage/Sandbox|private sandbox]]. But participation on the [[Project_talk:Testing pages|talk page]] before creating permanent test pages, while not required, would be appreciated :)

name: Module:VotingTest
body:
local M = {}

--- Function to decide what text that is going to be shown on the left side of the text ---
function left_text(first, second, third)
	
	local highest = math.max(first, second, third)
	local h_choice = "" -- high(est) choice
	
	--- Messages per "letter combination" ---
	local messages = {
    	A = "Option 1 accepted",
    	B = "Option 2 accepted",
    	C = "Option 3 accepted",
    	AB = "Tie between option 1 and 2",
    	AC = "Tie between option 1 and 3",
    	BC = "Tie between option 2 and 3",
    	ABC = "Tie between all options",
	}

	--- Quick checks to form a string to check for ties, and to identify the ties itself ---
	if first == highest then h_choice = h_choice .. "A" end -- if true: A else _
	if second == highest then h_choice = h_choice .. "B" end -- if true: B, AB else A,_

* 站点职员将尽最大努力保护您的信息隐私，如果您发现信息在wiki上意外泄露，可请求全球工作人员或本地监督员予以处理。

name: TestWiki:Testing policy/zh
body:
{{TNT|Policy}} 用户可以在此维基上做任何事，只要他们的行为不违反此方针。此测试政策是为了帮助指导社区明确禁止哪些行为而制定的。此政策是测试维基最少数的政策之一，因此请确保你没有违反此政策。 == 请求权限 == 用户可以以[[TestWiki:Request permissions]]自由请求任何可用于测试的权限，并将其用于测试目的。权限请求页面本身提供了可用权限列表。请求权限时，您可能需要提供您在其他项目中持有的其他帐户的信息，但这并不总是必需的。根据经验，我们的目标是授予每个用户他们请求的任何权限。 如果网络中的其他项目存在任何未解决的问题，您可能会在在获得测试权限之前被要求解决这些问题。 如果您已经拥有能够授予其他用户权限的测试权限，请随意授予自己额外的测试权限。请注意，您也可以自由授予其他用户测试权限，但前提是他们在wiki上提出了请求。但是，如果请求有争议，我们要求您将该请求留给项目经理。 == 封禁用户 ==
参见[[TestWiki:Blocking policy|封禁方针]]。
== 可供用户测试的帐户 == 我们已经创建了几个用户账户供您测试。这些用户是： * [[User:Example]] * [[User:Example2]] * [[User:Example3]] * [[User:TestUser (BZPN)|TestUser]] 您可以随意封禁和解封这些账户，以及测试添加和删除权限。然而，在发生了一些涉及Example的事件后，这些账户被锁定以防止恶意破坏。因此，如果您需要一个单独的账号进行测试，建议您[[Special:CreateAccount|创建其他账号]]。 == 编辑与删除页面 == 请随意编辑和删除内容吧！ 但请不要删除本页这类重要页面，也不可删除其他用户的用户页及用户讨论页。 同时，切勿为清空留言而删除自身的用户讨论页，直接清空页面内容即可。 标注分类为[[:Category:Non-test pages|非测试页面]]的页面，禁止用作测试删除对象。 == 非测试页面 == 不可用于测试的页面，均被归入''非测试''分类。顾名思义，请勿在这些页面上进行任何测试操作。 == 行为准则 == 一如既往，请尊重其他用户。骚扰及其他形式的恐吓行为均不被允许，应向执政员或行政员举报。 == 测试后 == 请务必在测试结束后'''[[TestWiki:Revert|回退]]'''你所做的编辑，并标注''测试完成''。 == 运用常识 == 在任何项目中，运用常识都很重要，但在本项目中这一点尤为重要。鉴于本项目的性质，在进行测试时务必运用常识。如果您对本政策或项目本身有任何疑问，欢迎在社区门户发帖，或加入我们在Libera.chat上的IRC频道#miraheze-testwiki。 [[Category:Policies{{#translation:}}]] [[Category:Non-test pages{{#translation:}}]]

name: TestWiki:Inactivity/zh
body:
{{TNT|policy}} *下次移除失效日期： '''2024-04-03''' *下次移除日期： '''2024-04-11'''
For mostly security reasons, if you are '''inactive''' for more than 3 months (meaning that you do not edit or perform a log action in the wiki) any user rights you hold will be removed by a '''[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Consuls|consul]]'''.
For the purposes of ''activity'', [[mw:Extension:StructuredDiscussions|StructuredDiscussions]]-related activity is '''not''' treated as ''activity'', due to the way in which the [[User:Void/findInactiveSysops.js|findInactiveSysops.js]] script works. Similarly, the script will not examine edits deleted by another user. In other words, blanking a page may be treated as a request for deletion by [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|administrators]], so should be avoided.
You can edit or perform some log actions to keep your permissions before the removal. Even if your permissions are removed, you can still request at [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Request permissions|TestWiki:Request permissions]] to regain rights.
A Consul or Bureaucrat must send a notification at least 7 days before rights are removed.
Consuls can use [[github:RhinosF1/PublicTestWiki-Inactive-Auto|Inactive-Auto]] to speed up processing of the inactivity removals.
([https://github.com/RhinosF1/PublicTestWiki-Inactive-Auto/archive/v1.zip download])
==Removal Procedure==
* A Consul or Bureaucrat will run the Inactivity script. * A Consul or Bureaucrat will post a {{tl|InactiveList}} on Community Noticeboard. * A Consul or Bureaucrat will mass message all users with rights to be removed using {{tl|InactiveReminder}}. * A week will be given to reply. * If you do not return to activity or reply otherwise, a consul will remove rights and send a {{tl|Inactivity}}.
[[Category:Policies{{#translation:}}]] [[Category:Non-test pages{{#translation:}}]]

name: TestWiki:Inactivity/zh
body:
{{TNT|policy}} *下次移除失效日期： '''2024-04-03''' *下次移除日期： '''2024-04-11''' 为保证账号安全，如果您连续三个月'''不活跃'''（即未作出任何编辑，也未进行任何日志操作），您的所有权限将被'''[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Consuls|执政员]]'''移除。
For the purposes of ''activity'', [[mw:Extension:StructuredDiscussions|StructuredDiscussions]]-related activity is '''not''' treated as ''activity'', due to the way in which the [[User:Void/findInactiveSysops.js|findInactiveSysops.js]] script works. Similarly, the script will not examine edits deleted by another user. In other words, blanking a page may be treated as a request for deletion by [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|administrators]], so should be avoided.
如果您想保留权限，您可以在除权之前做一笔编辑或操作。不过，即使移除了您的权限，您仍然可以到[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Request permissions|权限申请]]页面申请复原权限。
A Consul or Bureaucrat must send a notification at least 7 days before rights are removed.
Consuls can use [[github:RhinosF1/PublicTestWiki-Inactive-Auto|Inactive-Auto]] to speed up processing of the inactivity removals.
([https://github.com/RhinosF1/PublicTestWiki-Inactive-Auto/archive/v1.zip download])
==Removal Procedure==
* A Consul or Bureaucrat will run the Inactivity script. * A Consul or Bureaucrat will post a {{tl|InactiveList}} on Community Noticeboard. * A Consul or Bureaucrat will mass message all users with rights to be removed using {{tl|InactiveReminder}}. * A week will be given to reply. * If you do not return to activity or reply otherwise, a consul will remove rights and send a {{tl|Inactivity}}.

name: TestWiki:Autopatrolled/zh
body:
'''Autopatrolled''' users on '''Public Test Wiki''' have both the technical ability to [[Special:Log/patrol|patrol]] the edits, or ''revisions'', of other non-administrator users who aren't also members of either the [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Autopatrolled|autopatrolled]] user group or the [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed]] implicit user group, and have their ''own'' revisions automatically marked as ''patrolled''. Patrolling is mostly commonly done by reviewing the unpatrolled edits in the [[Special:NewPages|NewPages]] and [[Special:RecentChanges|RecentChanges]] feeds. On '''Public Test Wiki''', it is rare for this user group right to be granted as any user can [[TestWiki:Request permissions|request]] [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|administrator]] permissions, which also includes the ability to have one's revisions marked as patrolled and patrol other users' revisions.
Where there is a ''need'' for the [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Autopatrolled|autopatrolled]] permission, any [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|administrator]] may grant it, and you can request it by messaging any [https://publictestwiki.com/m/4aM active administrator] on their user talk page or at [[TestWiki:Request permissions|RfP]]. The ''most'' common reason for needing this permission would be a legitimate alternate account of an existing '''Public Test Wiki''' user.
The full list of permissions included in the [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Autopatrolled|autopatrolled]] user group are as follows: * {{int:Right-autopatrol}} (autopatrol) * {{int:Right-patrol}} (patrol) * {{int:Right-skipcaptcha}} (skipcaptcha) * {{int:Right-patrolmarks}} (patrolmarks) n.b. on the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page English Wikipedia], the autopatrol and patrol user permissions are separated into [[w:Wikipedia:Autopatrolled|Autopatrolled]] and [[w:Wikipedia:New pages patrol/Reviewers|New Pages Reviewers]]; however, in the latter case, it only has the ability to patrol [[Special:NewPages|NewPages]]. [[w:Wikipedia:User access levels#Pending changes reviewer|Pending changes reviewers]] have the technical capability to patrol [[Special:RecentChanges|RecentChanges]], except in ''that'' case, only non-autoconfirmed editors' revisions need patrolling.
== List of users with autopatrolled rights ==
The limited number of users (both sysop and non-sysop) with autopatrolled user rights are as follows:

body:
local M = {} --- Function to decide what text that is going to be shown on the left side of the text --- function left_text(first, second, third, highest) local h_choice = "" -- high(est) choice --- Messages per "letter combination" --- local messages = { A = "Option 1 accepted", B = "Option 2 accepted", C = "Option 3 accepted", AB = "Tie between option 1 and 2", AC = "Tie between option 1 and 3", BC = "Tie between option 2 and 3", ABC = "Tie between all options", } --- Quick checks to form a string to check for ties, and to identify the ties itself --- if first == highest then h_choice = h_choice .. "A" end -- if true: A else _ if second == highest then h_choice = h_choice .. "B" end -- if true: B, AB else A,_ if third == highest then h_choice = h_choice .. "C" end -- if true: C, ABC, AC, AB else A, AB, B, _ if messages == "" then return "none of the options have any votes" -- what on earth happened that the proposal got zero votes else return messages[h_choice] -- the text that is going to be shown end end function percentage(first, second, third, highest) local total = first + second + third local percentage if total == 0 then percentage = 0 -- no votes = 0%, also ensure no division by zero else Lua would crash out else local percentage = math.floor((highest / total) * 100 + 0.5) -- round up to the nearest ones, or else it will appear as 33.3333333... end local percentage = tostring(percentage) return percentage .. "%" end function M.main(frame) local getArgs = require("Module:Arguments").getArgs local args = getArgs(frame) local first = tonumber(args[1]) or 0 local second = tonumber(args[2]) or 0 local third = tonumber(args[3]) or 0 --- Step 1: Determine which option has the most amount of votes --- local highest = math.max(first, second, third) --- Step 2: Define the text that will be shown --- --- This has been decided from the left_text() function above --- local text = left_text(first, second, third, highest) -- the text that is going to be shown local percentage = percentage(first, second, third, highest) --- Step 3: Start building the HTML itself --- local whole = [[
]] --- Add the left text first --- local left_text = left_text(first, second, third, highest) local whole = whole .. left_text -- Add the percentage after --- local whole = whole .. "(" .. percentage .. "%)" end return M

local M = {} --- Function to decide what text that is going to be shown on the left side of the text --- function left_text(first, second, third, highest) local h_choice = "" -- high(est) choice --- Messages per "letter combination" --- local messages = { A = "Option 1 accepted", B = "Option 2 accepted", C = "Option 3 accepted", AB = "Tie between option 1 and 2", AC = "Tie between option 1 and 3", BC = "Tie between option 2 and 3", ABC = "Tie between all options", } --- Quick checks to form a string to check for ties, and to identify the ties itself --- if first == highest then h_choice = h_choice .. "A" end -- if true: A else _ if second == highest then h_choice = h_choice .. "B" end -- if true: B, AB else A,_ if third == highest then h_choice = h_choice .. "C" end -- if true: C, ABC, AC, AB else A, AB, B, _ if messages == "" then return "none of the options have any votes" -- what on earth happened that the proposal got zero votes else return messages[h_choice] -- the text that is going to be shown end end function percentage(first, second, third, highest) local total = first + second + third local percentage if total == 0 then percentage = 0 -- no votes = 0%, also ensure no division by zero else Lua would crash out else percentage = math.floor((highest / total) * 100 + 0.5) -- round up to the nearest ones, or else it will appear as 33.3333333... end percentage = tostring(percentage) return percentage .. "%" end function calculate_time(start_date) local deadline = start_date local day, month, year = deadline:match("(%d%d)%-(%d%d)%-(%d%d%d%d)") -- match each variable with a value (%d) start_date = os.time{ day = tonumber(day), month = tonumber(month), year = tonumber(year), hour = 23, min = 59, sec = 59 } deadline = start_date + 7 * 86400 -- user's time + 7 days multiplied with one day local days_left = math.max(0, math.ceil((deadline - os.time()) / 86400)) -- days left before deadline deadline = os.date("%d-%m-%Y", deadline) -- converts deadline which is in Unix timestamp into DD-MM-YYYY format return deadline, days_left end function M.main(frame) local getArgs = require("Module:Arguments").getArgs local args = getArgs(frame) local first = tonumber(args[1]) or 0 local second = tonumber(args[2]) or 0 local third = tonumber(args[3]) or 0 local extension_start_date = tostring(args[4]) or "" --- Step 1: Determine which option has the most amount of votes --- local highest = math.max(first, second, third) --- Step 2: Define the text that will be shown --- --- This has been decided from the left_text() function above --- local text = left_text(first, second, third, highest) -- the text that is going to be shown local percentage = percentage(first, second, third, highest) --- Step 3: Start building the HTML itself --- local whole = [[
]] --- Add the left text first --- local left_text = left_text(first, second, third, highest) local whole = whole .. left_text -- Add the percentage after --- local whole = whole .. "

(" .. percentage .. " Approval)

" -- Is there an extension? -- local extension_text local deadline, days_left = calculate_time(extension_start_date) if extension_start_date == "" then -- no extension :) else extension_text = [[

]] .. "Extension ongoing, " .. days_left .. " days left (" .. deadline .. ")" .. [[

]] end whole = whole .. extension_text --- End Script --- return whole end return M

local M = {} --- Function to decide what text that is going to be shown on the left side of the text --- function left_text(first, second, third, highest) local h_choice = "" -- high(est) choice --- Messages per "letter combination" --- local messages = { A = "Option 1 accepted ", B = "Option 2 accepted ", C = "Option 3 accepted ", AB = "Tie between option 1 and 2 ", AC = "Tie between option 1 and 3 ", BC = "Tie between option 2 and 3 ", ABC = "Tie between all options ", } --- Quick checks to form a string to check for ties, and to identify the ties itself --- if first == highest then h_choice = h_choice .. "A" end -- if true: A else _ if second == highest then h_choice = h_choice .. "B" end -- if true: B, AB else A,_ if third == highest then h_choice = h_choice .. "C" end -- if true: C, ABC, AC, AB else A, AB, B, _ if h_choice == "" then return "none of the options have any votes" -- what on earth happened that the proposal got zero votes else return "

" .. messages[h_choice] .. "

"-- the text that is going to be shown end end function percentage(first, second, third, highest) local total = first + second + third local percentage if total == 0 then percentage = 0 -- no votes = 0%, also ensure no division by zero else Lua would crash out else percentage = math.floor((highest / total) * 100 + 0.5) -- round up to the nearest ones, or else it will appear as 33.3333333... end percentage = tostring(percentage) return percentage .. "%" end function calculate_time(start_date) local deadline = start_date local day, month, year = deadline:match("(%d%d)%-(%d%d)%-(%d%d%d%d)") -- match each variable with a value (%d) if not day then -- if day doesn't exist then return nil return nil, nil end start_date = os.time{ day = tonumber(day), month = tonumber(month), year = tonumber(year), hour = 23, min = 59, sec = 59 } deadline = start_date + 7 * 86400 -- user's time + 7 days multiplied with one day local days_left = math.max(0, math.ceil((deadline - os.time()) / 86400)) -- days left before deadline deadline = os.date("%d-%m-%Y", deadline) -- converts deadline which is in Unix timestamp into DD-MM-YYYY format return deadline, days_left end function build_square(total,o1,o2,o3) -- o1 is option 1, o2 is option 2 and o3 is option 3. -- create the thing that contains the grid itself local grid = [[
]] -- add the text itself grid = grid .. [[Total Votes:]] if total <= 30 then -- create option 1 first for i = 1, o1 do grid = grid .. [[]] end -- create option 2 second for i = 1, o2 do grid = grid .. [[]] end -- create option 3 last for i = 1, o3 do grid = grid .. [[]] end else -- TOTAL VOTES IS MORE THAN 30 -- first, generate the o1 square grid = grid .. [[]] -- show the amount of o1 votes grid = grid .. [[

]] .. o1 .. "

" -- second, generate the o2 square grid = grid .. [[]] -- show the amount of o2 votes grid = grid .. [[

]] .. o2 .. "

" -- last, generate the o3 square grid = grid .. [[]] -- show the amount of o3 votes grid = grid .. [[

]] .. o3 .. "

" end grid = grid .. "
" -- close the div return grid end function M.main(frame) local getArgs = require("Module:Arguments").getArgs local args = getArgs(frame) local first = tonumber(args[1]) or 0 local second = tonumber(args[2]) or 0 local third = tonumber(args[3]) or 0 local extension_start_date = args[4] or nil --- Step 1: Determine which option has the most amount of votes --- local highest = math.max(first, second, third) --- Step 2: Define the text that will be shown --- --- This has been decided from the left_text() function above --- local text = left_text(first, second, third, highest) -- the text that is going to be shown local percentage = percentage(first, second, third, highest) --- Step 3: Start building the HTML itself --- local whole = [[
]] -- add text (left text) and percentage together in the same div local whole = whole .. [[
]] .. text .. " (" .. percentage .. ") Approval" .. "
" -- Is there an extension? -- if extension_start_date and extension_start_date ~= "" then -- it exists local extension_text = "" local deadline, days_left = calculate_time(extension_start_date) local extension_text = [[
]] .. "Extension ongoing, " .. days_left .. " days left (" .. deadline .. ")" .. [[
]] whole = whole .. extension_text else -- no extension, idk what to put here end --- End Script --- whole = whole .. "
" .. "
" -- closes the start tags return whole end return M

Formatting ! Usage ! To create a table in a TestWiki article, follow these steps: * Start the table with the opening tag {|. * Define the structure of the table by adding rows and columns using the following format: {| class="wikitable" |- ! Header 1 ! They can be used for various purposes, such as displaying information boxes, navigation bars, or citation templates. To use a template, simply insert its name surrounded by double curly brackets. '''自动确认用户'''是由[[mw:MediaWiki|MediaWiki]]软件为任何至少做出4天且10次''编辑''的用户账号被自动授予的一个用户组。它不能通过[[Special:UserRights|Slecial:UserRights]]进行手动授予以及为未登录用户提升该用户组。仅[[User:Abuse filter|滥用过滤器]]用户能移除[[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|自动确认权限]]，并只在由滥用过滤器操作员或执政员的特殊情况下才会生效，且仅为临时措施（通常为五天）。 由于一个特定于[[mh:meta|Miraheze]]的[[phab:T5940|MediaWiki配置问题]]，此前是[[TestWiki:Autopatrolled|巡查豁免者]]或 [[TestWiki:Administrators|管理员]]但随后失去了该用户组的 [[TestWiki:Users|用户]]，其在属于这两个用户组期间所做的编辑变成了未巡查状态，从而造成了不必要的巡查积压。为此，一位活跃的[[TestWiki:Bureaucrats|行政员]]发起了一项[[Special:Diff/27347|社区提案]]，将autopatrol用户组权限无限期地赋予[[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|自动确认用户]]组。无限期添加的原因有两个，即：（a）该配置问题/软件漏洞的修复日期尚不明确；（b）任何已登录的[[TestWiki:Users|注册用户]]都可以申请[[TestWiki:Administrators|管理员]]工具。
The following are the user rights included within the [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed]] user group:
* Create new user accounts (createaccount) * Delete own comments (comment-delete-own) * Edit pages protected as "Allow only autoconfirmed users" (editsemiprotected) * Have one's own edits automatically marked as patrolled (autopatrol) * Not be affected by IP-based rate limits (autoconfirmed) * Perform CAPTCHA-triggering actions without having to go through the CAPTCHA (skipcaptcha) * Propose new OAuth consumers (mwoauthproposeconsumer) * Submit comments (comment) * Update OAuth consumers you control (mwoauthupdateownconsumer)
==参见==
* [[Special:ListUsers/autoconfirmed|Special:ListUsers/autoconfirmed]], an automatically generated list of all registered users assigned implicitly to the autoconfirmed user group on '''Public Test Wiki''' * [[Special:ListUsers/confirmed]], an automatically generally list of all registered users who have been granted the confirmed user group as they don't otherwise qualify for the [[TestWiki:Autoconfirmed users|autoconfirmed]] implicit user group (commonly approved bot accounts and legitimate alternate accounts of existing users)

name: TestWiki:Bureaucrats/zh
body:
{{TNT|Policy}} {{shortcut|TW:B}}
'''Bureaucrat''' is a non-testing permission that allows users to add [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|administrator]], and [[TestWiki:Flooders|flooder]] permissions to other accounts. The '''bureaucrat''' permission is not easy to obtain as it is not a testing permission, and works closely with [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Consuls|Consuls]] to assist with administration of TestWiki.
== Eligibility ==
To obtain the '''bureaucrat''' permission, you must:
*Be a [[TestWiki:Users|registered user]] for at least '''three (3) months''' who has made at least '''two hundred (200) global edits''' (may include local edits)
*Pass a Request for Permission on the [[TestWiki:Community portal|community portal]] by community consensus
*Be '''trusted''' by the community
*Have '''no recent sanctions/blocks locally and/or recent global locks'''
== Revocation ==
Bureaucrats are subject to Consul oversight, and therefore this right may be revoked at any point at a Consul's discretion. Furthermore, the community may request revocation with overwhelming community consensus, with a minimum requirement of 6 votes on the community portal.
== Responsibilities ==
Bureaucrats will be responsible for:
*Handling [[TestWiki:Request permissions|permission requests]] for [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|administrator]] permissions.
*Handling obvious violations of [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Policies|TestWiki policies]]; these are subject to Consul review and/or modification.
*Handling initial appeals submitted by users whom a bureaucrat has blocked; subsequent appeals by the same user will be reviewed by a Consul.
*Handling general housekeeping and clean up throughout TestWiki.
*Create, and modify [[Special:AbuseFilter|abuse filters]] as needed.
*Prepare and send out [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Inactivity|inactivity notices]] on behalf of the Consuls; removals are still handled by Consuls.
In the event of an absence of active Consuls in an urgent situation, bureaucrats may take action to mitigate potential damage/abuse, with such actions being subject to Consul review at a later time. The above listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and may be subject to change at the discretion of a Consul.
== User Group Rights ==
Bureaucrats' user group rights are as follows:
* {{int:Right-bureaucrat}} (bureaucrat) * {{int:Right-editbureaucratprotected}} (editbureaucratprotected) * {{int:Right-massmessage}} (massmessage) * {{int:Right-noratelimit}} (noratelimit) * {{int:Right-nuke}} (nuke) * {{int:Right-globalblock-whitelist}} (globalblock-whitelist) * {{int:Right-override-antispoof}} (override-antispoof) * {{int:Right-move-rootuserpages}} (rootuserpages) * {{int:Right-torunblocked}} (torunblocked) * {{int:Right-editsitecss}} (editsitecss) * {{int:Right-editsitejson}} (editsitejson) * {{int:Right-editsitejs}} (editsitejs) * {{int:Right-editusercss}} (editusercss) * {{int:Right-edituserjson}} (edituserjson) * {{int:Right-edituserjs}} (edituserjs) * {{int:Right-editinterface}} (editinterface) * {{int:Right-tboverride}} (tboverride) * Add groups: [[TestWiki:Administrators|Administrators]], [[TestWiki:Testgroup|Testgroup]], [[TestWiki:Tor users|Tor users]] and [[TestWiki:Flooders|Flooders]] * Remove groups: [[TestWiki:Administrators|Administrators]], [[TestWiki:Testgroup|Testgroup]], [[TestWiki:Tor users|Tor users]] and [[TestWiki:Flooders|Flooders]] * Remove group from own account: [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats|Bureaucrats]]
== List of bureaucrats ==
There are currently '''{{NUMBERINGROUP:bureaucrat}}''' bureaucrats on TestWiki.
{{Special:listusers/bureaucrat}}
== Previous Non-Test Bureaucrats == Due to the change from being a testing permission to being a non-test permission, users who had previously held this right will have it revoked. However, Consuls at their discretion may allow certain users to retain the right, as long as said user meets the account age, and edit count requirements listed in the eligibility criterion, retention is at the sole discretion of Consuls, and may not be requested.
{{User groups}} [[Category:Non-test pages]] [[Category:User groups]]
