name: TestWiki:Bureaucrats/zh
body:
{{TNT|Policy}} {{shortcut|TW:B}} '''行政员'''是一项非测试性权限，允许用户添加[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|管理员]]和[[TestWiki:Flooders|机器用户]]权限至其它账户。'''行政员'''权限并不容易获得，因为它并不是一项测试权限，而是需要与[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Consuls|执政员]]密切协作，协助管理TestWiki。 == 资格标准 == 要获得'''行政员'''权限，你必须：
*Be a [[TestWiki:Users|registered user]] for at least '''three (3) months''' who has made at least '''two hundred (200) global edits''' (may include local edits)
*Pass a Request for Permission on the [[TestWiki:Community portal|community portal]] by community consensus
*Be '''trusted''' by the community
*Have '''no recent sanctions/blocks locally and/or recent global locks'''
== Revocation ==
Bureaucrats are subject to Consul oversight, and therefore this right may be revoked at any point at a Consul's discretion. Furthermore, the community may request revocation with overwhelming community consensus, with a minimum requirement of 6 votes on the community portal.
== Responsibilities ==
Bureaucrats will be responsible for:
*Handling [[TestWiki:Request permissions|permission requests]] for [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|administrator]] permissions.
*Handling obvious violations of [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Policies|TestWiki policies]]; these are subject to Consul review and/or modification.
*Handling initial appeals submitted by users whom a bureaucrat has blocked; subsequent appeals by the same user will be reviewed by a Consul.
*Handling general housekeeping and clean up throughout TestWiki.
*Create, and modify [[Special:AbuseFilter|abuse filters]] as needed.
*Prepare and send out [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Inactivity|inactivity notices]] on behalf of the Consuls; removals are still handled by Consuls.
In the event of an absence of active Consuls in an urgent situation, bureaucrats may take action to mitigate potential damage/abuse, with such actions being subject to Consul review at a later time. The above listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and may be subject to change at the discretion of a Consul.
== User Group Rights ==
Bureaucrats' user group rights are as follows:
* {{int:Right-bureaucrat}} (bureaucrat) * {{int:Right-editbureaucratprotected}} (editbureaucratprotected) * {{int:Right-massmessage}} (massmessage) * {{int:Right-noratelimit}} (noratelimit) * {{int:Right-nuke}} (nuke) * {{int:Right-globalblock-whitelist}} (globalblock-whitelist) * {{int:Right-override-antispoof}} (override-antispoof) * {{int:Right-move-rootuserpages}} (rootuserpages) * {{int:Right-torunblocked}} (torunblocked) * {{int:Right-editsitecss}} (editsitecss) * {{int:Right-editsitejson}} (editsitejson) * {{int:Right-editsitejs}} (editsitejs) * {{int:Right-editusercss}} (editusercss) * {{int:Right-edituserjson}} (edituserjson) * {{int:Right-edituserjs}} (edituserjs) * {{int:Right-editinterface}} (editinterface) * {{int:Right-tboverride}} (tboverride) * Add groups: [[TestWiki:Administrators|Administrators]], [[TestWiki:Testgroup|Testgroup]], [[TestWiki:Tor users|Tor users]] and [[TestWiki:Flooders|Flooders]] * Remove groups: [[TestWiki:Administrators|Administrators]], [[TestWiki:Testgroup|Testgroup]], [[TestWiki:Tor users|Tor users]] and [[TestWiki:Flooders|Flooders]] * Remove group from own account: [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats|Bureaucrats]]
== List of bureaucrats ==
There are currently '''{{NUMBERINGROUP:bureaucrat}}''' bureaucrats on TestWiki.
{{Special:listusers/bureaucrat}}
== Previous Non-Test Bureaucrats == Due to the change from being a testing permission to being a non-test permission, users who had previously held this right will have it revoked. However, Consuls at their discretion may allow certain users to retain the right, as long as said user meets the account age, and edit count requirements listed in the eligibility criterion, retention is at the sole discretion of Consuls, and may not be requested.
{{User groups}} [[Category:Non-test pages]] [[Category:User groups]]

Bureaucrats will be responsible for:
*Handling [[TestWiki:Request permissions|permission requests]] for [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|administrator]] permissions.

*Handling initial appeals submitted by users whom a bureaucrat has blocked; subsequent appeals by the same user will be reviewed by a Consul.
*Handling general housekeeping and clean up throughout TestWiki.
*Create, and modify [[Special:AbuseFilter|abuse filters]] as needed.
*Prepare and send out [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Inactivity|inactivity notices]] on behalf of the Consuls; removals are still handled by Consuls.
In the event of an absence of active Consuls in an urgent situation, bureaucrats may take action to mitigate potential damage/abuse, with such actions being subject to Consul review at a later time. name: TestWiki:Bureaucrats/zh
body:
{{TNT|Policy}} {{shortcut|TW:B}} '''行政员'''是一项非测试性权限，允许用户添加[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|管理员]]和[[TestWiki:Flooders|机器用户]]权限至其它账户。'''行政员'''权限并不容易获得，因为它并不是一项测试权限，而是需要与[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Consuls|执政员]]密切协作，协助管理TestWiki。 == 资格标准 == 要获得'''行政员'''权限，你必须： * 已成为[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Users|注册用户]]至少'''三个月'''，同时在全域范围内至少做出了'''两百次'''编辑（可能包含本地编辑） * 在[[TestWiki:Community portal|社区门户]]提交权限申请并获得社群共识。 * 受社群信任 * '''近期未受到本地封禁，且无全域锁定记录''' == 除权 == 行政员受执政官监督，因此这项权利可由执政官随时自行决定予以撤销。此外，在获得压倒性社区共识（即社区门户上至少6票）的情况下，社区也可以要求撤销此权利。 == 职责 == 行政员有责任： * 处理[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|管理员]]的[[TestWiki:Request permissions|权限申请]] *处理明显的[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Policies|TestWiki政策]]违规；这些处理需经执政员审查和/或修改。 *处理被行政员封禁的用户提交的首次申诉；同一用户的后续申诉将由执政员审查。
*Handling general housekeeping and clean up throughout TestWiki.
*Create, and modify [[Special:AbuseFilter|abuse filters]] as needed.
*Prepare and send out [[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Inactivity|inactivity notices]] on behalf of the Consuls; removals are still handled by Consuls.
In the event of an absence of active Consuls in an urgent situation, bureaucrats may take action to mitigate potential damage/abuse, with such actions being subject to Consul review at a later time. The above listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and may be subject to change at the discretion of a Consul.
== User Group Rights ==
Bureaucrats' user group rights are as follows:
* {{int:Right-bureaucrat}} (bureaucrat) * {{int:Right-editbureaucratprotected}} (editbureaucratprotected) * {{int:Right-massmessage}} (massmessage) * {{int:Right-noratelimit}} (noratelimit) * {{int:Right-nuke}} (nuke) * {{int:Right-globalblock-whitelist}} (globalblock-whitelist) * {{int:Right-override-antispoof}} (override-antispoof) * {{int:Right-move-rootuserpages}} (rootuserpages) * {{int:Right-torunblocked}} (torunblocked) * {{int:Right-editsitecss}} (editsitecss) * {{int:Right-editsitejson}} (editsitejson) * {{int:Right-editsitejs}} (editsitejs) * {{int:Right-editusercss}} (editusercss) * {{int:Right-edituserjson}} (edituserjson) * {{int:Right-edituserjs}} (edituserjs) * {{int:Right-editinterface}} (editinterface) * {{int:Right-tboverride}} (tboverride) * Add groups: [[TestWiki:Administrators|Administrators]], [[TestWiki:Testgroup|Testgroup]], [[TestWiki:Tor users|Tor users]] and [[TestWiki:Flooders|Flooders]] * Remove groups: [[TestWiki:Administrators|Administrators]], [[TestWiki:Testgroup|Testgroup]], [[TestWiki:Tor users|Tor users]] and [[TestWiki:Flooders|Flooders]] * Remove group from own account: [[TestWiki:Bureaucrats|Bureaucrats]]
== List of bureaucrats ==
There are currently '''{{NUMBERINGROUP:bureaucrat}}''' bureaucrats on TestWiki.
{{Special:listusers/bureaucrat}}
== Previous Non-Test Bureaucrats == Due to the change from being a testing permission to being a non-test permission, users who had previously held this right will have it revoked. However, Consuls at their discretion may allow certain users to retain the right, as long as said user meets the account age, and edit count requirements listed in the eligibility criterion, retention is at the sole discretion of Consuls, and may not be requested.
{{User groups}} [[Category:Non-test pages]] [[Category:User groups]]

== Proposal to modify user rights for bureaucrats and consuls ==

Currently, bureaucrats can remove the bureaucrat right from their own account, and consuls have the ability, among the listed user groups to grant and remove, to remove the consul user group from their own account and add and remove interface administrator from their own account as well, even though they can grant and remove the latter user group.

I would like to propose that bureaucrats may no longer remove the bureaucrat user group from their own account, and that consuls may no longer remove the consul user group from their own account, nor can they add and remove the interface administrator permission from their own account (as consuls can already grant and remove IA, doing that for one's own account is redundant).

In addition to the above, because bureaucrat and consul permissions are non-testing permissions, perhaps we might consider adding most/all bureaucrat user rights to the consul user group? I would arguably consider consuls to be the non-testing bureaucrats of this wiki.

Thoughts? [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 14:14, 7 June 2026 (UTC)
: One more thing to note, consuls do not need to assign themselves the interface administrator user group as they can already edit all CSS/JS/JSON/interface pages. [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 14:39, 7 June 2026 (UTC)
:I'm curious, what is the problem with crat and consul from removing the said groups from their own account? I'd say it makes resigning process easier and does not require another volunteer to action it. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 15:31, 7 June 2026 (UTC)

== Temporary protection reduction request of [[TestWiki]] (main page) ==

Can a consul temporarily reduce the protection of [[TestWiki]]? I am going to perform a dark mode change using TemplateStyles. Thank you. [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 15:22, 7 June 2026 (UTC)

== Request for Bureaucrat ==

Hi, I want to translate my gadget and handle permission requests for administrator permissions. Please graduate for me, thank you. [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy|talk]]) 04:27, 9 July 2026 (UTC)

[[File:OOjs UI icon userGroup-ltr.svg|40px|link=]] テストウィキのメリット

テストウィキは、MediaWikiの様々な観点をテストできるリラックスした環境を提供します。参加する理由をいくつか考えてみましょう。: *

[[File:OOjs UI icon lightbulb.svg|40px|link=]] いくつかの注意すべき点

テストしている際は、いくつかの単純なルールを念頭に置くようにしてください。これらのルールは、コミュニティを友好的で楽しめる場にし続けることを助けるものです。
*
編集は、他の利用者の編集に干渉しないようにしてください。
* テストが終了したら、そのテストを差し戻しまたは削除して元の状態に戻して下さい。 * 何かが許されているか判断する際は、[[w:WP:COMMONSENSE|常識的に]]考えてください。
これは、テストの方針の短縮版で、ここで認められていることや認められていないことについてのガイドラインです。疑問があれば、コミュニティポータルでお尋ねになる前に、正式版の[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Testing policy|テストの方針]]をお読みください。

[[File:OOjs UI icon referenceExisting-ltr.svg|40px|link=]] 何をテストできる?

*
ご自身の編集と、他の利用者の編集が干渉しないようにしてください。

name: Example article
body:
{{Infobox | title = '''Example article''' | image = [[File:Add more text icon.svg|100px]] | caption = ''This is a test article for experimenting with TestWiki features.''
'''Please clean up after yourself once testing is complete.'''
Last edit was made by: [[Special:Contributions/{{REVISIONUSER}}|{{REVISIONUSER}}]] }} '''Example Article''' is a demonstration page created for testing various features and functionalities on TestWiki. This test article serves as a sandbox for experimenting with various TestWiki features and functionalities. Feel free to edit and contribute to this page for testing purposes.Example reference == Formatting Text == You can apply different formatting styles to text in TestWiki articles. {| class="wikitable" |- ! Formatting ! Usage ! Effect |- | Italic text | ''Italic text'' | ''Italic text'' |- | Bold text | '''Bold text''' | '''Bold text''' |- | Bold italic text | '''''Bold italic text''''' | '''''Bold italic text''''' |- | Strikethrough text | Strikethrough text | Strikethrough text |- | Underlined text | Underlined text | Underlined text |- | Superscript text | Superscript text | Superscript text |- | Subscript text | Subscript text | Subscript text |- | Colored text | Colored text | Colored text |} ''Note: The tags are used to display the wiki markup in the table. They are not necessary when actually applying the formatting in a TestWiki article.'' == Headings == Headings help organize content into sections. They can be created using equal signs (=). For example: === Subheading === ==== Subsubheading ==== == Images == [[File:Mirahezetestwiki.png|thumb|left|200px|This is a test image for the test article.]] Images can be added to TestWiki articles to provide visual context or illustrate key pointsExample reference. {{clear}} A section meant for display of multiple images can be inserted using the tag. Mirahezetestwiki.png|Test image with a test caption. HotCat.svg|Another image with a caption. Rollback gadget.png|Ditto. == Tables == Tables are a useful way to organize and present data in a structured format. To create a table in a TestWiki article, follow these steps: * Start the table with the opening tag {|. * Define the structure of the table by adding rows and columns using the following format: {| class="wikitable" |- ! Header 1 ! Header 2 |- | Row 1, Column 1 | Row 1, Column 2 |- | Row 2, Column 1 | Row 2, Column 2 |} * Customize the appearance of the table by adding attributes to the opening tag, such as class="wikitable" for a standard table or style="border: 1px solid black;" to add a border. * Add content to the cells by inserting text or other elements between the table row and column tags (| and |-). * Close the table with the closing tag |}. '''Here's an example of a simple table:''' {| class="wikitable" |- ! Fruit ! Quantity |- | Apple | 3 |- | Banana | 5 |- | Orange | 4 |} == Templates == Templates are a powerful feature of TestWiki that allows for the inclusion of reusable content in articles. They can be used for various purposes, such as displaying information boxes, navigation bars, or citation templates. To use a template, simply insert its name surrounded by double curly brackets. For example, to include a citation template, use {{Template}}. == See also == * [[Sandbox]] * [[Template:Example|Example template]] == References == [[Category:Special test pages]]

テストウィキは、MediaWikiの様々な観点をテストできるリラックスした環境を提供します。参加する理由をいくつか考えてみましょう。: *
テストできる[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|管理者]]ツール。
*数十の拡張機能や外装のテスト *体験で学ぶことができ、過ちが罰せられない環境。 *あなたのテスト体験を通じて、あなたにアドバイスし、支援することができる、有益な利用者達 *テストできる最新バージョンのMediaWiki。 *
ミラヘゼ Miraheze ネットワークの強みは[[m:Special:MyLanguage/Single user login|Miraheze のどのウィキにもご自身のアカウントを使える]]ことも含まれます。
| style="height:10px" | | class="shortcut" style="border-top: 4px solid #6F6F6F; background-color: #F6F6F6; padding: 5px 15px 10px 15px; vertical-align:top; width: 50%; display: revert !important;" |

[[File:OOjs UI icon lightbulb.svg|40px|link=]] いくつかの注意すべき点

テストウィキはリラックスしたテスト用の空間ではありますが、同時にいくつかの単純なルールを念頭に置くようにしてください。これらのルールがあるから、友好的で楽しめるコミュニティの維持できます。
*
ご自身の編集と、他の利用者の編集が干渉しないようにしてください。
* テストが終了したら、そのテストを差し戻しまたは削除して元の状態に戻して下さい。 * 何かが許されているか判断する際は、[[w:WP:COMMONSENSE|常識的に]]考えてください。
この空間で認められていることに疑問があれば、コミュニティポータルでお尋ねになる前に、[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Testing policy|テストの方針]]をお読みください。
|} {| | style="height:10px" | |- | class="shortcut" style="border-top: 4px solid #180F67; background-color: #F7F6FF; padding: 5px 15px 10px 15px; vertical-align: top; width: 50%; display: revert !important;" |

[[File:OOjs UI icon referenceExisting-ltr.svg|40px|link=]] 何をテストできる?

TestWikiでは、幅広いテスト項目を提供しています! TestWikiで何ができるか考えてみましょう: *
[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|管理者]]の権限とツール。
*新規作成できるページとすでに作成されている[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Testing pages|テストページ]] *制限なくテストできる拡張機能とスキンが多数あります。 *CSSとスクリプトをあなたのアカウントで試す | style="height:10px" | | class="shortcut" style="border-top: 4px solid #67440F; background-color: #FFF2F6; padding: 5px 15px 10px 15px; vertical-align: top; width: 50%; display: revert !important;" |

[[File:Info black.png|40px|link=]] 私達について

'''テストウィキ'''（TestWiki）は利用者にとって、[[mw:MediaWiki|MediaWiki]]ソフトウェアから提供される[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Administrators|管理者]]用の権限やテンプレート、拡張機能及びその他の機能を実験する環境プロジェクトです。ここでは権限を認める前提条件として、他のプロジェクトでの"確認編集"を求めたりしません。
本ウィキはテストウィキであるとはいえ、やはり方針は存在します。[[Special:MyLanguage/TestWiki:Policies|TestWiki:Policies]]をご参照ください。
|} [[Category:Public Test Wiki]] [[Category:Non-test pages]]

= 大语言模型（LLM）行业动态与性能综述（2026年8月） =

截至2026年8月，大语言模型行业正处于“密集发布”与“激烈竞争”的阶段。仅在过去一个月内，就有9款旗舰模型扎堆发布。“最强模型”的宝座更迭频繁，头部模型之间的性能差距正在显著缩小。

== 行业趋势：竞争维度的转变 ==

=== “月抛”时代的来临 ===

模型更新迭代速度极快，厂商不再仅仅追求单一维度的绝对领先，而是围绕代码能力、智能体（Agent）水平、特定任务与成本控制等不同方向寻找差异化优势。

· 代码能力：成为最核心的争夺点之一。例如，月之暗面的Kimi K3在前端编程榜单中已排名第一，超过了GPT-5.6 Sol和Claude Fable 5。
· 智能体（Agent）：被视为下一个关键方向。模型需要能自主规划、使用工具（如浏览器、终端）并完成复杂任务。
· 成本竞争：价格战激烈。例如，OpenAI将GPT-5.6 Luna价格下调80%；DeepSeek V4 Flash执行复杂任务成本可低至$0.03，远低于Claude Fable 5的$3.15。

=== 开源模型的崛起 ===

开源模型正在进入第一梯队，开始在某些场景与闭源模型直接竞争。中国厂商在开源生态中表现尤为突出，在全球最大AI开源社区Hugging Face上，我国开源模型累计下载量居全球首位。多达80%的美国AI初创公司在融资路演时会使用中国开源模型。

== 主要模型动态与性能对比 ==

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! 模型 !! 开发商 !! 关键动态与特性（截至2026年8月） !! 参考价格（每百万tokens）
|-
| Qwen3.8-Max || 阿里巴巴 || 参数规模达2.4万亿。在Arena综合榜空降第5，ELO得分1496。性能对标Anthropic Fable 5。 || 输入$2 / 输出$6
|-
| Claude Sonnet 5 || Anthropic || 2026年6月30日发布。最具“智能体”能力的Sonnet模型。性能接近Opus 4.8。 || 优惠价：输入$2 / 输出$10（持续至8月31日）
|-
| Claude Fable 5 || Anthropic || Arena综合榜榜首，ELO得分1509。在数学（97.6分）、多模态（92.9分）等测试中表现卓越。 || 输入$10 / 输出$50
|-
| GPT-4o || OpenAI || 2026年7月有性能增强版本发布。在多语言对话、音频和视觉方面创下新基准。 || 输入$2.50 / 输出$10.00
|-
| Gemini 1.5 Pro || Google || 2024年发布，基于MoE架构。官方已建议升级到更新的Gemini模型，并计划于2025年9月29日弃用。 || -
|-
| Mistral Large 3 || Mistral AI || 多模态MoE模型，总参数量675B，激活参数41B。从零开始使用3000块H200训练。 || -
|}

=== 值得注意的新玩家 ===

· 小米 (Xiaomi)：其MiMo-V2.5模型在2026年4月公测，单周调用量达10.5万亿Tokens，登顶OpenRouter平台周榜和月榜第一。
· DeepSeek：V4-Flash版本回归，以极低成本提供高性能。
· 腾讯 (Tencent)：混元Hy3于7月6日开源，单周环比增幅超999%。

== 挑战与展望 ==

· 性能与安全的平衡：模型能力提升也带来风险。报告显示2025年AI驱动的网络攻击事件同比增长89%。
· 智能体（Agent）的成熟度：Agent被认为是未来方向，但目前在实际工作中仍不成熟，存在任务调度能力弱、Token消耗大等问题。
· 可持续的商业模式：在激烈的价格战和高昂的研发成本下，找到可持续的商业模式是所有厂商面临的共同挑战。

{{/header}} [[Category:Non-test pages]]

== Proposal to modify user rights for bureaucrats and consuls ==

Currently, bureaucrats can remove the bureaucrat right from their own account, and consuls have the ability, among the listed user groups to grant and remove, to remove the consul user group from their own account and add and remove interface administrator from their own account as well, even though they can grant and remove the latter user group.

I would like to propose that bureaucrats may no longer remove the bureaucrat user group from their own account, and that consuls may no longer remove the consul user group from their own account, nor can they add and remove the interface administrator permission from their own account (as consuls can already grant and remove IA, doing that for one's own account is redundant).

In addition to the above, because bureaucrat and consul permissions are non-testing permissions, perhaps we might consider adding most/all bureaucrat user rights to the consul user group? I would arguably consider consuls to be the non-testing bureaucrats of this wiki.

Thoughts? [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 14:14, 7 June 2026 (UTC)
: One more thing to note, consuls do not need to assign themselves the interface administrator user group as they can already edit all CSS/JS/JSON/interface pages. [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 14:39, 7 June 2026 (UTC)
:I'm curious, what is the problem with crat and consul from removing the said groups from their own account? I'd say it makes resigning process easier and does not require another volunteer to action it. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 15:31, 7 June 2026 (UTC)

== Temporary protection reduction request of [[TestWiki]] (main page) ==

Can a consul temporarily reduce the protection of [[TestWiki]]? I am going to perform a dark mode change using TemplateStyles. Thank you. [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 15:22, 7 June 2026 (UTC)

== Request for Bureaucrat ==
{{discussion top|Withdrawn. <!-- Template:Unsigned --><small class="autosigned">— Preceding [[Wikipedia:Project:Signatures|unsigned]] comment {{#if:|[[Special:Diff/|added]]|added}} by [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy#top|talk]] • [[Special:Contributions/Peterxy|contribs]]) 06:09, 9 July 2026 (UTC)</small>}}
Hi, I want to translate my gadget and handle permission requests for administrator permissions. Please graduate for me, thank you. [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy|talk]]) 04:27, 9 July 2026 (UTC)

:Right now the backlog of admin requests is not serious and translating gadgets don’t need bureaucrat rights. Therefore I {{oppose}} this request. [[User:PB2008|PB2008]] ([[User talk:PB2008|talk]]) 05:34, 9 July 2026 (UTC)
:Sorry, I'll {{withdrawn}} <!-- Template:Unsigned --><small class="autosigned">— Preceding [[Wikipedia:Project:Signatures|unsigned]] comment {{#if:|[[Special:Diff/|added]]|added}} by [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy#top|talk]] • [[Special:Contributions/Peterxy|contribs]]) 06:09, 9 July 2026 (UTC)</small>
{{Discussion bottom}}

== Bot vs. flooder ==

I notice that Consuls are responsible for appointing bot accounts, while Bureaucrats are able to appoint flooder. Is there any meaningful difference between the bot and flooder roles, in terms of what damage can be done? If not, wouldn't it make more sense to have the flooder role be appointed by Consuls? [[User:Harej|Harej]] ([[User talk:Harej|talk]]) 04:07, 9 August 2026 (UTC)

body: {{/header}} [[Category:Non-test pages]] {{clear}} == Proposal to modify user rights for bureaucrats and consuls == Currently, bureaucrats can remove the bureaucrat right from their own account, and consuls have the ability, among the listed user groups to grant and remove, to remove the consul user group from their own account and add and remove interface administrator from their own account as well, even though they can grant and remove the latter user group. I would like to propose that bureaucrats may no longer remove the bureaucrat user group from their own account, and that consuls may no longer remove the consul user group from their own account, nor can they add and remove the interface administrator permission from their own account (as consuls can already grant and remove IA, doing that for one's own account is redundant). In addition to the above, because bureaucrat and consul permissions are non-testing permissions, perhaps we might consider adding most/all bureaucrat user rights to the consul user group? I would arguably consider consuls to be the non-testing bureaucrats of this wiki. Thoughts? [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 14:14, 7 June 2026 (UTC) : One more thing to note, consuls do not need to assign themselves the interface administrator user group as they can already edit all CSS/JS/JSON/interface pages. [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 14:39, 7 June 2026 (UTC) :I'm curious, what is the problem with crat and consul from removing the said groups from their own account? I'd say it makes resigning process easier and does not require another volunteer to action it. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 15:31, 7 June 2026 (UTC) == Temporary protection reduction request of [[TestWiki]] (main page) == Can a consul temporarily reduce the protection of [[TestWiki]]? I am going to perform a dark mode change using TemplateStyles. Thank you. [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 15:22, 7 June 2026 (UTC) == Request for Bureaucrat == {{discussion top|Withdrawn. — Preceding [[Wikipedia:Project:Signatures|unsigned]] comment {{#if:|[[Special:Diff/|added]]|added}} by [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy#top|talk]] • [[Special:Contributions/Peterxy|contribs]]) 06:09, 9 July 2026 (UTC)}} Hi, I want to translate my gadget and handle permission requests for administrator permissions. Please graduate for me, thank you. [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy|talk]]) 04:27, 9 July 2026 (UTC) :Right now the backlog of admin requests is not serious and translating gadgets don’t need bureaucrat rights. Therefore I {{oppose}} this request. [[User:PB2008|PB2008]] ([[User talk:PB2008|talk]]) 05:34, 9 July 2026 (UTC) :Sorry, I'll {{withdrawn}} — Preceding [[Wikipedia:Project:Signatures|unsigned]] comment {{#if:|[[Special:Diff/|added]]|added}} by [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy#top|talk]] • [[Special:Contributions/Peterxy|contribs]]) 06:09, 9 July 2026 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == Bot vs. flooder == I notice that Consuls are responsible for appointing bot accounts, while Bureaucrats are able to appoint flooder. Is there any meaningful difference between the bot and flooder roles, in terms of what damage can be done? If not, wouldn't it make more sense to have the flooder role be appointed by Consuls? [[User:Harej|Harej]] ([[User talk:Harej|talk]]) 04:07, 9 August 2026 (UTC) : Looking at the permissions for Consul, they are already able to grant flooder. Re: [[Special:ManageWiki/permissions/consul#mw-section-group]] '''''[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] [[User Talk:PixDeVl|talk to me!]]''''' 21:07, 9 August 2026 (UTC)

body: {{/header}} [[Category:Non-test pages]] {{clear}} == Proposal to modify user rights for bureaucrats and consuls == Currently, bureaucrats can remove the bureaucrat right from their own account, and consuls have the ability, among the listed user groups to grant and remove, to remove the consul user group from their own account and add and remove interface administrator from their own account as well, even though they can grant and remove the latter user group. I would like to propose that bureaucrats may no longer remove the bureaucrat user group from their own account, and that consuls may no longer remove the consul user group from their own account, nor can they add and remove the interface administrator permission from their own account (as consuls can already grant and remove IA, doing that for one's own account is redundant). In addition to the above, because bureaucrat and consul permissions are non-testing permissions, perhaps we might consider adding most/all bureaucrat user rights to the consul user group? I would arguably consider consuls to be the non-testing bureaucrats of this wiki. Thoughts? [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 14:14, 7 June 2026 (UTC) : One more thing to note, consuls do not need to assign themselves the interface administrator user group as they can already edit all CSS/JS/JSON/interface pages. [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 14:39, 7 June 2026 (UTC) :I'm curious, what is the problem with crat and consul from removing the said groups from their own account? I'd say it makes resigning process easier and does not require another volunteer to action it. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 15:31, 7 June 2026 (UTC) == Temporary protection reduction request of [[TestWiki]] (main page) == Can a consul temporarily reduce the protection of [[TestWiki]]? I am going to perform a dark mode change using TemplateStyles. Thank you. [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 15:22, 7 June 2026 (UTC) == Request for Bureaucrat == {{discussion top|Withdrawn. — Preceding [[Wikipedia:Project:Signatures|unsigned]] comment {{#if:|[[Special:Diff/|added]]|added}} by [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy#top|talk]] • [[Special:Contributions/Peterxy|contribs]]) 06:09, 9 July 2026 (UTC)}} Hi, I want to translate my gadget and handle permission requests for administrator permissions. Please graduate for me, thank you. [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy|talk]]) 04:27, 9 July 2026 (UTC) :Right now the backlog of admin requests is not serious and translating gadgets don’t need bureaucrat rights. Therefore I {{oppose}} this request. [[User:PB2008|PB2008]] ([[User talk:PB2008|talk]]) 05:34, 9 July 2026 (UTC) :Sorry, I'll {{withdrawn}} — Preceding [[Wikipedia:Project:Signatures|unsigned]] comment {{#if:|[[Special:Diff/|added]]|added}} by [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy#top|talk]] • [[Special:Contributions/Peterxy|contribs]]) 06:09, 9 July 2026 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == Bot vs. flooder == I notice that Consuls are responsible for appointing bot accounts, while Bureaucrats are able to appoint flooder. Is there any meaningful difference between the bot and flooder roles, in terms of what damage can be done? If not, wouldn't it make more sense to have the flooder role be appointed by Consuls? [[User:Harej|Harej]] ([[User talk:Harej|talk]]) 04:07, 9 August 2026 (UTC) : Looking at the permissions for Consul, they are already able to grant flooder. Re: [[Special:ManageWiki/permissions/consul#mw-section-group]] '''''[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] [[User Talk:PixDeVl|talk to me!]]''''' 21:07, 9 August 2026 (UTC) ::I think my question more precisely would be, should Bureaucrats ''lose'' the ability to appoint flooder, to the extent they are not trusted with appointing bots? [[User:Harej|Harej]] ([[User talk:Harej|talk]]) 21:51, 9 August 2026 (UTC)

name: Template:Talk header/doc
body:
{{Documentation subpage}} {{notice|This template should be used only when needed. There is no need to add this template to every talk page. '''Do not create a talk page that contains only this template.'''}} This [[Help:Templates|template]] is a signpost. It may be used on [[Help:Talk page|talk page]]s to attract commentary from inexperienced editors, or where there are high levels of debate from everyone. It provides: * A short introduction and appropriate links for newcomers * A reminder of policy to experienced users * A list of links to the current talk page's archives * An optional archive search box == Usage == 
{{Talk header}}
To add this template to a talk page, just edit the talk page, and put {{tlc|Talk header}} at the top of the page. This template should only be placed where it's needed. Don't visit talk pages just to add this template, and don't place it on the talk pages of new articles. Talk pages that are frequently misused, that attract frequent or perpetual debate, articles often subject to controversy, and highly-visible or popular topics may be appropriate for this template. By convention, this template goes at the very top of the talk page. However, this is not an absolute rule, and editors should use common sense when deciding its placement. This template '''''should not be added to otherwise empty talk pages'''''. That changes the "discussion" tab at the top of the page from a "redlink" into a "bluelink", which may mislead people into thinking there is discussion. For more information on this topic, see the [[w:Template talk:Talk header|talk page for this template on the English Wikipedia:]], including the talk archives and the [[w:Wikipedia:Templates for discussion|TfD]] logs. == Parameters == ;Full syntax {{tlx|talk header|bottom{{=}}no|disclaimer{{=}}no|display_title{{=}}''custom page title''|noarchive{{=}}no|search{{=}}|shortcut1|shortcut2|shortcut3|shortcut4|shortcut5}} * Up to five shortcuts can be added to the template, as [[Help:Templates#Templates with unnamed parameters|unnamed parameters]], or as named ones (any of {{para|1}}, {{para|sc}}, {{para|sc1}}, {{para|shortcut}} or {{para|shortcut1}}, then {{para|2}}, {{para|sc2}} or {{para|shortcut2}}, etc., will work). For example, {{Talk header|WP:SHOR|WP:TCUT}}. They will display similar to the {{tlx|shortcut}} template, but within the Talk header message box. * When used on a talk page that has archives, links to those archives and a search box will be displayed automatically within this template. To switch the archive links off, use the parameter |noarchive=yes. For example: {{Talk header|noarchive=yes}}. ''For automatic archive links to be displayed, archives must be [[w:Help:Archiving a talk page#Subpage archive method|named in the standard way]]. A link to the archive index is also displayed, if it is named "/Archive index". If no archives exist for the current talk page, or if archives exist but possess non-standard names, no archive links will be displayed.'' * To override the default behaviour for the search box appearance, use |search=yes or |search=no. * On user talk pages, |disclaimer=yes adds an additional banner which identifies the page as being originally from Wikipedia (and modifies the width to suit), matching the style of {{tl|userpage}}. * To add an additional instructions to "please place new discussions at the bottom of the talk page", use |bottom=yes. * To display a custom page title, use |display_title=custom page title == Hiding the template == If you would prefer not to see this template on any talk page, you can hide it from your view. You'll need to have a [[Help:Logging in#Why log in?|named account]] to do this. # Edit your [[w:Help:User style|user style]] page. # Add a line: #talkheader {display:none;} # Save the change. # [[w:Wikipedia:Bypass your cache|Bypass your cache]]. == Appearance variations == Be aware that this template will appear differently in different [[Help:Namespace|namespaces]]. {{#ifeq:{{SUBPAGENAME}}|sandbox | | [[Category:Talk header templates]] [[Category:User talk header templates]] }}

Not all filters settings are available to administrators - only consuls have access to all settings (the restricted ones). However, if someone (non-consul) wants to create a serious filter that prevents, for example, vandalism, they should be able to fully configure it. That's why I'm proposing the AbuseFilter operator user group, which I described in my [[User:BZPN/AbuseFilter operators proposal|proposal]]. It's a similar situation to the interface administrators - these are users who need these permissions and can use them to perform important non-test actions. What do you think about this proposal? I also have a second question: after how many days does a Community portal request usually close? I think it's 7 or 5, but it's not mentioned anywhere in the rules. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 07:42, 11 September 2024 (UTC) == Discord server == Hello again!. Recently I came up with the idea of ​​creating a Discord server for TestWiki. I thought it would be a better and faster option for communicating with the community, because not everyone always visits, for example, the Community Portal here. It seems to me that community consensus is not needed to create a new communication channel. I've already created a server, and I'd like you to check it out and tell me what you think about it: https://discord.gg/7Yu4YYR2 I would like to notify users about this in several ways: * Send MassMessage to all (most) active users (admins and others with permissions) * Write a sitenotice on TestWiki * Report this on the Community portal here and on the Miraheze Meta (this is the appropriate place according to global policies). I look forward to hearing your opinion. Regards, [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 19:35, 10 September 2024 (UTC) :P.S. I also created a dedicated help page: [[User:BZPN/Help:Discord]]. body: {{/header}} [[Category:Non-test pages]] {{clear}} == Proposal to modify user rights for bureaucrats and consuls == Currently, bureaucrats can remove the bureaucrat right from their own account, and consuls have the ability, among the listed user groups to grant and remove, to remove the consul user group from their own account and add and remove interface administrator from their own account as well, even though they can grant and remove the latter user group. I would like to propose that bureaucrats may no longer remove the bureaucrat user group from their own account, and that consuls may no longer remove the consul user group from their own account, nor can they add and remove the interface administrator permission from their own account (as consuls can already grant and remove IA, doing that for one's own account is redundant). In addition to the above, because bureaucrat and consul permissions are non-testing permissions, perhaps we might consider adding most/all bureaucrat user rights to the consul user group? I would arguably consider consuls to be the non-testing bureaucrats of this wiki. Thoughts? [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 14:14, 7 June 2026 (UTC) : One more thing to note, consuls do not need to assign themselves the interface administrator user group as they can already edit all CSS/JS/JSON/interface pages. [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 14:39, 7 June 2026 (UTC) :I'm curious, what is the problem with crat and consul from removing the said groups from their own account? I'd say it makes resigning process easier and does not require another volunteer to action it. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 15:31, 7 June 2026 (UTC) == Temporary protection reduction request of [[TestWiki]] (main page) == Can a consul temporarily reduce the protection of [[TestWiki]]? I am going to perform a dark mode change using TemplateStyles. Thank you. [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 15:22, 7 June 2026 (UTC) == Request for Bureaucrat == {{discussion top|Withdrawn. — Preceding [[Wikipedia:Project:Signatures|unsigned]] comment {{#if:|[[Special:Diff/|added]]|added}} by [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy#top|talk]] • [[Special:Contributions/Peterxy|contribs]]) 06:09, 9 July 2026 (UTC)}} Hi, I want to translate my gadget and handle permission requests for administrator permissions. Please graduate for me, thank you. [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy|talk]]) 04:27, 9 July 2026 (UTC) :Right now the backlog of admin requests is not serious and translating gadgets don’t need bureaucrat rights. Therefore I {{oppose}} this request. [[User:PB2008|PB2008]] ([[User talk:PB2008|talk]]) 05:34, 9 July 2026 (UTC) :Sorry, I'll {{withdrawn}} — Preceding [[Wikipedia:Project:Signatures|unsigned]] comment {{#if:|[[Special:Diff/|added]]|added}} by [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy#top|talk]] • [[Special:Contributions/Peterxy|contribs]]) 06:09, 9 July 2026 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == Bot vs. flooder == I notice that Consuls are responsible for appointing bot accounts, while Bureaucrats are able to appoint flooder. Is there any meaningful difference between the bot and flooder roles, in terms of what damage can be done? If not, wouldn't it make more sense to have the flooder role be appointed by Consuls? [[User:Harej|Harej]] ([[User talk:Harej|talk]]) 04:07, 9 August 2026 (UTC) : Looking at the permissions for Consul, they are already able to grant flooder. Re: [[Special:ManageWiki/permissions/consul#mw-section-group]] '''''[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] [[User Talk:PixDeVl|talk to me!]]''''' 21:07, 9 August 2026 (UTC) ::I think my question more precisely would be, should Bureaucrats ''lose'' the ability to appoint flooder, to the extent they are not trusted with appointing bots? [[User:Harej|Harej]] ([[User talk:Harej|talk]]) 21:51, 9 August 2026 (UTC) :::I believe the historical context was that Consuls, as the ''de facto'' non-testing "bureaucrats" on Public Test Wiki would be the only ones to grant the bot group, as typically, users would have to outline the technical details of their bot, what task(s) it would perform, how frequently, and with what end date (if any). "Flooder" was meant for temporary periods, like mass deleting. I'm okay with Bureaucrats being able to grant the "flooder" flag, but if it's being misused, ''that'' should be addressed with the particular bureaucrat(s) at that time. It may well be if it's repeatedly misused, they lose their "bureaucrat" flag. That's my "hot take" anyway. [[mh:meta:User:Doug|Doug]] ([[User talk:Doug|talk]]) 23:18, 9 August 2026 (UTC) == Simplifying Common.css == Most of its content came from 9 years ago or longer, back when TemplateStyles was not commonly used. [[User:Codename Noreste]] cleaned up a lot of its content, but there is still some substantial CSS remaining that could've gone into personal CSS or templatestyles. In fact, I doubt whether any of the CSS is worth keeping at all since the templates it is supposed to support, such as [[Template:Navbox]], is broken due to missing a dependency [[Module:Navbox/configuration]]. All of its usages give the error message Lua error in package.lua at line 80: module 'Module:Navbox/configuration' not found.". [[User:PetraMagna|PetraMagna]] ([[User talk:PetraMagna|talk]]) 07:56, 17 August 2026 (UTC)

name: TestWiki:Assume good faith/zh
body:
{{TNT|essay}}
All editors on Test Wiki should try to '''assume good faith''', that is to say that unless there is reason to believe otherwise that any given editor is here to be constructive and improve the wiki. Assuming good faith is an important goal on all projects, but is especially important on Test Wiki, where administrator flag is nearly always granted upon request and only removed in the case of misuse. This does not mean that all actions must be accepted or cannot be reverted, it simply means that one should try to assume that others are trying to help.
This guideline does not require that editors continue to assume good faith in the presence of obvious evidence to the contrary. Obvious vandalism, personal attacks and harassment of others should never be considered to have been done in good faith. Instead, these type of edits should be reverted and, ''if applicable'', Revision Deletion should be done on it.
[[Category:Non-test pages]]
label: Peterxy

Test Wiki上的所有编辑都应该尝试'''假设善意'''，也就是说，除非有理由相信任何给定的编辑都是为了建设性和改进wiki。假设诚信是所有项目的重要目标，但在Test Wiki上尤其重要，管理员标志几乎总是应请求授予，仅在滥用情况下才被删除。这并不意味着所有的行动都必须被接受或不能被逆转，它只是意味着一个人应该试图假设其他人正在试图帮助。

本准则并不要求编辑在有明显的相反证据的情况下继续保持善意。明显的故意破坏、人身攻击和骚扰他人绝不应被视为出于善意。相反，应恢复这些类型的编辑，并且''如果适用''，应对其执行修订删除。

name: Askeladd's band
body:
'''Askeladd’s band''' is a group of Viking mercenaries led by '''Askeladd''' in the manga and anime series ''Vinland Saga''. The group plays an important role during the early part of the story and participates in raids, battles, and military campaigns across England.

'''Overview'''

Askeladd leads a band of roughly 100 Viking warriors. The group follows him because of his intelligence, leadership, and ability to successfully lead them through dangerous battles and raids. Although the members fight together, the band is primarily motivated by survival, money, and the rewards of warfare.

'''Leadership'''

'''Askeladd''' is the leader of the group. He is known for being an intelligent strategist who frequently uses deception and careful planning instead of relying only on physical strength.

'''Bjorn''' is one of Askeladd’s closest and most trusted warriors and acts as an important figure within the band.

'''Thorfinn'''

'''Thorfinn''' travels with Askeladd’s band for much of his childhood and teenage years. However, his relationship with the group is different from that of the other warriors. Thorfinn remains with Askeladd because he wants opportunities to challenge him to a duel.

Despite his young age, Thorfinn becomes a skilled fighter and completes dangerous missions for Askeladd in exchange for opportunities to duel him.

'''Known Members'''

Notable people associated with Askeladd’s band include:

* Askeladd
* Bjorn
* Thorfinn
* Atli
* Torgrim
* Ear
* Ake
* Olov
* Tore

'''Role in the Story'''

Askeladd’s band is particularly important during the '''War Arc''' of ''Vinland Saga''. The group becomes involved in the conflict surrounding the Danish invasion of England and eventually becomes connected to Prince Canute.

The experiences Thorfinn has while traveling with the band have a major influence on his early life and development as a character.

'''References'''

* ''Vinland Saga'' manga by Makoto Yukimura
* ''Vinland Saga'' anime series
* Official ''Vinland Saga'' anime character information

body:
local p = {}

function p.countVisibleText(frame)
    -- Получаем аргументы
    local args = frame.args
    if args == nil and frame:getParent() then
        args = frame:getParent().args
    end
    
    local text = ""
    local pageName = args.page or args['страница']
    
    -- 1. Получаем исходный текст статьи
    if pageName and pageName ~= "" then
        local title = mw.title.new(pageName)
        if title and title.exists then
            text = title:getContent() or ""
        else
            return "Страница не найдена"
        end
    else
        text = args[1] or args or ""
    end
    
    if text == "" then
        return "0"
    end
    
    -- 2. УДАЛЯЕМ СНОСКИ (<ref>...</ref>)
    text = string.gsub(text, "<ref[^>]*>.-</ref>", "")
    text = string.gsub(text, "<ref[^>]*/>", "")
    
    -- 3. УДАЛЯЕМ ВСЕ ВИКИ-ТАБЛИЦЫ, КАРТОЧКИ И НАВБОКСЫ ({| ... |})
    -- Заменяем переносы на пробелы внутри этого шага, чтобы Lua не спотыкался на многострочности
    text = string.gsub(text, "[\n\r]", " ")
    text = string.gsub(text, "{|.-|}", "")
    
    -- 4. УДАЛЯЕМ ШАБЛОНЫ, КОТОРЫЕ НЕ ЯВЛЯЮТСЯ СПОЙЛЕРАМИ
    -- Сначала «спасаем» контент из {{Spoiler|текст}}
    text = string.gsub(text, "{{[Ss]poiler%s*|%s*([^{}]+)}}", "%1")
    
    -- Теперь удаляем абсолютно все остальные конструкции {{...}}
    local oldText
    repeat
        oldText = text
        text = string.gsub(text, "{{[^{}]+}}", "")
    until text == oldText
    
    -- 5. УДАЛЯЕМ ЗАГОЛОВКИ (== Заголовок ==)
    text = string.gsub(text, "==+.-==+", "")
    
    -- 6. ОЧИЩАЕМ ССЫЛКИ
    -- [[Ссылка|Отображаемый Текст]] -> Отображаемый Текст
    text = string.gsub(text, "%[%[[^%]]-|([^%]]+)%]%]", "%1")
    -- [[Простая Ссылка]] -> Простая Ссылка
    text = string.gsub(text, "%[%[([^%]]+)%]%]", "%1")
    -- [http://site.com Внешняя ссылка] -> Внешняя ссылка
    text = string.gsub(text, "%[[^%s%]]+%s+([^%]]+)%]", "%1")
    -- [http://site.com] -> удаляем
    text = string.gsub(text, "%[[^%]]+]", "")
    
    -- 7. УДАЛЯЕМ ОСТАТОЧНЫЕ HTML-ТЕГИ И КОММЕНТАРИИ
    text = string.gsub(text, "<!--.--->", "")
    text = string.gsub(text, "<[^>]+>", "")
    
    -- 8. ОЧИЩАЕМ РАЗМЕТКУ СТИЛЕЙ (жирный, курсив ''')
    text = string.gsub(text, "''+", "")
    
    -- ИГНОРИРОВАНИЕ НЕВИДИМЫХ СПЕЦСИМВОЛОВ И ЛИШНИХ ПРОБЕЛОВ
    text = mw.ustring.gsub(text, "[\t]", "")
    text = mw.ustring.gsub(text, "%c", "") -- Управляющие символы
    text = mw.ustring.gsub(text, "%s+", " ") -- Схлопываем множественные пробелы
    text = mw.ustring.gsub(text, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1") -- Тримминг краев
    
    -- ПОДСЧЕТ И ОКРУГЛЕНИЕ
    local count = mw.ustring.len(text)
    local roundedCount = math.floor(count / 100 + 0.5) * 100
    
    return tostring(roundedCount)
end

return p

local p = {}

-- =========================================================================
-- НАСТРОЙКА: Добавляйте сюда шаблоны, текст внутри которых НАДО считать.
-- Регистр не важен (скрипт сам проверит и с большой, и с маленькой буквы).
-- =========================================================================
local ALLOWED_TEMPLATES = { "spoiler", "цитата", "скрыть" }

function p.countVisibleText(frame)
    -- Получаем аргументы
    local args = frame.args
    if args == nil and frame:getParent() then
        args = frame:getParent().args
    end
    
    local text = ""
    local pageName = args.page or args['страница']
    
    -- Определение шага округления (по умолчанию 100)
    local roundStep = tonumber(args.round or args['округление']) or 100
    if roundStep < 1 then roundStep = 1 end -- Защита от отрицательных чисел и нуля
    
    -- 1. Получаем исходный текст статьи
    if pageName and pageName ~= "" then
        local title = mw.title.new(pageName)
        if title and title.exists then
            text = title:getContent() or ""
        else
            return "Страница не найдена"
        end
    else
        text = args or args or ""
    end
    
    if text == "" then
        return "0"
    end
    
    -- 2. УДАЛЯЕМ СНОСКИ (<ref>...</ref>)
    text = string.gsub(text, "<ref[^>]*>.-</ref>", "")
    text = string.gsub(text, "<ref[^>]*/>", "")
    
    -- 3. УДАЛЯЕМ ВСЕ ВИКИ-ТАБЛИЦЫ, КАРТОЧКИ И НАВБОКСЫ ({| ... |})
    text = string.gsub(text, "[\n\r]", " ")
    text = string.gsub(text, "{|.-|}", "")
    
    -- 4. СПАСАЕМ КОНТЕНТ ИЗ РАЗРЕШЕННЫХ ТЕКСТОВЫХ ШАБЛОНОВ
    for _, templateName in ipairs(ALLOWED_TEMPLATES) do
        -- Формируем паттерн для поддержки первой буквы в любом регистре
        local firstLetter = mw.ustring.sub(templateName, 1, 1)
        local remainingLetters = mw.ustring.sub(templateName, 2)
        local pattern = "[" .. mw.ustring.upper(firstLetter) .. mw.ustring.lower(firstLetter) .. "]" .. remainingLetters
        
        -- Выковыриваем текст из шаблона
        text = string.gsub(text, "{{%s*" .. pattern .. "%s*|%s*([^{}]+)}}", "%1")
    end
    
    -- 5. УДАЛЯЕМ ВСЕ ОСТАЛЬНЫЕ ШАБЛОНЫ
    local oldText
    repeat
        oldText = text
        text = string.gsub(text, "{{[^{}]+}}", "")
    until text == oldText
    
    -- 6. УДАЛЯЕМ ЗАГОЛОВКИ (== Заголовок ==)
    text = string.gsub(text, "==+.-==+", "")
    
    -- 7. ОЧИСТКА ССЫЛОК
    text = string.gsub(text, "%[%[[^%]]-|([^%]]+)%]%]", "%1")
    text = string.gsub(text, "%[%[([^%]]+)%]%]", "%1")
    text = string.gsub(text, "%[[^%s%]]+%s+([^%]]+)%]", "%1")
    text = string.gsub(text, "%[[^%]]+]", "")
    
    -- 8. УДАЛЯЕМ HTML-ТЕГИ И КОММЕНТАРИИ
    text = string.gsub(text, "<!--.--->", "")
    text = string.gsub(text, "<[^>]+>", "")
    text = string.gsub(text, "''+", "")
    
    -- ИГНОРИРОВАНИЕ НЕВИДИМЫХ СПЕЦСИМВОЛОВ И ЛИШНИХ ПРОБЕЛОВ
    text = mw.ustring.gsub(text, "[\t]", "")
    text = mw.ustring.gsub(text, "%c", "")
    text = mw.ustring.gsub(text, "%s+", " ")
    text = mw.ustring.gsub(text, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
    
    -- ПОДСЧЕТ И ДИНАМИЧЕСКОЕ ОКРУГЛЕНИЕ
    local count = mw.ustring.len(text)
    local roundedCount = math.floor(count / roundStep + 0.5) * roundStep
    
    return tostring(roundedCount)
end

return p

    -- Получаем аргументы

    if args == nil and frame:getParent() then
        args = frame:getParent().args
    end
    
    local text = ""

    -- 1. Получаем исходный текст статьи
    if pageName and pageName ~= "" then
        local title = mw.title.new(pageName)
        if title and title.exists then

        else

        end
    else
        text = args[1] or args or ""
    end
    
    if text == "" then
        return "0"
    end
    
    -- 2. УДАЛЯЕМ СНОСКИ (<ref>...</ref>)
    text = string.gsub(text, "<ref[^>]*>.-</ref>", "")
    text = string.gsub(text, "<ref[^>]*/>", "")
    
    -- 3. УДАЛЯЕМ ВСЕ ВИКИ-ТАБЛИЦЫ, КАРТОЧКИ И НАВБОКСЫ ({| ... |})
    -- Заменяем переносы на пробелы внутри этого шага, чтобы Lua не спотыкался на многострочности
    text = string.gsub(text, "[\n\r]", " ")
    text = string.gsub(text, "{|.-|}", "")
    
    -- 4. УДАЛЯЕМ ШАБЛОНЫ, КОТОРЫЕ НЕ ЯВЛЯЮТСЯ СПОЙЛЕРАМИ
    -- Сначала «спасаем» контент из {{Spoiler|текст}}
    text = string.gsub(text, "{{[Ss]poiler%s*|%s*([^{}]+)}}", "%1")
    
    -- Теперь удаляем абсолютно все остальные конструкции {{...}}
    local oldText
    repeat
        oldText = text
        text = string.gsub(text, "{{[^{}]+}}", "")
    until text == oldText
    
    -- 5. УДАЛЯЕМ ЗАГОЛОВКИ (== Заголовок ==)
    text = string.gsub(text, "==+.-==+", "")
    
    -- 6. ОЧИЩАЕМ ССЫЛКИ
    -- [[Ссылка|Отображаемый Текст]] -> Отображаемый Текст
    text = string.gsub(text, "%[%[[^%]]-|([^%]]+)%]%]", "%1")
    -- [[Простая Ссылка]] -> Простая Ссылка
    text = string.gsub(text, "%[%[([^%]]+)%]%]", "%1")
    -- [http://site.com Внешняя ссылка] -> Внешняя ссылка
    text = string.gsub(text, "%[[^%s%]]+%s+([^%]]+)%]", "%1")
    -- [http://site.com] -> удаляем
    text = string.gsub(text, "%[[^%]]+]", "")
    
    -- 7. УДАЛЯЕМ ОСТАТОЧНЫЕ HTML-ТЕГИ И КОММЕНТАРИИ
    text = string.gsub(text, "<!--.--->", "")
    text = string.gsub(text, "<[^>]+>", "")
    
    -- 8. ОЧИЩАЕМ РАЗМЕТКУ СТИЛЕЙ (жирный, курсив ''')
    text = string.gsub(text, "''+", "")
    
    -- ИГНОРИРОВАНИЕ НЕВИДИМЫХ СПЕЦСИМВОЛОВ И ЛИШНИХ ПРОБЕЛОВ
    text = mw.ustring.gsub(text, "[\t]", "")
    text = mw.ustring.gsub(text, "%c", "") -- Управляющие символы
    text = mw.ustring.gsub(text, "%s+", " ") -- Схлопываем множественные пробелы
    text = mw.ustring.gsub(text, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1") -- Тримминг краев
    
    -- ПОДСЧЕТ И ОКРУГЛЕНИЕ
    local count = mw.ustring.len(text)
    local roundedCount = math.floor(count / 100 + 0.5) * 100
    
    return tostring(roundedCount)
end

Not all filters settings are available to administrators - only consuls have access to all settings (the restricted ones). However, if someone (non-consul) wants to create a serious filter that prevents, for example, vandalism, they should be able to fully configure it. That's why I'm proposing the AbuseFilter operator user group, which I described in my [[User:BZPN/AbuseFilter operators proposal|proposal]]. It's a similar situation to the interface administrators - these are users who need these permissions and can use them to perform important non-test actions. What do you think about this proposal? I also have a second question: after how many days does a Community portal request usually close? I think it's 7 or 5, but it's not mentioned anywhere in the rules. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 07:42, 11 September 2024 (UTC) == Discord server == Hello again!. Recently I came up with the idea of ​​creating a Discord server for TestWiki. I thought it would be a better and faster option for communicating with the community, because not everyone always visits, for example, the Community Portal here. It seems to me that community consensus is not needed to create a new communication channel. I've already created a server, and I'd like you to check it out and tell me what you think about it: https://discord.gg/7Yu4YYR2 I would like to notify users about this in several ways: * Send MassMessage to all (most) active users (admins and others with permissions) * Write a sitenotice on TestWiki * Report this on the Community portal here and on the Miraheze Meta (this is the appropriate place according to global policies). I look forward to hearing your opinion. Regards, [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 19:35, 10 September 2024 (UTC) :P.S. I also created a dedicated help page: [[User:BZPN/Help:Discord]]. Best regards. [[User:Chirocca77|Chirocca77]] ([[User talk:Chirocca77|talk]]) 10:17, 18 July 2024 (UTC) :Now you are active, because your message is edit on wiki. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 10:23, 18 July 2024 (UTC) ::Thank you so much. [[User:Chirocca77|Chirocca77]] ([[User talk:Chirocca77|talk]]) 16:09, 18 July 2024 (UTC) :::No problem :) [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 17:45, 18 July 2024 (UTC) ==Requesting bureaucrat right== Hi AlPad, I would like to test bureaucrat right. I have requested in Request permissions and would like you to look into it. Thanks for your time [[User:Cactusisme|Cactusisme]] ([[User talk:Cactusisme|talk]]) 02:41, 24 July 2024 (UTC) :{{Done}} by {{user|PB2008}} [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 20:26, 24 July 2024 (UTC) == Request == Please remove my admin and bureaucrat rights, as I've finished testing with them. All the test pages I made here may also be removed, except my [[User:Spacing_form/sandbox|sandbox]] which I would like to keep. Thank you [[User:Spacing form|Spacing form]] ([[User talk:Spacing form|talk]]) 18:56, 2 August 2024 (UTC) :{{done}} thank you for volunteering! [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 22:04, 2 August 2024 (UTC) == Questions == Hello! I've been working on AbuseFilter recently, and I came up with an interesting idea. Not all filters settings are available to administrators - only consuls have access to all settings (the restricted ones). However, if someone (non-consul) wants to create a serious filter that prevents, for example, vandalism, they should be able to fully configure it. That's why I'm proposing the AbuseFilter operator user group, which I described in my [[User:BZPN/AbuseFilter operators proposal|proposal]]. It's a similar situation to the interface administrators - these are users who need these permissions and can use them to perform important non-test actions. What do you think about this proposal? I also have a second question: after how many days does a Community portal request usually close? I think it's 7 or 5, but it's not mentioned anywhere in the rules. Kind regards, [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 20:09, 8 September 2024 (UTC) :Hello! I agree with proposal, but a discussion should be opened on the [[TestWiki:Community portal]]. There isn't a set amount of time to keep a vote for consul rights open, but I think it should stay open for a few more days so that as many users as possible can participate. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 21:42, 8 September 2024 (UTC) == Request == Hello. I think my consul request may now be closed. It's been 6 7 days and the support is clear. Could you please close it? Regards, [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 05:30, 10 September 2024 (UTC) :Your request is successful. Congratulations and welcome to consul team! [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 06:49, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :Congratulations! [[User:Justarandomamerican|Justarandomamerican]] ([[User talk:Justarandomamerican|talk]]) 07:32, 11 September 2024 (UTC) :Thank you for your support! Have a nice day! [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 07:42, 11 September 2024 (UTC) == Discord server == Hello again!. Recently I came up with the idea of ​​creating a Discord server for TestWiki. I thought it would be a better and faster option for communicating with the community, because not everyone always visits, for example, the Community Portal here. It seems to me that community consensus is not needed to create a new communication channel. I've already created a server, and I'd like you to check it out and tell me what you think about it: https://discord.gg/7Yu4YYR2 I would like to notify users about this in several ways: * Send MassMessage to all (most) active users (admins and others with permissions) * Write a sitenotice on TestWiki * Report this on the Community portal here and on the Miraheze Meta (this is the appropriate place according to global policies). I look forward to hearing your opinion. Regards, [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 19:35, 10 September 2024 (UTC) :P.S. I also created a dedicated help page: [[User:BZPN/Help:Discord]]. [[User:BZPN| BZPN ]] 20:56, 10 September 2024 (UTC) ::Hello! This is a good idea but I'll see it again tomorrow. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 23:59, 10 September 2024 (UTC) == socks == [[User:Ivlkar]], [[User:Ally-al]] and [[User:Akrz]] are like sockpuppets. They were created on the same day and edited the same page, [[Talk:SandboxAAK]]. I have block them as ''sockpuppets'' for now. Please unblock if I am wrong. [[User:Cactusisme|'''Cactus🌵''']] [[User talk:Cactusisme|spiky]] [[Special:Contributions/Cactusisme|ouch]] 07:51, 25 September 2024 (UTC) :I have deleted the page, [[SandboxAAK]] as it was a page out of scope, and vadalism. [[User:Cactusisme|'''Cactus🌵''']] [[User talk:Cactusisme|spiky]] [[Special:Contributions/Cactusisme|ouch]] 07:56, 25 September 2024 (UTC) ::::{{ping|Cactusisme}} Thank you for your action, but Reception123 is right, Ivlkar hasn't abused on this wiki. ::[[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 15:18, 26 September 2024 (UTC) == Interface Admin == Hello @[[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]], I request that you grant me Interface admin right for testing out the stuff that they can do. I believe I have a good track record, being a current Bureaucrat. If needed, I am also OK with a temporary Interface Admin right, 7 days would be enough. Thanks for your time! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 15:17, 25 October 2024 (UTC) :Hello! Please request interface admin rights on [[TestWiki:Request permissions]] and I'll see your request. Thanks! [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 08:00, 26 October 2024 (UTC) ::Done! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 05:59, 29 December 2024 (UTC) :::Hello and sorry for the late reply! Your request has {{done}}. [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 09:52, 1 January 2025 (UTC) ::::No worries, thanks again! [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 10:22, 1 January 2025 (UTC) == Request == Please remove bureaucrat flag from LocalSettings.php using [[Special:ApiSandbox]], thanks. It seems very unfair to stop account creation and email and talk page access for a username. I have been inactive for a long time and now I'm back, I need it to be able to do testing tasks and also assist in processing authorization requests here. Thanks! [[User:Như Gây Mê|Halley]] [[Philippines|luv Filipino ❤]] 01:58, 17 May 2025 (UTC) :Hi, you can request admin rights at [[TW:RfP]], for bureaucrat right you need to start a discussion at [[TestWiki:Community portal]] per new policy [[User:AlPaD|AlPaD]] ([[User talk:AlPaD|talk]]) 18:16, 19 May 2025 (UTC) == VisualEditor settings tweak == Hi AlPaD, Hope you're doing well. Would you be able to enable $wgVisualEditorEnableWikitext and $wgVisualEditorUseSingleEditTab in [[Special:ManageWiki/extensions]] "editors" tab, please? When users have the source editor as their primary editor ''and'' they use VisualEditor, it causes problems. As a result, Clicking on "Request permissions" redirects me to the TestWiki Main Page, unfortunately. Thanks,
[[mh:meta:User:Doug|Doug]] ([[User talk:Doug|talk]]) 01:39, 14 August 2026 (UTC) :{{done}} and sorry for the late response. name: TestWiki:Community portal
body: {{/header}} [[Category:Non-test pages]] {{clear}} == Proposal to modify user rights for bureaucrats and consuls == Currently, bureaucrats can remove the bureaucrat right from their own account, and consuls have the ability, among the listed user groups to grant and remove, to remove the consul user group from their own account and add and remove interface administrator from their own account as well, even though they can grant and remove the latter user group. I would like to propose that bureaucrats may no longer remove the bureaucrat user group from their own account, and that consuls may no longer remove the consul user group from their own account, nor can they add and remove the interface administrator permission from their own account (as consuls can already grant and remove IA, doing that for one's own account is redundant). In addition to the above, because bureaucrat and consul permissions are non-testing permissions, perhaps we might consider adding most/all bureaucrat user rights to the consul user group? I would arguably consider consuls to be the non-testing bureaucrats of this wiki. Thoughts? [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 14:14, 7 June 2026 (UTC) : One more thing to note, consuls do not need to assign themselves the interface administrator user group as they can already edit all CSS/JS/JSON/interface pages. [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 14:39, 7 June 2026 (UTC) :I'm curious, what is the problem with crat and consul from removing the said groups from their own account? I'd say it makes resigning process easier and does not require another volunteer to action it. [[User:Bunnypranav|Bunnypranav]] ([[User talk:Bunnypranav|talk]]) 15:31, 7 June 2026 (UTC) == Temporary protection reduction request of [[TestWiki]] (main page) == Can a consul temporarily reduce the protection of [[TestWiki]]? I am going to perform a dark mode change using TemplateStyles. Thank you. [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 15:22, 7 June 2026 (UTC) == Request for Bureaucrat == {{discussion top|Withdrawn. — Preceding [[Wikipedia:Project:Signatures|unsigned]] comment {{#if:|[[Special:Diff/|added]]|added}} by [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy#top|talk]] • [[Special:Contributions/Peterxy|contribs]]) 06:09, 9 July 2026 (UTC)}} Hi, I want to translate my gadget and handle permission requests for administrator permissions. Please graduate for me, thank you. [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy|talk]]) 04:27, 9 July 2026 (UTC) :Right now the backlog of admin requests is not serious and translating gadgets don’t need bureaucrat rights. Therefore I {{oppose}} this request. [[User:PB2008|PB2008]] ([[User talk:PB2008|talk]]) 05:34, 9 July 2026 (UTC) :Sorry, I'll {{withdrawn}} — Preceding [[Wikipedia:Project:Signatures|unsigned]] comment {{#if:|[[Special:Diff/|added]]|added}} by [[User:Peterxy|Peterxy]] ([[User talk:Peterxy#top|talk]] • [[Special:Contributions/Peterxy|contribs]]) 06:09, 9 July 2026 (UTC) {{Discussion bottom}} == Bot vs. flooder == I notice that Consuls are responsible for appointing bot accounts, while Bureaucrats are able to appoint flooder. Is there any meaningful difference between the bot and flooder roles, in terms of what damage can be done? If not, wouldn't it make more sense to have the flooder role be appointed by Consuls? [[User:Harej|Harej]] ([[User talk:Harej|talk]]) 04:07, 9 August 2026 (UTC) : Looking at the permissions for Consul, they are already able to grant flooder. Re: [[Special:ManageWiki/permissions/consul#mw-section-group]] '''''[[User:PixDeVl|PixDeVl]] [[User Talk:PixDeVl|talk to me!]]''''' 21:07, 9 August 2026 (UTC) ::I think my question more precisely would be, should Bureaucrats ''lose'' the ability to appoint flooder, to the extent they are not trusted with appointing bots? [[User:Harej|Harej]] ([[User talk:Harej|talk]]) 21:51, 9 August 2026 (UTC) :::I believe the historical context was that Consuls, as the ''de facto'' non-testing "bureaucrats" on Public Test Wiki would be the only ones to grant the bot group, as typically, users would have to outline the technical details of their bot, what task(s) it would perform, how frequently, and with what end date (if any). "Flooder" was meant for temporary periods, like mass deleting. I'm okay with Bureaucrats being able to grant the "flooder" flag, but if it's being misused, ''that'' should be addressed with the particular bureaucrat(s) at that time. It may well be if it's repeatedly misused, they lose their "bureaucrat" flag. That's my "hot take" anyway. [[mh:meta:User:Doug|Doug]] ([[User talk:Doug|talk]]) 23:18, 9 August 2026 (UTC) == Simplifying Common.css == Most of its content came from 9 years ago or longer, back when TemplateStyles was not commonly used. [[User:Codename Noreste]] cleaned up a lot of its content, but there is still some substantial CSS remaining that could've gone into personal CSS or templatestyles. In fact, I doubt whether any of the CSS is worth keeping at all since the templates it is supposed to support, such as [[Template:Navbox]], is broken due to missing a dependency [[Module:Navbox/configuration]]. All of its usages give the error message Lua error in package.lua at line 80: module 'Module:Navbox/configuration' not found.". [[User:PetraMagna|PetraMagna]] ([[User talk:PetraMagna|talk]]) 07:56, 17 August 2026 (UTC) : I removed a ton of outdated CSS code from that page, keeping only what's necessary. [[User:Codename Noreste|Codename Noreste]] ([[User talk:Codename Noreste|talk]]) 19:33, 3 September 2026 (UTC)
